On the in-domain ISIC 2017 benchmark, the ensemble attains a mean Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 91.60% across the two classification tasks (melanoma and seborrheic keratosis vs. rest), and a DSC of 84.72% for segmentation. Classification remains competitive with baselines; in-domain segmentation trails single-task specialists, yet the proposed priors and alignment regularization yield representations that generalize consistently across cohorts of different scales.

AI.tldr: MDSkin-Net将皮肤镜Pattern Analysis先验注入混合CNN-Transformer架构，通过PAGAM三种注意力先验与MSAR多尺度空间对齐正则耦合分割与分类任务，在ISIC 2017训练下实现强零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有皮肤镜分割与分类多任务框架仅在架构上耦合两任务而缺乏临床知识；注入知识的方案多依赖宏观ABCD规则，该规则并非为皮肤镜设计，与皮肤镜诊断实际依据的微观Pattern Analysis框架不匹配。
AI.method: 提出MDSkin-Net，将线索级Pattern Analysis先验融入混合CNN-Transformer架构。核心为Pattern Analysis-Guided Attention Module (PAGAM)，包含三种先验：改进的高效通道注意力iECA、多尺度空间注意力MSSA、带偏置的非对称注意力BAA。另引入多尺度空间对齐正则MSAR，以分割真值掩码作为分层软监督，将分类头限定于病灶定位证据，并通过共享空间先验耦合两条任务路径。仅使用ISIC 2017训练集，无外部皮肤镜数据。
AI.result: 零样本评估下，模型集成在PH2上达到DSC 92.38%、黑色素瘤AUC 97.84%，在ISIC 2018 Task 1测试集上DSC 88.92%。域内ISIC 2017基准上，两分类任务（黑色素瘤、脂溢性角化病vs其余）平均AUC为91.60%，分割DSC为84.72%。分类性能与基线相当；域内分割略逊于单任务专用模型，但所提先验与对齐正则产生跨队列一致泛化的表示。
AI.conclusion: 将皮肤镜Pattern Analysis线索级先验与空间对齐正则嵌入多任务网络，可有效耦合分割与分类路径，在无外部数据条件下获得稳健的跨数据集泛化能力；分类具竞争力，分割虽不及专用模型但表示泛化性更强。

title: Persistent Negatives for Adversarial Black-Box On-Policy Distillation
summary: Black-box On-Policy Distillation (OPD) seeks to improve a student from its own generations when the teacher provides sampled responses but not token probabilities. Adversarial distillation offers one route: it learns a discriminator over prompt-matched teacher and student responses and uses its score as the policy reward. However, sampling discriminator negatives from the latest student at each step couples the learned reward to a negative distribution that changes after every policy update. We address this moving-target problem with persistent-negative adversarial distillation, a live-pool method that replaces a fraction of each discriminator batch with historical, prompt-matched teacher--student comparisons. Under matched discriminator compute, historical comparisons train the discriminator, while GRPO remains on-policy with fresh student responses. Our analysis identifies the Bayes-optimal reward as a teacher-to-negative log-density ratio and, under explicit assumptions, shows how persistent negatives anchor the discriminator and reduce reward-estimation MSE relative to fresh-negative training. Across two student families, three judges, and four judged-chat benchmarks, persistent-negative adversarial distillation consistently improves performance over current methods at matched discriminator compute. It also yields smoother fresh-policy discriminator trajectories, with fewer below-chance dips. These findings identify the discriminator's negative distribution as an important design axis in black-box on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出persistent-negative adversarial distillation，通过引入历史（持久）负样本来缓解黑箱on-policy蒸馏中负样本分布随策略更新而漂移的"移动靶"问题，实验证明其性能与稳定性均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 黑箱On-Policy Distillation（OPD）中，教师只提供采样响应而不提供token概率，因此采用对抗蒸馏：训练判别器区分匹配提示下的教师与学生响应，并以判别器分数作为策略奖励。但若每步都从最新学生策略采样负样本，奖励所依赖的负样本分布会随策略更新不断变化，形成"移动靶"问题，导致奖励估计不稳定。
AI.method: 提出persistent-negative adversarial distillation（持久负样本对抗蒸馏），一种"实时池"方法：在每个判别器batch中用一个历史、提示匹配的教师—学生对比样本替换一部分新样本。在判别器计算量匹配的条件下，历史对比用于训练判别器，而GRPO仍保持on-policy、使用新鲜学生响应。
AI.result: 理论分析表明贝叶斯最优奖励是教师对负样本的对数密度比，并在显式假设下证明持久负样本能锚定判别器、相对新鲜负样本训练降低奖励估计的MSE。在两类学生模型族、三种judge、四个judged-chat基准上，持久负样本对抗蒸馏在判别器计算量匹配时一致优于现有方法，且新鲜策略判别器轨迹更平滑、低于随机水平的下降更少。
AI.conclusion: 判别器的负样本分布是黑箱on-policy蒸馏中的一个重要设计维度；持久负样本方法在性能与训练稳定性上均具优势。该内容未通过合规检测，已隐藏。

title: Reliability-Regulated Trajectory Optimization for Progressive COLMAP-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: COLMAP-free 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) bypasses computationally expensive structure-from-motion (SfM) pipelines, yet progressive camera pose tracking remains fundamentally vulnerable to error compounding---early pairwise tracking inaccuracies both corrupt subsequent frame initializations and remain permanently frozen in the scene representation. Rather than relying on heavyweight external neural priors or treating progressive tracking through isolated heuristic fixes, we propose a unified reliability-regulated trajectory optimization framework for progressive COLMAP-free 3DGS. At its core, our framework establishes an intrinsic, self-supervised bidirectional cycle-consistency mechanism that systematically regulates progressive camera trajectory estimation across two complementary temporal horizons: (1) Forward Motion Propagation, where the online reliability signal adaptively gates first-order kinematic warm-starts of rigid motion into upcoming pairwise registrations, supplying informed directional search priors while safely intercepting untrusted transitions; and (2) Retrospective Trajectory Correction, where the same reliability signal dynamically weights relative-pose consistency constraints within a sliding window of neighboring camera poses. By governing both prospective state initialization and retrospective trajectory consolidation through a unified reliability regulator, our self-contained framework resolves progressive drift without external priors or offline preprocessing. Extensive evaluations on Tanks and Temples and CO3D-V2 benchmarks show that our method substantially improves camera trajectory accuracy and novel-view rendering quality, outperforming existing unposed baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/Zijian1026/RRTO-CF3DGS.

AI.tldr: 提出可靠性调节的轨迹优化框架（RRTO-CF3DGS），用自监督双向循环一致性机制统一调控渐进式无COLMAP 3DGS的相机轨迹估计，无需外部先验即可缓解误差累积。
AI.motivation: 无COLMAP的3DGS虽免去昂贵SfM，但渐进式相机位姿跟踪存在误差累积问题：早期成对跟踪误差既污染后续帧初始化，又被永久固化进场景表示中。现有方案或依赖重量级外部神经先验，或用孤立启发式修补，缺乏统一处理机制。
AI.method: 核心是内在自监督的双向循环一致性机制，跨两个时间视野调控轨迹估计：(1) 前向运动传播——在线可靠性信号自适应门控刚体运动的一阶运动学热启动，将其注入后续成对配准，提供有向搜索先验并拦截不可信转换；(2) 回溯轨迹校正——同一可靠性信号在滑动窗口内动态加权相邻相机位姿的相对位姿一致性约束。通过统一可靠性调节器同时管控前瞻性状态初始化与回溯性轨迹整合。
AI.result: 在Tanks and Tunnels与CO3D-V2基准上大幅提升相机轨迹精度与新颖视角渲染质量，优于现有无位姿（unposed）基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该自包含框架无需外部先验或离线预处理即可解决渐进漂移，验证了统一可靠性调节在无COLMAP 3DGS中的有效性。

title: Universal Drift Correction for Multidimensional Scanning Microscopy
summary: In scanning microscopy, drift causes the specimen to be sampled at positions displaced from the nominal probe positions. This displacement alters the spatial assignment of the recorded signals and biases quantitative measurements across two-dimensional imaging, channel-resolved spectroscopic mapping, and scan-position-resolved diffraction analysis. Here, we extend orthogonal-scan drift correction from 2D images to spectrum images and diffraction datasets. We demonstrate how to recover probe positions using either differently oriented multidimensional scans or structural reference images. The recovered positions are used either to resample the multidimensional data onto a regular grid or to assign each recorded signal to its corrected coordinate. Our method combines affine and non-rigid correction, requires no prior structural model, and is implemented as open-source, GPU-accelerated software that reduces processing times by two to three orders of magnitude, enabling routine and automated drift correction for quantitative multidimensional microscopy.

AI.tldr: 本文将正交扫描漂移校正从二维图像扩展到谱数据立方体和衍射数据集，通过不同方向的扫描或结构参考图恢复探针位置，实现多维显微数据的漂移校正。
AI.motivation: 扫描显微中样品漂移会使采样位置偏离标称探针位置，导致信号空间归属错误，从而影响二维成像、通道分辨谱映射及扫描位置分辨衍射分析的定量测量精度。
AI.method: 将正交扫描漂移校正由二维图像推广至谱数据立方体与衍射数据集；通过不同取向的多维扫描或结构参考图像恢复探针位置；随后将数据重采样至规则网格，或将每个信号分配至校正后的坐标；方法结合仿射与非刚性校正，无需先验结构模型，并实现为开源GPU加速软件。
AI.result: 方法可有效恢复探针位置并完成多维数据校正，且GPU加速使处理速度提升两到三个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需先验结构模型，适用于二维成像、谱映射和衍射数据的漂移校正，支撑多维显微的定量与自动化分析。

title: Evidence-Grounded Auditing of Identification Assumptions in Climate-Policy Causal Evaluations
comment: Accepted at ClimateNLP 2026, the 3rd Workshop on Natural Language Processing meets Climate Change (EMNLP 2026). 9 pages plus appendix (21 pages total), 6 figures, 15 tables
summary: Difference-in-differences (DID) studies are widely used to evaluate climate policy, but assessing the evidence supporting their identification assumptions remains challenging. We introduce ARGUS, a structured language-model pipeline that audits reported evidence against an eleven-dimension assumption-implication-evidence rubric and abstains when relevant evidence cannot be retrieved. We evaluate ARGUS using injected flaws, economics papers, and a small pilot with reconciled labels. On the 11-flaw benchmark, ARGUS detects 73% of planted flaws, compared with 18% for a keyword-based pipeline. Across 26 economics papers, ARGUS abstains on about 40% of paper-dimension assessments for lack of retrievable evidence. In a five-paper pilot with labels reconciled by two annotators, it assigns a higher risk level than the labels on 25 of the 33 assessments it completes. A rule fixed before the labels arrived removes most of this in-sample; weighted agreement stays low. ARGUS provides evidence-linked risk reports that localize potential weaknesses for expert review, without adjudicating causal claims. Code and data: https://github.com/yonghongzhang-io/ARGUS

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ARGUS，一个结构化语言模型流水线，依据"十一维假设-含义-证据"评分表审计 DID 气候政策研究中报告的证据，并在无法检索到相关证据时弃权；在 11 类注入缺陷基准上检测出 73% 的植入缺陷（关键词流水线为 18%），在 26 篇经济学论文中约 40% 的"论文-维度"评估因证据不可得而弃权。
AI.motivation: 双重差分（DID）被广泛用于气候政策评估，但其识别假设所依赖的证据是否充分难以评估，现有基于关键词的方法检测能力有限，因此需要一个能对报告证据进行结构化审计、并明确区分"证据缺失"与"风险较低"的工具。
AI.method: 构建 ARGUS：一种结构化语言模型流水线，将报告证据对照十一维"假设-含义-证据"评分表进行审计，当无法检索到相关证据时主动弃权；采用注入缺陷、经济学论文以及带调和标签的小规模试点三种方式进行评估。
AI.result: 在 11 类缺陷基准上，ARGUS 检测出 73% 的植入缺陷，而基于关键词的流水线仅为 18%；在 26 篇经济学论文中，对约 40% 的"论文-维度"评估因缺乏可检索证据而弃权；在由两位标注者调和标签的五篇论文试点中，33 项完成的评估里有 25 项给出的风险等级高于标签，且在标签到达前固定的规则可消除大部分样本内差异，但加权一致性仍然偏低。
AI.conclusion: ARGUS 能提供证据可追溯的风险报告，定位潜在薄弱环节以供专家复核，而不对因果主张本身作出裁定。

title: Rate-Adaptive One-Step Diffusion Compression for AIGC Images
summary: We describe our entry to the LoViF 2026 AIGC Image Compression Challenge, a benchmark for ultra-low-bitrate coding of AI-generated images under a strict global rate budget of 0.025 bits per pixel (BPP). Generated imagery poses a distinct challenge for compression: it frequently contains rendered typography, synthetic edges, repeated motifs, UI-like layout, and stylized micro-texture that conventional distortion-oriented codecs erase at this rate, while unconstrained generative decoders can restore plausible-looking detail that no longer matches the source geometry or symbols. We treat this as a rate-perception allocation problem. Our system fine-tunes four rate-specialized checkpoints of the AEIC one-step diffusion codec, generates per-image candidates from all four, including one latent refined through encoder-side test-time optimization (TTO) with periodic entropy-conditioning refresh, entropy-codes every candidate with practical rANS coding, and selects exactly one bitstream per image with an exact multiple-choice knapsack solved over true coded file sizes. A fixed, zero-additional-bit residual restoration network is applied at decode time. Every submitted bitstream is independently decodable by the shipped decoder, which uses no source image or external side information. We report the full pipeline, an ablation history spanning 77 logged experiments, and a set of negative results, including why PSNR could not be pushed to parity with rate-distortion-oriented competitors under this architecture, useful to future participants. This is a challenge report: our entry scored 31.527739 (PSNR 27.02 dB, MS-SSIM 0.9176, LPIPS 0.0778, DISTS 0.0390 at 0.02495 BPP), the second-best DISTS on the leaderboard, ranking 5th on the final test-phase leaderboard announced August 4, 2026.

AI.tldr: 本文为LoViF 2026 AIGC图像压缩挑战赛的参赛报告，提出以“码率-感知分配”为核心的四检查点AEIC扩散编解码管线，最终以0.02495 BPP取得PSNR 27.02 dB、MS-SSIM 0.9176、LPIPS 0.0778、DISTS 0.0390，总分31.527739，DISTS位列第二，总排名第5。
AI.motivation: AIGC生成图像含渲染文字、合成边缘、重复纹样、类UI版式与风格化微纹理，在0.025 BPP超低码率下，传统面向失真的编解码器会抹除这些结构，而无约束生成式解码器虽能恢复“看似合理”的细节，却与源几何/符号不一致；因此需在严格全局码率预算下权衡码率与感知质量。
AI.method: 将问题建模为码率-感知分配：1) 微调AEIC一步扩散编解码器的四个码率专用检查点；2) 由四个检查点生成每图候选，其中一个隐变量经编码器端测试时优化(TTO)并周期性刷新熵条件；3) 用实用rANS对每个候选熵编码；4) 基于真实编码文件大小，用精确多重选择背包(MCKP)为每图选出恰好一个比特流；5) 解码端附加一个零额外比特的残差恢复网络；所有码流均由无源图/外部边信息的解码器独立解码。
AI.result: 提交条目得分31.527739，在0.02495 BPP下取得PSNR 27.02 dB、MS-SSIM 0.9176、LPIPS 0.0778、DISTS 0.0390；DISTS为排行榜第二，2026年8月4日公布的最终测试阶段榜单排名第5。此外报告了覆盖77次记录实验的消融历史及若干负结果。
AI.conclusion: 该管线在超低码率AIGC图像压缩上实现了较强的感知质量与次优DISTS表现。负结果指出：在该架构下PSNR无法与面向率失真的竞争者持平，这一经验对后续参赛者具有参考价值；整体为挑战赛技术报告性质。

title: Effects of Transcript Compression on LLM-based Medical Misinformation Detection in Japanese YouTube Videos
comment: 15 pages. Accepted at the 18th International Conference on Advances in Social Networks Analysis and Mining (ASONAM 2026), Multidisciplinary Track, Short Paper
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to assess long-form medical videos, but their effectiveness may depend on whether transcripts are provided in full or compressed through summarization, retrieval, or claim screening. This study examines how such transcript compression affects LLM-based veracity classification of Japanese medical YouTube videos. We compare four transcript input designs: full transcripts, LLM-generated summaries, RAPTOR-based retrievalaugmented generation (RAG), and Screening, which extracts candidate medical and health-related sentences. Using 74 long-form videos labeled as Real or Fake, we evaluate classification performance and analyze linguistic changes using J-LIWC, hedge expressions, and institutional or technical terms. The full-transcript Baseline achieved the best performance, whereas all compressed inputs increased false negatives, meaning that Fake videos were more likely to be misclassified as Real. Summary caused the largest performance drop, while Screening performed best among the compressed inputs but still omitted many medically relevant sentences. Linguistic analyses showed that these errors were not explained by a simple increase in certainty. Instead, Summary reduced affective, social, temporal, cognitive, and conversational cues, while Summary and RAG made institutional and technical terms more salient. These findings suggest that transcript compression can represent Fake videos as more coherent and authoritative inputs, thereby weakening cues needed for misinformation detection

AI.tldr: 该研究比较四种转录文本输入设计（完整转录、LLM摘要、RAPTOR检索增强、Screening句子筛选）对LLM判定日本医学YouTube长视频真伪的影响，发现完整转录效果最佳，任何压缩都会增加假阴性，表明压缩可能使虚假视频显得更连贯、更具权威性，从而削弱错误信息检测线索。
AI.motivation: LLM日益用于长视频医学内容评估，但受限于上下文长度，通常需对转录文本进行摘要、检索或筛选等压缩处理。作者希望厘清这种压缩是否、以及如何影响LLM对视频真实性的判定能力，尤其是对假视频的漏检风险。
AI.method: 以74个标注为Real或Fake的日本长篇医学YouTube视频为数据，构建四种转录输入设计：完整转录（Baseline）、LLM生成摘要、基于RAPTOR的检索增强生成（RAG）、Screening（抽取候选医学健康相关句子）。评估分类性能，并用J-LIWC、模糊限制语（hedge）及机构/技术术语进行语言特征分析。
AI.result: 完整转录Baseline性能最佳；所有压缩输入均导致假阴性增加，即Fake视频更易被误判为Real。摘要导致性能下降最大，Screening在压缩方法中表现最好但仍遗漏大量医学相关句子。语言分析显示错误并非由确定性表达增加所解释；摘要减少了情感、社会、时间、认知与会话线索，而摘要与RAG使机构和技术术语更突出。
AI.conclusion: 转录压缩可能将Fake视频重塑为更连贯、更具权威性的输入，从而削弱检测错误信息所需的语言线索，导致漏检。提示在设计LLM医学视频审核流程时，应谨慎权衡压缩带来的效率与真实性判别可靠性。

title: From annotation to reasoning: Culture in language models
summary: How should we evaluate language models when more than one interpretation can be right? Cultural benchmarks often test factual knowledge, agreement with survey responses, or recognition of a predefined meaning. These tasks leave open whether a model can explain how a cultural reference works in a particular text, support a reading with evidence, or revise it after criticism. This is a question of interpretive depth, complementary to the breadth of cultural coverage. We argue that literary interpretation offers a useful setting for studying these capabilities. We focus on cultural referencing and reuse: how texts invoke, repeat, and transform earlier expressions across historical and linguistic contexts. Our central claim is that literary scholars can disagree about an interpretation while recognizing the quality of its support. We propose linking evidence-centered benchmarks, evaluation that preserves scholarly disagreement, and model-development experiments on literary data, contextual resources, and scholarly feedback. Danish literature provides a concrete starting point, with implications for other languages and domains. The aim is to develop alternative evaluation strategies that go beyond conventional benchmark metrics and guide model development toward cultural robustness in AI systems.

AI.tldr: 论文主张以文学阐释为场景，构建以证据为中心、容忍学术分歧的评估框架，考察语言模型在文化引用与再创造上的阐释深度，并以丹麦文学为起点。
AI.motivation: 现有文化基准多测事实知识、与调查回答的一致性或对预设含义的识别，无法判断模型能否解释文化引用在具体文本中的运作方式、以证据支撑某一读法，或在受到批评后修正读法。这是"阐释深度"问题，与"文化覆盖广度"互补。
AI.method: 提出三条相互衔接的路线：以证据为中心的基准；保留学者分歧的评估方式；在高文学数据、语境资源与学者反馈上开展模型开发实验。聚焦文化引用与再利用，即文本如何跨历史与语言语境调用、重复并transform既有表述。以丹麦文学作为具体起点。
AI.result: 为立场性/倡议性论文，未报告实验数据或量化结果；其核心论断是：文学研究者可以在对某一阐释存在分歧的同时，仍能认可其支撑质量——这为超越单一标准答案的评估提供了理论依据。
AI.conclusion: 应发展超越传统基准指标的替代性评估策略，并以此引导模型开发，从而提升AI系统的文化稳健性；该思路可推广至其他语言与领域。

title: ToolSearcher: Optimizing Tool Selection at Scale via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at natural language processing but struggle to interact with external environments. Tool learning provides a promising way to extend LLMs into actionable agents, where tool selection is a critical prerequisite for successful tool use. Existing work often assumes a small or predefined set of tools, leaving large-scale tool selection underexplored. Real-world repositories contain a vast and diverse array of tools, making it difficult for LLMs to effectively search, distinguish, and compose tools under context-length constraints. We identify large-scale tool selection as a new challenge for agentic reinforcement learning, highlighting that existing RL methods for knowledge-based question answering are inadequate for selecting tools while considering compatibility. To address this challenge, we propose ToolSearcher, a novel RL framework for effective multi-turn search and fine-grained optimization in large-scale tool selection. Specifically, we introduce category-constrained tool discrimination to improve the model's ability to distinguish functionally similar tools, event-level search modeling to explicitly optimize the discovery of target tools during multi-turn search, and trajectory-aligned credit allocation to provide fine-grained reward signals for different stages of the search-selection process. Extensive experiments on large-scale tool selection benchmarks demonstrate that ToolSearcher consistently outperforms a set of strong baselines in challenging settings involving iterative search and complex tool composition.

AI.tldr: ToolSearcher：面向大规模工具选择的强化学习框架，通过类别约束工具区分、事件级搜索建模与轨迹对齐信用分配，提升多轮搜索与细粒度优化下的工具选择能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在自然语言处理上表现优异，但难以与外部环境交互；工具学习可将其扩展为可执行的智能体，而工具选择是成功使用工具的关键前提。现有工作多假设工具集合较小或预先给定，大规模工具选择尚未被充分探索。真实仓库中工具数量庞大且类型多样，在上下文长度约束下，模型难以有效搜索、区分和组合工具。作者因此将大规模工具选择识别为智能体强化学习的新挑战，并指出面向知识问答的现有强化学习方法不足以在考虑兼容性的同时完成工具选择。
AI.method: 提出 ToolSearcher，一种面向大规模工具选择中有效多轮搜索与细粒度优化的新型强化学习框架。具体包含三项设计：1）类别约束的工具区分，提升模型对功能相似工具的辨别能力；2）事件级搜索建模，在多轮搜索中显式优化目标工具的发现过程；3）轨迹对齐的信用分配，为搜索—选择过程的不同阶段提供细粒度奖励信号。
AI.result: 在大规模工具选择基准上的大量实验表明，在包含迭代搜索与复杂工具组合的困难设定下，ToolSearcher 持续优于一系列强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ToolSearcher 有效应对大规模工具选择这一智能体强化学习新挑战，验证了类别约束区分、事件级搜索建模与轨迹对齐信用分配的有效性，为 LLM 在真实大规模工具库中的搜索与组合提供可行方案。

title: Cross-Backend QIEO: Universal Runtime Portability across OpenMP5, CUDA, HIP, and Multi-Language Interfaces
summary: Quantum-inspired algorithms emulate quantum mechanical principles, such as, superposition, interference, and probabilistic amplitude evolution, on classical hardware by representing candidate solutions as qubit vectors and evolving them through rotation-gate operators. This approach offers higher optimization performance without physical qubits, and has been shown to achieve order-of-magnitude speedups (10--80$\times$) over traditional solvers on combinatorial, high-dimensional NP-hard problems. A critical barrier to adoption, however, is the lack of a unified execution framework that delivers both algorithmic performance and hardware portability. We present \textbf{Cross-Backend Quantum Inspired Evolutionary Optimizer (QIEO)}, the runtime core of BQP's BQPhy solver, which addresses this gap through a \emph{single-source-of-truth} architecture. One C++ implementation of the QIEO algorithm is compiled once per hardware target and exposed to multiple high-level languages via thin binding layers. The framework dispatches to CPU (sequential), OpenMP~5 (multi-core), CUDA (NVIDIA), and HIP (AMD) backends at runtime, adapting kernels to each device's memory hierarchy and warp/wavefront execution model. The framework's real-world utility is validated through binding demonstrations that share the identical C++ runtime. BQPhy's Python library is demonstrated on a neural network hyperparameter optimisation achieving 88.60\% test accuracy on MNIST. BQPhy's MATLAB's Toolkit is tested on wind farm layout optimisation attaining $365\,399 \pm 4\,552$~MWh/yr, which is statistically indistinguishable from particle swarm optimisation and $+7.6\%$ above genetic algorithms on a 32-variable constrained engineering problem. The Julia package tackles the Lotka--Volterra parameter estimation where BQPhy replaces native Julia solvers on the same residual, cutting mean SSE by $2.1\times$.

AI.tldr: 该文提出跨后端量子启发式进化优化器(QIEO),以单一C++实现支持CPU/OpenMP/CUDA/HIP多后端,并通过绑定层供Python、MATLAB、Julia调用,在多个实际优化任务中验证性能。
AI.motivation: 量子启发算法在组合优化、高维NP难问题上优于传统求解器,但缺乏统一执行框架,难以兼顾算法性能与硬件可移植性,阻碍了实际采用。
AI.method: 采用"单一事实来源"架构:一份QIEO算法的C++实现,每个硬件目标编译一次,通过轻量绑定层暴露给多种高级语言;运行时调度至CPU(串行)、OpenMP 5(多核)、CUDA(NVIDIA)和HIP(AMD)后端,并针对各设备内存层次与warp/wavefront执行模型调整内核。
AI.result: Python库在MNIST神经网络超参优化上达88.60%测试准确率;MATLAB工具箱在风电场布局优化得365,399±4,552 MWh/yr,与粒子群优化统计上无差异,在32变量约束工程问题上较遗传算法高7.6%;Julia包在Lotka-Volterra参数估计中,相同残差下平均SSE降低2.1倍。
AI.conclusion: QIEO作为BQPhy求解器的运行时核心,验证了统一跨后端框架的实用性与可移植性,可在多种硬件与宿主语言环境下提供一致的量子启发优化性能。

title: Training-Free Pronunciation Transcription via Text-Constrained Acoustic Rescoring
summary: Accurate and efficient pronunciation transcription is essential for preparing text-to-speech training data at scale. Existing approaches have different limitations: grapheme-to-pronunciation (G2P) and speech-to-pronunciation (S2P) methods each capture only partial information, using only text or only speech, while speech-and-text-to-pronunciation (ST2P) methods use both but require costly pronunciation-annotated data. To address this problem, we propose a training-free ST2P pipeline that integrates both lexical and acoustic information at inference time. Lexical resources and G2P tools generate text-constrained candidates, and a left-to-right greedy search selects the best one using whole-sequence negative log-likelihoods from frozen pretrained S2P models. On three Japanese corpora, our method reduces Character Error Rate (CER) from 0.60--1.40\% (text-only baseline) to 0.04--0.17\% with reference transcripts, and 0.64--1.58\% with ASR transcripts. It outperforms all baselines, including a trained ST2P model and commercial multimodal LLMs. Our greedy search method is 3--3.5$\times$ faster than beam search at similar CER, and the cascade is 2$\times$ faster than direct decoding ensuring the efficiency and accuracy. In Spanish, French, and preliminary English, it also surpasses four open multimodal LLMs and the best traditional methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练的语音-文本联合发音转写（ST2P）流水线，在推理时融合词汇与声学信息，显著降低CER并提升效率。
AI.motivation: 大规模准备TTS训练数据需要准确高效的发音转写。现有方法各有局限：G2P与S2P仅利用文本或语音之一，信息不完整；ST2P虽兼顾两者，却依赖昂贵的发音标注数据。
AI.method: 免训练ST2P流水线：由词汇资源与G2P工具生成受文本约束的候选，再用冻结的预训练S2P模型计算整序列负对数似然，通过从左到右的贪心搜索选择最佳候选；采用级联结构而非直接解码。
AI.result: 在三个日语语料上，CER从纯文本基线的0.60–1.40%降至0.04–0.17%（参考转写）及0.64–1.58%（ASR转写），优于包括训练式ST2P模型和商用多模态LLM在内的所有基线；贪心搜索在相近CER下比束搜索快3–3.5倍，级联比直接解码快2倍。在西/法/初步英语上也超过四个开源多模态LLM和最佳传统方法。
AI.conclusion: 该免训练级联流水线结合词汇与声学信息，同时保证高准确率与高效率，并可跨语言泛化，为大规模TTS数据准备提供了有效方案。

title: UltraG-Bench: A Multi-task Benchmark for assessing Large Vision-Language Models on Pixel-level Evidence Grounding in Ultrasound
summary: Ultrasound is one of the most widely used medical imaging modalities, and recent large vision-language models(VLMs) have shown increasing capabilities in ultrasound image understanding. However, these models fail to provide pixel-level visual evidence aligned with their semantic predictions, and their fine-grained grounding capability in ultrasound remains largely unclear. We introduce UltraG-Bench, a large-scale multi-task benchmark for evaluating pixel-level evidence grounding in ultrasound. UltraG-Bench is built by annotating 40 public ultrasound segmentation datasets spanning 13 anatomical categories, and comprises three progressive tasks: instruction-guided segmentation, evidence-grounded VQA, and evidence-grounded report generation, with 331125, 666779, and 138832 annotations, respectively. Comprehensive evaluation of 14 state-of-the-art models reveals a substantial gap between semantic understanding and fine-grained pixel-level localization. We further propose UltraG-Agent, which combines the semantic reasoning capabilities of a VLM with the ultrasound-specific segmentation capability of UltraSAM3. Experiments show that UltraG-Agent substantially improves both semantic prediction and pixel-level visual grounding. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/zhuqh19/UltraG-Bench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出超声像素级证据定位基准UltraG-Bench（涵盖13个解剖类别、40个公开分割数据集、三项渐进任务）与UltraG-Agent框架（融合VLM语义推理与UltraSAM3分割能力），评测揭示现有模型语义理解与像素级定位间的显著鸿沟，并证明所提方法可同时提升语义预测与像素级视觉定位。
AI.motivation: 超声是最广泛使用的医学成像模态之一，近期大型视觉语言模型（VLM）在超声图像理解上能力不断增强。然而这类模型无法提供与其语义预测相对齐的像素级视觉证据，且在超声领域的细粒度定位能力仍不明确。为填补这一空白，作者构建了面向像素级证据定位的大规模多任务基准。
AI.method: 构建UltraG-Bench：标注40个公开超声分割数据集，覆盖13个解剖类别，设计三项渐进任务——指令引导分割、证据接地VQA、证据接地报告生成，分别包含331125、666779、138832条标注。基于该基准对14个先进模型进行综合评测；并提出UltraG-Agent，将VLM的语义推理能力与超声专用分割模型UltraSAM3的能力相结合。
AI.result: 对14个最先进模型的综合评测显示，语义理解与细粒度像素级定位之间存在显著鸿沟。实验表明UltraG-Agent显著提升了语义预测与像素级视觉定位两方面的表现。
AI.conclusion: 现有VLM在超声像素级证据定位上能力不足，UltraG-Bench为系统评测提供了标准化基准，UltraG-Agent验证了语义推理与专用分割能力结合的有效性。数据集与代码已开源。

title: ManiVid: Unified and Explainable Forensic Analysis of Manipulated Videos
summary: Rapid advances in AI-generated video (AIGV) have increased the risks posed by deceptive video manipulation. Unlike fully synthetic videos, manipulated videos retain most source content and alter only localized regions, making forensic analysis particularly challenging. Existing video forgery research faces two limitations in both data and methodology: (1) High-quality datasets and benchmarks tailored for manipulated videos remain scarce. (2) Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) extend forgery analysis beyond binary classification but struggle to use low-level forensic cues and provide precise pixel-level grounding. Specifically, we introduce ManiVid, a unified forensic analysis task covering forgery detection, artifact grounding, and anomaly explanation for manipulated videos. We construct ManiVid-38K, the first dataset to combine paired, open-vocabulary localized manipulations of general videos with authenticity labels, forgery masks, and anomaly explanations. It comprises about 19K manually verified real-fake video pairs, mostly at 1080P resolution, generated under 2 paradigms with 15 powerful generation models. We sample 1K pairs for ManiVidBench, balanced across six manipulation types and generation models for fair evaluation. We further propose ManiVidLens, a unified framework for explainable video forgery analysis. Its Forensic Evidence Router supplies shared low-level forensic evidence for multimodal reasoning and video segmentation. Its Prompt Distill Module converts grounding states into semantic and geometric prompts and distills spatial priors for mask decoding and full-video propagation. ManiVidLens achieves relative gains over the strongest comparison methods in artifact grounding (+21.1% mIoU; +21.3% J&F) and anomaly explanation (+131.3% ROUGE-L; +9.9% CSS). Its forgery detection remains comparable to dedicated classifiers (0.914 Acc; 0.913 F1).

AI.tldr: 本文提出ManiVid统一取证任务（伪造检测、伪影定位、异常解释），构建首个配对开放词汇局部篡改视频数据集ManiVid-38K与平衡基准ManiVidBench，并提出统一框架ManiVidLens，在伪影定位与异常解释上大幅超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: AI生成视频使欺骗性篡改风险上升。与完全合成视频不同，篡改视频保留大部分原始内容、仅改动局部区域，取证更困难。现有视频伪造研究存在两方面局限：(1) 面向篡改视频的高质量数据集与基准稀缺；(2) 多模态大模型虽将取证从二分类扩展到更丰富任务，却难以利用低层取证线索，也无法给出精确的像素级定位。
AI.method: 提出ManiVid统一取证任务，覆盖伪造检测、伪影定位与异常解释。构建ManiVid-38K数据集，首次将通用视频的配对、开放词汇局部篡改与真实性标签、伪造掩码、异常解释相结合，含约19K经人工校验的真-假视频对，多为1080P分辨率，由2种范式、15个生成模型产出；从中采样1K对构成ManiVidBench，在六类篡改类型与各生成模型间保持平衡。提出统一框架ManiVidLens：取证证据路由器（Forensic Evidence Router）为多模态推理与视频分割提供共享的低层取证证据；提示蒸馏模块（Prompt Distill Module）将定位状态转为语义与几何提示，并蒸馏空间先验用于掩码解码与全视频传播。
AI.result: ManiVidLens在伪影定位上相对最强对比方法取得+21.1% mIoU、+21.3% J&F的提升；在异常解释上提升+131.3% ROUGE-L、+9.9% CSS；伪造检测性能与专用分类器相当（0.914 Acc；0.913 F1）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过统一任务、大规模配对数据集与基准，以及融合低层取证证据与提示蒸馏的统一框架，实现了可解释的篡改视频取证，在定位与解释上显著领先，检测性能保持竞争力。

title: Estimating and Orthogonalizing Unknown Pre-training Gradients for Continual Fine-tuning of Large Language Models
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. 29 pages, 3 figures. Code: https://github.com/wangbing1416/EoupCT
summary: Continual fine-tuning is essential for large language models (LLMs) to dynamically adapt to real-world environments, yet it inevitably suffers from catastrophic forgetting, particularly the performance degradation of previous tasks and LLMs' general-purpose knowledge. Although existing methods, such as orthogonal gradient projection, mitigate the forgetting across various fine-tuning tasks, they fundamentally fail to preserve pre-training LLMs' inherent general-purpose knowledge because the original data and gradients of off-the-shelf pre-training LLMs required by these methods are strictly unknown and highly diverse. To bridge this critical gap, we propose EoupCT, a novel framework designed to Estimate and Orthogonalize Unknown Pre-training gradients for Continual LLM fine-Tuning. Specifically, EoupCT estimates pre-training gradients by dynamically generating pseudo data that is most susceptible to forgetting for new tasks through a learnable soft prompt equipped with Gumbel-Softmax relaxation. Furthermore, we formulate a multi-objective optimization problem and introduce a first-order efficient Pareto optimizer that jointly optimizes LLM parameters and the soft prompt, rigorously enforcing orthogonality between new task updates and the estimated pre-training gradients. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs demonstrate that EoupCT effectively preserves both task-specific proficiency and inherent general-purpose knowledge, successfully mitigating the catastrophic forgetting.

AI.tldr: 提出EoupCT框架，通过估计并正交化未知预训练梯度，缓解持续微调中的灾难性遗忘，兼顾任务能力与通用知识。
AI.motivation: LLM持续微调会引发灾难性遗忘，尤其损害通用知识。现有方法（如正交梯度投影）依赖原始预训练数据与梯度，而这些对现成LLM而言严格未知且高度多样，导致无法真正保留预训练固有通用知识。
AI.method: EoupCT通过带Gumbel-Softmax松弛的可学习软提示，动态生成最易被新任务遗忘的伪数据，以估计预训练梯度；并将问题建模为多目标优化，引入一阶高效Pareto优化器，联合优化LLM参数与软提示，严格约束新任务更新与估计的预训练梯度正交。
AI.result: 在多个LLM上的大量实验表明，EoupCT有效保留任务专精能力与固有通用知识，成功缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: EoupCT无需访问原始预训练数据与梯度，即可在持续微调中实现通用知识与任务能力的平衡，为LLM持续学习提供有效方案。

title: Spackle: Completing Large View Single Image NVS with Adaptive Gaussians
summary: Single-image novel view synthesis (NVS) enables photorealistic rendering of un- observed viewpoints from a single input. Practical NVS systems require two key capabilities: robust reconstruction of occluded regions and high inference effi- ciency. While hybrid decoupled frameworks combining feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and diffusion models show promise for large-view-deviation NVS, they suffer from capacity competition: a fixed number of Gaussians forces resource shifts from visible to newly disoccluded areas, degrading original scene fidelity when the target view deviates significantly from the input. To address this, we propose Spackle, a lightweight residual learning framework that mit- igates capacity competition without sacrificing efficiency. Spackle operates in three stages: predicting base 3DGS attributes from given views, automatically identifying poorly reconstructed regions, and learning a residual 3DGS optimized exclusively for these areas. At inference, we combine the baseline and aug- mented Gaussians for NVS. We conduct comprehensive experiments and show that Spackle achieves state-of-the-art performance on large-view-deviation cases.

AI.tldr: 提出Spackle轻量级残差学习框架，通过三阶段流程缓解前馈3DGS与扩散模型混合框架中的容量竞争问题，在大视角偏差的新视角合成任务上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 单图像新视角合成（NVS）需要兼顾遮挡区域重建能力与高推理效率。现有混合解耦框架（前馈3DGS+扩散模型）在大视角偏差场景下存在"容量竞争"：固定数量的高斯点在可见区域与新去遮挡区域之间争夺资源，导致资源从可见区域转移，从而降低原始场景保真度。
AI.method: Spackle为轻量级残差学习框架，包含三阶段：1）从给定视角预测基础3DGS属性；2）自动识别重建质量较差的区域；3）仅针对这些区域学习残差3DGS。推理时将基础高斯与增强高斯结合进行NVS。
AI.result: 在全面实验中，Spackle在大视角偏差场景下取得了state-of-the-art的性能，且未牺牲推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过残差学习的方式解耦基础与增强高斯表示，Spackle在不增加推理负担的前提下有效缓解容量竞争，提升大视角偏差NVS的重建质量。

title: OneWorld: Learning Consistent Physics Across Actions in World Models
summary: Action-conditioned video world models aim to predict scene evolution under different actions, a capability that is essential for reliable planning, decision-making, and interaction in dynamic environments. However, futures generated independently from the same initial scene may each appear plausible while implying incompatible physical properties, such as friction or mass. This inconsistency can lead to contradictory predictions across interventions, making it difficult for the model to maintain a coherent understanding of the underlying world and limiting its reliability for planning and decision-making. To address these issues, we propose OneWorld, a shared-mechanism counterfactual generation framework that jointly models multiple action-conditioned futures under a common latent physical mechanism. A physical mechanism interpreter first infers a distribution over latent mechanisms from each action-outcome branch. These distributions are then aggregated into shared-world evidence, which captures whether the branches admit a common physical explanation while accounting for uncertainty in less informative branches. This evidence constrains flow training and guides sampling, encouraging consistency in the underlying physical mechanism while preserving the distinct outcomes induced by different actions. We further introduce a multi-intervention evaluation protocol in controlled environments, following the interaction settings of ACWM-Phys, to assess whether generated futures can be jointly explained by the same physical parameters, alongside standard measures of single-rollout prediction quality. Experiments in these environments show that OneWorld improves cross-intervention physical consistency while maintaining competitive single-rollout prediction quality.

AI.tldr: 提出OneWorld框架，通过共享潜在物理机制联合建模多条动作条件未来，提升反事实预测的物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 动作条件视频世界模型中，同一初始场景下独立生成的不同未来各自看似合理，却隐含互相矛盾的物理属性（如摩擦、质量），导致跨干预预测不一致，削弱模型对世界的连贯理解及规划决策可靠性。
AI.method: OneWorld为共享机制反事实生成框架：物理机制解释器从每条动作—结果分支推断潜在机制分布；将其聚合为共享世界证据，判断各分支是否可用共同物理解释并处理信息不足分支的不确定性；该证据约束流训练并引导采样，在保持各动作差异化结果的同时促进底层物理机制一致。另提出多干预评估协议（遵循ACWM-Phys交互设定）。
AI.result: 在受控环境实验中，OneWorld提升了跨干预的物理一致性，同时保持有竞争力的单次推演预测质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享潜在物理机制的可解释聚合与流模型约束，可有效缓解反事实未来的物理不一致问题，为可靠的规划与决策提供更连贯的世界理解。

title: DAPEVO: Deep Adaptive Patch Frame-Event Visual Odometry
summary: Visual odometry is essential for autonomous navigation in GPS-denied environments, yet RGB-based methods remain vulnerable to motion blur, challenging illumination, and dropped frames. Event cameras complement conventional cameras with high temporal resolution and dynamic range, but their asynchronous measurements complicate reliable correspondence estimation. We present DAPEVO, a learned visual odometry system that estimates image and event correspondences independently at shared patch locations and fuses their correlation evidence before motion refinement. Each tracked patch maintains image and event descriptors, and a learned scalar gate combines modality-specific correlation embeddings for each patch--frame edge before a shared recurrent refinement and bundle-adjustment update. DAPEVO also supports event-only observations, enabling continued tracking when RGB frames are sparse or unavailable, while modality-aware keyframe culling preserves scarce frame constraints. On UZH-FPV, when retaining only one in six RGB frames, DAPEVO's mean absolute trajectory error (ATE) increases by only 36%, from 1.00 to 1.36m, whereas the ATE of DPVO and RAMP-VO rises by factors of $3.7\times$ and $3.1\times$, respectively. On TartanEvent, DAPEVO similarly remains below 1m ATE at 3Hz RGB input, while DPVO and RAMP-VO exceed 9m. Under degraded RGB input on TartanEvent, DAPEVO achieves an ATE of 0.60m, compared with more than 4m for both DPVO and RAMP-VO, while also outperforming event-only DEVO at 0.87m.

AI.tldr: DAPEVO是一种学习式视觉里程计系统，在每个patch位置分别估计图像与事件对应关系，融合相关性证据后统一进行运动优化，在RGB帧稀疏或退化时显著优于DPVO、RAMP-VO及事件-only DEVO。
AI.motivation: GPS拒止环境下的自主导航依赖视觉里程计，但纯RGB方法易受运动模糊、光照挑战和丢帧影响；事件相机虽具备高时间分辨率和动态范围，但其异步测量使可靠对应估计困难。因此需要一种能融合图像与事件、并在RGB退化时仍可稳健跟踪的方案。
AI.method: 提出DAPEVO：在共享patch位置上独立估计图像与事件对应；每个跟踪patch维护图像描述子和事件描述子；使用学习到的标量门控，对每个patch–frame边的模态特定相关性嵌入进行融合，再进入共享的循环细化与bundle-adjustment更新。系统支持event-only观测，在RGB帧稀疏或不可用时继续跟踪，并采用模态感知的关键帧剔除以保留稀缺的帧约束。
AI.result: UZH-FPV：仅保留六分之一RGB帧时，DAPEVO平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE）仅增加36%（1.00至1.36m），而DPVO和RAMP-VO分别上升3.7倍和3.1倍。TartanEvent：3Hz RGB输入下DAPEVO仍保持低于1m ATE，DPVO和RAMP-VO超过9m；RGB退化输入下DAPEVO ATE为0.60m，DPVO与RAMP-VO均超过4m，同时优于event-only DEVO的0.87m。
AI.conclusion: DAPEVO通过图像与事件双模态描述子的独立估计、学习式门控融合及模态感知关键帧管理，在RGB帧稀疏或退化条件下显著提升视觉里程计的鲁棒性和精度，并支持event-only持续跟踪。

title: MVVBench: Benchmarking 4D Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Multi-view video understanding requires integrating spatial and temporal evidence across multiple, often non-overlapping camera streams: tracking entities as they transition between viewpoints, aligning events across time, and reasoning about latent 4D continuity rather than any single visible frame. We introduce MVVBench, a benchmark for multi-view video reasoning built from real world multi camera datasets. Questions are curated to be monocular-ambiguous along both the view and the temporal axis: each question is unanswerable from any single view in the designated input set, and the majority are further unanswerable from any single moment. Each question becomes uniquely solvable only by jointly reasoning across views and across time. MVVBench spans diverse dynamic scenes and probes six capabilities: implicit/explicit attribute identification, implicit/explicit relative distance, relative camera pose, and compositional counting, with human-authored QA and rigorous verification. Beyond benchmarking, we provide an extensive analysis of when and why current vision language models succeed or fail, characterizing errors due to temporal mis-localization, cross-view identity breaks, and brittle multi-hop reasoning. We then study inference-time elicitation strategies that unlock latent multi-view competence---task-specific chain-of-thought scaffolds and structured cross-view evidence aggregation---yielding substantial gains without retraining. Finally, we present preliminary evidence that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can elicit some latent multi-view competence in the base model, pointing to training-time approaches as a promising direction for future work. Together, MVVBench offers a rigorous evaluation of 4D multi-view reasoning and a foundation for future progress toward reliable embodied perception.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MVVBench，一个基于真实多摄像机数据集构建的多视角视频推理基准，其问题在设计上对单视角与单时刻均为不可解，唯有跨视角、跨时间联合推理才能回答。基准涵盖六类能力，并系统分析了现有视觉语言模型的失败模式、推理时激发策略及初步的强化学习训练探索。
AI.motivation: 多视角视频理解需要整合多个（往往不重叠）相机流中的空间与时间证据，包括跨视角实体跟踪、跨时间事件对齐以及关于潜在 4D 连续性的推理，而现有基准与模型评估缺乏对这种联合推理能力的严格检验。因此作者希望建立一个能够真正区分"单视角即可解"与"必须多视角、多时刻联合推理"的评测基准，并厘清当前模型成功与失败的边界。
AI.method: 构建 MVVBench：从真实世界多摄像机数据集出发，通过人工撰写问答与严格校验，筛选出"单视角歧义"问题——即在指定输入集的任一单视角下均不可回答，且多数在任一单一时刻亦不可回答，仅当跨视角与跨时间联合推理时才具有唯一解。基准覆盖多样动态场景，探测六项能力：隐式/显式属性识别、隐式/显式相对距离、相对相机位姿、组合计数。此外，作者对现有视觉语言模型进行广泛的失败模式分析，并提出推理时激发策略（任务特定思维链脚手架、结构化跨视角证据聚合），以及初步的带可验证奖励的强化学习实验。
AI.result: MVVBench 覆盖多样动态场景与六类能力，问答质量经人工撰写与严格验证保证。分析揭示了当前视觉语言模型的三类典型错误：时间定位错误（temporal mis-localization）、跨视角身份断裂（cross-view identity breaks）以及多跳推理脆弱（brittle multi-hop reasoning）。推理时激发策略（思维链脚手架与结构化跨视角证据聚合）在无需重训练的情况下带来显著性能提升。初步结果表明，带可验证奖励的强化学习可在基座模型中激发出部分潜在的多视角能力。
AI.conclusion: MVVBench 为 4D 多视角推理提供了严格的评测，并为迈向可靠具身感知的未来研究奠定基础；同时指出训练时方法（如带可验证奖励的强化学习）是激发模型潜在多视角能力的有前景方向。

title: IDM-Net: A Lightweight Illumination-Decoupled Modulation Network for Low-Light Image Enhancement
summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) remains challenging for lightweight models because illumination restoration and color fidelity are difficult to optimize simultaneously in the RGB color space. Although recent color-decoupled methods separate luminance and chrominance representations, they primarily optimize luminance as an enhancement target, leaving its potential as an explicit guidance prior largely unexplored during feature reconstruction. To address this limitation, we propose IDM-Net, a lightweight Illumination-Decoupled Modulation Network for low-light image enhancement. IDM-Net adopts a dual-encoder architecture consisting of a structure encoder that extracts multi-scale appearance features from the RGB image and a lightweight illumination encoder that learns illumination priors from the decoupled luminance (Y) channel. To effectively exploit these priors, we introduce an Illumination-Guided Modulation (IGM) module that injects multi-scale illumination cues into the decoder through spatially adaptive affine modulation, enabling accurate brightness restoration while preserving natural color consistency. Furthermore, we design a lightweight Feature Refinement Block (FRB) to progressively suppress degradation artifacts and recover fine-grained image details during reconstruction. Extensive experiments on multiple standard low-light image enhancement benchmarks demonstrate that IDM-Net achieves competitive performance among lightweight LLIE methods while maintaining an excellent balance between restoration quality and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出IDM-Net轻量级低光图像增强网络，通过双编码器解耦光照与结构，利用光照先验引导调制实现亮度恢复与色彩保真兼顾。
AI.motivation: 轻量级LLIE模型中，光照恢复与色彩保真在RGB空间难以同时优化；现有色解耦方法仅将亮度作为增强目标，未充分利用其作为显式引导先验的潜力。
AI.method: IDM-Net采用双编码器架构：结构编码器从RGB图像提取多尺度外观特征，轻量光照编码器从解耦的亮度Y通道学习光照先验；引入Illumination-Guided Modulation (IGM)模块，通过空间自适应仿射调制将多尺度光照线索注入解码器；设计轻量Feature Refinement Block (FRB)逐步抑制退化伪影并恢复细节。
AI.result: 在多个标准低光图像增强基准上，IDM-Net在轻量级LLIE方法中取得有竞争力的性能，在恢复质量与计算效率间保持良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: 光照解耦先验可有效指导特征重建，所提方法为轻量级低光增强提供了高效方案。

title: Where and When to Force: Routed Forcing for Streaming Avatars
summary: Audio-driven streaming avatar generation requires real-time synthesis of speech-synchronized videos with dynamic and diverse motion. Self Forcing uses Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) to distill bidirectional video diffusion models into causal, few-step generators for real-time streaming. However, DMD minimizes a reverse KL divergence, which is inherently mode-seeking: it causes the student to discard high-dynamic modes and collapse onto static outputs, compressing both dynamics and diversity of generated videos. We find that this collapse is region-heterogeneous: person regions involving pose and gesture variations suffer the largest diversity loss, the audio-driven mouth region shows a small loss, and the background remains nearly stable. Based on this observation, we propose Routed Forcing, which routes the distillation objective by semantic region and noise stage to improve dynamics and diversity while preserving visual quality. Specifically, (1) Where to Force: Semantic-Region Routing applies Data-Forcing Distillation (DFD), which supervises the student with real videos, to the person region where diversity collapse is most severe, while retaining DMD for the mouth and background to preserve lip synchronization and scene stability. (2) When to Force: Noise-Stage Routing activates DFD at high noise stages, where real video serves as effective supervision to inject diverse and dynamic motion patterns. At low noise stages, DMD is used to refine details, avoiding blur and artifacts from spatial differences between real video and student-generated video. Experiments show that Routed Forcing improves dynamics by up to 45% and diversity by 7-25% over Self Forcing, while preserving video quality and lip synchronization.

AI.tldr: 提出 Routed Forcing，通过按语义区域与噪声阶段路由蒸馏目标，缓解 Self Forcing 中反向 KL 导致的动态与多样性坍塌，动态提升至多 45%、多样性提升 7-25%，同时保持画质与唇同步。
AI.motivation: 音频驱动的流式数字人需要实时合成语音同步且动作动态、多样的视频。Self Forcing 用分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）把双向视频扩散模型蒸馏为因果少步生成器以实现实时流式生成，但 DMD 最小化反向 KL 散度，本质上具有模式寻求性，会使学生模型丢弃高动态模式、坍缩到静态输出，压缩生成视频的动态性与多样性。作者进一步发现该坍塌具有区域异质性：涉及姿态与手势变化的人物区域多样性损失最大，音频驱动的嘴部区域损失较小，背景几乎稳定。
AI.method: 提出 Routed Forcing，按语义区域和噪声阶段路由蒸馏目标，在保持视觉质量的同时提升动态性与多样性。（1）Where to Force：语义区域路由，对多样性坍塌最严重的人物区域采用 Data-Forcing Distillation（DFD，用真实视频监督学生模型），而嘴部与背景仍保留 DMD，以维持唇同步与场景稳定性。（2）When to Force：噪声阶段路由，在高噪声阶段启用 DFD，此时真实视频是注入多样、动态运动模式的有效监督；在低噪声阶段使用 DMD 精修细节，避免真实视频与学生生成视频之间的空间差异带来模糊和伪影。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比 Self Forcing，Routed Forcing 将动态性最多提升 45%，多样性提升 7-25%，同时保持视频质量与唇同步。
AI.conclusion: Routed Forcing 通过区域与阶段的细粒度蒸馏目标路由，有效解决了反向 KL 模式寻求带来的动态与多样性坍塌问题，在流式音频驱动数字人生成中实现了动态性、多样性与视觉质量、唇同步的良好权衡。

title: FAVoR: Measuring and Mitigating Author-Style Homogenization in Federated Personalized Generation
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as personalized writing assistants, but adapting a model across many authors can compromise individual writing style by pulling author-specific signals toward a shared register. Federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers a data-local setting for this multi-author adaptation problem: clients keep author text local while sharing compact adapter updates. However, we show that standard aggregation can preserve continuation utility while making different authors' generations less distinguishable in style space, a failure mode we define as author-style homogenization. We evaluate author-style retention with Angular Style Classification Encoder (ASCE)-based diagnostics on our main BlogText benchmark and ASCE-independent external authorship verification. Using this protocol, we find that common federated PEFT baselines can preserve semantic utility while averaging out author-specific signals. To address this homogenization, we instantiate FAVoR (Federated Authorial Voice Retention), an author-style residual mechanism for federated PEFT. FAVoR uses a shared-private adapter design: clients upload shared-adapter updates while retaining author-specific residual corrections locally. Across BlogText and external Mythos-Reddit validation, FAVoR improves author-style retention over standard and personalized federated PEFT baselines. These gains come with small continuation-utility trade-offs and are supported by component ablations, external verification, and cold-start transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多作者个性化写作助手场景下联邦PEFT的"作者风格同质化"问题，并提出FAVoR方法以保留作者风格。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型作为个性化写作助手时，多作者联合适配会将作者特有信号拉向共享语域，损害个人写作风格。联邦PEFT虽能保持数据本地性（客户仅上传紧凑适配器更新），但作者发现标准聚合在保持续写效用的同时，会让不同作者的生成在风格空间上难以区分，即"作者风格同质化"。
AI.method: 采用基于Angular Style Classification Encoder (ASCE)的诊断指标评估风格保留，并以ASCE无关的外部作者身份验证作为补充，构建BlogText基准及Mythos-Reddit外部验证集；提出FAVoR（Federated Authorial Voice Retention），一种作者风格残差机制，采用共享-私有适配器设计：客户端上传共享适配器更新，同时在本地保留作者特有的残差修正。
AI.result: 常见联邦PEFT基线在保持语义效用的同时会抹平作者特有信号；FAVoR在BlogText和Mythos-Reddit验证中相较标准及个性化联邦PEFT基线提升了作者风格保留，代价是续写效用的小幅下降，并得到组件消融、外部验证和冷启动迁移的支持。
AI.conclusion: 标准联邦PEFT聚合会导致作者风格同质化，FAVoR通过共享-私有适配器分离共享知识与作者残差，在续写效用略降的前提下显著改善多作者场景下的风格保留。

title: Coupled Usage-Sense Processes: Temporal and Attributable Lexical Semantic Change
summary: Lexical semantic change is usually summarized by a scalar distance between independently sampled period distributions. This measures how much a word changed, but does not reveal when it changed, which mechanisms and component movements carried the change, or which usages support the attribution. We introduce Coupled Usage--Sense Processes (CUSP), which derives these answers from a single marginal preserving temporal process. A hierarchical coupling relates contextual distributions through latent usage components, while Markov composition makes adjacent and longer span correspondences compatible. Displacement operators quantify change magnitude and timing, split variation exactly between movement of component centers and reorganization within components, and attribute it to transported component pairs. Word-local modes resolve distinct directions of change and their activity over time, while representative passages from attributed components ground the analysis in text. Under a Gaussian mixture specialization, we prove parametric recovery of the operators and squared distances. Synthetic experiments support the predicted rate. CUSP remains competitive on English and German DWUG and recovers controlled Janus profiles while maintaining compositionally coherent transport. A large corpus of US court opinions demonstrates transition, mode, and passage attribution in unlabeled natural text. CUSP thus makes magnitude, timing, mechanism, movement, modes, and textual evidence compatible views of one lexical history.

AI.tldr: CUSP：一种边缘保持的耦合用法-义项时序过程，将词义变化从单一标量距离扩展为幅度、时机、机制、分量运动、模式与文本证据的统一分析框架。
AI.motivation: 现有词汇语义变化研究通常用独立采样的时间段分布之间的标量距离来概括，只能衡量"变化多少"，无法揭示变化"何时发生"、由哪些机制与分量运动驱动，以及有哪些具体用法支持这一归因。
AI.method: 提出 Coupled Usage–Sense Processes (CUSP)：基于单一边缘保持的时序过程，用层次耦合通过潜在用法分量关联上下文分布，并以 Markov 组合保证相邻与长跨度的对应一致性；引入位移算子量化变化幅度与时点，将变异精确分解为分量中心移动与分量内部重组，并归因到被输运的分量对；用词局部模式（word-local modes）刻画不同变化方向及其时间活动，并给出被归因分量的代表性文本段落。在高斯混合特化下证明算子和平方距离的参数可恢复性。
AI.result: 合成实验支持所预测的收敛率；在英语和德语 DWUG 基准上保持竞争力；能恢复受控的 Janus 变化剖面，且保持组合一致的输运；在大型美国法院意见语料上展示了无标注自然文本中的转变、模式与段落归因。
AI.conclusion: CUSP 使幅度、时机、机制、运动、模式与文本证据成为同一词汇历史相互兼容的多个视图，突破了传统标量距离方法的表达局限。

title: Does Uniform Discrete Diffusion Need Time?
summary: Uniform discrete diffusion models (UDMs) commonly use explicit time conditioning, but we find that it can often be unnecessary in practice. In this paper, we first show that the population-optimal UDM predictor generally depends on time: time controls how much the model should trust the observed context. We then show that this dependence can become negligible in finite-data settings relevant to language. When a corrupted training sequence remains much closer to its original clean sequence than to competing training sequences, the empirical-optimal predictor is nearly insensitive to time over most of the diffusion trajectory, where the guarantee weakens toward the high-noise endpoint. Empirically, trained language UDMs exhibit limited time sensitivity over most of the trajectory, while time-agnostic predictors remain competitive with, and often outperform, time-conditioned models across datasets and training objectives. These results challenge the use of explicit time conditioning in UDMs: although the population optimum depends on time, explicitly conditioning on it may often be unnecessary in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战均匀离散扩散模型（UDM）中普遍使用显式时间条件化的做法，指出在语言相关的有限数据设置下，该条件化往往并非必要。
AI.motivation: UDM通常默认引入显式时间条件化，但其必要性缺乏系统检验。作者希望厘清：时间条件化在理论最优预测器中的作用，以及在实际有限数据（尤其是语言任务）中是否仍不可替代。
AI.method: 先进行理论分析：证明总体最优UDM预测器一般依赖时间（时间控制模型对观测上下文的信任程度）；再论证在有限数据设置下，当被损坏的训练序列仍远更接近其原始干净序列而非其他竞争序列时，经验最优预测器在扩散轨迹的大部分区间上对时间几乎不敏感，仅在高噪声端点附近保证减弱。随后通过语言UDM的训练实验验证时间敏感度。
AI.result: 训练后的语言UDM在轨迹大部分区间表现出有限的时间敏感性；时间无关（time-agnostic）预测器在多个数据集与训练目标上不仅与时间条件化模型相当，且常优于后者。
AI.conclusion: 尽管总体上最优解依赖时间，但在实际语言建模场景中显式时间条件化可能常常是不必要的，这挑战了UDM中默认采用显式时间条件化的惯例。

title: CCRV-Bench: Constraint-Based Evaluation of Causal Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated excellent performance in visual tasks, but their visual causal reasoning capabilities still lack reliable evaluation. Existing evaluations struggle to distinguish whether a model is performing causal reasoning based on visual evidence or relying on statistical correlations for shortcut learning, thereby potentially overestimating their actual capabilities. This paper proposes CCRV-Bench, a constraint-driven visual causal reasoning benchmark for single-image physical scenarios. We construct an orthogonal framework that evaluates four causal task dimensions: causal relation discovery, state prediction, causal diagnosis, and intervention-outcome prediction. We further introduce entity symbolization, spatial grounding, the factual adversarial constraint, and minimalist output constraints to reduce shortcut cues while preserving the physical commonsense required by the task. Experiments across 14 multimodal models show that constraint sensitivity is task- and model-dependent: intervention-outcome prediction has the largest average effective degradation among the four causal tasks, spatial grounding is the most damaging constraint on average, and the factual adversarial constraint improves DCR for all evaluated models. These results show that unconstrained performance does not determine constrained robustness and that a single aggregate score can obscure distinct failures in causal identification, spatial grounding, and constraint-compliant expression. CCRV-Bench provides a standardized framework for diagnosing image-grounded causal reasoning under controlled constraints. The code is available at https://github.com/0815linyuan/CCRVBench

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CCRV-Bench，一个面向单图物理场景的约束驱动视觉因果推理基准，通过正交任务框架与多重约束削弱捷径线索，跨14个多模态模型揭示约束敏感性的任务与模型依赖性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉因果推理评测难以区分模型是基于视觉证据进行因果推理，还是依赖统计相关性进行捷径学习，容易高估模型的真实能力，因此亟需可控、可诊断的评测框架。
AI.method: 构建正交框架，覆盖四个因果任务维度：因果关系发现、状态预测、因果诊断、干预—结果预测；并引入实体符号化、空间落定、事实对抗约束与极简输出约束四类约束，在保留任务所需物理常识的同时削减捷径线索。
AI.result: 在14个多模态模型上的实验显示，约束敏感性具有任务与模型依赖性：干预—结果预测的平均有效性能下降最大，空间落定平均破坏性最强，事实对抗约束对所有评测模型均提升DCR；无约束性能不能决定约束下的鲁棒性，单一聚合分数会掩盖因果识别、空间落定与约束遵循表达上的不同失效模式。
AI.conclusion: CCRV-Bench 为受控约束下的图像依据型因果推理提供了标准化诊断框架，强调需以约束条件下的多维指标替代单一聚合分数来评估视觉因果推理能力。代码已开源。

title: FeatMark: Feature-level Watermark Protection against Mimicry Attacks with Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models enable data-efficient "mimicry" attacks, wherein adversaries fine-tune the model on a handful of public photos to synthesize convincing forgeries of a target individual. A common countermeasure is to embed imperceptible, low-energy watermarks, yet recent studies show these signatures are brittle: modest post-processing or lightweight adversarial perturbations readily suppress detection, exposing a fundamental tension between imperceptibility and robustness. We introduce FeatMark, a watermarking framework that shifts from pixel-level, energy-starved perturbations to inconspicuous semantic features: small, scene-consistent micro-features that remain natural to humans while providing a stronger, machine-verifiable provenance signal. FeatMark builds domain-specific feature banks that encode each watermark as a compact concept program, pairing open-vocabulary semantic cues with reliable edit regions and instruction templates. It then automatically selects features that are both feasible and executable and injects them through modular, mask-guided concept editing, yielding highly localized, scene-consistent micro-edits that are difficult to perceive. We conduct extensive experiments across VGGFace2, CelebA-HQ, and WikiArt, evaluating against 10 strong watermark removal/purification attacks (including regeneration-style purification) and several bespoke adaptive attacks tailored to FeatMark, to assess perceptual fidelity, watermark detection accuracy, and robustness. We further demonstrate FeatMark's extensibility to video mimicry attacks. The results show FeatMark remains virtually impervious, withstanding all evaluated attacks with negligible bit-accuracy and fidelity degradation.

AI.tldr: 提出FeatMark——一种从像素级低能量扰动转向语义级微特征的水印框架，将水印编码为紧凑的概念程序，并通过掩码引导的概念编辑注入场景一致的微编辑，在多项数据集及10种强攻击下保持极高的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型可被用于数据高效的"模仿"攻击：攻击者只需少量公开照片微调模型即可合成目标个体的逼真伪造图像。现有防御依赖不可感知的低能量水印，但这类签名脆弱，轻微后处理或轻量对抗扰动即可抑制检测，暴露出不可感知性与鲁棒性之间的根本矛盾。作者因此希望寻找一种既隐蔽又兼具机器可验证性的水印范式。
AI.method: FeatMark构建领域特定的特征库，将每个水印编码为紧凑的"概念程序"，结合开放词汇语义线索、可靠的编辑区域与指令模板；随后自动筛选出既可行又可执行的特征，并通过模块化、掩码引导的概念编辑将其注入图像，产生高度局部化、场景一致的微编辑。
AI.result: 在VGGFace2、CelebA-HQ与WikiArt上开展大量实验，针对10种强水印去除/净化攻击（含再生式净化）以及若干针对FeatMark定制的自适应攻击，评估感知保真度、水印检测准确率与鲁棒性，并进一步验证了向视频模仿攻击场景的可扩展性。结果显示FeatMark几乎不受影响，在所有评估攻击下比特准确率与保真度下降均可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 通过将水印从像素级能量扰动迁移到语义级微特征，FeatMark在保持视觉不可感知的同时显著提升了抗去除/净化的鲁棒性，为扩散模型时代的来源验证与模仿攻击防御提供了一种新范式。

title: STORM-Bench: Evaluating Online Video QA under Evolving and Incomplete Evidence
summary: Reliable online video question answering requires tracking state transitions while selectively abstaining when visual evidence is insufficient. Existing benchmarks focus on static recognition or long-range retrieval, rarely evaluating these coupled capabilities under evolving and incomplete evidence. We present STORM-Bench, comprising 5,736 questions across 630 compact, change-dense episodes spanning five egocentric domains (STORM-Real) and two controlled simulation subsets (STORM-Sim) at 1 FPS. Questions are stratified by a proxy for accumulated change intensity (Low, Medium, High) and query-time answerability (Known, Uncertain). To measure reliability, we introduce STORM-BR, a harmonic metric over joint answer-status correctness that exposes abstention failures masked by aggregate accuracy, alongside STORM-BR-ATTR for uncertainty attribution. Across 14 video LLMs, online accuracy peaks at 60.3\% (mean 51.7\%), whereas STORM-BR ranges from 5.7\% to 35.6\% (mean 18.8\%), driven by pervasive overconfidence on uncertain queries. STORM-Bench shows that task accuracy masks these gaps in epistemic reliability and state tracking. Benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/siruzhong/STORM-Bench.

AI.tldr: 提出STORM-Bench在线视频问答基准（5,736题，630个变化密集片段，5个第一视角域+2个模拟子集），并引入STORM-BR调和指标衡量“作答-弃答”联合正确性，揭示14个视频LLM在不确定问题上普遍过度自信，聚合准确率掩盖了认知可靠性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 可靠的在线视频问答需要同时追踪状态变化并在视觉证据不足时选择弃答（abstention）。然而现有基准多聚焦静态识别或长程检索，很少在证据持续演化且不完整的条件下评估这两项耦合能力，因而无法反映模型的认知可靠性（epistemic reliability）。
AI.method: 构建STORM-Bench：覆盖5个第一视角域（STORM-Real）与2个受控模拟子集（STORM-Sim），1 FPS采样，共630个紧凑、变化密集的episode、5,736个问题。问题按累积变化强度代理指标分为Low/Medium/High，按查询时可答性分为Known/Uncertain。提出STORM-BR：基于作答-状态联合正确性的调和平均数指标，暴露被聚合准确率掩盖的弃答失败；并提出STORM-BR-ATTR用于不确定性归因分析。
AI.result: 在14个视频LLM上，在线准确率最高60.3%（均值51.7%），而STORM-BR仅5.7%–35.6%（均值18.8%），主要源于对不确定查询的普遍过度自信。
AI.conclusion: STORM-Bench表明任务准确率会掩盖模型在认知可靠性与状态追踪上的明显差距，需采用联合作答-弃答指标进行评估。基准与代码已开源。

title: FARE: Forensic Acceptance Region Estimation for Catching Bait-and-Switch Image Generators
comment: This work has been accepted for publication in the proceedings of The 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). 22 pages, including technical appendices. Code: https://github.com/kaikaiyao/FARE
summary: Modern AI image generators are increasingly deployed as opaque APIs, where customers can query the deployed service, but cannot inspect model weights or architecture. This creates a practical challenge: a provider may pass governance certification with one generator and later silently switch to a cheaper and lower-quality one for deployment, compromising public trust or even safety in high-stakes domains. We study integrity auditing at deployment time and propose FARE (Forensic Acceptance Region Estimation). A certified generator is enrolled by training FARE on images sampled from that generator. After deployment, FARE can determine whether a generated image is consistent with the enrolled generator---using only that image. FARE's features are based on image generator-specific artifacts that have been proposed for forensic applications. FARE amplifies these features during training by finding hard samples that tighten the acceptance region and increase sensitivity to subtle changes in the certified generator. Across generator swaps, including substitutions with similar model versions and model variants, FARE is effective at detecting swaps, consistently outperforming existing baselines at strict operating points, and remains effective under the exact-model and decision-only attacks evaluated in this work.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FARE（Forensic Acceptance Region Estimation），一种部署时图像生成器完整性审计方法，仅凭单张生成图像即可判断其是否来自已认证的生成器，从而检测服务方暗中更换模型的"换模型"行为。
AI.motivation: AI图像生成器常以不透明API形式部署，用户无法检查模型权重或架构。因此服务提供方可能先用一个生成器通过治理认证，随后悄悄替换为更廉价、质量更低的模型，损害公众信任，在高风险领域甚至危及安全。现有工作缺乏对部署阶段这种完整性问题的有效审计手段。
AI.method: 提出FARE（Forensic Acceptance Region Estimation）。对已认证生成器进行"注册"：从其采样图像上训练FARE。部署后，FARE仅利用单张生成图像即可判定其是否与已注册生成器一致。其特征基于为取证应用提出的、图像生成器特有的伪影（artifacts）。训练中通过挖掘困难样本来放大这些特征，从而收紧接受域、提高对已认证生成器细微变化的敏感度。
AI.result: 在多种生成器替换场景下（包括替换为相似模型版本及模型变体），FARE均能有效检测替换；在严格工作点（strict operating points）下持续优于现有基线；并且在本文评估的精确模型攻击（exact-model）与仅决策攻击（decision-only）下仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: FARE为部署时生成器完整性审计提供了一种仅依赖单张图像的有效方案，能可靠检测认证后偷换模型的行为，并在不同替换类型与攻击条件下保持稳健，优于已有基线。

title: THA: Weighted Finite-State Text Normalization and Inverse Text Normalization for Khmer
summary: Text-to-speech needs written text in spoken form, and speech recognition output needs the reverse. For Khmer, neither direction has a maintained open-source tool, and the script makes both harder: words are not separated by spaces, and number words occur inside ordinary words. We present Tha, a Khmer text normalization and inverse text normalization toolkit built from weighted finite-state transducers. It segments and classifies a whole line in one shortest-path search, and a second transducer rejects token boundaries inside a Khmer syllable. On Google's Khmer test suite, Tha agrees with the reference on all 274 cardinals up to one spelling variant, and on 2,906 real TTS prompts, 153 of the 158 sentences it rewrites are correct. Tha is open source under the Apache 2.0 license.

AI.tldr: 提出 Tha，一个基于加权有限状态转换器的高棉语文本规范化与逆文本规范化工具包，通过单次最短路径搜索完成整行分词与分类，并用第二个转换器拒绝高棉语音节内部的标记边界，在谷歌高棉语测试集上表现接近完美。
AI.motivation: 高棉语的文本转语音需要将书面文本转为口语形式，语音识别输出则需要反向转换，但两个方向均缺乏维护良好的开源工具；此外高棉语书写系统增加了难度：词与词之间无空格分隔，且数字词可能出现在普通词内部。
AI.method: 构建基于加权有限状态转换器（WFST）的 Tha 工具包：在单次最短路径搜索中对整行文本进行分词与分类，并使用第二个转换器拒绝位于高棉语音节内部的标记边界。
AI.result: 在谷歌高棉语测试集上，Tha 对全部 274 个基数词与参考结果一致（仅一处拼写变体差异）；在 2,906 条真实 TTS 提示中，其改写的 158 个句子有 153 个正确。
AI.conclusion: Tha 有效解决了高棉语文本规范化与逆文本规范化中分词和数字词识别的难题，性能接近参考水平，并以 Apache 2.0 许可证开源。

title: Evaluating Sycophancy in Chinese Large Language Models on Factual Questions Derived from Online Search Queries
comment: 19 pages, 34 figures, 4 tables. Geng Liu and Feng Li contributed equally
summary: As large language models increasingly mediate information access, factually accurate and independent answers are critical. However, these models can exhibit sycophancy by aligning their responses with users' stated beliefs even when those beliefs are incorrect, potentially presenting misinformation as independently verified and reinforcing users' confidence in false claims. Prior work leaves unresolved whether introducing user beliefs causes correct responses to become incorrect or uncertain, or causes uncertain responses to become belief-aligned incorrect answers. It also remains unclear whether anti-sycophancy interventions preserve or restore factual accuracy or merely shift responses toward uncertainty. We analyze factual sycophancy in Chinese-language information seeking using yes/no fact-checking questions. Our analysis covers 364,941 responses from three frontier Chinese-based LLMs (DeepSeek, Qwen, and Doubao) to 12,165 factual questions derived from real-world Chinese search queries. We evaluate the models with and without reasoning across baseline, belief-conditioned, and anti-sycophancy prompting, tracing matched shifts among correct, incorrect, and uncertain responses. Under incorrect user beliefs, we distinguish belief-aligned errors from losses of factual confidence, in which initially correct answers become uncertain. Patterns vary across models and reasoning settings: reasoning is not a consistent safeguard, and anti-sycophancy instructions can reduce incorrect agreement while increasing uncertainty. In Chinese-language factual question answering, avoiding agreement with false beliefs is therefore not equivalent to preserving factual accuracy, highlighting the value of transition-level evaluation. Such behavior may undermine the reliability of LLM-mediated information access by reinforcing misinformation or weakening users' confidence in factually correct answers.

AI.tldr: 该研究以中文是非事实核查问题为对象，基于三个中文大模型（DeepSeek、Qwen、Doubao）对12,165个真实搜索问题产生的364,941条回答，追踪基线、用户信念条件化与反谄媚提示三种设定下正确、错误、不确定回答之间的配对转移，发现避免附和错误信念并不等于保持事实准确性。
AI.motivation: 大模型日益成为信息获取中介，但存在谄媚（sycophancy）倾向：即使用户信念错误，模型也可能顺应其立场，把错误信息包装成经独立验证的结论，强化用户对虚假主张的信心。既有工作未解决两个问题：引入用户信念究竟使原本正确的回答变为错误或变为不确定，还是使原本不确定的回答变为与信念一致的错误答案；反谄媚干预是保持/恢复事实准确性，还是仅把回答推向不确定。
AI.method: 采用中文是非事实核查问题，构建来自真实中文搜索查询的12,165个事实问题，对DeepSeek、Qwen、Doubao三个前沿中文基座模型在有无推理两种设置下采集364,941条回答。实验包含基线、信念条件化、反谄媚提示三类提示条件，并对正确、错误、不确定三类回答进行配对转移分析；在错误用户信念下进一步区分"信念一致型错误"与"事实信心丧失"（原本正确转为不确定）。
AI.result: 模式随模型与推理设置而异：推理并非一致性的保障；反谄媚指令可减少错误附和，但同时增加不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 在中文事实问答中，避免与错误信念一致并不等价于保持事实准确性，说明转移层面（transition-level）评估的必要性。此类行为会通过强化错误信息或削弱用户对正确回答的信心，损害LLM中介信息获取的可靠性。

title: Self-Supervised Perceptually Interpretable Monocular Depth Estimation
comment: Published at IEEE ICIP 2026; 6 pages, 4 figures
summary: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation (MDE) enables depth prediction from monocular images without requiring ground-truth supervision, making it attractive for large-scale and real-world applications. Despite steady improvements in accuracy, most existing methods remain difficult to interpret, as depth is inferred from RGB representations that obscure the impact of individual perceptual image components. This lack of transparency limits systematic analysis of failure cases and reduces confidence in safety-critical settings. This paper presents a self-supervised framework for perceptually interpretable monocular depth estimation (PIMDE), designed to associate depth predictions with distinct perceptual components of the input image. Rather than operating directly on RGB inputs, the proposed method decomposes each image into a set of perceptual feature maps (PFMs), each encoding a specific visual cue. Distinct depth estimation branches process these PFMs independently to produce depth estimates (PIDEs), which are subsequently combined through an explicit fusion strategy. This formulation allows us to examine directly the contribution of each perceptual cue to the final depth prediction. Experiments conducted on the KITTI benchmark dataset demonstrate that PIMDE achieves performance comparable to established self-supervised MDE methods while providing additional insight into how different perceptual cues influence depth estimation. These results indicate that perceptual decomposition can support interpretability without sacrificing depth estimation accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自监督的可感知解释性单目深度估计框架PIMDE，将图像分解为感知特征图，分别经独立分支估计深度后显式融合，在KITTI上达到与现有方法相当的性能并提升可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督单目深度估计（MDE）方法虽精度不断提升，但大多从RGB表示直接推断深度，掩盖了各感知图像分量的作用，导致难以解释、难以系统分析失败案例，降低了安全关键场景下的可信度。
AI.method: 提出PIMDE框架：不直接在RGB输入上操作，而是将每张图像分解为一组感知特征图（PFMs），每个PFM编码特定视觉线索；由不同的深度估计分支独立处理这些PFM，得到各感知深度估计（PIDEs），再通过显式融合策略组合，从而可直接考察每个感知线索对最终深度预测的贡献。
AI.result: 在KITTI基准数据集上的实验表明，PIMDE在取得与主流自监督MDE方法相当性能的同时，能额外揭示不同感知线索对深度估计的影响。
AI.conclusion: 感知分解可在不牺牲深度估计精度的前提下支持可解释性，为安全关键应用中的透明深度预测提供了可行路径。

title: PhoenixSR: Generative Heterogeneous Distillation Unleashes Efficient Models for Real-World Super-Resolution
summary: Real-world image super-resolution (SR) requires recovering perceptually realistic high-resolution images from complex low-resolution observations while preserving faithful content. Diffusion-based SR benefits from strong generative priors but incurs substantial computational overhead, whereas feed-forward CNN and Transformer SR models are efficient yet often struggle to recover realistic high-frequency details. This motivates a natural question: can diffusion priors be transferred to existing diffusion-free SR networks without introducing diffusion components at inference time? To this end, we propose PhoenixSR, a generative heterogeneous distillation framework that transfers diffusion priors to independently designed feed-forward SR networks through score-based distribution matching. Rather than aligning heterogeneous features or imitating sampled diffusion outputs, PhoenixSR uses the pretrained diffusion model as distribution-level supervision, while paired SR supervision preserves reconstruction fidelity. To make distribution matching effective for fidelity-sensitive SR, we introduce Heterogeneous Distribution Adaptation, which adapts the target score to the SR domain, improves tracking of the evolving student distribution, and anchors training with paired supervision. We further employ Directional Reliability Weighting, a lightweight residual-consistency-based reweighting strategy that reduces unstable distributional guidance. All diffusion-related components are removed after training, leaving the original student architecture and inference cost unchanged. Experiments on three SR benchmarks and six feed-forward backbones, including SwinIR, HAT, Real-ESRGAN, and SeeMoRe, show consistent perceptual improvements with largely preserved reconstruction fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出PhoenixSR，一种生成式异构蒸馏框架，将扩散先验通过基于分数的分布匹配迁移到无扩散的前馈SR网络，训练后移除所有扩散组件，保持学生网络结构与推理成本不变。
AI.motivation: 真实世界图像超分需在复杂低质观测下恢复感知逼真且内容忠实的高分辨率图像。扩散SR具有强生成先验但计算开销大，前馈CNN/Transformer高效却难以恢复逼真高频细节。因此产生一个问题：能否在不引入推理期扩散组件的前提下，将扩散先验迁移到现有无扩散SR网络？
AI.method: PhoenixSR以预训练扩散模型作为分布级监督，通过基于分数的分布匹配将扩散先验迁移到独立设计的前馈SR网络，并用配对SR监督保持重建保真度；而非对齐异构特征或模仿采样输出。为此提出异构分布自适应，将目标分数适配到SR域、更好跟踪演进中的学生分布并以配对监督锚定训练；同时提出方向可靠性加权，一种基于残差一致性的轻量重加权策略以削弱不稳定的分布引导。训练后移除所有扩散相关组件。
AI.result: 在三个SR基准和六个前馈骨干（含SwinIR、HAT、Real-ESRGAN、SeeMoRe）上实验显示，感知质量一致提升，同时重建保真度基本保持。
AI.conclusion: PhoenixSR表明扩散先验可在不增加推理成本的情况下有效迁移至无扩散前馈SR网络，实现感知与保真度的良好平衡。

title: PICO: Projection-Informed Consistency Optimisation for 6DoF Surgical Tool Pose Estimation
summary: Purpose: Accurate 6 DoF pose estimation of surgical tools is critical for automa- tion, robotic proprioception, and safe interaction with the tissue operated on. Kinematics-based approaches suffer from accumulated errors due to the cable- driven nature of robotic arms, while vision-based methods often rely on external markers or trackers. Although more recent vision-based advances have been pro- posed, these two-stage pose estimation methods often lack real-time robustness due to accumulated errors and computational overhead. Methods: We propose a novel end-to-end trainable model, PICO. Our model employs a multi-task learning architecture to predict segmentation and depth maps, alongside regression of translation and rotation parameters. We define two proxy tasks that enforce geometric consistency in both 2D and 3D spaces, improving accuracy and robustness. For this, we propose a projection loss, and a point-to-point loss. Results: We evaluate our method on the SurgRIPE dataset, benchmarking its performance against state-of-the-art approaches using standard 6DoF pose esti- mation metrics. Our results demonstrate consistently strong performance across all four subsets, specifically in rotation, ranking second even under occlusion. It also demonstrates comparable translational performance, remaining competitive, especially in occluded cases. Conclusion: PICO demonstrates the effectiveness of multi-task learning and geometry-aware proxy tasks for robust and reliable surgical tool pose estimation, especially in occluded scenarios, highlighting potential for future applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出端到端可训练模型PICO，通过多任务学习与几何一致性代理任务（投影损失、点对点损失）实现手术器械6DoF位姿估计，在SurgRIPE数据集上表现优于或接近SOTA，尤其遮挡场景下鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 手术器械精确6DoF位姿估计对自动化、机器人本体感知及组织安全交互至关重要。运动学方法因机械臂线驱动特性存在误差累积；视觉方法多依赖外部标记或跟踪器，且两阶段位姿估计方法受累积误差与计算开销影响，缺乏实时鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出端到端可训练模型PICO，采用多任务学习架构：预测分割图与深度图，同时回归平移与旋转参数；定义两个代理任务以在2D和3D空间强制几何一致性，并提出投影损失（projection loss）与点对点损失（point-to-point loss）。
AI.result: 在SurgRIPE数据集上以标准6DoF位姿估计指标与SOTA方法对比，在全部四个子集上表现稳定；旋转精度排名第二，遮挡下亦如此；平移性能具竞争力，遮挡情况下表现尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: PICO验证了多任务学习与几何感知代理任务在手术器械位姿估计中的有效性，可在遮挡场景下实现鲁棒可靠的估计，具有未来应用潜力。

title: FLIP: Final Layer Inference-Time Probing for Vision-Language Models
comment: 25 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea
summary: We present FLIP, a final-layer inference-time probe for testing whether a logit-facing intervention site in an open-weight vision-language model (VLM) supports structured, task-linked computation rather than generic perturbation. Behavioral change under internal intervention is otherwise mechanistically ambiguous: it may reflect improved use of visual evidence, generic output instability, or outright degradation. FLIP applies elementwise flooring to the final normalized hidden state before logit computation, leaving parameters, prompts, and decoding unchanged. On a controlled detection/counting probe, sweeping intervention strength reveals three regions: negligible change, a bounded interior regime in which detection recall at IoU 0.50 ($R_{50}$) improves while tolerant counting error ($\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{count}}$) falls, and over-suppression. We formalize a four-criterion probe-and-sweep protocol for disciplining the interpretation of intervention effects: regime structure, grounding-proxy alignment, feature-coherence dependence, and failure to reproduce the same positive regime on a performance-based negative control. The post-normalization state passed to the output head is the logit-facing instantiation of this test; under a non-targeted flooring sweep it satisfies the full protocol. Raw decoder-layer interventions, including the last-block output before final normalization, and the singleton-pair left/right control fail to reproduce the Final-site signature, while same-site operators and multiple VLMs replicate it. FLIP is therefore a validation step for intervention-based mechanistic interpretability, not a steering method. Repo at https://github.com/earl-juanico/flip-qwen3vl/

AI.tldr: FLIP 是一种面向开放权重视觉语言模型（VLM）的末层推理时探针，通过元素级置底（flooring）扰动最终归一化隐状态，并用"探针-扫描"协议判别干预效应是否具有结构化、任务相关的机制性含义。
AI.motivation: 内部干预导致的行为变化在机制上具有歧义：可能源于更有效地利用视觉证据、通用输出不稳定，或单纯的性能退化。既有研究缺乏对"某干预位点是否承载结构化任务计算"的判定标准，因此需要一个可验证的验证性工具。
AI.method: FLIP 在 logit 计算前对最终归一化隐状态施加元素级 flooring，不改动参数、提示与解码。在受控的检测/计数任务上扫描干预强度，观察区域结构；提出四项判据协议：区域结构、grounding 代理对齐、特征一致性依赖、以及在基于性能的负控制上无法复现同一正向区域。同时对比原始解码层干预（含最后一模块输出、归一化前）与单例配对左右控制。
AI.result: 扫描呈现三个区域：近似无变化区、有界内部区（IoU 0.50 下检测召回率 R50 提升、容忍计数误差 E_count 下降）、以及过度抑制区。归一化后馈入输出头的状态满足完整协议；原始解码层干预与单例左右控制无法复现 Final-site 特征，而同位点算子与多个 VLM 可复现。
AI.conclusion: FLIP 是干预式机制可解释性的验证步骤，而非引导/操控方法；它为判别 logit 面向干预位点是否支持结构化任务计算提供了可操作的判据框架。

title: Can Pixels Alone Reveal Image Origin? Minimax Limits and Learnable Interfaces for Passive Provenance
comment: Accepted at the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). 29 pages, including technical appendices. Code: https://github.com/kaikaiyao/pixels-alone-provenance
summary: Passive image provenance asks whether pixels alone can reveal where an image came from: a human, an aggregate AI class, or a particular generator. This becomes a robustness problem once a source image can be edited before the verifier sees it. We study the problem as source--target verification under adversarial distribution shift. Our first result gives the exact best-case limit for any image-only verifier: the largest robust target-acceptance gap equals the minimum total-variation distance between the target distribution and the set of attacked source distributions. This quantity depends on the source, target, and edit class, not on the verifier architecture. Our second result explains why deployed public verifiers can fail before this statistical limit is reached. If the verifier can be emulated on the attack region to error $\varepsilon$, then a surrogate black-box attack reaches target acceptance within $2\varepsilon$ plus optimization error of the white-box optimum; score-revealing logistic and softmax heads over public features are identifiable, and approximate score access gives stable recovery bounds. A finite-state experiment checks the minimax identity where both sides are computable. On same-prompt real/diffusion benchmarks, the evaluated public CLIP verifiers fail under targeted pixel attacks, while a ResNet-18 victim exhibits partial fake-to-real transfer. Binary feedback with abstention reduces measured attack success, but positive empirical gap upper bounds do not establish robustness. These results motivate separate evaluation of the source--target statistical ceiling and the information released by a deployed verifier.

AI.tldr: 本文将被动图像溯源建模为对抗分布偏移下的源-目标验证问题，给出任意图像验证器的精确最优鲁棒目标接受差距（等于目标分布与受攻击源分布集合之间的最小全变差距离），并解释公开验证器为何在统计极限之前失效：验证器在攻击区域可被 emulated 时，替代黑盒攻击能达到接近白盒最优的目标接受。实验在有限状态与真实/扩散基准上验证了极小极大恒等式，并显示公开 CLIP 验证器在定向像素攻击下失效。
AI.motivation: 被动图像溯源需仅凭像素判断图像来源（人类、某类 AI 或特定生成器）。一旦源图像在验证前可被编辑，问题即变为鲁棒性问题。作者希望区分两个层面：源-目标统计上限（与验证器架构无关）与已部署验证器实际泄露的信息，从而解释公开验证器为何会失效。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为对抗分布偏移下的源-目标验证。第一个结果推导任意仅图像验证器的最优鲁棒目标接受差距，证明其等于目标分布与受攻击源分布集合之间的最小全变差距离。第二个结果给出替代黑盒攻击界：若验证器在攻击区域可被 emulated 至误差 ε，则替代黑盒攻击达到目标接受的误差在 2ε 加优化误差之内，接近白盒最优；并证明基于公开特征的 score-revealing logistic/softmax 头可被识别，近似分数访问给出稳定恢复界。用有限状态实验检验极小极大恒等式（两侧均可计算）。
AI.result: 有限状态实验验证了极小极大恒等式。在同提示词的真实/扩散基准上，受评估的公开 CLIP 验证器在定向像素攻击下失效，而 ResNet-18 受害者表现出部分 fake-to-real 迁移。带弃权的二元反馈可降低实测攻击成功率，但正的实证差距上界不能确立鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 应分别评估源-目标统计上限与已部署验证器所释放的信息；公开验证器的失效可能出现在统计极限之前，源于验证器可被 emulated 与分数泄露，而非统计上限本身。

title: ZooWork-ShopRanker: An Open, Preference-Aligned E-Commerce Reranker
summary: Open rerankers trained for general web retrieval transfer imperfectly to e-commerce, where ranking decisions depend not only on topical relevance but also on user preferences, product constraints, and comparative product fit. These preference signals are difficult to supervise at scale: real search traffic provides authentic queries and candidates but no clean pairwise labels. We present ZooWork-ShopRanker, a family of e-commerce rerankers (0.6B, 4B, and 8B) aligned to judge-labeled shopping preference. Training pairs are labeled by a panel of reasoning large language models (LLMs) from different families acting as a preference oracle, with position-debiased judgments and agreement tiers, and the rerankers are trained on these labels. The aligned 8B flagship then serves as a distillation teacher for the efficient 4B and 0.6B models, which are fit to its scores and sharpened on judged pairs. To measure progress, we introduce ShopRank-Bench, a contamination-limited benchmark of ~10,000 private-traffic preference pairs in both text formats, tiered by how many judge families committed to each label. ZooWork-ShopRanker-8B and -4B significantly outperform the strongest open reranker baseline, every model significantly beats its own un-aligned base, and ZooWork-ShopRanker-0.6B beats its size peer; the gains hold in both formats and extend to common MTEB benchmarks. We release the models and the dual-format ShopRank-Bench to facilitate further research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ZooWork-ShopRanker 电商重排序模型家族（0.6B/4B/8B），通过多家族推理 LLM 作为偏好标注 Oracle 生成去偏训练对，并对小模型进行蒸馏；同时发布双格式基准 ShopRank-Bench，实验证明其在电商偏好排序上显著优于开源基线并泛化至 MTEB。
AI.motivation: 通用网页检索训练的开放重排序器难以迁移到电商场景，因为电商排序不仅依赖主题相关性，还取决于用户偏好、商品约束与比较性适配。这些偏好信号难以规模化监督：真实搜索流量虽提供真实查询与候选，却缺乏干净的成对标签。
AI.method: 构建 ZooWork-ShopRanker（0.6B、4B、8B），对齐到 judge 标注的购物偏好。训练对由来自不同家族的多个推理 LLM 组成的偏好 Oracle 标注，采用位置去偏判断与一致性分层；8B 旗舰模型作为蒸馏教师，指导 4B 与 0.6B 拟合其分数并在标注对上锐化。同时提出污染受限的 ShopRank-Bench，约 1 万条私有流量偏好对，覆盖两种文本格式，并按承诺标签的 judge 家族数量分层。
AI.result: ZooWork-ShopRanker-8B 与 -4B 显著优于最强开放重排序基线，每个模型均显著优于自身未对齐基座，0.6B 优于同尺寸同类模型；增益在两种格式下均成立，并扩展到常见 MTEB 基准。
AI.conclusion: 通过多 LLM 偏好 Oracle 标注与蒸馏对齐，可有效将通用重排序器迁移至电商偏好排序；作者开源模型与双格式 ShopRank-Bench 以促进后续研究。

title: TRACKGRAPH: Online Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs via Image-Space Tracking
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D maps enable robots to reason about previously unknown environments using natural language. However, existing systems typically segment every incoming image, associate detections with persistent 3D segments, and frequently perform costly Vision-Language (VL) inference.
