We present TRACKGRAPH, an online open-vocabulary system that maintains short-term 2D mask identity directly in the image stream before fusing segments into 3D. FastSAM masks and CLIP features are computed at sparse keyframes, while dense DINOv3 features are used to propagate masks at a high rate in between. The resulting tracked masks are fused into a class-agnostic 3D segment layer within a hierarchical scene graph, with 3D association handling tracking interruptions and long-term revisits. Compact multi-view CLIP embeddings enable open-vocabulary retrieval. Across Replica, ScanNet++, and HM3D, TRACKGRAPH achieves competitive open-vocabulary segmentation and retrieval against state-of-the-art mapping methods, including the highest synonym frequency on Replica (0.50). On the same NVIDIA A100, it is 1.7x faster and uses 3.3x less GPU memory than ViT-H OVI-MAP. Real-world quadruped deployments demonstrate onboard scene graph construction and object search at 7.5Hz, while recorded drone data is used to test the method under aerial viewpoints.

AI.tldr: TRACKGRAPH 提出一种在线开放词汇 3D 建图系统，先在图像流中维持短期 2D 掩码身份再融合为 3D 分割，兼顾效率与性能。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇 3D 建图系统通常对每帧图像进行分割，并将检测结果与持久 3D 分割关联，同时频繁执行昂贵的视觉-语言（VL）推理，导致计算和显存开销大，难以满足机器人实时在线运行需求。
AI.method: 在稀疏关键帧上计算 FastSAM 掩码与 CLIP 特征，关键帧之间利用稠密 DINOv3 特征以高帧率传播掩码，从而在图像流中直接维持短期 2D 掩码身份；随后将跟踪掩码融合到分层场景图中的类别无关 3D 分割层，并通过 3D 关联处理跟踪中断与长期重访；采用紧凑的多视角 CLIP 嵌入实现开放词汇检索。
AI.result: 在 Replica、ScanNet++ 和 HM3D 上，TRACKGRAPH 的开放词汇分割与检索性能与最先进建图方法相当，在 Replica 上取得最高同义词频率（0.50）。在相同 NVIDIA A100 上，相比 ViT-H OVI-MAP 速度提升 1.7 倍，显存占用减少 3.3 倍。真实四足机器人部署实现机载场景图构建与目标搜索，达到 7.5Hz；并使用录制的无人机数据测试空中视角下的表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过将 2D 掩码跟踪前置并减少高频 VL 推理，TRACKGRAPH 在保持竞争性开放词汇建图性能的同时显著提升效率与显存表现，并验证了在真实机器人平台上的在线运行能力。

title: G$^2$PTQ: Improving LLM Post-Training Quantization with Generalized Gradient Compensation
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is a practical approach to reducing the memory and computational footprint of large language models (LLMs) without retraining. GPTQ-based methods have become the de facto standard, yet they suffer from two complementary limitations. Methods with local, layer-wise objectives lack global supervision; while methods with global objectives fix their Hessian estimates at the start and ignore first-order gradients, so their guidance grows stale as quantization proceeds. This paper presents G$^2$PTQ, a unified PTQ framework with Generalized Gradient Compensation that integrates both first- and second-order information under a globally supervised, block-wise optimization objective. By refreshing gradient and Hessian estimates before quantizing each Transformer block, G$^2$PTQ avoids the staleness of prior global methods. Furthermore, to stabilize the exact first-order compensation, we introduce a trust-region scaling mechanism that dynamically bounds the gradient step to prevent exploding weight updates. Finally, we derive efficient implementations for block-wise Hessian approximation and exact gradient compensation. Experimental results on various model families and bit-widths demonstrate that G$^2$PTQ enables better alignment with the full-precision model, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Code is available at: https://github.com/G2PTQ/G2PTQ.

AI.tldr: 提出G$^2$PTQ统一后训练量化框架，结合一阶与二阶信息并在全局监督的块级目标下优化，通过刷新梯度/Hessian估计与信赖域缩放，优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: GPTQ类后训练量化方法存在两类互补局限：局部逐层目标缺乏全局监督；而全局目标方法在开始时固定Hessian估计且忽略一阶梯度，导致量化推进中指导信息逐渐过时。
AI.method: G$^2$PTQ（广义梯度补偿）：在全局监督的块级优化目标下整合一阶与二阶信息；在量化每个Transformer块前刷新梯度与Hessian估计以避免陈旧性；引入信赖域缩放机制动态约束梯度步以防权重更新爆炸；并推导块级Hessian近似与精确梯度补偿的高效实现。
AI.result: 在多种模型家族与不同比特宽度上，G$^2$PTQ与全精度模型对齐更好，性能优于当前最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: G$^2$PTQ通过全局监督的块级优化与梯度、Hessian动态刷新及信赖域缩放，统一了一阶与二阶量化补偿，实现了更优的PTQ效果。

title: Same Text, Different Numbers: The Divergence of LLM-Based Measures
summary: Researchers increasingly use generative large language models (LLMs) to convert corporate text into empirical variables. We examine the extent to which LLM-based textual measures are invariant to model choice using thirteen measures, including sentiment, management clarity, uncertainty, answer specificity, and climate and political risk. Seven LLMs from different providers score earnings call transcripts of S&P 500 companies on these constructs. Cross-model rank correlations average only 0.52, and transcript-level differences common across providers account for only 34% of total score variation. Cross-model disagreement does not predict subsequent analyst or market disagreement, consistent with a substantial model-specific component rather than common ambiguity in the underlying disclosure. Model choice significantly affects downstream inference, with coefficient magnitudes, signs, and statistical significance varying substantially across models. Averaging across providers makes transcript rankings more stable for most constructs, but score levels remain sensitive to the models included in the ensemble. LLM-generated variables should therefore be treated as model-contingent measurements and validated across providers.

AI.tldr: 基于13个文本构念、7个厂商LLM对S&P 500财报电话会议文本打分，跨模型排序相关性平均仅0.52，模型选择显著影响下游推断；LLM文本变量应被视为"模型条件性测量"并做跨厂商验证。
AI.motivation: 研究者日益广泛地用生成式大语言模型将企业文本转化为实证变量，但这类测量的可靠性前提——即测量结果是否对模型选择保持不变（measurement invariance）——尚未得到系统检验。若不同模型给出差异很大的取值，则基于LLM变量的结论可能只是模型选择的产物。
AI.method: 构建13个文本构念（情感、管理层表达清晰度、不确定性、回答具体性、气候风险、政治风险等），由来自不同厂商的7个LLM对S&P 500公司财报电话会议记录（transcript）逐一打分。通过跨模型排序相关性、方差分解（区分transcript层面共有差异与模型特异成分）、与后续分析师/市场分歧的关联检验，以及下游回归中系数大小、符号与显著性的跨模型比较来评估模型不变性；并考察跨厂商集成（ensemble averaging）对排序与分数水平的影响。
AI.result: 跨模型排序相关性平均仅0.52；在所有厂商间共同的transcript层面差异仅解释总分数变异的34%，说明存在显著的模型特异成分。跨模型分歧并不能预测后续分析师或市场分歧，这与"模型特异成分"而非"底层披露本身的共同模糊性"一致。模型选择显著影响下游推断：回归系数的大小、符号和统计显著性在不同模型间差异明显。跨厂商平均可提升多数构念下transcript排序的稳定性，但分数水平仍对纳入集成的具体模型敏感。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的文本测度并非模型不变的，而应被视为"模型条件性测量"（model-contingent measurements）；研究者在生成与使用这类实证变量时需进行跨厂商验证，并在稳健性设计中明确报告模型选择的影响。

title: Refining Cytology Predictions with Conditional Random Fields
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong zero-shot (ZS) classification on histology images but do not perform as well on cytology, whose stains and cell morphology differ markedly compared to histology. Conditional random fields (CRFs) can refine noisy VLM predictions by propagating information across patches, but existing CRF frameworks were designed for histopathology and do not transfer to cytology datasets, released as independent patch pools spanning multiple staining protocols. We introduce CytoCRF, which adapts the pairwise terms to cytology by targeting chromatin and cytology-specific staining, and further enrich the neighborhood of each potential term by combining multiple backbones. Across ten cytology datasets, CytoCRF outperforms existing CRF frameworks at every annotation budget, reaching +13.6 percentage points over the best baseline and +33.7 over ZS with only 50 annotations. Combining information from multiple backbones brings further gains, showing that the neighborhood topology matters more than the pairwise potential computed over it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CytoCRF，一种针对细胞学图像的条件随机场框架，通过适配染色质/染色特征的一元与成对势项并融合多主干网络邻域，在十个细胞学数据集上以低标注预算显著超越现有CRF与零样本基线。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在组织学图像零样本分类上表现优异，但在细胞学图像上因染色与细胞形态差异明显而效果下降；现有CRF框架面向组织病理学设计，无法迁移到以独立图块池形式发布、跨越多种染色方案的细胞学数据集。
AI.method: 提出CytoCRF：针对染色质与细胞学特有染色调整成对势项（pairwise terms），并通过组合多个骨干网络（backbones）丰富每个势项的邻域（neighborhood），从而在有限标注下优化含噪的VLM预测。
AI.result: 在十个细胞学数据集上，CytoCRF在每个标注预算下均优于现有CRF框架；仅用50个标注即比最佳基线提升+13.6个百分点，比零样本提升+33.7个百分点。融合多骨干信息带来进一步增益，表明邻域拓扑比其上的成对势计算更重要。
AI.conclusion: CytoCRF有效将CRF适配至细胞学场景并借助多骨干邻域融合提升低标注条件下的分类性能，证明邻域拓扑结构对细胞学CRF设计具有关键作用。

title: TempQ-Jail: Query-Constrained Candidate Ranking for Text-to-Video Jailbreak Attacks
summary: Existing text-to-video (T2V) jailbreak methods mainly seek more effective or stealthier attack candidates. In guarded T2V systems, however, video generation and security evaluation are costly, so an attacker often cannot test a large candidate pool. We therefore formulate T2V jailbreak as a query-constrained candidate allocation and ranking problem and propose TempQ-Jail. The method combines heterogeneous attack mechanisms to expand candidate coverage, estimates each candidate's end-to-end attack value from security-gate passage, dangerous visual generation, preservation of the original intent, and temporal validity, and ranks candidates so that high-value attacks appear early in a limited query trajectory. We evaluate TempQ-Jail on CogVideoX-5B using 70 common viable intents derived from T2VSafetyBench and compare it with six representative T2V jailbreak methods under a unified protocol. TempQ-Jail achieves TP-ASR@5 and TP-ASR@10 of 48.9% and 65.4%, improving over the strongest baselines by 4.6 and 4.0 percentage points, respectively. It also obtains the highest AUC-TP (0.469) and the lowest AvgQ (6.3). Analyses of query trajectories, candidate allocation, failure attribution, and ablations show that TempQ-Jail more effectively identifies and prioritises candidates with complete attack potential under limited query budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出 TempQ-Jail，将文本到视频越狱建模为查询受限下的候选分配与排序问题，在有限查询预算内优先暴露高价值攻击候选。
AI.motivation: 现有 T2V 越狱方法主要追求更强或更隐蔽的攻击候选，但在受防护 T2V 系统中视频生成与安全评估代价高昂，攻击者无法测试大规模候选池，因此需要研究查询受限条件下的候选分配与排序问题。
AI.method: 融合异构攻击机制以扩大候选覆盖；从安全门通过、危险视觉生成、原始意图保持、时序有效性四方面估计候选的端到端攻击价值；据此对候选排序，使高价值攻击在有限查询轨迹中尽早出现。
AI.result: 在 CogVideoX-5B 上，基于 T2VSafetyBench 衍生的 70 个常见可用意图，与六种代表性 T2V 越狱方法在统一协议下对比，TempQ-Jail 的 TP-ASR@5 与 TP-ASR@10 分别达 48.9% 和 65.4%，较最强基线提升 4.6 与 4.0 个百分点；同时取得最高 AUC-TP（0.469）和最低 AvgQ（6.3）。
AI.conclusion: 查询轨迹、候选分配、失败归因与消融分析表明，TempQ-Jail 在有限查询预算下能更有效地识别并优先选择具备完整攻击潜力的候选。

title: Exploiting Spatial Structure for Transductive Few-Shot Classification of Whole-Slide Images
summary: Automating the analysis of whole-slide images (WSIs), a key step in cancer diagnosis, has high clinical value, as it can reduce pathologist's workload while improving diagnosis accuracy. Recently, vision-language models have shown promising performance for patch-level classification without requiring any annotation, yet these zero-shot (ZS) predictions remain noisy on fine-grained tasks and must be further refined. A promising direction is to refine all predictions jointly, i.e., a transductive approach. However, most existing methods are not tailored to WSIs. We thus propose SlideTIM, an adaptation to WSIs of the recent transductive approach LC-TIM, which introduces a combined spatial--latent regularizer together with a prior on the patch class distribution. The former enforces spatially and semantically close patches to receive the same predictions, while the prior calibrates the predicted class proportions. Together, they address the complex spatial organization and the strong class imbalance of WSIs. Evaluated on four histology datasets, SlideTIM consistently outperforms all TIM variants, improving the macro-F1 by +8.1pp over the best competing baseline at 1 shot. Compared to the ZS, it raises the macro-F1 by +19.4pp at 1 shot. The code will be made available after submission.

AI.tldr: 提出SlideTIM，将转导式方法LC-TIM适配到全幻灯片图像，通过空间-隐空间正则化与类别分布先验提升零样本补丁级分类性能。
AI.motivation: 全幻灯片图像分析对癌症诊断有高临床价值，可减轻病理学家负担并提高诊断准确性。视觉语言模型在无标注补丁级分类上表现有前景，但零样本预测在细粒度任务上噪声较大，需进一步精炼。联合精炼所有预测的转导式方法是潜在方向，但现有方法未针对WSI设计。
AI.method: 提出SlideTIM，将近期转导式方法LC-TIM适配到WSI。引入组合的空间-隐空间正则化器与补丁类别分布先验：前者使空间和语义上接近的补丁获得相同预测，后者校准预测的类别比例，从而应对WSI复杂的空间组织和强类别不平衡。
AI.result: 在四个组织学数据集上评估，SlideTIM一致优于所有TIM变体，在1 shot设置下相比最佳竞争基线macro-F1提升+8.1pp；相比零样本，1 shot下macro-F1提升+19.4pp。
AI.conclusion: SlideTIM通过针对WSI特性的转导式适配，有效精炼零样本补丁级预测，在多种组织学数据集上取得显著且一致的性能提升，代码将在投稿后公开。

title: KuaFu: Compressing Long User Behavior into Understanding at Billion Scale
summary: Conversational agents, generative recommenders, and personalized advertising all rest on one capability: understanding each user from raw behavior. Prevailing industrial practice is task-specific: for each task, a relevant subsequence is extracted from the full history and a dedicated model trained on it. In production it hits two bottlenecks. First, even after filtering, a single-task sequence stays extremely long: content-interest summarization reads several hundred items per user, tens of thousands of tokens once serialized as prompt text. Second, profiles are refreshed routinely: a billion users weekly, roughly 100K QPM in aggregate, which under a fixed GPU budget sets a hard throughput floor. Compression is therefore mandatory, yet truncation or coarse compression can silently distort the profile, introducing four hallucination types (fabrication, omission, date misattribution, broken logic) that, with no way to evaluate the compressed representation itself, surface only as diffuse degradation in downstream metrics. We present KuaFu, a unified behavior-compression layer whose minimal unit is one behavior item. A two-axis projector compresses each item into 2-4 tokens of width 128-256 (about 10x along the token axis, 20x along width; per-item cache 10 KB to 0.5 KB), with fidelity-oriented four-stage training and layered intermediate evaluation. Across four production profiling tasks it matches or exceeds uncompressed single-task production models on all five headline metrics, raises per-GPU throughput by 37%-350%, and saves 190 GPUs. On public benchmarks it nearly always beats prior compressors at the same compression ratio (up to +17.7 EM on out-of-domain MRQA); on RecBench, a 4B model surpasses its 8B counterpart by 1.90 points. KuaFu has run on the Tencent advertising and recommendation platform for ten months, lifting overall GMV by 1.37%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 KuaFu——一个以单个行为为最小单元的通用行为压缩层，通过双轴投影器与四阶段训练，把用户长行为序列压缩为高保真表征，在工业推荐/广告系统中同时实现精度提升与吞吐量大幅增长。
AI.motivation: 现有工业实践为每个任务单独抽取子序列并训练专用模型，面临两大瓶颈：(1) 单任务序列依然极长（数百条内容、数万 token）；(2) 用户画像需高频刷新（每周十亿用户、聚合约 100K QPM），在固定 GPU 预算下存在硬性吞吐下限。压缩是必需的，但截断或粗粒度压缩会静默扭曲画像，产生四类幻觉（捏造、遗漏、日期错配、逻辑断裂），且压缩表征本身缺乏评估手段，只能表现为下游指标的弥散性退化。
AI.method: KuaFu 以单条行为为最小压缩单元。采用双轴投影器将每条行为压缩为 2-4 个 token、宽度 128-256（token 轴约 10 倍、宽度轴约 20 倍压缩；单条缓存从 10 KB 降至 0.5 KB）。训练上使用面向保真度的四阶段流程，并配合分层的中间评估来直接检验压缩表征质量。
AI.result: 在四个生产画像任务上，KuaFu 在全部五项核心指标上追平或超过未压缩的单任务生产模型，单 GPU 吞吐提升 37%-350%，节省 190 张 GPU。公开基准上，相同压缩率下几乎全面优于既有压缩器（域外 MRQA 最高 +17.7 EM）；在 RecBench 上 4B 模型超过其 8B 对照 1.90 分。该系统已在腾讯广告与推荐平台运行十个月，整体 GMV 提升 1.37%。
AI.conclusion: 以行为为最小单元的通用压缩层能够在保持甚至提升下游精度的同时显著降低序列长度与计算开销，兼顾吞吐与保真度，并已在超大规模工业平台上取得可观的业务收益，验证了统一行为压缩作为基础层的可行性。

title: Modeling Student Sensemaking with LLMs and Knowledge-Graph-Guided Inference
summary: Collaborative science learning requires nuanced interpretation of student dialogue to characterize how learners identify knowledge gaps, build explanations, and work toward resolution - a theory-driven analysis that is labor-intensive and difficult to scale. We investigate whether instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) can support multidimensional analysis of collaborative sensemaking without task-specific training, and whether structured knowledge-state information improves model inference. We evaluate two mid-size LLMs on 23 richly annotated, expert-labeled episodes across prompting conditions that vary definitional scaffolding, reasoning mode, and turn structure. Without reasoning, models tend to overpredict successful sensemaking; reasoning-enabled prompting improves identification of unsuccessful cases. Knowledge-state diagnostics provide additional grounding, improving detection of unsuccessful sensemaking and increasing agreement with expert annotations. No single configuration performs best across all sensemaking dimensions, underscoring the multidimensional nature of the task.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估中等规模指令微调 LLM 在不进行任务特定训练的条件下，对协作科学学习中多维度意义建构进行自动分析的可行性，并检验结构化知识状态信息对模型推理的增益。
AI.motivation: 协作科学学习需要对学习者对话进行细致的解释性分析，以刻画其如何识别知识缺口、建构解释并推进问题解决；此类分析理论驱动、劳动密集且难以规模化，因此需要探索可扩展的自动化方案。
AI.method: 在两个中等规模指令微调 LLM 上，对 23 个标注丰富、由专家标注的协作意义建构片段进行评估；设置多种提示条件，变化定义性支架、推理模式与对话轮次结构，并引入知识状态诊断信息作为附加依据。
AI.result: 无推理提示时模型倾向于过度预测成功的意义建构；启用推理的提示能改善对不成功案例的识别。知识状态诊断提供额外依据，进一步提升对不成功意义建构的检测并增强与专家标注的一致性。没有任何单一配置在所有意义建构维度上均表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 指令微调 LLM 可在无任务特定训练条件下支持多维协作意义建构分析，推理提示与知识状态信息是有益的补充，但任务的多维性意味着需按维度选择配置，尚不存在通用最优方案。

title: Where Compute Matters: Heterogeneous Attention for Efficient Video Diffusion
summary: Efficient video generation requires reducing the quadratic cost of self-attention over long spatio-temporal token sequences. Existing efficient-attention methods typically apply the same computation pattern to every token, even though denoising difficulty varies substantially across video regions and evolves throughout the generation process. We introduce HetA-DiT, a heterogeneous attention mechanism that adaptively allocates computation according to token difficulty. A lightweight uncertainty branch predicts a token-wise estimate of denoising difficulty, which is used to route uncertain tokens through dense global attention while processing more reliable tokens with efficient local attention. The resulting routing is content- and timestep-adaptive, retains global context where it matters most, and provides a single parameter for controlling the quality-efficiency trade-off. HetA-DiT is compatible with few-step distribution-matching distillation and introduces no additional Transformer evaluation at inference time by reusing uncertainty estimates from the preceding denoising step. We evaluate the method on DMD-distilled Wan2.2-5B and Wan2.1-1.3B models. Across VBench, VBench-2.0, and human preference evaluation, HetA-DiT maintains competitive generation quality while routing only approximately 20% of tokens through dense attention.

AI.tldr: HetA-DiT 提出一种异构注意力机制，根据 token 去噪难度自适应分配计算：用轻量不确定性分支预测 token 难度，将高不确定 token 路由到稠密全局注意力、可靠 token 用高效局部注意力，仅需约20% token 走稠密注意力即可保持竞争性视频生成质量，且兼容少步蒸馏、推理时无额外 Transformer 开销。
AI.motivation: 视频生成中自注意力对长时空 token 序列的二次复杂度代价高昂。现有高效注意力方法对所有 token 施加统一的计算模式，忽略了视频不同区域的去噪难度差异以及生成过程中难度的动态演变，因此计算分配并非最优。
AI.method: 提出 HetA-DiT 异构注意力机制：1）轻量不确定性分支预测 token 级去噪难度估计；2）据此将不确定 token 路由至稠密全局注意力，将更可靠的 token 交由高效局部注意力处理；3）路由具备内容与时间步自适应能力，保留关键位置的全局上下文，并提供单一参数控制质量-效率权衡；4）通过复用前一步去噪的不确定性估计，推理时不引入额外 Transformer 评估，并兼容 few-step 分布匹配蒸馏。
AI.result: 在 DMD 蒸馏的 Wan2.2-5B 与 Wan2.1-1.3B 模型上评估，覆盖 VBench、VBench-2.0 及人类偏好评测，HetA-DiT 在仅约 20% token 经过稠密注意力的情况下保持了有竞争力的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 该方法表明按 token 难度自适应分配注意力计算可显著降低稠密注意力占比，同时维持生成质量，且与少步蒸馏兼容、推理开销不增加，为高效视频生成提供了实用的质量-效率权衡方案。

title: CG-Probes: Recovering Guardrail Directions from Patient Query Embeddings
comment: Accepted as a short paper at CIKM '26 (35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management), Rome, Italy. 7 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/mrehacek/cg-probes
summary: Patient-facing AI assistants promise valuable support to patients, but incoming queries can pose medical risks. To create guardrails, we work with oncologists to define three ordinal risk axes: Medical Urgency, Psychological Urgency, and Topic Sensitivity. We propose Clinical Guardrail Probes (CG-Probes) to measure the risks from query embeddings. We probe for each axis in the normalized embedding space of frozen embedders via the difference-in-means method, treating each axis as a potential linear direction. To train the probes, we cluster 79,658 Czech oncology search queries with BERTopic and use these clusters to generate pairs of queries with contrastive risk levels via few-shot prompting. We evaluate the approach on 200 queries (90 real, 110 synthetic), each graded by two oncologists, against two open-weight LLMs and a frontier LLM. We find that urgency-based axes are recoverable as linear directions, and the probes are competitive with open-weight LLMs (no significant differences in quadratic-weighted kappa) at a fraction of the latency. Each axis yields a scalar score that clinicians can inspect and use to set escalation thresholds. The pipeline requires only search logs, axis definitions, and black-box access to the embedding model, suggesting transferability across healthcare domains. Robust validation on new queries and axes remains future work.

AI.tldr: 提出临床护栏探针（CG-Probes），在冻结嵌入模型的归一化嵌入空间中用差值均值法将三类序数风险轴（医疗紧迫性、心理紧迫性、话题敏感性）视为线性方向进行探测，实现对患者查询风险的标量评分，性能与开源LLM相当但延迟极低。
AI.motivation: 面向患者的AI助手能提供有价值的支持，但患者输入查询可能带来医疗风险，需要建立护栏（guardrails）机制来识别与管控这些风险，而现有方法缺乏可解释、低延迟的风险度量手段。
AI.method: 与肿瘤科医生合作定义三条序数风险轴：医疗紧迫性、心理紧迫性、话题敏感性。在冻结嵌入器的归一化嵌入空间中，采用差值均值（difference-in-means）方法，将每个风险轴视为潜在线性方向进行探测。训练探针时，用BERTopic对79,658条捷克语肿瘤学搜索查询进行聚类，并通过少样本提示由聚类生成具有对比风险等级的查询对。
AI.result: 在200条查询（90条真实、110条合成，各由两名肿瘤科医生评分）上评估，与两个开源权重LLM和一个前沿LLM对比。结果显示：紧迫性类风险轴可作为线性方向被恢复，探针性能与开源权重LLM具有竞争力（二次加权kappa无显著差异），而延迟仅为后者的一小部分；每条轴输出一个临床医生可检查并用于设定升级阈值的标量分数。
AI.conclusion: 该流程仅需搜索日志、轴定义和对嵌入模型的黑盒访问，提示其可迁移至其他医疗领域；在新查询与新风向险轴上的稳健验证仍属未来工作。

title: Quantum Diffusion Models for Medical Image Analysis
comment: 12 pages, 12 supplementary pages, 7 figures, 1 table, 12 supplementary figures
summary: Quantum Machine Learning is a novel field of research aimed at devising machine learning approaches exploiting principles of quantum mechanics, such as superposition, entanglement and interference. In this context, we present a scalable hybrid Quantum Diffusion Model, and evaluate its use for medical image analysis. Specifically, our method is based on a Discrete-Time Quantum Walk algorithm, executed on a real quantum device, to model the forward dynamics of the diffusion model. For the backward step of the diffusion model, we devise and evaluate a classical learning model, which is used to reversely denoise the data. In contrast with other existing attempts at applying quantum machine learning for image analysis tasks, severely limited by the size of existing quantum devices, our method allows to process real-world large size medical data. In particular, we present results on grayscale and RGB images, as well as 3D volumes of moderate sizes. We benchmark our results by reproducing an alternative classical counterpart model, based on diffusion models on discrete state spaces. By doing so, we compare the generation capabilities of both models in terms of three distinct state-of-the-art metrics in the field of image generation, showing the competitive, promising results of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可扩展的混合量子扩散模型，利用离散时间量子行走在真实量子设备上建模前向扩散，结合经典学习模型完成反向去噪，实现对中等规模医学图像与3D体积的生成分析。
AI.motivation: 量子机器学习旨在利用叠加、纠缠和干涉等量子力学原理改进机器学习方法；但现有量子机器学习在图像分析中的应用受限于量子设备规模，难以处理真实世界的大尺寸医学数据，因此需要一种可扩展的混合方案。
AI.method: 方法基于离散时间量子行走算法，在真实量子设备上执行以建模扩散模型的前向动力学；反向步骤则设计并评估一个经典学习模型，用于对数据进行反向去噪。整体构成可扩展的混合量子扩散模型，并与基于离散状态空间扩散模型的经典对照模型进行基准比较。
AI.result: 在灰度图像、RGB图像以及中等规模的3D体积上给出结果；通过复现经典对照模型，采用图像生成领域三种主流指标比较两者的生成能力，显示所提方法具有竞争力且有前景。
AI.conclusion: 该混合量子扩散模型突破了现有量子设备规模对图像分析任务的限制，能够处理真实世界较大尺寸医学数据，并在生成质量指标上展现出与经典方法竞争的良好表现。

title: Band-Selection Stability and Semantic Segmentation Performance: A Study on Hyperspectral City
summary: Resource constraints make high-dimensional hyperspectral imaging challenging in autonomous perception, motivating the use of band selection methods. However, the sensitivity of band-selection methods to sampled data and their relationship to semantic segmentation models (SSMs) remain underexplored. This study evaluates six band selection methods on ten independently sampled, class-balanced region-of-interest (ROI) sets, yielding 60 top-25 band subsets from the Hyperspectral City V2 (128 bands: 450-950nm) dataset. Top-$K$ bands ($K\in\{3,5, ... 13\}$) from the first three ROI sets are evaluated with three SSMs against the corresponding 128-band baseline. Experiments show that intra-method stability is method-dependent: Sim-LP shows the highest stability (pairwise Jaccard similarity) and, together with JMIM+CSNR, yields the best segmentation results. Top-$K$ based SSMs remain competitive with baselines, with gains of up to 2.01 mIoU and 1.72 mF1 points, and 18-22x faster CPU inference for $K=9$. However, performance does not improve monotonically with $K$, and stability shows no consistent association with SSM performance. These findings suggest that intra-method stability is informative but an unreliable indicator of downstream segmentation performance, highlighting the need to evaluate band-selection methods across repeated samples, subset sizes, and SSMs.

AI.tldr: 该研究在Hyperspectral City V2数据集上系统评估了6种波段选择方法在10个独立采样ROI集上的表现，生成60个top-25波段子集，并用3种语义分割模型评估前3个ROI集的Top-K波段，发现方法内稳定性依赖于具体方法，且稳定性与分割性能无一致关联。
AI.motivation: 高光谱成像因资源受限在自主感知中面临挑战，波段选择成为关键手段；然而波段选择方法对采样数据的敏感性及其与语义分割模型的关系尚未被充分探究。
AI.method: 在Hyperspectral City V2数据集（128波段，450–950nm）上，对6种波段选择方法在10个独立采样、类别均衡的ROI集上进行评估，产生60个top-25波段子集；从前3个ROI集中选取Top-K波段（K∈{3,5,...,13}），用3种语义分割模型与128波段基线对比。
AI.result: 方法内稳定性依方法而异，Sim-LP稳定性最高（成对Jaccard相似度），并与JMIM+CSNR共同取得最佳分割结果；基于Top-K的分割模型与基线相当甚至更优，提升达2.01 mIoU和1.72 mF1，K=9时CPU推理快18–22倍；但性能不随K单调提升，稳定性与分割性能无一致关联。
AI.conclusion: 方法内稳定性具有参考价值，但不能可靠指示下游分割性能，需在重复采样、不同子集大小和多种分割模型下评估波段选择方法。

title: DepthEvidence: Unifying Metric Depth Prediction and Geometric Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models
summary: Spatial reasoning with metric constraints requires linking objects to geometric measurements and preserving their numerical content during language reasoning. We present DepthEvidence, a 4B model that uses its own dense metric predictions as object-grounded evidence for language generation. A camera-conditioned decoder predicts full-resolution metric depth using multi-scale visual features and high-resolution RGB refinement. A dense-to-language interface converts predicted depths and decoder features into object-aligned continuous geometry tokens anchored to object identifiers. Geometric supervision encourages metric information to remain recoverable before and after language-context interaction, while instruction tuning supports object measurement and compositional reasoning. We introduce a Depth-VQA benchmark evaluating object-depth queries, relative comparisons, and decisions combining spatial and numerical constraints. Across nine datasets, DepthEvidence achieves the highest average dense $δ_1$ among evaluated methods, competitive with specialized estimators. It also leads the evaluated methods in instance-level metric depth estimation and overall accuracy on both relative and metric reasoning tracks, while broadly preserving general VQA performance and improving spatial understanding relative to the base model.

AI.tldr: DepthEvidence：一个4B模型，将自身密集度量深度预测作为对象锚定证据用于语言推理，在深度估计与度量空间推理上领先。
AI.motivation: 空间推理需在语言推理中把物体与几何测量关联并保持数值信息，现有方法难以在语言链条中保留度量内容。
AI.method: 相机条件解码器用多尺度视觉特征与高分辨率RGB精修预测全分辨率度量深度；密集到语言接口将预测深度与解码器特征转为锚定对象标识的连续几何token；几何监督保证语言上下文交互前后度量信息可恢复，指令微调支持物体测量与组合推理；并构建Depth-VQA基准。
AI.result: 在九个数据集上平均密集δ1最高，媲美专用估计器；在实例级度量深度估计及相对与度量推理赛道总体准确率上均领先，同时基本保持通用VQA性能并提升空间理解。
AI.conclusion: 以自预测深度作为对象锚定证据可有效衔接度量几何与语言推理，在保持通用能力的同时增强度量空间理解。

title: Double-stream registration with pyramid fusion for HDR video with alternating exposures
summary: High dynamic range (HDR) video reconstruction from al\-ter\-na\-ting-exposure sequences remains challenging, especially in regions with extreme luminance variation. We propose a novel HDR reconstruction framework based on dual-stream registration and accurate pyramid fusion. Given three consecutive frames, our method computes optical flow directly with the central frame, while introducing a complementary midpoint displacement strategy to handle cases with severe overexposition. A pyramid fusion stage then merges the resulting radiance and LDR images into a final HDR output. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于双流配准与金字塔融合的HDR视频重建框架，从交替曝光序列重建HDR视频。
AI.motivation: 从交替曝光序列进行HDR视频重建仍具挑战性，尤其在高动态范围、极端亮度变化区域，现有方法难以准确对齐与融合。
AI.method: 给定三帧连续图像，方法与中心帧直接计算光流，并引入互补的中点位移策略以处理严重过曝情形；随后通过金字塔融合阶段将得到的辐照度图与LDR图像合并，输出最终HDR结果。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法持续优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 双流配准与精确金字塔融合可有效提升HDR视频重建在极端亮度变化场景下的性能。

title: LocUS: Head Selection and Subspace Projection for Targeted Activation Steering
summary: Activation steering is a powerful training-free paradigm for controlling large language models at inference time. However, standard approaches estimate a per-layer steering direction from contrastive data and apply it on the layer's entire representation space, which may couple the intervention to off-target properties present in the contrastive data and degrade unrelated capabilities. To mitigate this issue, we introduce LocUS (Localized Unembedding Steering), a method which grounds activation steering to the model's own output vocabulary subspace. By identifying a property-specific linear subspace within the unembedding matrix, LocUS enforces a geometric constraint that restricts the steering transformation to a specific subspace and at the same time localizes its application to a sparse subset of attention heads. Extensive evaluations across three model families on toxicity mitigation, sentiment redirection and sycophancy suppression show that LocUS matches or outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while intervening on under 6% of parameters and better preserving general capability.

AI.tldr: LocUS 是一种将激活引导锚定到模型输出词表子空间的无训练方法，通过识别属性特定的线性子空间，施加几何约束从而引导方向局限于特定子空间，并将干预定位到稀疏的注意力头子集。
AI.motivation: 标准激活引导从对比数据中估计逐层引导方向并作用于整层表示空间，可能会将干预与对比数据中的非目标属性耦合，从而损害无关能力。
AI.method: LocUS（Localized Unembedding Steering）：在解嵌入矩阵中识别属性特定的线性子空间，并施加几何约束，将引导变换限制在该子空间，同时把干预定位到稀疏的注意力头子集。
AI.result: 在三个模型族上针对毒性缓解、情感重定向和谄媚抑制的广泛评估表明，LocUS 达到或超越最先进基线水平，同时仅干预不足 6% 的参数并更好地保持通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将激活引导锚定于模型输出词表子空间并实现稀疏化定位，LocUS 在有效控制目标属性的同时显著降低参数干预比例并减少对无关能力的损害。

title: Do we need to answer that question? Salience and Answerability of Potential Questions in Naturalistic Dialogue
summary: We empirically investigate Question Under Discussion based modelling in naturalistic dialogue by studying whether the salience of generated potential questions predicts their subsequent resolution. Building on Wu et al. (2024), we construct a dataset of 7,124 questions automatically generated from utterances and preceding context from the British National Corpus, and annotated for salience and answerability. We find a robust but low positive correlation between salience and answerability in dialogue, indicating that more salient questions are more likely to be addressed. However, this effect is markedly weaker than in monologic text, suggesting that conversational structure is less predictable. We further observe that structured interactions exhibit stronger alignment between annotators than less organised dialogues.

AI.tldr: 本文实证检验自然对话中"讨论中的问题（QUD）"建模假设，发现生成问题的显著度可预测其被后续回答的概率，但相关性弱于独白文本。
AI.motivation: 探究QUD模型（显著度驱动问题解决）是否适用于自然对话，检验显著度与可回答性关系在对话与独白中的差异。
AI.method: 基于Wu et al. (2024)，从英国国家语料库（BNC）的话语及前文语境中自动生成7,124个问题，并标注显著度（salience）与可回答性（answerability），进行相关性分析，比较对话与独白及不同结构化程度互动的差异。
AI.result: 显著度与可回答性呈稳健但低度正相关，显著问题更易被回应；该效应明显弱于独白文本，表明会话结构更不可预测；结构化互动中标注者一致性更高。
AI.conclusion: QUD显著度对问题解决的预测在自然对话中成立但较弱，说明对话结构可预测性低于独白，互动组织程度影响标注一致性。

title: Pocket-STVG: lightweight architecture for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
comment: 14 pages total. 8 pages main manuscript, 3 pages references, 3 pages additional material
summary: Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) aims to localize the spatio-temporal tube in a video corresponding to a natural language query. While recent methods achieve strong performance in fully supervised, weakly supervised, and zero-shot settings, they typically rely on computationally expensive architectures, complex training pipelines, or multimodal large language models. We present Pocket-STVG (P-STVG), a lightweight cascade architecture that addresses STVG by combining efficient pre-trained components instead of large end-to-end models. P-STVG integrates a temporal-aware video encoder based on MobileViCLIP, a spatial encoder-decoder derived from MDETR, and a shared aligned text encoder. Temporal localization is performed through either a lightweight 1D U-Net or a simple thresholding strategy, enabling the same framework to operate in both weakly supervised and zero-shot settings. Furthermore, video representations are precomputed independently of the query, yielding an indexing-friendly pipeline for efficient inference and large-scale video collections. Despite requiring fewer than 90M parameters, P-STVG performs on par with weakly supervised methods and improves on earlier zero-shot approaches at a fraction of their memory and computational cost, establishing a favorable performance-efficiency trade-off for STVG.

AI.tldr: P-STVG是一种轻量级级联架构，通过组合预训练组件（MobileViCLIP视频编码器、MDETR空间编解码器、共享对齐文本编码器）实现时空视频定位，参数量不足90M，在弱监督和零样本设置下达到与现有方法相当或更优的性能，同时显著降低计算与内存开销。
AI.motivation: 现有STVG方法虽在完全监督、弱监督和零样本设置下性能较强，但依赖计算昂贵的架构、复杂训练流程或多模态大语言模型，成本高、效率低。作者希望构建一种轻量、高效的替代方案，在保持性能的同时大幅降低资源消耗。
AI.method: 提出Pocket-STVG（P-STVG），一种轻量级级联架构，用高效预训练组件替代大型端到端模型：基于MobileViCLIP的时序感知视频编码器、源自MDETR的空间编解码器、共享对齐的文本编码器。时序定位通过轻量级1D U-Net或简单阈值策略实现，使同一框架可同时用于弱监督和零样本设置。视频表示独立于查询预先计算，形成索引友好的流水线，便于高效推理和面向大规模视频集合的应用。
AI.result: P-STVG参数量不足90M，性能与弱监督方法相当，并优于早期零样本方法，同时内存和计算成本仅为其一小部分，在STVG任务上实现了良好的性能-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过组合高效预训练组件而非大型端到端模型，P-STVG证明了轻量级级联架构可在STVG中兼顾弱监督与零样本能力，并以极低的参数量和计算成本取得有竞争力的性能，为STVG提供了性能与效率平衡的实用方案。

title: JevAdvBench: A Benchmark and Black-Box Attacks for Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions Models
summary: Models trained with reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD), such as Jev, answer a typed question about an input, the state, with a probability, a choice, or a score, and software acts on the answer without a person reading it. Their robustness has not been measured: adversarial benchmarks score what a model generates or executes, whereas a typed model generates nothing and returns a well-formed answer even when manipulated. Measurement is also hard, because identical requests can return different answers, most available labels come from the model itself, and the API preprocesses each request out of view. Our key idea is to score each attacked decision against the model's own clean decision rather than against labels, and to read it against the change caused by an identical re-run. Building on this, we introduce JevAdvBench, to our knowledge the first adversarial benchmark for RLCD models, with 812 typed questions over 66 scenarios, and a black-box attack suite of 9,744 single-edit variants that each edit one part of a request, with billed input tokens confirming that the edit reached the model. On jev-1.13.0, rewording stays within 1.2 percentage points of the re-run baseline, and fields outside the schema never reach the model. In contrast, one unverified opinion appended to the state flips 12.1% of decisions, statistically tied with the strongest injected command (10.1%), and pushes 38% of confident answers below the 0.8 confidence threshold that routes them to human review. Applications built on RLCD models should therefore treat the state as untrusted, argued input. Project website: https://JevAdvBench.github.io/JevAdvBench/

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个针对 RLCD（强化学习校准决策）模型的对抗基准 JevAdvBench，用模型自身干净决策作为参照来度量攻击效果，发现"状态"中一句未经核实的观点即可翻转 12.1% 的决策，与最强注入命令（10.1%）统计上无差异。
AI.motivation: RLCD 模型（如 Jev）以概率、选择或分数回答类型化问题，软件直接依据答案行动而无人复核，但其鲁棒性从未被度量。现有对抗基准只评估模型"生成或执行"的内容，而类型化模型不生成文本、即使被操纵仍返回格式正确的答案，因此传统评测失效。同时度量本身困难：相同请求可能返回不同答案、多数标签来自模型自身、API 会对每个请求做不可见的预处理。
AI.method: 提出以"模型自身的干净决策"而非外部标签作为评分基准，并对照相同请求重跑（re-run）所产生的波动来判读攻击造成的改变。据此构建 JevAdvBench：包含 66 个场景、812 个类型化问题的首个 RLCD 对抗基准，以及由 9,744 个单点编辑变体组成的黑盒攻击套件，每个变体只改动请求的一个部分，并用计费输入 token 确认改动确实到达模型。
AI.result: 在 jev-1.13.0 上：改写（rewording）与重跑基线的差距在 1.2 个百分点以内，schema 之外字段无法到达模型；而向 state 追加一句未经核实的观点可翻转 12.1% 的决策，与最强注入命令（10.1%）统计上持平，并使 38% 的高置信答案跌破 0.8 置信阈值、被路由至人工复核。
AI.conclusion: 基于 RLCD 模型的应用应将 state 视为不可信、可被论证影响的输入（untrusted, argued input）；改写类扰动影响有限，但语义层面的观点注入与命令注入危害相当，且会显著削弱置信度路由机制的有效性。

title: Seeing Semantic Shift: Difference-Aware Sentence-Level Temporal Segmentation of Sign Language Videos
summary: Recent advances in sign language understanding have achieved impressive success on short, single-sentence videos, yet their performance drops sharply when applied to long, continuous sign language videos. To bridge this gap, we focus on a challenging and realistic setting: Visual-only Sentence-level Sign Language Segmentation (Vis-SSLS), which aims to partition continuous sign language videos into non-overlapping sentence-level segments without any caption assistance, serving as a crucial prerequisite for downstream recognition and translation tasks. However, sentence transitions in sign language are often smooth and visually ambiguous, lacking explicit pauses or posture resets. As a result, static frame representations may fail to capture the subtle temporal changes that indicate sentence boundaries. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{SignShift}, a difference-aware segmentation framework that explicitly models frame-to-frame feature variation as semantic cues for sentence boundary detection. First, to model the feature variation, we design a Temporal Difference Module, which incorporates full-frame, facial, and hand cues, and employs inter-frame differencing to learn multi-scale temporal variations that capture both fine-grained local kinematics and global semantic transitions. Second, to mitigate over- and under-segmentation issues, we design a Segment Count Prediction module, which predicts the number of sentences to guide boundary selection. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that SignShift substantially outperforms existing methods, validating its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SignShift框架，用于纯视觉、无字幕辅助的连续手语视频句级分割（Vis-SSLS），通过显式建模帧间特征差异来检测句子边界，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有手语理解方法在短句、单句视频上表现优异，但在长连续手语视频上性能骤降。为此作者聚焦一个更具挑战且更贴近实际的设定：纯视觉句级手语分割（Vis-SSLS），即在无任何字幕辅助的情况下，将连续手语视频切分为互不重叠的句子片段，作为下游识别与翻译任务的关键前提。难点在于手语句子转换通常平滑且视觉上模糊，缺乏明显停顿或姿态重置，静态帧表示难以捕捉指示句子边界的细微时间变化。
AI.method: 提出SignShift——一种差异感知的分割框架，显式建模帧间特征变化作为句边界检测的语义线索。包含两个模块：(1) 时序差异模块（Temporal Difference Module），融合全身、面部与手部线索，采用帧间差分学习多尺度时序变化，兼顾细粒度局部运动学与全局语义转换；(2) 句子数量预测模块（Segment Count Prediction），预测句子数目以引导边界选择，缓解过分割与欠分割问题。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，SignShift大幅优于现有方法，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将帧间特征变化作为分割线索并结合句子数量预测，SignShift有效解决了连续手语句级分割中边界模糊的问题，为纯视觉手语分割提供了有效方案。

title: FedHisto-PAST: Parameter-Efficient Stain-Aware Federated Learning for Cross-Site Lung Histopathology Classification
comment: Submitted to Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence (Elsevier)
summary: Cross-site lung histopathology classification must account for stain variation, non-IID client data, missing classes, and the cost of adapting large pathology encoders. This study evaluates FedHisto-PAST v2 for three-way classification of adenocarcinoma (ACA), Normal, and squamous cell carcinoma (SCC). FedHisto-PAST v2 combines a frozen HIBOU-B foundation model with parameter-efficient adaptation, stain-conditioned paired-view prediction and feature consistency, reliability-aware prototype learning, and adaptive federated aggregation. Experiments used a five-client, non-IID, raw-data-local simulation with fixed internal evaluation, client-level analysis, component ablations, communication accounting, and a development-influenced exploratory LungHist700 cohort. All principal methods achieved near- ceiling internal performance, which limited discrimination on the fixed split. On LungHist700, FedHisto- PAST v2 achieved a Macro-F1 of 0.728560 and a balanced accuracy of 0.730454. Higher recognition of Normal and SCC was accompanied by lower ACA recall, and calibration remained imperfect. Prediction-level consistency was the only component with a clearly supported independent contribution in the external ablation analysis. Feature consistency and prototype regularization showed no conclusive independent overall gains in Macro-F1. The framework updated 1.253841% of the model parameters. The results provide exploratory cross-dataset evidence for stain-aware, parameter-efficient federation; they do not establish formal privacy, patient-level independence, prospective deployment, or clinical validation.

AI.tldr: FedHisto-PAST v2 结合冻结 HIBOU-B 基础模型与参数高效适配、染色条件配对视图预测、可靠性感知原型学习和自适应联邦聚合，用于跨站点肺组织病理三分类；内部评估接近饱和，外部 LungHist700 探索性队列 Macro-F1 为 0.7286，仅预测级一致性有明确独立贡献，仅更新 1.25% 参数。
AI.motivation: 跨站点肺组织病理分类面临染色差异、客户端数据非独立同分布（non-IID）、类别缺失以及大病理编码器适配成本高等问题，需在原始数据不出本地的前提下实现高效、染色鲁棒的联邦学习方案。
AI.method: FedHisto-PAST v2 以冻结的 HIBOU-B 基础模型为骨干，叠加参数高效适配（PEFT）、染色条件配对视图预测与特征一致性、可靠性感知原型学习以及自适应联邦聚合；实验采用五客户端 non-IID 原始数据本地化模拟，包含固定内部评测、客户端级分析、组件消融与通信量核算，并使用受开发过程影响的探索性 LungHist700 队列。
AI.result: 所有主要方法在固定内部划分上接近性能上限，区分度受限。在 LungHist700 上，FedHisto-PAST v2 的 Macro-F1 为 0.728560，平衡准确率为 0.730454；Normal 与 SCC 识别率较高但 ACA 召回率偏低，校准仍不理想。外部消融显示仅预测级一致性具有明确支持的独立贡献，特征一致性与原型正则化未在整体 Macro-F1 上呈现结论性独立增益。模型仅更新 1.253841% 的参数。
AI.conclusion: 结果为染色感知、参数高效的联邦学习提供了探索性跨数据集证据，但未建立形式化隐私保证、患者级独立性、前瞻性部署或临床验证，结论应视为初步与探索性。

title: HyperErase: Scale-Calibrated Hypernetwork for Multi-Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Models
summary: Recent advances in text-to-image (T2I) generation have substantially improved visual synthesis, but have also raised increasing safety concerns due to their potential to generate harmful or undesirable content. Existing concept erasure methods predominantly follow a static weight paradigm, producing a single frozen adapter that struggles to adapt to diverse prompt variations and suffers from parameter interference when scaling to multiple concepts. We propose \textbf{HyperErase}, a framework for concept erasure based on hypernetwork-driven prompt-conditioned parameter synthesis. Our approach first reframes concept erasure as prompt-conditioned parameter amortization and trains a hypernetwork to map textual descriptions to prompt-specific LoRA updates, eliminating the need for per-prompt gradient optimization or manual LoRA merging. To further improve the stability and precision of synthesized adapters, we develop a decoupled rectification strategy, which disentangles LoRA tokens into pattern and scale subspaces, applies a square-root transform to curb multiplicative over-scaling, and leverages teacher-derived canonical priors for inference-time correction. Extensive experiments across major concept categories demonstrate that HyperErase consistently improves the trade-off between erasure effectiveness, image quality, and semantic alignment, achieving performance comparable to gold-standard single-concept baselines. Furthermore, the resulting models can provide specialized LoRAs for each input prompt variation in a single forward pass without requiring gradient updates during inference. These principled and flexible framework offers a new paradigm for concept erasure in T2I models.

AI.tldr: HyperErase：基于超网络提示条件参数合成的概念擦除框架，为每个提示动态生成专属LoRA，避免静态权重带来的参数干扰。
AI.motivation: 现有概念擦除方法多采用静态权重范式，生成单一冻结适配器，难以适应多样的提示变化，且在扩展到多概念时出现参数干扰。
AI.method: 将概念擦除重新表述为提示条件参数摊销，训练超网络把文本描述映射为提示专属的LoRA更新；提出解耦矫正策略：将LoRA token分解为模式与尺度子空间、施加平方根变换抑制乘性过缩放、利用教师导出的规范先验进行推理时校正。
AI.result: 在主要概念类别上的大量实验表明，HyperErase在擦除有效性、图像质量与语义对齐的权衡上持续改善，性能可与单概念金标准基线相当；且单次前向即可为每个输入提示变体提供专门LoRA，推理时无需梯度更新。
AI.conclusion: 该原则化且灵活的框架为T2I模型中的概念擦除提供了新范式。

title: ReG-SAM: Reference Graph-Driven SAM for 2D Foundational Vessel Segmentation
summary: Vessel segmentation in medical images is essential for many clinical tasks, ranging from diagnosis to treatment planning. However, it remains challenging due to complex vascular morphology and diverse imaging conditions. Existing deep learning methods rarely aim at building a generalizable vessel segmentor across anatomies and modalities. While the Seg- ment Anything Model (SAM) has shown promise for med- ical image segmentation, its original design does not fully exploit vascular morphology and struggles with fine-grained vascular structures, leading to suboptimal performance. In this paper, we propose ReG-SAM, a SAM-based framework tailored to 2D vessel segmentation that leverages reference graph set for enhancing vascular representations. Specifically, we introduce two modality-aware representations derived from the reference masks: graph prompt embeddings (GPEs) that encode global spatial features from graphs, and vascu- lar prototype embeddings (VPEs) that capture fine-grained modality-specific vessel characteristics from multi-scale fea- ture maps and vascular masks. Since both require vascular masks that are unavailable during inference and require robust modality-aware vascular feature representations, we construct a modality-wise vascular database and develop two reference graph-guided representation learning schemes for estimating GPEs and VPEs using samples from the database rather than ground-truth masks. Extensive experiments across 19 datasets demonstrate that ReG-SAM consistently outperforms existing baselines, even those using manual prompts, particularly on challenging thin vessels.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReG-SAM，一种基于 SAM 的 2D 血管分割框架，利用参考图集增强血管表征，实现跨解剖结构与模态的泛化分割。
AI.motivation: 血管分割对临床诊断与治疗规划至关重要，但血管形态复杂、成像条件多样，现有深度学习方法难以构建跨解剖结构与模态的通用分割器。SAM 虽在医学分割中有潜力，但其原始设计未充分利用血管形态，且对细粒度血管结构表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出 ReG-SAM 框架，引入两种源自参考掩码的模态感知表征：图提示嵌入（GPEs）编码图中的全局空间特征，血管原型嵌入（VPEs）从多尺度特征图与血管掩码中捕获细粒度模态特有的血管特征。由于推理时无法获得血管掩码，构建模态级血管数据库，并设计两种参考图引导的表征学习方案，用数据库样本估计 GPEs 与 VPEs，而非依赖真值掩码。
AI.result: 在 19 个数据集上的大量实验表明，ReG-SAM 持续优于现有基线，甚至优于使用人工提示的方法，在具有挑战性的细小血管上尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: ReG-SAM 通过参考图集引导的模态感知表征学习，有效提升了 SAM 在 2D 血管分割中的泛化能力与细粒度血管分割性能。

title: Improving Visual Sensitivity of LLMs on Multimodal Machine Translation with Metric-based Loss Weighting
summary: Multimodal Machine Translation aims to incorporate additional signal from non-textual modalities to improve translations by resolving ambiguities. While models, through multimodal fusion, are able to accept images related to the source text, they can ignore this information. Therefore, increasing their visual sensitivity remains an active research area. In this work, we introduce a training method, Metric-based Loss Weighting, that improves visual grounding of translations by increasing the loss function for tokens that benefit from the accompanying image. We identify these tokens using the Point-wise Cross-mutual Information (PCXMI) metric, which compares the model's output probabilities with and without visual context. We introduce a Congruency-based PCXMI metric and experimentally show that both metrics working in combination yield the best results. We evaluate our method by fine-tuning three pretrained Multimodal Large Language Models on the task of Image-guided Machine Translation for three language directions. Metric-based Loss Weighting outperforms other tested methods on the CoMMuTE contrastive dataset, improving accuracy by up to more than 7 percentage points compared to standard fine-tuning, while maintaining strong general translation performance.

AI.tldr: 提出Metric-based Loss Weighting训练方法，通过PCXMI及其Congruency变体识别受益于图像的token并加大其损失权重，提升多模态机器翻译的视觉敏感性。
AI.motivation: 多模态机器翻译虽引入图像信号以消解歧义，但模型在多模态融合中可能忽略视觉信息，因此提升模型的视觉敏感度（visual grounding）仍是活跃的研究方向。
AI.method: 提出基于度量的损失加权（Metric-based Loss Weighting）训练方法：用Point-wise Cross-mutual Information (PCXMI)指标，比较有无视觉上下文时模型的输出概率，识别受益于图像的token；同时提出Congruency-based PCXMI，两者组合使用。
AI.result: 在三个翻译方向上微调三个预训练多模态大语言模型；在CoMMuTE对比数据集上优于其他测试方法，相比标准微调准确率提升最多超过7个百分点，同时保持较强的通用翻译性能。
AI.conclusion: 对受益于视觉上下文的token加权损失可有效增强翻译的视觉依据，两指标组合效果最佳，且在提升对比任务准确率的同时不牺牲通用翻译能力。

title: TaskIR: Task-Driven Image Restoration via Degradation Adaptation and Task Feedback
summary: Task-driven image restoration aims to improve both image quality and downstream task performance. However, existing methods predominantly focus on single degradation type and struggle to handle the diverse degradations encountered in real-world scenarios. Different degradations impose distinct restoration demands, and insufficient restoration may leave residual degradations and artifacts that impair object boundaries and semantic cues, thereby compromising downstream task performance. To address these challenges, we propose TaskIR, a two-stage task-driven unified image restoration framework that integrates degradation-adaptive restoration with task feedback refinement. In Stage I, a Degradation Representation Module (DRM) extracts degradation representations, enabling a Degradation-Guided Transformer Block (DGTB) to dynamically modulate feature transformations for adaptive restoration. In Stage II, a Task-to-Restoration Feedback Generation module (TRFG) transforms heterogeneous task features into restoration feedback by modeling task-representation discrepancies associated with the current restoration. Subsequently, a Selective Task Feedback Refinement module (STFR) assesses feedback relevance and selectively refines intermediate restoration features to mitigate interference with well-restored content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TaskIR achieves competitive restoration quality and downstream task performance across diverse degradations and tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段统一图像复原框架 TaskIR：第一阶段用退化表征模块与退化引导 Transformer 实现自适应复原；第二阶段用任务-复原反馈生成与选择性精炼模块利用任务反馈优化复原特征，在多种退化与任务上取得竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: 现有任务驱动图像复原方法多针对单一退化类型，难以应对真实场景中多样退化。不同退化对复原需求不同，复原不足会残留退化与伪影，损害目标边界和语义线索，从而降低下游任务性能。
AI.method: 两阶段任务驱动统一复原框架。Stage I：退化表征模块（DRM）提取退化表征，驱动退化引导 Transformer 模块（DGTB）动态调制特征变换，实现退化自适应复原。Stage II：任务-复原反馈生成模块（TRFG）通过建模任务特征与当前复原表征之间的差异，将异构任务特征转化为复原反馈；随后选择性任务反馈精炼模块（STFR）评估反馈相关性，选择性精炼中间复原特征，避免干扰已复原良好的内容。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TaskIR 在多种退化类型与多种下游任务上均取得具有竞争力的复原质量和下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: TaskIR 通过退化自适应复原与任务反馈精炼的结合，有效统一处理多样退化，并兼顾图像质量与下游任务表现，为任务驱动统一图像复原提供了可行方案。

title: Electric Potential Patterns Forecasting in the Southern Hemisphere with Deep Learning Techniques
comment: Submitted to Journal of Geophysical Research: Machine Learning and Computation
summary: Space weather disturbances driven by the solar wind can degrade satellite navigation, disrupt radio communications, and threaten power infrastructure, making accurate forecasting of the high-latitude ionosphere's response a critical operational need. Existing approaches, empirical climatological models and physics-based magnetohydrodynamic simulations, either smooth out the ionosphere's time-dependent, non-linear response or are too computationally expensive for real-time use, while prior machine learning efforts have mostly targeted scalar indices rather than the full spatial structure of ionospheric convection. Here we train and compare three deep learning architectures, a probabilistic diffusion model conditioned on multi-variate solar wind and interplanetary magnetic field measurements at the L1 Lagrange point, an unconditioned diffusion ablation, and a deterministic U-Net baseline, to forecast Southern Hemisphere high-latitude electric potential maps derived from SuperDARN radar observations. Using five years (2020--2025) of SuperDARN data synchronised with DSCOVR L1 measurements, we evaluate the models under a single-pass regime, an extended autoregressive rollout of up to 350 frames, and an out-of-distribution case study on the intense March 2015 St.\ Patrick's Day storm, unseen during training. We find that the relative advantage of the deterministic and probabilistic approaches is not fixed: the deterministic model is competitive over short horizons and calm conditions, while the diffusion model's advantage grows and eventually dominates as the forecast horizon lengthens and the event becomes more dynamic, evidence that probabilistic, sample-based generative models are the more promising direction for operational, long-horizon space weather forecasting.

AI.tldr: 该论文训练并比较三种深度学习架构（条件扩散模型、无条件扩散消融、确定性U-Net），基于2020–2025年SuperDARN与DSCOVR L1同步数据预报南半球高纬电离层电势图，发现确定性与概率方法的相对优势随预报时长与事件动态性变化。
AI.motivation: 太阳风驱动的空间天气扰动会削弱卫星导航、干扰无线电通信并威胁电力基础设施，因此准确预报高纬电离层响应是关键的运行需求。现有经验气候学模型与基于物理的磁流体力学模拟，要么平滑掉电离层的时间依赖非线性响应，要么计算代价过高难以实时应用；而此前的机器学习工作多针对标量指数，而非电离层对流的完整空间结构。
AI.method: 训练并比较三种深度学习架构：以L1拉格朗日点多变量太阳风与行星际磁场测量为条件的概率扩散模型、无条件扩散消融模型、确定性U-Net基线，用于预报由SuperDARN雷达观测导出的南半球高纬电势图。使用与DSCOVR L1测量同步的五年（2020–2025）SuperDARN数据，在单步预测、最长350帧的扩展自回归推演，以及在训练中未见的2015年3月强磁暴（圣帕特里克节风暴）上的分布外案例研究三种设置下评估模型。
AI.result: 确定性与概率方法的相对优势并非固定：确定性模型在短预报时域和 calm（平静）条件下具有竞争力，而随着预报时域延长、事件动态性增强，扩散模型的优势逐渐增大并最终占据主导。
AI.conclusion: 概率性、基于采样的生成模型是面向业务化长时域空间天气预报更有前景的方向。

title: Where a Model Sends Its Own Repeated Token
comment: 8 pages, 3 tables. Companion to arXiv:2608.10986, arXiv:2608.21315 and arXiv:2609.29507. Code, per-run results, pre-registrations and the findings ledger: https://github.com/nicoveraz/token-lattice-ca (archived: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21880472)
summary: Black-box model identification works by scoring a model's response to natural-language prompts. One line of work feeds models a degenerate input -- their own token, repeated -- to find a failure mode rather than an identity. We take that input and ask where the model goes when it does not. For each token t, read argmax p(. | t, t) in one forward pass; the result is a map on the whole vocabulary, with two halves. The first -- which tokens are fixed points -- is partially anticipated, and we report it as a failed estimand: the natural distance on it is 83% cardinality, separates a corpus manipulation by two bits in 3471 against a precision floor of zero, and attributes families at 0.5833. The second half, where the map sends tokens that are not fixed points, is unrecorded; the one paper holding those tokens logged them as a zero. Pairing on the source token removes the cardinality confound by construction (r from 0.9128 to -0.0932) and attributes families at 0.8333 -- twelve models scored against a pool of nineteen -- with chance 0.1389, across seven tokenizer groups and several corpora. Two nulls clear it: frequency-matched destinations agree at 0.1429, independent marginals at 0.0798. Family predicts agreement better than tokenizer (0.2031 against 0.1205), and recurrent architectures cluster at balanced accuracy 1.0 against a 0.7895 majority rate, or 0.90 once each model's dominant destination is excluded -- the figure we stand behind. We measure the robustness envelope: 8-bit weight rounding moves the map less than deduplicating the training corpus does (0.9004 against 0.6353, on one support), 4-bit destroys it (0.0098; 0.1812 at deployment granularity, so not a coarseness artefact), and the precision floor varies by model from 0.201 to 0.9778. All estimands and kill conditions were registered before the data, and the failed one is reported as fully as the surviving one.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究模型对退化输入（重复自身token）的响应：取 argmax p(.|t,t) 构成词表上的映射，其中非不动点半部为未被记录的新对象。通过源token配对消除基数混淆后，该映射能以0.8333的平衡准确率归因模型家族，且稳健性优于训练语料去重，但4-bit量化会摧毁它。
AI.motivation: 已有黑盒模型识别依赖自然语言提示评分，另一支工作用退化输入（重复token）寻找失败模式而非身份特征。作者希望利用这一输入探索"模型不走不动点时去了哪里"，即映射中非不动点半部这一未被记录的部分。
AI.method: 对每个token t，单次前向传播读取 argmax p(.|t,t)，得到整个词表上的映射。将映射分为不动点与非不动点半部；用源token配对消除基数混淆；用频率匹配目的词与独立边缘两个零模型作对照；比较家族与分词器对一致性的预测力；并用8-bit/4-bit权重量化与语料去重检验稳健性包络。所有估计量与失效条件在数据前预注册。
AI.result: 不动点半部作为失败估计量：距离83%为基数，语料操纵仅拉开两bit（3471，精度下限为0），家族归因0.5833。非不动点半部：源token配对后基数混淆被消除（r由0.9128降至-0.0932），家族归因0.8333（12模型/19池，几率0.1389），跨七个分词器组与多语料；两零模型分别为0.1429与0.0798。家族预测力优于分词器（0.2031对0.1205）；循环架构聚类平衡准确率1.0（多数类0.7895），排除主导目的词后0.90。稳健性：8-bit量化影响小于语料去重（0.9004对0.6353），4-bit摧毁映射（0.0098，部署粒度0.1812），精度下限因模型从0.201到0.9778不等。
AI.conclusion: 非不动点半部映射是一个可复现的模型身份特征，源token配对后家族归因显著高于零模型，且家族比分词器更具预测力。稳健性有明确边界：8-bit可容忍、去重影响更大、4-bit破坏映射。失败的不动点估计量与幸存估计量被同等完整地报告。

title: Who Says What: Symbolic Trimodal Binding Mechanisms in Audio-Visual LLMs
summary: Current Audio-Visual LLMs (AVLLMs) struggle with reasoning over videos featuring multi-speaker dialogues. In such videos, resolving "who says what" is crucial, which necessitates trimodal (text-audio-visual) binding. Motivated by these challenges, we systematically investigate how this trimodal binding is achieved in AVLLMs. Specifically, we identify emergent symbolic trimodal binding mechanisms in AVLLMs that utilize modality-specific symbolic variables. By encoding auditory and visual components into symbolic variables-capturing temporal utterance sequences and spatial entity coordinates, respectively-the model establishes cross-modal linking within this abstract space. Crucially, we reveal that when trimodal binding fails, the breakdown predominantly stems from misaligned audio-visual connections. To overcome this bottleneck, we introduce an audio-visual prompting method utilizing an off-the-shelf Active Speaker Detection (ASD) model. By simply overlaying visual bounding boxes on active speakers, this training-free approach yields immediate performance gains across four conversation-centric benchmarks. Moreover, lightweight fine-tuning of fewer than 300 steps on these ASD-prompted-videos extends these gains to three general AV benchmarks, suggesting the generalizability of our method.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究AVLLMs在多说话人对话视频中的三模态绑定机制，发现其依赖符号化绑定，失效主因是视听错配，并提出基于ASD模型的免训练视听提示方法，在4个对话类基准上即得提升，轻微调优后可泛化至3个通用视听基准。
AI.motivation: 当前Audio-Visual LLMs在多说话人对话视频推理中表现不佳，核心难点在于"谁说了什么"（who says what）的判定，这要求文本-音频-视觉的三模态绑定。然而该绑定机制在AVLLMs中的实现方式尚不明确，其失效原因也未被系统研究。
AI.method: 1) 系统分析AVLLMs中三模态绑定的实现机制；2) 提出"涌现的符号化三模态绑定"解释：将听觉成分编码为时间化话语序列的符号变量、视觉成分编码为空间实体坐标的符号变量，在抽象符号空间中建立跨模态连接；3) 定位绑定失效的主要原因为视听连接错配；4) 提出免训练的视听提示方法，利用现成Active Speaker Detection (ASD)模型在活跃说话人上叠加视觉边界框。
AI.result: ASD提示方法在4个以对话为中心的基准上取得即时性能提升；在此基础上对ASD提示视频进行少于300步的轻量微调，提升可扩展至3个通用视听基准，表明方法具有泛化性。
AI.conclusion: AVLLMs通过符号变量实现三模态绑定的机制可被识别与利用；绑定失效瓶颈主要位于视听对齐环节；通过ASD驱动的免训练提示及极少步数微调即可有效缓解该瓶颈并具备跨基准泛化能力。

title: Light Field Primitive for Novel View Synthesis
summary: We present Light Field Primitives (LFP), a formulation for novel view synthesis that replaces the dense ray database with a compact set of differentiable primitives in the classical two-plane parameterization. Each primitive condenses a group of rays into one learned record, and its response to a query is governed by how closely that query belongs to the group. Rendering a camera ray then reduces to compositing all responses it elicits, and a scene can be optimized directly from posed images and rendered in real time with rays. Beyond its competitive performance on standard benchmarks, the main advantage of LFP is structural: its primitives reside directly in the 4D ray space, so optical and appearance effects that are already operations on the light field become behaviors of a single shared renderer. With minimal changes to that renderer, LFP supports multi-scale anti-aliasing, defocus deblurring with refocusing, rendering for fisheye cameras, and even transparent object reconstruction with ray refraction, matching specialized frameworks that devote substantial machinery to these effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出光场基元（LFP），用经典双平面参数化下的一组紧凑可微基元替代稠密光线数据库，实现新视角合成与实时渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有新视角合成方法依赖稠密光线数据库，缺乏结构化的光线表达，导致难以统一处理光学与外观效应，往往需要为每种效应构建专门框架。
AI.method: LFP将经典双平面参数化下的光线组织为可学习的基元，每个基元将一组光线压缩为一个记录；查询光线依据其与所属组的匹配程度获得响应，渲染时对所有响应进行合成。场景可直接从带位姿图像优化，并支持实时光线渲染。
AI.result: 在标准基准上取得有竞争力的性能；仅需对共享渲染器做最小改动，即支持多尺度抗锯齿、带重聚焦的散焦去模糊、鱼眼相机渲染，以及带光线折射的透明物体重建，效果可与投入大量专门机制的专用框架相匹配。
AI.conclusion: 基元直接驻留于4D光线空间，使各类光学与外观效应转化为光场上的操作、成为单一共享渲染器的行为，兼具性能与结构统一性。

title: Enhancing Photogrammetric Digital Surface Models with Pretrained Diffusion Models and Multimodal Conditioning
summary: Large-scale Digital Surface Models (DSMs) can be produced cost-effectively from satellite images via stereo-photogrammetry. However, the resulting 3D maps are often contaminated by noise, outliers, and voids. On the other hand, aerial LiDAR provides high-accuracy elevation measurements at a substantially higher cost. In this work, we study diffusion models conditioned both on photogrammetric DSMs and Pléiades imagery to refine vertically co-registered DSMs. We introduce a modified Stable Diffusion 3 architecture with a pruned text stream and a patch-wise normalization strategy, enabling stable training on LiDAR data and transfer from natural images to elevation maps. Experiments in French cities demonstrate that multimodal conditioning improves elevation accuracy, reducing Dense Urban RMSE from 6.00 to 3.45 m in the in-context cities and from 4.16 to 2.77 m in the held-out city of Bordeaux.

AI.tldr: 本文利用条件扩散模型，结合摄影测量DSM与Pléiades影像，对DSM进行精化，提升高程精度。
AI.motivation: 摄影测量可低成本生成大范围DSM，但含噪声、离群值与空洞；LiDAR精度高但成本昂贵。因此需要一种低成本高精度的DSM精化方法。
AI.method: 基于改进的Stable Diffusion 3架构，采用裁剪文本流与分块归一化策略，以摄影测量DSM和Pléiades影像为双模态条件对垂直共配准的DSM进行精化，实现LiDAR数据上的稳定训练及从自然图像到高程图的迁移。
AI.result: 法国城市实验表明多模态条件提升高程精度：密集城区RMSE从6.00降至3.45 m（上下文城市），从4.16降至2.77 m（未见城市波尔多）。
AI.conclusion: 条件扩散模型结合多模态遥感输入可有效精化摄影测量DSM，兼顾低成本与高精度，并具备跨城市泛化能力。

title: Preserve-and-Compose Training for Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed image retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve images that satisfy a user-specified modification while preserving relevant visual content from a reference image. Collecting target images for this purpose is costly, motivating zero-shot CIR methods that instead use target captions as supervision. However, target captions may omit source details that should be preserved. We therefore propose, Preserve-and-Compose Training, which complements target-caption supervision with visual evidence from the source image. PACT learns from image--text--text (ITT) triplets without target images or gallery updates, aligning composed queries with target captions while preserving source evidence through visual supervision. We further introduce Chord scoring, which combines target similarity with source-relative directional agreement in the frozen image space. Results across four ZS-CIR benchmarks show that combining target-caption supervision with source-image evidence leads to strong retrieval performance across datasets, backbone scales, and external galleries. The code is available on https://github.com/sehyunkwon/PACT.

AI.tldr: 提出PACT训练方法，用源图像视觉证据补充目标描述监督，结合Chord评分实现零样本组合图像检索。
AI.motivation: 组合图像检索（CIR）需要在保留参考图像相关内容的同时满足用户指定的修改，但为目标图像收集标注成本高昂，因此出现以目标描述作为监督信号的零样本CIR方法。然而目标描述往往会遗漏应当保留的源图像细节，导致仅依赖描述监督不足以学到准确的组合表示。
AI.method: 提出Preserve-and-Compose Training（PACT），在目标描述监督之外引入源图像的视觉证据。PACT从图像-文本-文本（ITT）三元组中学习，无需目标图像、无需更新图库，通过视觉监督在将组合查询与目标描述对齐的同时保留源图像证据。此外提出Chord评分，在冻结的图像空间中把目标相似度与源相对方向一致性相结合。
AI.result: 在四个零样本CIR基准上验证，结合目标描述监督与源图像证据在多个数据集、不同骨干规模和外部图库设置下均取得强检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 将目标描述监督与源图像视觉证据相结合，是提升零样本组合图像检索泛化性与性能的有效途径，代码已开源。

title: FlatClip: A Geometry-Aware Surface-Level Baseline for fMRI Representation Learning
summary: Recent fMRI foundation models differ substantially in the spatial scale at which they represent brain activity. ROI- and connectivity-based models are efficient but coarse, whereas voxel-level models preserve fine-grained spatial structure but require specialized 3D/4D architectures and costly fMRI-specific pretraining. We ask how effectively an image-pretrained encoder can reuse the spatial organization of cortical activity. Motivated by evidence that macroscale brain activity is strongly constrained by brain geometry, we introduce FlatClip, a frozen-encoder surface-level baseline that renders cortical activity as geometry-aware flatmap sequences and reuses a frozen SigLIP2 image encoder with only a lightweight downstream probe. Across resting-state benchmarks, FlatClip serves as a competitive middle-ground representation, outperforming ROI-level baselines on HCP and ADNI tasks while remaining weaker on PPMI and below the strongest voxel-level models overall. On visual-fMRI decoding, restricting the input to visual or NSD-provided task-active cortex improves performance, highlighting the value of task-relevant cortical coverage. Spatial perturbation controls reduce the predictive performance of flatmap features under both retrained and fixed readouts, and anatomy-linked arrangements consistently outperform vertex permutations across three colormaps. Together, these results position surface-level flatmap sequences as a practical middle-ground baseline between ROI and voxel models, and support the utility of anatomy-linked spatial organization for reusing image-pretrained features. Code is available at https://github.com/OneMore1/FlatClip.

AI.tldr: 提出 FlatClip——一种冻结编码器的皮层表面级基线，将皮层活动渲染为几何感知的 flatmap 序列并复用冻结的 SigLIP2 图像编码器，仅用轻量下游探针，作为 ROI 与体素模型之间的折中方案。
AI.motivation: 现有 fMRI 基础模型在空间尺度上存在权衡：ROI/连接模型高效但粗糙，体素级模型保留细粒度空间结构但需专用 3D/4D 架构和昂贵预训练。受宏观脑活动强烈受脑几何约束的证据启发，作者希望探究图像预训练编码器能否有效复用皮层活动的空间组织。
AI.method: FlatClip 将皮层活动渲染为几何感知的 flatmap 序列，复用冻结的 SigLIP2 图像编码器，并仅训练轻量下游探针。此外进行空间扰动对照实验，并比较解剖学关联排列与顶点置换在三种 colormap 下的表现。
AI.result: 在静息态基准上，FlatClip 作为有竞争力的中间表示，在 HCP 和 ADNI 任务上优于 ROI 级基线，在 PPMI 上较弱，整体低于最强体素级模型。视觉 fMRI 解码中，限制输入到视觉或 NSD 任务活跃皮层可提升性能。空间扰动降低预测性能，解剖学关联排列在三种 colormap 下一致优于顶点置换。
AI.conclusion: 表面级 flatmap 序列可作为 ROI 与体素模型之间的实用折中基线，并支持解剖学关联空间组织在复用图像预训练特征中的有效性。

title: Enabling a Unified Cross-Domain Representation for Two-Finger Gripper Manipulation via Interaction-Centric Modeling
summary: Achieving robust cross-embodiment generalization in imitation learning demands overcoming a critical representation flaw that inextricably entangles task semantics with hardware-specific visual geometry. We propose an interaction-centric framework that leverages the shared structure of two-finger grippers via a parameterized universal gripper abstraction, yielding a canonical gripper-frame representation. Given language and RGB-D observations, a VLM infers the subtask and grounds an interaction triplet (gripper, held, target), while SAM~2.1 tracks masks to reduce VLM queries. We design concise hybrid features that combine target/collision artificial potential fields for global guidance with segmented gripper-frame point clouds for local geometry, and use a Flow-Matching Transformer to predict smooth 7-DoF action chunks. Experiments in simulation and real-world tasks demonstrate that ours is the first imitation learning approach to simultaneously achieve competitive benchmark scores and extreme cross-embodiment/cross-viewpoint zero-shot sim-to-real transfer to completely distinct, heterogeneous robot platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出以交互为中心的模仿学习框架，通过参数化通用夹爪抽象获得规范夹爪坐标系表示，结合VLM推理、SAM2.1跟踪、混合势场/点云特征与Flow-Matching Transformer，实现跨本体、跨视角的零样本仿真到真实迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有模仿学习存在关键表示缺陷：任务语义与硬件特定的视觉几何被纠缠在一起，导致跨本体泛化能力差。作者希望解耦任务语义与硬件几何，实现异构机器人平台间的零样本迁移。
AI.method: 1) 利用两指夹爪的共享结构，提出参数化通用夹爪抽象，得到规范的夹爪坐标系表示；2) 以语言和RGB-D观测为输入，用VLM推断子任务并定位交互三元组（夹爪、被抓物、目标物），并用SAM 2.1跟踪掩码以减少VLM查询；3) 设计简洁混合特征：目标/碰撞人工势场提供全局引导，分割后的夹爪坐标系点云提供局部几何；4) 用Flow-Matching Transformer预测平滑的7-DoF动作块。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界任务中，该方法同时取得有竞争力的基准分数，并实现对完全不同、异构机器人平台的极端跨本体/跨视角零样本仿真到真实迁移，是首个同时达成这两点的模仿学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 以交互为中心、基于规范夹爪坐标系表示与混合特征的设计，有效解耦任务语义与硬件几何，为异构平台间的零样本灵巧操作迁移提供了可行路径。

title: Video-to-Music Generation for Gameplay Videos
summary: Video-to-music models have advanced considerably in the last few years, particularly in film and music video applications. In this paper, we investigate this problem in the video game domain, which introduces new challenges for these models: video frames are rendered graphics, music is mostly synthetic audio, and soundtracks loop across entire levels rather than following on-screen events. We introduce a new dataset of 217.6 hours of Super Nintendo (SNES) gameplay video paired with 485 hours of clean soundtracks, free of sound effects and voice-overs, matched to gameplay audio via audio fingerprinting. With this dataset, we train a simple encoder-decoder transformer that passes video features directly to a MusicGen decoder, comparing different encoding strategies: textual descriptions (T5), independent frames (ViT), or spatiotemporal patches (ViViT). Each encoder is tested both frozen and fine-tuned, while the decoder is always fine-tuned. Frozen encoders match or outperform their fine-tuned counterparts on every metric, and the frozen ViViT achieves the best overall results. We compare this model with state-of-the-art baselines using both objective metrics and a listening study (N = 96). Despite having up to 18% fewer parameters, our model outperforms all baselines on objective metrics, surpasses GVMGen in the listening study, and performs comparably to OSSL.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了SNES游戏视频-音乐数据集，训练编码器-解码器Transformer生成配乐，发现冻结编码器优于微调，ViViT最佳。
AI.motivation: 视频到音乐生成在电影和音乐视频领域已有进展，但游戏领域存在新挑战：画面为渲染图形、音乐多为合成音频、配乐跨整个关卡循环而非跟随屏幕事件，现有模型未必适配。
AI.method: 构建217.6小时SNES游戏视频与485小时无音效无配音纯净原声配乐的数据集，通过音频指纹匹配游戏音频；训练简单编码器-解码器Transformer，将视频特征直接传入MusicGen解码器；对比三种编码策略：文本描述（T5）、独立帧（ViT）、时空块（ViViT），每种编码器分别冻结与微调，解码器始终微调。
AI.result: 冻结编码器在所有指标上匹配或超过微调版本，冻结ViViT总体最佳；与SOTA基线相比，尽管参数量最多少18%，客观指标全面超越所有基线，听测研究（N=96）中超越GVMGen，与OSSL表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 在游戏视频-音乐生成任务中，直接使用冻结的视频编码器配合微调MusicGen解码器即可取得优异效果，冻结ViViT为最优配置，模型以更少参数实现或超越现有方法。

title: WeaveAgent: A Two-Stage Tool-Routing Agent for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Problem. Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing with vague user intents has two bottlenecks: visual tokens are expensive, and tool calling must be format-reliable (pretrained models emit zero tool calls zero-shot). Method. WeaveAgent, a two-stage tool-routing agent, decouples routing from visual perception. Stage A is routing-first: emission is trained, not elicited. Stage B executes conditionally: intrinsic queries enter visual answering (full-scene thumbnail; a WeaveEarth-style evidence board as an optional fixed-budget, approx. 5k-token compression interface); extrinsic queries execute tool call on original full-resolution imagery, answering from tool observations in a second, observation-masked round. Training: alignment SFT, then GRPO under reward R_WA2. Results. Alignment SFT lifts extrinsic routing from 0% to 80.75% (323/400); GRPO suppresses 9 intrinsic mis-emissions while tool selection is unchanged. The trained 2B system does not beat the zero-shot 8B baseline overall (0.263 vs. 0.250), a diagnostic contribution. Oracle attribution separates two repair ingredients: loading the observation into context lifts extrinsic answer accuracy from 0.025 to 0.425 under marker-free cross-mode returns, and the two-turn SFT stage adds a further +9.3 points to 0.518 at a small routing cost. A +/- image ablation shows emission suppression is visually grounded, and a query-register matrix shows LLM-rewritten queries cost trained checkpoints 2-11 points. Scope. All training and evaluation use the 5,000 / 3,273 / 1,000-record VagueUHR corpus (600 intrinsic + 400 tool-requiring; the base seeds synthesis and is not used for optimization). Single-pass evidence construction runs at 7.31 s per image on an RTX 4090. Code, data, and evaluation protocols will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WeaveAgent，一种两阶段工具路由智能体，将工具路由与视觉感知解耦：阶段A先训练工具调用发射能力，阶段B按查询类型条件执行（内在查询走缩略图/证据板压缩问答，外在查询在原始全分辨率影像上执行工具调用并以观测掩码二次作答）。系统经对齐SFT与GRPO训练，实现外在路由从0%提升至80.75%。
AI.motivation: 超高分（UHR）遥感结合模糊用户意图存在两个瓶颈：一是视觉token开销高昂，二是工具调用必须格式可靠，而预训练模型零样本下无法产生任何工具调用（0%发射）。
AI.method: WeaveAgent两阶段工具路由智能体：Stage A为路由优先，通过训练而非诱导实现工具调用发射；Stage B条件执行，内在查询进入视觉问答（全场景缩略图，可选WeaveEarth式证据板作为固定预算约5k token的压缩接口），外在查询在原始全分辨率影像上执行工具调用，并在第二轮以观测掩码方式基于工具观测作答。训练流程为对齐SFT后进行GRPO，奖励为R_WA2。
AI.result: 对齐SFT将外在路由从0%提升至80.75%（323/400）；GRPO抑制9例内在误发射且工具选择不变。训练后的2B系统整体未超越零样本8B基线（0.263 vs 0.250），作为诊断性发现。Oracle归因分离出两项修复要素：将观测载入上下文使外在答案准确率在无标记跨模式返回下从0.025升至0.425，两轮SFT再增加+9.3点至0.518，路由仅小幅代价。±图像消融显示发射抑制具有视觉依据；查询寄存器矩阵显示LLM改写查询使训练检查点损失2-11点。
AI.conclusion: 在VagueUHR语料（5,000/3,273/1,000条记录，600内在+400需工具；基座仅用于合成种子不参与优化）上训练与评估，单次证据构建在RTX 4090上每图耗时7.31秒，代码、数据与评测协议将开源。

title: RupeeBias: Auditing Demographic Bias in Indian Economic Guidance from Large Language Models
summary: Individuals turn to large language models (LLMs) for guidance across a wide range of economic tasks, from comparing loan options and planning savings to deciding what raise to ask for or how much to charge for their services. LLMs are known to reproduce social biases, and biased economic guidance may influence what users believe they are worth, what they ask for, and what they ultimately accept. This risk is especially salient in India, where economic outcomes are shaped by demographic categories such as caste and urban-rural location. Existing LLM bias benchmarks, however, are largely designed around Western demographic categories and therefore miss key axes of economic disparity in the Indian context. We introduce RupeeBias, a benchmark for auditing demographic bias in LLM-generated economic guidance across Indian economic settings. RupeeBias consists of 39,150 prompts spanning four use cases: salary estimation, salary increment estimation, counter-offer recommendation, and service pricing recommendation. The benchmark follows a single-attribute counterfactual design, holding the description of the user's qualifications, experience, or service offering fixed while varying one demographic identifier at a time. RupeeBias covers 87 India-specific demographic identifiers across six axes: caste, religion, regional identity, gender, disability, and urban-rural location, with all prompts constructed in both English and Hinglish. We evaluate nine LLMs on RupeeBias and find systematic demographic disparities across all six axes. For otherwise identical prompts that differ only in demographic identifier, LLM-generated economic outputs differ by 20.2% on average. We publicly release RupeeBias to support future research on demographic bias in LLM-generated economic guidance across India-specific demographic and economic contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RupeeBias，一个针对印度经济场景下LLM生成经济建议的人口统计偏差审计基准，包含39,150条提示，覆盖6个人口统计维度，评估9个LLM后发现在所有维度上均存在系统性偏差，平均经济产出差异达20.2%。
AI.motivation: 用户日益依赖LLM获取薪资、储蓄、报价等经济建议，而LLM已知会复现社会偏见，可能导致用户对自身价值、索要金额和最终接受条件的判断被扭曲。现有LLM偏差基准主要基于西方人口统计类别，无法捕捉印度语境下由种姓、城乡位置等塑造的关键经济不平等维度，因此亟需针对印度经济场景的偏差审计工具。
AI.method: 提出RupeeBias基准，包含39,150条提示，覆盖四个用例：薪资估计、薪资涨幅估计、还价建议和服务定价建议。采用单属性反事实设计，固定用户资质、经验或服务描述，一次仅改变一个人口统计标识。覆盖印度特有的87个人口统计标识，分属六个维度：种姓、宗教、地区身份、性别、残疾和城乡位置，所有提示均以英语和Hinglish双语构建。在RupeeBias上评估九个LLM。
AI.result: 在RupeeBias上评估九个LLM，发现所有六个维度均存在系统性人口统计差异。对于仅人口统计标识不同的其他完全相同提示，LLM生成的经济产出平均差异达20.2%。
AI.conclusion: RupeeBias揭示了印度经济场景下LLM经济建议中普遍存在的人口统计偏差，填补了现有基准在印度语境下的空白。作者公开释放RupeeBias，以支持未来在印度特定人口统计和经济背景下LLM生成经济建议偏差的研究。

title: Geometric Inconsistency Localization in Multi-View Image Sets
comment: 8 pages, accepted at the Deepfake Forensics Workshop (DFF 2026) at ACM Multimedia 2026
summary: Novel view synthesis (NVS) models can produce realistic new views of the same scene from different viewpoints. However, these generated views are not always geometrically consistent with one another. Multi-view (MV) consistency has shown promise as a tool for evaluating these NVS models. Its potential for multimedia forensics, however, remains largely unexplored, particularly for localizing geometric inconsistencies across wide-baseline image pairs. To enable research in this direction, we introduce DeformView, a wide-baseline MV dataset with pixel-level annotations of geometric inconsistencies. Using DeformView, we evaluate state-of-the-art MV consistency-scoring methods and show that approaches developed for NVS evaluation transfer poorly to the forensic task of geometric inconsistency localization. To address this limitation, we propose DEFECt3R, a lightweight learning-based classifier that uses cross-view feature relationships to localize geometric inconsistencies at the pixel level. By learning from explicit supervision, including hard negatives from geometrically consistent yet deformed views, DEFECt3R improves localization performance and substantially reduces false positives compared to existing consistency-scoring methods. Ablation experiments further show that both feature representations and correspondence quality contribute to localization performance. Overall, our findings demonstrate that MV geometric consistency is a promising yet underexplored signal for multimedia forensics and establish a benchmark and baseline for geometric inconsistency localization in wide-baseline MV image pairs. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/IDLabMedia/DeformView-DEFECt3R

AI.tldr: 本文提出宽基线多视图数据集DeformView与轻量学习方法DEFECt3R，用于像素级几何不一致定位，发现现有NVS一致性评分方法迁移到取证任务效果不佳，而显式监督学习显著提升定位性能并降低误报。
AI.motivation: 新视图合成（NVS）生成的视图之间并不总是几何一致。多视图一致性虽已被用于评估NVS模型，但其在多媒体取证中的潜力，尤其是跨宽基线图像对的几何不一致定位，仍鲜有探索。
AI.method: 1) 构建DeformView：带像素级几何不一致标注的宽基线多视图数据集；2) 在该数据集上评估现有SOTA多视图一致性评分方法；3) 提出DEFECt3R：轻量级学习式分类器，利用跨视图特征关系进行像素级不一致定位，并引入来自几何一致但发生形变视图的硬负样本进行显式监督。
AI.result: 现有面向NVS评估的一致性评分方法在几何不一致定位任务上迁移效果差；DEFECt3R提升了定位性能并大幅降低误报；消融实验表明特征表示与对应关系质量均影响定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 多视图几何一致性是多媒体取证中一个有前景但尚未充分挖掘的信号；本文为宽基线多视图图像对的几何不一致定位建立了基准与基线方法。

title: Gauss What You Need: Compact Gaussian Splatting Across Scene Scales
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs a scene as a collection of Gaussian primitives from a set of posed photographs called the capture. The number of primitives used to represent the scene affects reconstruction quality, storage, and rendering cost. How to select this number automatically across capture scales remains unresolved: configurations effective on standard benchmarks can leave larger captures with too few Gaussians to reconstruct fine details. We observe that the surface to represent, given by the capture's extent and resolution, is known before training, whereas its content complexity becomes apparent during training, through the reconstruction quality on the training views. We introduce TangoGS, which combines capture-derived model sizing with training-based adaptation: the capture determines the scale of the model, and training feedback determines its final size within that scale. Before training, TangoGS derives a learning allowance for model growth from the capture's total pixels after discounting views that re-observe the same scene points. During training, reconstruction quality guides how many Gaussians to add and remove. On 13 standard benchmark scenes, TangoGS matches the mean PSNR of the best-performing evaluated baseline, LeGS, with $48\%$ fewer Gaussians. On eight large captures, the same configuration automatically scales to larger models when necessary, achieving the highest mean PSNR among evaluated methods: $0.54$ dB above the runner-up with $2.3\times$ as many Gaussians. Together, capture-derived learning allowances and training-quality guided density control enable a state-of-the-art quality--size compromise across scene scales without retuning.

AI.tldr: TangoGS通过从捕获信息推导模型规模、并借助训练反馈自适应调整高斯数量，在13个标准基准场景中以少48%的高斯数量达到最佳基线LeGS的平均PSNR，在8个大型捕获上自动扩展模型规模并获得最高平均PSNR（比第二名高0.54 dB），实现了跨场景尺度、无需调参的最优质量-规模权衡。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯溅射重建质量、存储与渲染成本取决于高斯原语数量，但如何跨不同捕获规模自动选择该数量尚未解决：在标准基准上有效的配置，在更大捕获上可能导致高斯数量不足，难以重建细节。作者的关键观察是：待表示表面（由捕获的范围与分辨率决定）在训练前已知，而内容复杂度在训练期间才通过训练视图的重建质量显现。因此需要将"捕获推导的模型规模"与"训练驱动的自适应"相结合。
AI.method: TangoGS将捕获推导的模型规模与基于训练的自适应相结合：捕获决定模型尺度，训练反馈决定该尺度内的最终规模。训练前，TangoGS在扣除重复观测同一场景点的视图后，由捕获的总像素数推导出一个用于模型增长的学习额度（learning allowance）。训练中，重建质量指导高斯原语的增加与删除（密度控制）。
AI.result: 在13个标准基准场景上，TangoGS以比最佳评估基线LeGS少48%的高斯数量，达到与之相当的平均PSNR。在8个大型捕获上，同一套配置在必要时自动扩展到更大的模型，取得评估方法中最高的平均PSNR：比第二名高0.54 dB，高斯数量为其2.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 捕获推导的学习额度与训练质量引导的密度控制相结合，使方法能够在不同场景尺度下实现当前最优的质量-规模权衡，且无需重新调参。

title: PIA: A Personal Intelligence Agent Turning Health Conversations into Records and Records into Understanding
summary: General-purpose agent memory summarizes conversations: it extracts salient snippets, embeds them, and retrieves the top-k into the prompt. A health agent cannot run on summaries: a dose becomes a sentence, "since last week" is resolved at the model's discretion, and a three-month glucose trend cannot be answered by text similarity. We present PIA, a personal intelligence agent deployed alongside a consumer health agent. PIA receives the agent's natural-language requests, decides for itself whether and how to write or read, and turns conversations into typed clinical records and records into a synthesized understanding of the user. Its memory harness consists of four controls -- extraction, memory, retrieval, and understanding -- each a domain-agnostic mechanism with a pluggable health module: schema, medical alias dictionary, knowledge graph, and temporal rules. We show how the same query receives a different answer as the memory injected into the response context deepens from one-dimensional recall, to a two-dimensional health snapshot, to a three-dimensional trajectory with causality, and report lessons from operation: self-reported health data are missing not at random, question phrasing governs the quality of synthesized understanding, and nearly a third of candidate causal links are structural noise that rules alone remove.

AI.tldr: 提出PIA，一种与消费级健康智能体协同部署的个人智能体，将对话转化为带类型的临床记录并反向生成用户理解，通过提取、记忆、检索、理解四重可控机制与可插拔健康模块，实现从一维召回、二维健康快照到三维因果轨迹的分层记忆注入。
AI.motivation: 通用智能体记忆以摘要方式处理对话（抽取要点、嵌入、取top-k注入提示），但无法支撑健康场景：剂量被压缩为句子、"自上周以来"的时间语义由模型随意解释、三个月血糖趋势无法靠文本相似度回答。
