AI.method: PIA接收智能体的自然语言请求，自主决定是否及如何读写，将对话转为带类型的临床记录、将记录转为对用户的综合理解；记忆框架含四个控制环节——提取、记忆、检索、理解，每环节为领域无关机制并配有可插拔健康模块：模式（schema）、医学别名词典、知识图谱、时序规则。
AI.result: 同一查询在记忆注入由一维召回、二维健康快照到三维含因果轨迹逐步深化时得到不同答案；运营经验显示：自报健康数据非随机缺失、问题措辞决定综合理解质量、近三分之一的候选因果链是结构性噪声且仅靠规则即可剔除。
AI.conclusion: 面向健康等专业领域的智能体记忆不能停留在摘要式通用方案，需要结构化、类型化、时序与因果感知的领域模块；记忆注入的维度深度直接决定回答质量。

title: MoSAR: Mixture of Semantic Attention Regimes for Learning Adaptive and Approximable Attention Geometries
summary: The quadratic complexity of dense self-attention remains a central bottleneck for long-context language modeling. Many efficient alternatives address this cost by deciding in advance where attention should be sparse or local. We argue that attention approximation should instead be approached as a geometric problem, with the relevant interaction geometry learned from data: natural-language dependencies are input-dependent and difficult to prescribe in advance, so the model should learn where positional relevance can decay and where broader interactions must be preserved. We introduce Mixture of Semantic Attention Regimes (MoSAR), which learns such an adaptive, controlled-decay geometry over query--key interactions. Input-conditioned query and key routers, applied after positional encoding, select mixtures over short, medium, and global regimes, inducing a continuous distance-dependent attention field rather than a fixed sparsity pattern. This geometry is learned during training and can subsequently be discretized through top-1 routing. In controlled pre-training experiments with matched 500M-parameter models, MoSAR learns a substantially lower-reach attention geometry without degrading language-modeling quality, improving perplexity over dense RoPE at the training context length. Under length extrapolation, MoSAR achieves the best perplexity among all evaluated variants, including strong baselines such as ALiBi. Moreover, the learned geometry remains stable under deterministic top-1 discretization, suggesting that it is not only adaptive, but also amenable to low-cost approximation at inference time.

AI.tldr: 提出 MoSAR，将注意力近似视为几何问题，通过学习输入相关的查询/键路由器在短、中、全局注意力机制间混合，形成连续的距离相关注意力场，可事后离散为 top-1 路由。
AI.motivation: 稠密自注意力的二次复杂度是长上下文语言建模的核心瓶颈。现有高效方法多在事前预设稀疏或局部模式，但自然语言依赖是输入相关的，难以预先规定。作者主张应将注意力近似视为几何问题，让模型从数据中学习交互几何，即何处位置相关性可衰减、何处需保留更广交互。
AI.method: MoSAR（Mixture of Semantic Attention Regimes）：在位置编码之后施加输入条件化的查询与键路由器，对短程、中程、全局三类注意力机制进行混合选择，从而诱导连续的、距离相关的注意力场，而非固定稀疏模式。该几何在训练中学习，并可在推理时通过 top-1 路由离散化。
AI.result: 在参数匹配的 500M 模型受控预训练实验中，MoSAR 学到更低"触及范围"的注意力几何，且不损害语言建模质量，在训练上下文长度上困惑度优于稠密 RoPE。在长度外推下，MoSAR 取得所有评估变体中最佳的困惑度，包括 ALiBi 等强基线。此外，学到的几何在确定性 top-1 离散化下保持稳定，表明其既具自适应性，也适合推理时的低成本近似。
AI.conclusion: MoSAR 通过可学习的混合注意力几何实现高效长上下文建模：在不损失质量的前提下降低注意力触及范围，提升长度外推性能，并可通过 top-1 路由进行低成本离散化推理。

title: Identifying Scientists on X
comment: Corrected version of Identifying Scientists on X published at Companion Publication of the 18th ACM Web Science Conference 2026
summary: With the growing importance of science-related discourse on the Web and the erosion of the classical knowledge order, it is important to identify different user groups, such as scientists, automatically. This work proposes an approach for identifying scientists and non- scientists on X/Twitter based on their user biographies and tweets. We show that we are able to classify accounts as scientists and non- scientists on two different datasets, reaching an F1 score of up to 0.88 using Random Forests with linguistic features and up to 0.96 using a contrastively fine-tuned DeBERTa model in an ensemble setup. Furthermore, we provide two datasets with X users labeled as scientists or non scientists and their respective tweets and user biographies.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出在X/Twitter上基于用户简介和推文自动识别科学家与非科学家账号，在两个数据集上分类F1分别最高达0.88（随机森林+语言特征）和0.96（对比微调DeBERTa集成），并公开两个标注数据集。
AI.motivation: 网络科学相关话语日益重要，经典知识秩序受到侵蚀，因此需要自动识别科学家等不同用户群体。
AI.method: 基于X/Twitter用户的个人简介（user biographies）和推文内容进行建模：一方面使用随机森林结合语言特征；另一方面采用对比微调的DeBERTa模型，并在集成（ensemble）框架下进行分类；在两组数据集上评估科学家/非科学家的二分类效果。
AI.result: 在两个不同数据集上均实现科学家与非科学家的账号分类，随机森林结合语言特征最高F1为0.88，对比微调DeBERTa在集成设置下最高F1达0.96；同时提供两个含X用户标签（科学家/非科学家）及其推文和用户简介的数据集。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明基于简介与推文可有效自动区分科学家与非科学家账号，其中对比微调DeBERTa集成方法性能最优，并公开数据集以支持后续研究。

title: Beyond Sparsity: Weight Location and Network Context in Pruned MRI Reconstruction
summary: Pruning reduces the number of weights in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reconstruction networks. Equal sparsity, however, can retain weights with different computational roles and different compatibility with the trained network. We study these effects across 120 convolutional U-Net and vision transformer models using controlled edits evaluated before retraining. In U-Net, preserving high-resolution computation improves reconstruction at equal deletion counts across all tested sparsity levels. Equal-operation controls reveal additional sensitivity of the first convolution, which operation count alone cannot explain. In transformers, retained pretrained weight energy correlates with quality within sparsity levels, yet the same masks reverse their reconstruction ranking when the surrounding trained weights change. At 90\% sparsity, matching intermediate output scales largely removes a high-energy-mask penalty while retaining an advantage for the network's original mask. Thus sparsity alone does not characterize reconstruction quality: architecture-specific descriptors are informative, but mask quality can still depend on the surrounding trained network.

AI.tldr: 本文研究MRI重建网络剪枝中的结构性效应：在相同稀疏度下，不同权重保留方式会导致不同重建质量，且该效应依赖架构并受周围训练权重影响。
AI.motivation: 剪枝虽能减少MRI重建网络权重数量，但相同稀疏度可保留计算角色不同、与训练网络兼容性不同的权重，仅用稀疏度不足以刻画重建质量。
AI.method: 在120个卷积U-Net与视觉Transformer模型上进行受控编辑，并在重训练前评估；比较不同剪枝掩码、等操作数控制、保留预训练权重能量、以及匹配中间输出尺度等条件。
AI.result: U-Net中保留高分辨率计算在所有测试稀疏度下均改善重建；等操作数控制显示第一层卷积存在操作数无法解释的敏感性。Transformer中，保留的预训练权重能量与稀疏度内质量相关，但相同掩码在周围训练权重改变时重建排名反转；90%稀疏度下，匹配中间输出尺度可大幅消除高能量掩码惩罚，同时保留原网络掩码优势。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏度本身不能表征重建质量；架构特定描述符具有信息量，但掩码质量仍可能依赖周围训练网络，需结合架构结构与网络上下文评估剪枝。

title: Awaken, Then Scale: Tiny Adaptation for MRI Reconstruction
summary: Dormant Awakening (DA) specializes a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reconstruction model by fitting a small set of zero weights to one labeled slice. Across fourteen U-shaped convolutional network (U-Net) and vision transformer (ViT) sources, fitting 1,004 or 10,560 weights gives mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) gains of .430 and .509 dB. We analyze how scaling the fitted output correction changes evaluation PSNR, then use the calibration correction size to cap changes on new images. The cap bounds changes in root mean squared error (RMSE) relative to the source without an evaluation reference. At 10\% adaptation budget, we compare fixed halving and dynamic capping for DA, unrestricted sparse adaptation and low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The controls increase both measured calibration-evaluation correlations across all six tested architecture-adapter settings. Experiments concern one constructed fastMRI-to-M4Raw shift with fixed source checkpoints and participant panels.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出并分析"休眠觉醒"（DA）方法：通过在单个标注切片上拟合少量零初始化权重，将MRI重建模型特化，并研究用校准校正幅度来限制新图像上的变化。
AI.motivation: MRI重建模型在源域与目标域之间存在分布偏移，需要低成本的特化/适配。作者希望探究仅拟合极少量权重（如1,004或10,560个）能否有效提升重建质量，并控制适配带来的风险。
AI.method: DA通过在单张标注切片上拟合一组小规模零权重来特化MRI重建模型；分析缩放拟合输出校正对评估PSNR的影响，并以校准校正幅度为上限约束新图像上的改变。在10%适配预算下，对比固定减半、动态封顶、无约束稀疏适配与LoRA，覆盖14个U-Net与ViT源模型、6种架构-适配器设置。
AI.result: 拟合1,004与10,560个权重分别带来平均PSNR增益0.430 dB与0.509 dB；校准校正幅度上限可在无评估参考的情况下约束RMSE变化；控制方法在全部六种架构-适配器设置中均提高了校准-评估相关性。
AI.conclusion: 极少量权重拟合即可有效特化MRI重建模型，基于校准校正幅度的封顶机制能在无参考评估时限制风险，且优于固定减半等基线，实验基于一个构建的fastMRI-to-M4Raw偏移场景。

title: MoTop: Motion-Topological Model For Micro AU Detection
summary: Facial micro-expressions are spontaneous, brief, and subtle facial movements that reveal suppressed emotions in high-stakes environments. In contrast to classic expression analysis, detecting action unit (AU) yields a finer representation of facial movements, serving as a preliminary step before defining expression classes and other downstream tasks. Therefore, it represents a crucial upstream task in facial analysis, and improving an AU detection module increases the precision of facial analysis. Despite that, detecting AU is challenging because of the constrictive nature of the AU activation regions, leading to confusion among different AUs known as AU ambiguity. To model the fine-scale changes, we propose \textbf{MoTop}, a motion-topological model that is augmented with a learnable motion context, yielding regional soft guidance for facial activity, followed by facial landmarks that capture the fine-scale topological changes of micro AUs. To increase the micro facial landmark representations, we amplify the encoded facial landmark transitions via linear extrapolation, thereby increasing the spatial proximity of landmarks and enhancing the low-intensity landmark dynamics. In addition, we design anatomical facial clusters that enhance the hierarchical representation, facilitating multi-scale modelling of facial geometry and improving micro-topological representations. With these contributions, we have achieved state-of-the-art performance on the CD6ME protocol for the micro AU detection task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoTop，一个运动-拓扑模型，通过可学习运动上下文、面部关键点线性外推放大及解剖学面部聚类，提升微表情动作单元检测性能，在CD6ME协议上达到最优。
AI.motivation: 面部微表情是自发的、短暂且细微的动作，能揭示高压力情境下被抑制的情绪。相比经典表情分析，检测动作单元（AU）能更精细地表征面部运动，是定义表情类别及下游任务的关键上游步骤。然而AU激活区域高度局限，导致不同AU之间易混淆（AU歧义），使得AU检测极具挑战性。
AI.method: 提出MoTop运动-拓扑模型：(1)引入可学习运动上下文，生成面部活动的区域软引导；(2)利用面部关键点捕捉微AU的细尺度拓扑变化；(3)通过线性外推放大编码后的关键点位移，增大关键点空间邻近性并增强低强度关键点动态；(4)设计解剖学面部聚类，增强层次化表示，促进面部几何的多尺度建模并改善微拓扑表示。
AI.result: 在微AU检测任务的CD6ME协议上取得了当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: MoTop通过融合运动上下文与关键点拓扑建模，有效缓解AU歧义问题，为微表情AU检测提供了高精度的解决方案，并可作为面部分析中更精确的上游模块。

title: Why Alzheimer's Speech Screening Fails to Generalize: Bridging the Deployment Gap via Cross-Corpus Evidence Anchoring
summary: Speech-based screening is a promising, non-invasive approach for detecting Alzheimer's disease and related cognitive risks. However, models trained on a single domain often generalize poorly to unseen languages, tasks, or recording protocols. This paper investigates this deployment gap using a leave-one-corpus-out evaluation across four distinct datasets. Among 70 interpretable speech and language features, 59 exhibit direction conflicts between healthy control and cognitive risk groups across corpora, with pause, silence, and speech rate showing high protocol sensitivity. Furthermore, while the XLM-R text baseline achieves strong average performance, its Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC) drops to 0.520 on the weakest held-out domain. A standard GroupDRO baseline reaches a 0.766 mean speaker AUC and a 0.504 worst-domain AUC under the same protocol. To address this, we propose a fusion method that integrates XLM-R text baseline scores with evidence anchors selected during training. Balanced fusion achieves a 0.785 mean speaker AUC, while anchor-heavy fusion raises the worst-case speaker AUC to 0.615. This work highlights the need to audit feature transferability and report worst-case domain robustness in cognitive speech screening.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语音认知筛查模型的跨域泛化问题，采用留一语料库评估揭示特征方向冲突与协议敏感性，提出融合XLM-R文本分数与证据锚点的方法，将最差域说话人AUC从0.504提升至0.615。
AI.motivation: 语音筛查阿尔茨海默病及相关认知风险具有无创、便捷的优势，但单域训练的模型在未见语言、任务或录音协议上泛化能力差，部署存在显著鸿沟；同时可解释语音特征的跨语料可迁移性缺乏审计，最差域鲁棒性也鲜有报告。
AI.method: 在四个数据集上进行留一语料库交叉评估；审计70个可解释语音与语言特征的跨语料方向一致性；以XLM-R文本基线作为参照，并引入GroupDRO基线；提出将XLM-R文本基线分数与训练时选取的证据锚点（evidence anchors）相融合的方法，比较均衡融合与锚点重加权融合两种策略。
AI.result: 70个特征中有59个在健康对照与认知风险组间存在跨语料方向冲突，停顿、静音与语速对录音协议高度敏感；XLM-R文本基线平均表现强但在最弱留出域AUC降至0.520；标准GroupDRO取得0.766平均说话人AUC与0.504最差域AUC；均衡融合达0.785平均说话人AUC，锚点重加权融合将最差域说话人AUC提升至0.615。
AI.conclusion: 认知语音筛查研究需系统审计特征的可迁移性，并报告最差域鲁棒性；基于证据锚点的融合策略可有效缓解跨域性能崩塌，在保持平均性能的同时显著改善最差域表现。

title: UniAR: A Unified Framework for Autism Recognition Enhanced by Multi-View Prompt Learning
summary: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a complex neurodevelopmental disorder for which early and accurate diagnosis is critical to improving long-term developmental outcomes. However, existing ASD recognition methods are often constrained by the scarcity of diagnostic text data, forcing them to rely mainly on visual analysis and limiting their ability to model clinically meaningful semantic reasoning. To address this challenge, we propose UniAR, a unified framework enhanced by multi-granularity prompt learning for robust ASD recognition under heterogeneous data variations. Specifically, UniAR leverages a large multimodal model to generate hierarchical diagnostic descriptions at the word, phrase, and sentence levels, compensating for the lack of paired clinical reports. To align the generated semantics with visual evidence, we further design a Mixture-of-Experts-based Multi-Scale Alignment Module, which dynamically matches vector-quantized visual prototypes with semantic representations at corresponding granularities. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks covering brain MRI and facial expression scenarios show that UniAR consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, achieving average accuracies of 75.9\% on MRI benchmarks and 91.6\% on facial benchmarks, while improving average Accuracy on MRI benchmarks by 1.5 percentage points and average Accuracy on facial benchmarks by 1.2 percentage points over baselines. These results demonstrate that UniAR offers a robust and interpretable framework for ASD screening under semantic scarcity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UniAR 框架，通过多粒度提示学习生成词、短语、句三级诊断描述，并结合专家混合的多尺度对齐模块匹配视觉原型与语义表征，在脑部 MRI 与人脸表情四类基准上实现稳健且可解释的 ASD 识别。
AI.motivation: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）的早期准确诊断对改善长期发育结果至关重要，但现有识别方法受限于诊断文本数据稀缺，主要依赖视觉分析，难以建模具有临床意义的语义推理。
AI.method: UniAR 为统一框架，由多粒度提示学习增强：利用大型多模态模型生成词、短语、句子层级的层次化诊断描述，以弥补配对临床报告的缺失；并设计基于混合专家（MoE）的多尺度对齐模块，将向量量化视觉原型与对应粒度的语义表征动态匹配，实现语义与视觉证据的对齐。
AI.result: 在涵盖脑部 MRI 与人脸表情场景的四个基准上，UniAR 稳定优于现有最先进方法：MRI 基准平均准确率 75.9%、人脸基准 91.6%；相较基线，MRI 平均准确率提升 1.5 个百分点，人脸提升 1.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: UniAR 为语义稀缺条件下的 ASD 筛查提供了稳健且可解释的框架，验证了多粒度语义生成与跨模态对齐的有效性。

title: CytoSPM: Open-Vocabulary Cytopathology Detection with Structured Prompt Bank
summary: Cytopathology detection requires open-vocabulary recognition because cellular categories are fine-grained, long-tailed, and continuously evolving across different organ systems. However, existing cytology detectors are mostly single-domain and closed-set, and there is still no unified benchmark for evaluating open-vocabulary cytopathology detection. We present PentaCyto, a multi-domain benchmark covering cervical, urinary, respiratory, serous fluid, and thyroid cytology, with 24 base categories and 9 held-out novel categories. Each category is associated with structured cytomorphology prompts that describe diagnostic morphological attributes and provide clinically grounded textual knowledge. We further propose CytoSPM, an efficient detector based on a decoupled two-stage design. It first extracts reusable class-agnostic visual representations, and then performs class-aware structural prompt matching with class names and cytomorphology prompts. On PentaCyto, CytoSPM outperforms existing methods in novel-category detection and open-vocabulary detection while maintaining efficient inference.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出多域开放词汇细胞病理检测基准PentaCyto及高效检测器CytoSPM，在新类别与开放词汇检测上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 细胞病理检测中的细胞类别具有细粒度、长尾分布且不断演化的特点，因此需要开放词汇识别能力。然而现有细胞学检测器多为单域、闭集设计，且缺乏用于评估开放词汇细胞病理检测的统一基准。
AI.method: 构建PentaCyto基准，覆盖宫颈、泌尿、呼吸、浆液和甲状腺五个细胞学域，含24个基础类别和9个留出新类别，每类配备描述诊断形态属性的结构化细胞形态学提示。提出CytoSPM检测器，采用解耦两阶段设计：先提取可复用的类别无关视觉表征，再结合类别名与细胞形态学提示进行类别感知的结构化提示匹配。
AI.result: 在PentaCyto上，CytoSPM在新类别检测和开放词汇检测方面优于现有方法，同时保持高效的推理速度。
AI.conclusion: PentaCyto为开放词汇细胞病理检测提供了统一的多域评估基准，CytoSPM以解耦两阶段与结构化提示匹配实现了性能与效率的兼顾，推动了该领域开放词汇识别的发展。

title: CG-HAF: An Interpretable Global-Local Lesion-Burden Fusion Framework for Ordinal Acne Severity Grading in Agentic Skincare Support
comment: Manuscript under review at Expert Systems with Applications
summary: Ordinal acne severity grading requires distinguishing visually similar neighboring grades while jointly weighing holistic facial appearance and localized lesion burden - evidence that most existing approaches collapse into a single opaque representation. We introduce CG-HAF, a global-local fusion framework that instead keeps this evidence explicit: averaged holistic severity probabilities from independently trained classifiers are combined with structured lesion-burden descriptors from an object detector (lesion count, detection confidence, lesion area) into a compact representation, from which a lightweight, interpretable classifier produces the final grade. On a widely used benchmark, this fusion yields a clear, statistically supported improvement over global-evidence-only baselines, with the largest gains on the most severe cases. Testing on an independent dataset with a different grading standard shows that strong within-dataset performance does not transfer automatically, and a follow-up diagnostic attributes much of this gap to mismatched grading criteria rather than detection failure alone. These findings support interpretable global-local fusion as an effective strategy for ordinal acne grading while highlighting criterion alignment as key to cross-dataset portability, with a further illustration of how the resulting severity signal can support transparent, non-diagnostic decision-making in skincare applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CG-HAF框架，通过显式融合全局整体严重度概率与目标检测器提取的病灶负担描述符，实现可解释的序数型痤疮分级，并揭示跨数据集迁移的关键障碍在于分级标准不一致而非检测失效。
AI.motivation: 序数型痤疮分级需同时区分视觉相似的相邻等级，并兼顾整体面部外观与局部病灶负担；现有方法多将两类证据压缩为单一不透明表征，缺乏可解释性，且跨数据集泛化能力不明。
AI.method: 提出CG-HAF全局-局部融合框架：将独立训练的全局分类器输出的整体严重度概率平均值，与目标检测器提取的结构化病灶负担描述符（病灶计数、检测置信度、病灶面积）组合为紧凑表征，再由轻量且可解释的分类器输出最终等级。
AI.result: 在常用基准上，该融合相较仅用全局证据的基线取得具统计显著性的提升，且在重度病例上增益最大；在采用不同分级标准的独立数据集上，数据集内优异表现无法自动迁移，诊断分析表明差距主要源于分级标准不匹配，而非单纯的检测失败。
AI.conclusion: 可解释的全局-局部融合是序数型痤疮分级的有效策略，而分级标准对齐是跨数据集可迁移性的关键；所得严重度信号可支持护肤应用中透明、非诊断性的决策。

title: ChronoFuseGS: Multi-Temporal Gaussian Fusion with Per-Splat Persistence and Change Visualization
summary: Reconstructing environments where parts of the scene change between captured image sets poses a challenge for 3D scene reconstruction. We present ChronoFuseGS, a multi-temporal Gaussian Splatting approach that addresses this issue by taking multiple separately trained Gaussian Splatting models, each representing a distinct timestep and partially overlapping in geographic coverage, and merging them into a single combined model. By allowing Gaussians from one timestep to contribute to the reconstruction at other timesteps, our approach leverages data across all captured timesteps to refine persistent parts of the scene. The model supports incremental extension, allowing new timesteps to be added while preserving the existing merged reconstruction. It encodes, for each Gaussian primitive, at which timesteps it contributes to the reconstruction. To support visual exploration of the reconstructed scene, we present a change-aware visualization approach that highlights the parts of the scene that have changed across a user-defined time selection, while preserving the color of persistent parts. Since the persistence encoding operates at the Gaussian primitive level, changes are visualized at sub-object granularity rather than being limited to object-level changes. We evaluate our approach on a real-world outdoor dataset of a flood management area, captured over 7 months across eight recording days and covering seasonal vegetation changes, snow cover, and flooding events, which we make publicly available. Our results demonstrate that the combined model consistently outperforms individually trained single-timestep models in novel-view synthesis quality, recovers structural details absent in the individual reconstructions, and reliably highlights changes in fine details and sub-parts of objects and natural structures.

AI.tldr: ChronoFuseGS 将多个独立训练的多时相高斯泼溅模型合并为单一模型，通过高斯原语级持久性编码实现跨时相数据融合、增量扩展与变化感知可视化，并在公开的洪泛管理区数据集上取得优于单时相模型的合成质量。
AI.motivation: 重建场景中部分内容随不同时期采集的图像集而发生变化的3D环境，是3D场景重建的难点。单时相模型仅能利用各自的观测数据，无法借助其他时相的充足观测来补全遮挡或未观测区域，难以区分持久部分与变化部分。
AI.method: 该方法以多个分别训练、地理覆盖部分重叠的高斯泼溅模型为输入，将其合并为统一模型：允许某一时相的高斯对其他时相的渲染产生贡献，从而利用所有已捕获时相的数据精修场景中的持久部分；为每个高斯原语编码其参与重建的时相集合，支持在保留已合并重建的前提下增量加入新时相。此外提出变化感知可视化方法，按用户选定的时间区间高亮变化区域，同时保持持久部分的颜色，由于持久性编码作用于高斯原语级别，变化可视化可达子物体粒度。
AI.result: 在自建的户外洪泛管理区真实数据集（覆盖7个月、8个采集日，包含季节性植被变化、积雪与洪涝事件）上评估，合并模型在新视角合成质量上持续优于各单时相独立训练模型，恢复了单独重建中缺失的结构细节，并能可靠高亮细粒度变化及物体与自然结构的子部件变化。
AI.conclusion: ChronoFuseGS 通过跨时相融合与高斯原语级持久性编码，实现了多时相3D场景的统一重建、增量扩展与子物体级变化可视化，并公开数据集以支持后续研究。

title: The Right Information Extraction Pipeline Depends on the Document: Accuracy-Energy Trade-offs for Small, Local Models
summary: Whether an information extraction pipeline should process page images or parsed text depends on the document, and the answer flips across the layout spectrum. We study this trade-off under a constraint that rules out (closed) cloud services: privacy-sensitive documents processed on-premise by small ($\le 8\mathrm{B}$ parameter) text-only and vision--language models, evaluated on both accuracy and energy over a design space spanning input representation, model family, and inference configuration. Benchmarking on the near-plain-text Kleister-NDA contracts and the layout-rich VRDU forms, we find that batching is the dominant energy lever, cutting energy per page by 38-85% at no cost in accuracy, while FP8 quantization saves 27-32% when requests are served one at a time but less than 1mWh per page (9-19%) once batching is applied. Preprocessing dominates what remains: neural OCR costs $17\times$ more energy per page than classical OCR and never reaches the Pareto frontier. Which representation wins flips with the type of document: vision--language models on layout-rich documents and small text-only models with a cheap parser on near-plain text, where they are both more accurate and cheaper than any vision--language configuration. Our work yields concrete guidelines for energy-efficient, privacy-compliant local information extraction.

AI.tldr: 在本地部署（≤8B参数）隐私合规约束下，比较页面图像与解析文本两种输入表示的信息抽取方案，发现批处理是主导能耗杠杆，最优表示随文档版式类型翻转。
AI.motivation: 信息抽取流程应处理页面图像还是解析文本取决于文档本身，其答案随版式谱系而变。既有工作多依赖云端闭源服务，无法满足隐私敏感文档的本地处理需求，也缺乏对准确率与能耗联合的权衡分析。
AI.method: 在禁止闭源云服务的约束下，使用≤8B参数的纯文本与视觉语言模型进行本地推理；构建涵盖输入表示、模型族与推理配置的设计空间，在准确率和能耗两个维度上评估；基准数据集为近乎纯文本的Kleister-NDA合同与版式丰富的VRDU表单。
AI.result: 批处理是主导能耗杠杆，每页能耗降低38-85%且无准确率损失；FP8量化在单请求服务时节省27-32%，但应用批处理后节省不足1mWh/页（9-19%）。预处理占剩余能耗主导：神经OCR每页能耗是经典OCR的17倍，且从未进入帕累托前沿。最优表示随文档类型翻转：版式丰富文档用视觉语言模型，近乎纯文本用小型纯文本模型配廉价解析器，后者在准确率和成本上均优于任何视觉语言配置。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了面向能效优化且隐私合规的本地信息抽取具体指南：优先采用批处理，审慎使用量化，避免神经OCR，并根据文档版式类型选择输入表示。

title: Stale-Document Poisoning: When Outdated Retrieval Overrides Correct Model Answers
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is often used to address outdated knowledge by providing external evidence. But retrieval helps only when that evidence is still valid. We identify a temporal alignment failure, stale-document poisoning, in which outdated evidence makes a model wrong despite answering correctly without retrieval. We construct a benchmark of 317 verified knowledge reversals across medicine, law, software, and platform policy, grounded in dated official sources. Across 12 models, recent medical reversals are harder than long-established ones. More importantly, outdated retrieval flips 30% of Llama and 37% of Qwen answers even without instructions to trust the document; explicit follow instructions raise these rates to 66% and 75%. Across four open models and four domains, poisoning ranges from 17-91%, while matched up-to-date evidence is followed in 97-100% of trials. To isolate temporal applicability, we keep the historical evidence unchanged across 50 reversals and vary only the evaluation date. A clear pattern emerges: dates alone produce only modest adaptation, but when models are explicitly told when the old evidence stops applying, the larger models switch to the appropriate answer almost perfectly. Causal interventions confirm that this validity information directly shapes the final decision. The same internal components also support broader comparison tasks, suggesting that temporal applicability can recruit a general reasoning mechanism used for other comparisons. Finally, a fixed recency-aware hybrid re-ranker reduces poisoning by 4.6-10.0 points when dates are accurate, with gains that depend on reliable temporal metadata. Reliable RAG therefore requires selective trust: models must determine not only what retrieved evidence says, but whether it still applies.

AI.tldr: 论文识别出RAG中的"过期文档投毒"（stale-document poisoning）问题：过时证据会误导本可正确作答的模型。作者构建了317个跨医学、法律、软件、平台政策的知识反转基准，发现过期检索可使模型回答翻转30%-91%，而显式告知证据失效时点后大模型几乎能完全纠正，并验证了再排序器可部分缓解此问题。
AI.motivation: RAG通常用于弥补知识过时问题，但其有效性前提是检索到的证据仍然有效。现有研究忽视了证据的时间适用性（temporal applicability）问题：即使检索到内容相关，若证据已过时，反而会误导模型，使其在无检索时本可正确回答却给出错误答案。作者因此提出并刻画"过期文档投毒"这一时间对齐失败模式。
AI.method: 1) 构建含317个经核实的知识反转基准，覆盖医学、法律、软件、平台政策四个领域，均以有日期的官方来源为依据；2) 在12个模型上测试过期检索对答案的影响，区分"无指令信任"与"显式遵循"两种条件；3) 在4个开源模型、4个领域中测量投毒率，并与匹配的最新证据对照（后者被遵循率97%-100%）；4) 通过保持历史证据不变、仅改变评估日期（50个反转）来隔离时间适用性因素；5) 进行因果干预实验，定位支撑有效性信息的内部组件；6) 评估固定时效感知混合再排序器（recency-aware hybrid re-ranker）的缓解效果。
AI.result: 过期检索在无信任指令下翻转Llama 30%、Qwen 37%的答案，加入显式遵循指令后升至66%和75%。四个开源模型、四个领域中投毒率为17%-91%，而匹配的最新证据遵循率达97%-100%。仅提供日期只带来有限适应，但显式告知旧证据何时失效时，较大模型几乎能完美切换到正确答案。因果干预证实有效性信息直接塑造最终决策，且相同内部组件也支撑更广泛的比较任务，提示时间适用性可调用通用推理机制。固定时效感知混合再排序器在日期准确时将投毒降低4.6-10.0个百分点，增益依赖可靠的时间元数据。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的RAG需要"选择性信任"：模型不仅要判断检索证据说了什么，还要判断其是否仍然适用。时间适用性是RAG系统中被忽视但关键的一环，显式提供证据失效信息可显著提升模型正确性，而仅靠日期或再排序器的效果有限，且依赖准确的时间元数据。

title: DyMD: Preserving Interaction Dynamics through Distribution Matching Distillation in Few-Step Video World Models
summary: Large video diffusion models offer expressive priors for embodied prediction and learning, yet their many-step sampling remains costly for interactive downstream use. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) enables few-step video generation, but can suppress robot--object motion while preserving visual quality. Examining DMD's teacher and fake-score signals, we find that weak re-noising keeps the teacher posterior concentrated near motion-deficient rollouts, limiting motion-restoring guidance. Meanwhile, stronger-motion rollouts tend to incur larger fake-score fitting errors, which can hinder the generator's learning of interaction dynamics. We propose DyMD, a DMD framework that adapts both teacher supervision and critic fitting to the evolving student. Temporal affinity--conditioned re-noise sampling adapts the timestep distribution to each rollout's current interaction fidelity by mixing the base schedule with a teacher prior motivated by local posterior variation, thereby balancing motion recovery and appearance refinement. To better track stronger-motion rollouts, dynamics-guided fake-score tracking uses a noise-conditioned predictor to estimate noise-relative fitting difficulty from latent temporal dynamics, then upweights predicted-hard rollouts in the critic loss. Using DyMD, we distill a 14B teacher into a four-step 1.3B student with no auxiliary modules at inference. On embodied-video benchmarks, the student improves R-Bench task adherence by $9.6$ percentage points and PAI-Bench-G Domain score by $5.1$ points over Base DMD while maintaining comparable visual quality. As a backbone for downstream action planning, our student achieves 34% mean success across two WorldArena tasks, compared with 16% for Base DMD.

AI.tldr: DyMD：自适应蒸馏框架，通过时间亲和度条件重噪采样与动力学引导假分数跟踪，将14B视频扩散教师蒸馏为四步1.3B学生模型，在保持视觉质量的同时显著提升具身视频运动保真度与下游规划成功率。
AI.motivation: 大型视频扩散模型虽为具身预测与学习提供强先验，但多步采样成本高，难以用于交互式下游任务。分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）可实现少步生成，但会抑制机器人-物体运动——弱重噪使教师后验集中于运动匮乏的采样轨迹，限制运动恢复引导；而强运动轨迹又常带来更大的假分数拟合误差，阻碍生成器学习交互动力学。
AI.method: 提出DyMD，使教师监督与评论家（critic）拟合随学生演化自适应调整。其一，时间亲和度条件重噪采样：依据每条轨迹当前交互保真度，将基础调度与基于局部后验变化的教师先验混合，自适应调整时间步分布，平衡运动恢复与外观精修。其二，动力学引导假分数跟踪：用噪声条件预测器从潜时序动力学估计相对噪声的拟合难度，在评论家损失中对预测为"难拟合"的轨迹加权。
AI.result: 将14B教师蒸馏为四步1.3B学生，推理时无需辅助模块。在具身视频基准上，相较Base DMD，R-Bench任务遵循度提升9.6个百分点，PAI-Bench-G Domain分数提升5.1分，视觉质量相当。作为下游动作规划骨干，学生在两项WorldArena任务上平均成功率达34%，而Base DMD为16%。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应调整教师监督与假分数拟合，DyMD有效缓解DMD在具身视频蒸馏中的运动抑制问题，实现少步、高质量且运动保真的学生模型，并显著增强下游动作规划能力。

title: Open Vocabulary Domain Unlearning
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit remarkable zero-shot generalization, yet they often encode unwanted or hazardous stylistic domains such as idealized textbook diagrams in medical AI or cartoon vehicles in autonomous driving. Approximate Domain Unlearning (ADU) aims to selectively erase a model's recognition of a target visual domain while preserving accuracy on the remaining domains. However, existing ADU methods operate under a flawed closed-vocabulary assumption: they evaluate unlearning solely on the specific object classes seen during the unlearning fine-tuning phase. Consequently, these methods do not unlearn the domain itself; they merely overfit to seen class-domain pairs, leaving the domain easily recognizable for unseen classes and providing a false sense of removal. We argue that true domain erasure must be class-agnostic. To address this, we formalize Open-Vocabulary Domain Unlearning (OVDU), a rigorous protocol that mandates domain forgetting must transfer to held-out classes. To solve the OVDU challenge, we propose a surgical parameter-editing framework. First, a Fisher Information mask isolates domain-sensitive weights, mathematically protecting foundational zero-shot generalization. Second, our Targeted Manifold Scattering (TMS) objective uses preference-based mining to locally scatter the forget domain's stylistic geometry. Evaluated across PACS, OfficeHome, and DomainNet, our method vastly improves open-vocabulary generalization over existing baselines. Crucially, it delivers exceptional sample efficiency, outperforming peak 8-shot baseline results with only 4 shots.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出近似域遗忘(ADU)依赖闭词表假设，仅在已见类别上评估遗忘效果，实为过拟合类-域对而非真正遗忘域。作者形式化提出开放词表域遗忘(OVDU)协议，并要求遗忘能迁移至留出类别。基于此提出手术式参数编辑框架：用Fisher信息掩码定位域敏感权重以保护零样本泛化，并以目标流形散射(TMS)通过偏好挖掘局部打散遗忘域的样式几何。在PACS、OfficeHome、DomainNet上，该方法显著提升开放词表泛化并具备极高样本效率，仅用4-shot即超越8-shot基线峰值。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型(VLM)虽具零样本泛化能力，但会编码不期望或有害的风格域（如医学AI中的理想化教科书图示、自动驾驶中的卡通车辆）。近似域遗忘(ADU)旨在选择性擦除模型对目标视觉域的识别同时保留其余域精度，然而现有方法基于有缺陷的闭词表假设：仅在遗忘微调中见过的具体物体类别上评估遗忘，导致其并未真正遗忘域本身，而只是过拟合已见的类-域对，对未见类别该域仍易被识别，造成虚假的移除感。因此需要一种类无关的真正域擦除。
AI.method: 作者形式化开放词表域遗忘(OVDU)协议，要求域遗忘必须迁移到留出类别。提出手术式参数编辑框架：第一步，Fisher信息掩码隔离域敏感权重，在数学上保护基础零样本泛化能力；第二步，目标流形散射(TMS)目标函数利用基于偏好的挖掘，在局部打散遗忘域的样式几何结构。
AI.result: 在PACS、OfficeHome和DomainNet三个数据集上评估，该方法相比现有基线大幅提升开放词表泛化性能；并且具备优异的样本效率，仅用4 shots即超过基线8-shot的峰值结果。
AI.conclusion: 真正的域擦除必须是类无关的，现有ADU的闭词表评估会给出虚假的移除感；通过OVDU协议与Fisher掩码加TMS的手术式参数编辑，可在保护零样本泛化的同时实现迁移到未见类别的域遗忘，并展现出极高的样本效率。

title: OpenVAM: Open-World Visual Attention Modeling with VLMs
summary: Predicting human gaze is a core capability for applications ranging from web/UI design analysis to robotics and human-computer interaction. Yet, most visual attention modeling methods output only a dense saliency map, which is often insufficient for action: practitioners need to connect attention peaks to discrete elements in the scene (what) and understand the drivers of those peaks in context (why), while remaining robust to domain shift across natural images, commercial content, and UI/web layouts. We, therefore, introduce OpenVAM (Open-world Visual Attention Modeling with VLMs), a unified framework that jointly addresses universality and explainability across heterogeneous domains (natural scenes, commercial imagery, and UI/web layouts) and supervision modalities. OpenVAM adopts a decoupled-but-aligned design: a dedicated dense visual pathway provides stable, spatially precise localization, while an instruction-following vision--language semantic head generates grounded what/why explanations conditioned on the same image and data-type prompts. A three-stage training strategy preserves strong localization priors while progressively introducing language grounding and improving explanation alignment via parameter-efficient adaptation without perturbing the saliency branch. We further propose a scalable pipeline to generate multi-domain saliency-reason annotations for training and systematic evaluation. Experiments across diverse datasets show that OpenVAM improves robustness under domain shift while producing image-grounded explanations that make saliency predictions more interpretable.

AI.tldr: OpenVAM 提出一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的统一框架，同时实现跨域（自然图像、商业图像、UI/Web 布局）的注视预测的通用性与可解释性，通过解耦但对齐的双通路设计输出空间精确的显著性定位以及基于图像内容的 what/why 解释。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉注意力建模方法大多只输出稠密显著性图，难以支撑实际决策：实践者需要将注意力峰值与场景中的离散元素（what）关联，并理解其上下文驱动因素（why），同时还需在自然图像、商业内容、UI/Web 布局等异构域间保持对域偏移的鲁棒性。因此需要一个兼顾通用性与可解释性的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出 OpenVAM 框架，采用"解耦但对齐"设计：1）专用稠密视觉通路提供稳定、空间精确的定位；2）指令跟随的视觉语言语义头基于同一图像与数据类型提示生成有依据的 what/why 解释。采用三阶段训练策略，在保持强定位先验的同时逐步引入语言 grounding，并通过参数高效适配改善解释对齐而不扰动显著性分支。此外提出可扩展流水线生成多域显著性-理由标注，用于训练与系统评测。
AI.result: 在多个多样化数据集上的实验表明，OpenVAM 在域偏移下提升了鲁棒性，并能生成基于图像内容的解释，使显著性预测更具可解释性。
AI.conclusion: OpenVAM 通过解耦但对齐的稠密定位与语言语义头结合三阶段训练，统一解决了跨异构域注视预测的通用性与可解释性问题，并配套多域标注流水线，为注意力建模提供了更具行动价值的输出。

title: RECAST: From Log Replay to Closed-Loop Driving Simulation with View-Complete Actors
summary: Closed-loop driving simulation requires rendered observations to remain reliable as the ego vehicle and surrounding actors move beyond their recorded trajectories, exposing views absent from the source log. Existing data-driven simulators reconstruct dynamic actors from sparse observations, which can result in rendering artifacts under these viewpoint changes. We introduce RECAST (REconstructing Controllable Actors for Simulation and Testing), a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that generates a view-complete actor from a single segmented vehicle observation in a driving log and registers the generated actor in the reconstructed scene. RECAST supports planner-in-the-loop rendering under controlled ego-actor interactions. To adapt an image-to-3D prior to real vehicles, we further introduce RECAR, a dataset of approximately 20K real vehicles with 600K background-free RGBA images spanning diverse vehicle colors and types. We use two-stage adaptation to improve vehicle generation from real driving-log observations. At the actor level, RECAST reduces $\mathrm{FD}_{\mathrm{incep}}$ from 9.788 to 7.992 relative to unadapted TRELLIS. At the scene level, under actor motion beyond logged trajectories, RECAST reduces $\mathrm{FD}_{\mathrm{incep}}$ from 129.35 to 112.10 and increases $\mathrm{CLIP}_{\mathrm{margin}}$ ($\times1000$) from 0.14 to 3.47 relative to Street Gaussians. We demonstrate planner-in-the-loop simulation with the image-conditioned planner GTRS-Dense. Compared with native Street Gaussians actors, RECAST increases the no-collision (NC) rate from 22.2% (12/54) to 63.0% (34/54) and the mean minimum predicted time-to-collision (TTC) from 0.798 s to 2.150 s. These experiments show that RECAST supports closed-loop planner evaluation under controlled ego-actor interactions beyond log replay. Visit our project page at https://zijunkr.github.io/RECAST/

AI.tldr: RECAST是一个基于3D高斯泼溅的框架，能从驾驶日志中单次分割的车辆观测生成视角完整的可控动作者并注册进重建场景，支持闭环仿真中自车-动作者受控交互下的规划器评估。
AI.motivation: 闭环驾驶仿真要求自车与周围动作者移动超出记录轨迹时渲染观测仍保持可靠，但现有数据驱动仿真器仅从稀疏观测重建动态动作者，在视角变化下产生渲染伪影，难以支持脱离日志回放的规划器闭环测试。
AI.method: 提出RECAST：以3D高斯泼溅从单次分割车辆观测生成视角完整动作者并配准到重建场景，支持规划器在环渲染；构建RECAR数据集（约2万真实车辆、60万张去背RGBA图像，覆盖多样颜色与车型），并采用两阶段适配将图像到3D先验迁移到真实车辆。
AI.result: 动作者层面，相对未适配的TRELLIS将FD_incep从9.788降至7.992；场景层面，在超出日志轨迹的运动下，相对Street Gaussians将FD_incep从129.35降至112.10，CLIP_margin(×1000)从0.14升至3.47。与GTRS-Dense规划器联调的闭环仿真中，相较原生Street Gaussians动作者，无碰撞率从22.2%(12/54)提升至63.0%(34/54)，平均最小预测TTC从0.798 s提升至2.150 s。
AI.conclusion: RECAST能在受控自车-动作者交互下支持超越日志回放的闭环规划器评估。

title: Towards Whole-Study Screening for Congenital Heart Disease in Fetal Ultrasound Using Multiple Instance Learning
summary: Congenital heart disease (CHD) is the most common birth defect, yet a large fraction of cases remain undetected on prenatal ultrasound, in part because current artificial-intelligence methods assume that the key diagnostic frames have already been isolated from a study, by a clinician or by a view classifier. We remove that assumption and address CHD screening directly at the level of the whole ultrasound study. We propose a two-stage framework that first learns transferable frame representations by self-supervised masked-autoencoder pre-training on unlabeled fetal ultrasound, then identifies cardiac frames with a disease-robust module and aggregates them with a transformer-based multiple instance learning (MIL) model that produces a case-level diagnosis from study-level labels alone. The model further returns its highest-scoring frames for clinician review, and a hierarchical head separates critical from non-critical CHD. On the internal test set of our multi-source development cohort (FUSE), the proposed cardiac-gated MIL model reaches an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.985 with a specificity of 0.990, outperforming the reproduced NATMED ensemble (AUC 0.861, specificity 0.600) and the FetalCLIP foundation model (AUC 0.867, specificity 0.710). On an independent external cohort, all models initially perform near chance, but label-free CORAL adaptation raises the proposed model from an AUC of 0.513 to 0.944, whereas whole-study and view-dependent baselines do not recover. These results indicate that whole-study MIL with disease-robust cardiac-frame identification is an accurate and deployable route to prenatal CHD screening.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段全研究级MIL框架，无需预先筛选心脏帧即可实现产前CHD筛查，内部AUC 0.985，外部队列经CORAL自适应后AUC由0.513升至0.944。
AI.motivation: 先天性心脏病（CHD）是最常见出生缺陷，但产前超声漏诊率高。现有AI方法假设关键诊断帧已被临床医生或视图分类器从检查中分离出来，这一假设在真实筛查流程中往往不成立。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：①在无标注胎儿超声上用自监督掩码自编码器（MAE）预训练，学习可迁移的帧表征；②用疾病鲁棒模块识别心脏帧，并以基于Transformer的多实例学习（MIL）模型聚合，仅用研究级标签产生病例级诊断。模型同时返回最高分帧供医生复核，并用层级头区分危重与非危重CHD；跨中心用无标签CORAL自适应。
AI.result: 内部多源开发队列（FUSE）测试集上，心脏门控MIL的AUC为0.985、特异性0.990，优于复现的NATMED集成（AUC 0.861、特异性0.600）与FetalCLIP基础模型（AUC 0.867、特异性0.710）。独立外部队列上各模型初始接近随机水平，CORAL无标签自适应将所提模型AUC从0.513提升至0.944，而全研究与视图依赖基线未能恢复。
AI.conclusion: 全研究级MIL结合疾病鲁棒的心脏帧识别，是准确且可部署的产前CHD筛查路径，去除了对预筛选诊断帧的依赖并具备跨中心泛化能力。

title: ContraFM-S2O: Flow Matching-Based One-step SAR-to-Optical Image Translation Model with Contrastive Learning
summary: In recent years, diffusion models and GAN-based models have become the mainstream approaches for SAR-to-optical image translation, owing to their advantages, such as high-quality generation and stable training. However, they have shortcomings such as high inference latency and the generated optical images suffer from low detail fidelity, often resulting in blurred edges and loss of fine textures. Thus, we propose ContraFM-S2O, which is a flow matching-based model for SAR-to-optical image translation. Unlike conventional diffusion models, ContraFM-S2O learns to predict the velocity field in training and solves ODE instead of SDE during inference to improve the sampling efficiency. In addition, ContraFM-S2O replaces instantaneous velocity with average velocity along the interpolation path to realize one-step SAR-to-optical image translation and uses contrastive learning to improve the quality of the generated optical images. Experiments show our model achieves state-of-the-art on SAR2Opt and QXS datasets, outperforming baselines, and reduces inference latency via one-step generation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于流匹配的SAR到光学图像翻译模型ContraFM-S2O，通过预测速度场、求解ODE和平均速度实现单步生成，并用对比学习提升质量，在SAR2Opt和QXS数据集上达到SOTA并降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型和GAN模型虽具备高质量生成与稳定训练的优势，但存在推理延迟高、生成光学图像细节保真度低（边缘模糊、细纹理丢失）的问题。
AI.method: 基于流匹配的ContraFM-S2O：训练时学习预测速度场；推理时求解ODE而非SDE以提升采样效率；以插值路径上的平均速度替代瞬时速度，实现单步SAR到光学图像翻译；并引入对比学习提升生成图像质量。
AI.result: 在SAR2Opt和QXS数据集上达到SOTA，优于基线方法，并通过单步生成降低了推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 流匹配结合平均速度单步生成与对比学习，可有效克服扩散/GAN方法在推理延迟与细节保真度上的不足，为SAR到光学图像翻译提供高效高质量方案。

title: Highlight-Then-Summarize: Learning to Compress Evidence for Long-Context Understanding
comment: 23 pages, 13 figures. Zhaoyuan Xia and Qinghongbing Xie contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Dai Dai, Tong Mo, and Long Zeng. Code and data are available at https://github.com/X-Luffy/Highlight-Then-Summarize
summary: Long-context understanding requires large language models (LLMs) to reason over lengthy documents, conversations, and code, yet task-relevant evidence is often sparse and scattered amid substantial irrelevant and redundant content. We propose Highlight-Then-Summarize (H2S), a compress-then-reason paradigm that first identifies source-grounded, question-relevant evidence and then integrates it into a compact, question-conditioned summary before producing the final answer. To train this behavior, we construct H2S-Dataset, comprising 6,647 examples from 11 benchmark families with an average context length of 43.9K tokens, and introduce H2S-RL, which provides process-level rewards for evidence selection and summary construction in addition to final-answer correctness. We evaluate on H2S-Bench, a seven-task long-context suite. Under a shared 128K input and 4K output budget, H2S-14B achieves an average score of 32.60, outperforming Qwen3.8-27B by 10.17 points and obtaining the strongest overall result among the evaluated open-source models. H2S-14B also achieves the highest Evidence-Summary Quality score and retains 97.1% of its 16K-budget performance with only a 4K output budget. These results show that explicitly selecting and integrating evidence improves long-context reasoning while enabling more compact generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Highlight-Then-Summarize (H2S) 压缩再推理范式，先定位问题相关证据再整合为紧凑摘要，并配套 H2S-Dataset 与 H2S-RL 训练，在长上下文任务上显著超越开源基线。
AI.motivation: 长上下文理解中任务相关证据往往稀疏且分散在大量无关冗余内容里，直接推理效率低、效果受限，因此需要一种先压缩证据再推理的机制。
AI.method: 提出 H2S 压缩再推理范式：先识别有源依据、与问题相关的证据，再整合成紧凑的问题条件化摘要，最后生成答案。构建 H2S-Dataset（11 个基准族、6,647 个样例、平均上下文 43.9K tokens），并提出 H2S-RL，对证据选择与摘要构建提供过程级奖励，同时兼顾最终答案正确性。
AI.result: 在 H2S-Bench（七项长上下文任务）上，统一 128K 输入与 4K 输出预算下，H2S-14B 平均得分 32.60，超 Qwen3.8-27B 10.17 分，为所评估开源模型中最优；同时取得最高 Evidence-Summary Quality 分数，并在仅 4K 输出预算下保留 16K 预算性能的 97.1%。
AI.conclusion: 显式地选择并整合证据能提升长上下文推理能力，同时实现更紧凑的生成，验证了压缩再推理范式的有效性与输出效率优势。

title: Guiding End-to-End Driving Models with Endpoint-Constrained Trajectory Optimization
summary: End-to-end driving policies are commonly trained through open-loop behavior cloning, yet they must ultimately operate in closed-loop when deployed on a vehicle, creating a fundamental mismatch between training and execution. Beyond the commonly studied effects of covariate shift and causal confusion, we identify a complementary factor for this open-loop/closed-loop gap: waypoint-based supervision and displacement metrics do not ensure that the intermediate trajectory is physically coherent or easy for the controller to track. We observe that these inconsistencies concentrate primarily at intermediate waypoints, while the predicted endpoint remains comparatively reliable. Based on this observation, we introduce Endpoint-Constrained Optimization (ECO), a lightweight postprocessing layer that anchors the trajectory to the vehicle's executed history, preserves the policy's predicted endpoint, and reshapes the intermediate waypoints to improve feasibility. ECO requires no map, privileged simulator state, or additional training, and can be inserted between a broad range of waypoint-emitting policies and their controllers. Across two closed-loop simulators, it improves the aggregate closed-loop score of all six evaluated generative and regression-based driving policies, and the gains tend to increase with how often the base plans violate motion limits. On HUGSIM, ECO improves VaVAM from 18.1 to 31.0 HD-Score (+71%), achieving 1st place on the HUGSIM Closed-Loop Driving Challenge. Similarly, on AlpaSim, ECO increases the scene scores of VaVAM and DiffusionDrive by 123% and 22%, respectively. These results show that for a broad collection of end-to-end driving models, repairing the intermediate geometry of predicted trajectories without changing the policy's predicted endpoint can substantially improve closed-loop performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出端点约束优化（ECO），一种无需训练、地图或特权状态的轻量后处理层，通过锚定执行历史、保留预测端点并重塑中间航点，修复端到端驾驶策略的开环/闭环差距。
AI.motivation: 端到端驾驶策略通常以开环行为克隆训练，但部署时需闭环运行，二者存在根本性错配。除常见的协变量偏移与因果混淆外，作者指出一个补充因素：基于航点的监督与位移指标无法保证中间轨迹物理一致或易于控制器跟踪，而这些不一致主要集中在中间航点，预测端点相对可靠。
AI.method: ECO 是一个轻量后处理层，可插入多种输出航点的策略与其控制器之间。它无需地图、特权仿真器状态或额外训练，将轨迹锚定到车辆已执行历史，保留策略预测的端点，并重塑中间航点以提升可行性。
AI.result: 在两个闭环仿真器中，ECO 提升了全部六个生成式与回归式驾驶策略的总体闭环得分，且基础规划违反运动限制越频繁，增益越大。HUGSIM 上 VaVAM 的 HD-Score 从 18.1 提升至 31.0（+71%），获该挑战赛第一；AlpaSim 上 VaVAM 与 DiffusionDrive 场景得分分别提升 123% 和 22%。
AI.conclusion: 针对广泛端到端驾驶模型，在不改变策略预测端点的前提下修复预测轨迹的中间几何，可显著提升闭环性能。

title: InternW0-$Δ$: A World Action Model Bridging Predictive Dynamics and Actions with 20K+ Hours of Open Data
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly model visual dynamics and action generation for generalist robot manipulation. A central challenge is to integrate priors from large-scale pretrained models---including visual dynamics, scene semantics, geometry, and motion---into a unified framework for robot action generation. We introduce InternW0-$Δ$, a unified WAM pretrained on a heterogeneous corpus that outperforms prior methods across simulation benchmarks and real-robot platforms. InternW0-$Δ$ combines pretrained visual dynamics, scene-level semantics, 4D geometric and motion priors, and action generation within a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) framework. A pretrained video expert and an action expert interact under semantic guidance from a frozen VLM, while a pretrained 4D foundation model injects geometric and motion priors through training-only distillation. We further introduce Causal Imprint, which learns future-relevant scene changes from training-only future supervision and provides predictive representations directly to the action expert without future-video rollout at inference. For large-scale joint training, we construct a heterogeneous corpus of robot demonstrations, UMI data, egocentric human demonstrations, and Ego2Robot data, curated and aligned under a common state-action representation. The resulting corpus contains over 20K hours of processed training data, to our knowledge the largest open-source corpus of its kind. We pretrain InternW0-$Δ$ on this corpus and demonstrate strong performance across simulation benchmarks and real-robot platforms. We will open source the training code, model weights, infrastructure, data-processing pipeline, and processed data where licenses permit. Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/InternW0-Delta/

AI.tldr: InternW0-Δ 是一个统一的"世界动作模型"(WAM),通过混合Transformer框架整合视觉动力学、场景语义、4D几何与运动先验及动作生成,并在超过2万小时的异构语料上预训练,在仿真与真机任务上均取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人操作需要同时建模视觉动态与动作生成,核心难点在于如何将大规模预训练模型中的多种先验(视觉动态、场景语义、几何、运动)统一整合进一个面向机器人动作生成的框架中。
AI.method: 采用 Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) 框架:预训练视频专家与动作专家在冻结 VLM 的语义引导下交互;预训练 4D 基础模型通过仅训练期蒸馏注入几何与运动先验;提出 Causal Imprint,从仅训练期的未来监督中学习与未来相关的场景变化,直接向动作专家提供预测性表征而无需推理时滚动生成未来视频;构建由机器人示教、UMI 数据、第一视角人类示教和 Ego2Robot 数据组成、统一状态-动作表示的异构语料进行大规模联合训练。
AI.result: 构建的语料含超过 2 万小时处理后训练数据,据称是同类中最大的开源语料;InternW0-Δ 在该语料上预训练后,在多个仿真基准和真机平台上均展现出优于先前方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明多源预训练先验可在统一 WAM 框架下有效服务于机器人动作生成,并将开源训练代码、模型权重、基础设施、数据处理流程及许可范围内的处理后数据。

title: Intent2Tc: Automated Intent-to-Traffic Control Translation with Language Models
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, Accepted to IEEE Conference on Future Communications and Networks (FCN) 2026
summary: Automated and highly usable Quality-of-Service (QoS) enforcement requires translating high-level service intents into deployable traffic-management policies. Although intent-based networking (IBN) has simplified policy specification, bridging the gap between business-level intents and executable network configurations remains complex, error-prone, and difficult to automate. This paper presents Intent2Tc, a closed-loop language-model-driven framework that translates business-level traffic-shaping intents into declarative sub-intents and subsequently into validated, executable Linux traffic control (tc) configurations. The framework integrates an Active Queue Management (AQM)-based digital twin (DT) semantic model, automated metadata extraction, critique-driven refinement, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based knowledge reuse to improve semantic consistency and configuration reliability. We evaluate multiple open-source large language models (LLMs) and small language models (SLMs), together with Claude Sonnet-4.6, on 100 Request for Comments (RFC) 9315-compliant traffic-shaping intents. Across both translation stages, Intent2Tc achieves high semantic fidelity, configuration accuracy, and deployment readiness, with Claude Sonnet-4.6 reaching 0.98 semantic similarity, 1.0 semantic unit coverage, and 0.045 normalized edit distance. Furthermore, RAG reduces token consumption and inference latency while enabling compact models such as Phi-4-mini to approach the performance of substantially larger models. Linux tc serves as the target configuration platform, demonstrating the practical applicability of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Intent2Tc，一个由语言模型驱动的闭环框架，可将业务级流量整形意图自动转化为可验证、可执行的 Linux tc 配置，通过数字孪生语义模型、批判式精化与 RAG 知识复用提升语义一致性与配置可靠性。
AI.motivation: 基于意图的网络虽简化了策略描述，但从业务级意图到可执行网络配置的自动映射仍然复杂、易错、难以自动化，缺乏可靠的 QoS 强制手段。
AI.method: 提出闭环 LLM 驱动框架 Intent2Tc：将业务意图翻译为声明式子意图，再生成已校验的 Linux tc 配置；集成基于 AQM 的数字孪生语义模型、自动化元数据提取、批判驱动的迭代精化，以及基于 RAG 的知识复用。
AI.result: 在 100 条符合 RFC 9315 的流量整形意图上，评测多种开源 LLM/SLM 及 Claude Sonnet-4.6，两阶段均实现高语义保真度与配置准确度；Claude Sonnet-4.6 达到 0.98 语义相似度、1.0 语义单元覆盖率、0.045 归一化编辑距离；RAG 降低 token 消耗与推理时延，使 Phi-4-mini 等紧凑模型接近大模型性能。
AI.conclusion: Intent2Tc 证明了大模型驱动框架在意图到可执行 QoS 策略转化中的可行性与实用性，Linux tc 作为目标平台验证了框架的实际部署能力。

title: Sorry Robot, Happy Human: Vision-Language Models Read Only One of Two Legible Typographic Layers
comment: Accepted to the First Workshop on Document Intelligence and Understanding (DocInsights 2026), co-located with the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs), despite their success in optical character recognition (OCR) tasks, are vulnerable to typographic attacks and have a fragile structure for images with multiple text layers. In this study, the DecoyBench dataset was created using the Decoy Font method. The dataset consists of 300 images, each containing text with sharp contour lines superimposed on another text with soft shading. Six recent closed-source models from three different model families were evaluated using this dataset under two different prompting conditions (naive and guided) and at two different resolutions ($512\times512$ and $64\times64$). A validation study showed that human participants could read both text layers with high accuracy. In contrast, the models, with most variants and both prompting methods, read the contour text with near-human accuracy at high resolution, but almost never fully extracted the shading text. At low resolution, the contour text could not be read by either the models or humans, while the shading text could be extracted with high accuracy. The findings indicate that the evaluated VLMs exhibit a consistent behavioral limitation when processing typographic structures containing multiple spatial frequency layers.

AI.tldr: 研究提出DecoyBench数据集（Decoy Font方法，300张双层文字图像），评估6个闭源VLM在两种提示与两种分辨率下的表现，发现模型在高分辨率下可读轮廓文字却几乎无法提取阴影文字，低分辨率下则相反，揭示其对多重空间频率文字层的结构性局限。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型虽在OCR任务上表现优异，但存在排版攻击脆弱性，且对包含多个文字层的图像结构处理能力不足，缺乏系统性评测手段。
AI.method: 构建Decoy Font方法生成DecoyBench数据集，共300张图像，每张将锐利轮廓线文字叠加在柔和阴影文字之上；对来自3个模型家族的6个近期闭源模型，在naive与guided两种提示条件、512×512与64×64两种分辨率下进行评测，并开展人类被试验证实验。
AI.result: 人类被试可高准确率读取两层文字；多数模型变体在两种提示方法下，高分辨率时对轮廓文字达到接近人类水平的识别精度，但几乎无法完整提取阴影文字；低分辨率时模型与人类均无法读取轮廓文字，而阴影文字可被高准确率提取。
AI.conclusion: 被评估的VLM在处理包含多重空间频率文字层的排版结构时表现出一致的行为局限，说明其多文字层解析能力受空间频率特性制约。

title: Towards Mitigating Fabricated Consensus: The Active Provenance Gate for Multi-Agent Debate Synthesis
comment: Accepted for publication at the 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026)
summary: Large language model-based multi-agent debate (MAD) systems are being increasingly used as complex decision pipelines in distributed processes. However, their final synthesis phase still remains inadequately controlled. Even with detailed debate logs, summarizing models are prone to fabricating smoothly written debate consensus that is not grounded in the debate's history. To address this safety gap, this paper presents empirical research and studies if the introduction of active post-debate verification can mitigate the production of such factually unsupported summaries, while still providing valuable information. Furthermore, it is examined whether explicitly signalling divergence is preferable in the absence of a reliable compromise. The Active Provenance Gate (APG) is introduced as a post-debate verification layer that treats the source as a hard constraint, analysing the debate logs, auditing each claim, and applying self-correction. In crisis simulations, the self-healing mechanism more than doubles the average data Provenance Fidelity in difficult condition scenarios, before the strict gate blocks unsupported claims and generates divergence reports. In the human study, a vast majority of the users (over 75%) preferred a report explicitly stating failure in critical scenarios, despite most of them perceiving fabricated consensus from the baseline system as more fluent. Our main contribution is the transition of data origin tracing from passive logging to active conditional blocking before publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"主动溯源门控"（APG）作为辩论后验证层，将来源作为硬约束对辩论日志逐条审计并自纠错，从而抑制多智能体辩论最终综合阶段的事实无依据共识，并在无可靠折衷时显式报告分歧。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的多智能体辩论（MAD）被 increasingly 用作分布式决策流水线，但其最终综合阶段缺乏有效控制。即便有详细辩论日志，总结模型仍易编造"流畅但无依据"的辩论共识，构成安全隐患。
AI.method: 引入 Active Provenance Gate（APG）作为辩论后验证层，将来源视为硬约束：分析辩论日志、逐条审计每个论断、执行自纠错再校验；当不存在可靠折衷时，以显式分歧报告（divergence report）替代虚假共识。
AI.result: 危机模拟中，自愈机制在困难条件下将平均数据溯源保真度（Provenance Fidelity）提升逾一倍；严格门控随后拦截无依据论断并生成分歧报告。人类研究中，超过 75% 用户偏好明确声明失败的临界场景报告，尽管多数人认为基线系统的编造共识更流畅。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于将数据来源追踪从被动日志记录转变为发布前的主动条件阻断，为 MAD 综合阶段提供了可验证的安全控制机制。

title: AxonSynth: Domain-Randomized Synthetic Data for Zero-Shot 3D Axon Segmentation in Light-Sheet Microscopy
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at SASHIMI 2026, held with MICCAI 2026
summary: Accurate segmentation of axons in 3D microscopy data is important for analyzing white-matter organization, but dense ground truth labels are expensive to obtain. Existing supervised axon segmentation methods rely on target-domain annotations and can be brittle when tissue type, species, modality, or acquisition conditions change. We present AxonSynth, a domain-randomized synthetic-data framework for training 3D axon segmentation models without manually annotated real training volumes. AxonSynth generates dense synthetic axon labels with orientation priors that reflect realistic fiber configurations and renders them with randomized density, contrast, bias fields, blur, and noise. A three-class 3D U-Net is trained to predict background, axon sheath and intra-axonal space. We evaluate zero-shot transfer on 10 held-out light-sheet microscopy (LSM) patches from macaque and human brain samples labeled with one of three axonal markers, comparing against calibrated thresholding and Frangi filtering using overlap, corrected detection, false-positive, and topology metrics. On macaque samples, AxonSynth achieved the best corrected Dice and corrected precision (0.826 and 0.851), compared with 0.765 and 0.754 for thresholding and 0.685 and 0.762 for Frangi. On human samples, corrected Dice was comparable to thresholding (0.857 vs. 0.868), while component-count error decreased from 22,504 to 3,377. Across all held-out patches, AxonSynth reduced component-count error in 10/10 patches and Euler-characteristic error in 8/10. These results show that synthetic-label domain randomization can reduce dependence on manual axon annotation while supporting synthetic-to-real 3D segmentation.

AI.tldr: AxonSynth：一种域随机化合成数据框架，无需真实标注即可训练3D轴突分割模型，在零样本迁移中优于阈值化和Frangi滤波，并显著降低拓扑误差。
AI.motivation: 3D显微图像中轴突的精确分割对分析白质组织至关重要，但密集的真实标注成本高昂。已有监督方法依赖目标域标注，当组织类型、物种、模态或采集条件变化时表现脆弱，泛化能力不足。
AI.method: 提出AxonSynth域随机化合成数据框架：生成带有反映真实纤维构型的朝向先验的密集合成轴突标签，并以随机化的密度、对比度、偏置场、模糊与噪声进行渲染；训练一个三分类3D U-Net预测背景、轴突鞘与轴突内空间；在猕猴和人类脑样本的10个留出光片显微镜（LSM）图像块上进行零样本迁移评估，与校准阈值化和Frangi滤波对比，采用重叠度、校正检测、假阳性与拓扑指标。
AI.result: 猕猴样本上，AxonSynth取得最佳校正Dice与校正精确率（0.826与0.851），优于阈值化（0.765、0.754）和Frangi（0.685、0.762）；人类样本上校正Dice与阈值化相当（0.857 vs. 0.868），但连通分量计数误差从22,504降至3,377。总体而言，AxonSynth在10/10图像块中降低连通分量计数误差，在8/10中降低欧拉示性数误差。
AI.conclusion: 合成标签的域随机化可减少对手工轴突标注的依赖，并支持从合成到真实的3D分割，是一种有效的零样本3D轴突分割方案。

title: Implicit Neural Representation for Hyperspectral Video Compression
summary: With the advent of snapshot cameras, hyperspectral video is becoming more readily available. In recent years, new applications have emerged which have led to increasingly larger datasets. However, hyperspectral video compression remains in the early stages. In this study, we explore the use of implicit neural representation as a candidate solution. We propose a novel extension of an existing RGB video compression model, achieving Bjøntegaard Delta PSNR gains of +4.99 dB and Bjøntegaard Delta rate of -88.88% compared to traditional hyperspectral image compression methods applied frame-by-frame. In addition to reconstruction quality, the effects on downstream task performance are measured in the form of object tracking success. Compared to video compressed with methods based on principal component analysis and JPEG2000 in low data regimes, our proposed method improves tracking area under the curve by up to 23.42% and distance precision by up to 35.56% on examples from the HOT2026 dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文将隐式神经表示（INR）引入高光谱视频压缩，扩展现有RGB视频压缩模型，在重建质量和下游跟踪任务上均显著优于逐帧高光谱图像压缩及PCA+JPEG2000等方法。
AI.motivation: 快照式相机使高光谱视频更易获取，新应用催生越来越大的数据集，但高光谱视频压缩仍处于早期阶段，缺乏高效方案。
AI.method: 探索将隐式神经表示作为高光谱视频压缩的候选方案，对现有RGB视频压缩模型进行新颖扩展以适配高光谱视频。
AI.result: 相比逐帧应用的传统高光谱图像压缩方法，取得BD-PSNR +4.99 dB、BD-rate -88.88%；在低数据条件下相比PCA与JPEG2000方法，HOT2026数据集上跟踪AUC最高提升23.42%，距离精度最高提升35.56%。
AI.conclusion: 隐式神经表示是高光谱视频压缩的有效方案，不仅提升重建质量，还能改善下游目标跟踪任务性能。

title: ViSTA: A Simple Bridge Extends Visual Alignment to Clinical Time-Series Understanding in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Clinical prediction models estimate risk from patient measurements, while large language models support medical text understanding and question answering. Yet their language capabilities do not ensure accurate prediction from structured, high-dimensional clinical time series. Improving this ability would connect risk estimation with flexible questions about a patient's evolving condition. We introduce ViSTA, a compact adapter that incorporates irregular numerical measurements into a pretrained vision-language model's chart representations. It learns corrections to visual tokens while leaving all pretrained parameters unchanged. On MIMIC-IV, ViSTA has the highest mean scores among the compared adaptations on all four metrics for acute kidney injury and mortality prediction across models with 2-9 billion parameters. With 0.516 million trainable parameters, the 2-billion-parameter model reaches an area under the ROC curve of 0.7376 for acute kidney injury, compared with GPT-5.6 Sol's 0.7380 with text input and high reasoning effort. Training for temporal question answering yields 69.27% accuracy at 4 billion parameters with over 90% fewer trainable parameters than low-rank adaptation using charts or numerical text, at a 2.82-4.88 percentage-point accuracy gap. ViSTA extends pretrained language models to numerical prediction and temporal questions.

AI.tldr: ViSTA是一种轻量适配器，将不规则数值测量注入预训练视觉-语言模型的图表表示中，使语言模型获得临床时间序列的数值预测与时间问答能力。
AI.motivation: 临床预测模型擅长从患者测量数据估计风险，大语言模型擅长医学文本理解与问答，但后者的语言能力并不能保证从结构化、高维临床时间序列中做出准确预测。提升这一能力可将风险估计与关于患者病情演变的灵活提问连接起来。
AI.method: 提出ViSTA——一个紧凑适配器，把不规则数值测量融入预训练视觉-语言模型的图表表示；它学习对视觉token的修正，同时保持所有预训练参数不变。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV上，对急性肾损伤与死亡率预测，ViSTA在2–9B参数各模型、四项指标上均取得最高平均分。仅0.516M可训练参数时，2B模型急性肾损伤AUROC达0.7376，接近GPT-5.6 Sol文本输入高推理强度的0.7380。时间问答训练在4B参数下准确率69.27%，可训练参数比基于图表或数值文本的LoRA少90%以上，准确率差距2.82–4.88个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ViSTA将预训练语言模型扩展至数值预测与时间问答任务，以极少可训练参数实现与大规模专用方案相当的预测性能。

title: From Reward Signal to Visual Utility: A Controlled Audit of Medical VLM Post-Training
summary: Medical vision-language model (VLM) post-training is commonly evaluated through answer accuracy. We examine how changes in accuracy and training objectives relate to image-conditioned decisions in a controlled Qwen2.5-VL-3B study on PMC-VQA. We compare supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) restricted to the language model, expanded multimodal adaptation scopes, standard answer-only Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and a counterfactual evidence objective. On 2,000 clean-test questions, language model LoRA SFT changes correct-image accuracy by +1.10 percentage points (95% paired bootstrap CI:-0.85 to +3.05), while visual-benefit events decrease by 2.40 points and image sensitivity decreases by 5.60 points. Paired records reveal 155 acquired and 203 lost visual-benefit events. Broader adaptation yields lower correct-image accuracy than language-model LoRA SFT. Standard GRPO produces mixed-reward groups and parameter updates, with an uncertain clean test accuracy change. A generation audit reveals that canonical option scores can follow a different token path from generated answers. With scores taken along the greedy generation path, the evidence target improves on the training set; its gains over standard GRPO remain inconsistent on validation data at matched training doses. Sample-level analyses trace how evidence scores, decision margins, and generated answers change during post-training. This empirical and measurement audit identifies gaps between optimization activity, target acquisition, and useful held-out visual behavior.

AI.tldr: 该研究对Qwen2.5-VL-3B在PMC-VQA上的后训练进行受控审计，发现答案准确率变化与图像条件决策行为之间关系薄弱。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉语言模型后训练通常仅以答案准确率评估，但准确率能否反映真正依赖图像的决策尚不清楚，作者希望厘清准确率变化、训练目标与图像条件行为之间的关系。
AI.method: 在PMC-VQA上对Qwen2.5-VL-3B进行受控实验，比较仅语言模型的LoRA SFT、扩大范围的多模态适配、标准答案-only GRPO以及反事实证据目标，并引入视觉获益事件、图像敏感性、配对记录与生成审计等测量手段。
AI.result: 2,000道干净测试题上，语言模型LoRA SFT使正确图像准确率变化+1.10个百分点（95%配对bootstrap CI：-0.85至+3.05），视觉获益事件下降2.40点、图像敏感性下降5.60点；配对记录显示155个获得与203个失去视觉获益事件。扩大适配范围准确率低于语言模型LoRA SFT；标准GRPO产生混合奖励组但干净测试准确率变化不确定。生成审计发现规范选项分数与生成答案可能走不同token路径；沿贪心生成路径取分时，证据目标在训练集上改进，但在匹配训练剂量下相对标准GRPO的验证集增益不一致。
AI.conclusion: 该经验与测量审计揭示了优化活动、目标获取与有用留出视觉行为之间存在差距，说明仅凭答案准确率无法可靠表征后训练是否真正提升了图像条件决策能力。

title: TemplateCraft: Agentic Visual Template Generation
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: The growing popularity of short videos has driven demand for one-click content creation. Visual templates turn uploaded images into personalized content with preset effects, but reusable template generation still requires substantial manual effort in asset preparation and tool orchestration. We propose TemplateCraft, a multi-agent system that converts natural-language instructions into client-executable templates through planning, material generation, effect-workflow generation, and protocol compilation. Its Planner-Evaluator loop uses execution feedback for targeted rollback, while stage-level and long-term memory support revision without parameter updates. We evaluate TemplateCraft on TemplateBench, derived from 60 real-world templates. With the same Qwen3-VL backbone, TemplateCraft raises image/video generation success rates from 56.7%/30.0% to 66.7%/50.0% over Planner-only (best-of-three) and improves template adherence and style consistency. With additional evaluation and revision, it matches or exceeds a GPT-4o Planner-only baseline on selected metrics. Persistent assets further improve cross-input style consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体系统TemplateCraft，将自然语言指令转为客户端可执行的短视频视觉模板，在TemplateBench上将图像/视频生成成功率从56.7%/30.0%提升至66.7%/50.0%，并提升模板贴合度与风格一致性。
AI.motivation: 短视频流行带来一键式内容创作需求。视觉模板可将上传图片转为带预设效果的个性化内容，但可复用模板的生成仍需在素材准备与工具编排上投入大量人工。为此需要自动化、可复用的模板生成方案。
AI.method: TemplateCraft为多智能体系统，将自然语言指令通过规划、素材生成、效果工作流生成与协议编译转化为客户端可执行模板。采用Planner-Evaluator循环，利用执行反馈进行针对性回滚；并引入阶段级与长期记忆，支持无需参数更新的修订。
AI.result: 在基于60个真实模板构建的TemplateBench上，相同Qwen3-VL骨干下，相较Planner-only（三选一）将图像/视频生成成功率由56.7%/30.0%提升至66.7%/50.0%，并改善模板贴合度与风格一致性；加入额外评估与修订后，在部分指标上达到或超过GPT-4o Planner-only基线；持久化素材还能提升跨输入风格一致性。
AI.conclusion: TemplateCraft通过多智能体规划—评估—记忆机制，实现了从自然语言到可执行视觉模板的自动化生成，在成功率、模板贴合度和风格一致性上均优于Planner-only基线，并在部分指标上可与更强的GPT-4o基线相当或更优。

title: Vision-Based 6-DoF Grasp Pose Estimation for Robot Cloth Unfolding
comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Cybernetics
summary: Cloth manipulation is a challenging task due to the deformable and high-dimensional nature of cloth, which leads to complex interaction dynamics and perceptual ambiguity arising from frequent occlusions of critical visual cues such as folds, edges, and grasp points. In this work, we tackle cloth unfolding using a regrasping-in-the-air strategy, where one manipulator holds the cloth while the other grasps it at an optimally selected point to unfold it. To this end, we propose CeDiRNet-6DoF, a deep learning framework that jointly predicts effective grasp points and the complete 6-DoF grasp pose from the observed cloth configuration. By integrating dense 3D grasp regression with segmentation and sine-cosine-encoded Euler angles, the proposed method reliably estimates the grasp configuration that maximizes the unfolded cloth area. We extensively evaluated CeDiRNet-6DoF on a bimanual robotic setup within the ICRA 2024 Cloth Competition framework, achieving state-of-the-art performance. An ablation study further validates the benefits of key design components, including joint segmentation, background randomization, and image cropping. These results establish CeDiRNet-6DoF as a robust and versatile foundation for reliable robotic cloth manipulation in unstructured environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CeDiRNet-6DoF，一个联合预测抓取点与完整6-DoF抓取位姿的深度学习框架，用于双臂机器人在空中重抓取以展开布料，并在ICRA 2024 Cloth Competition中取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 布料具有可变形性和高维特性，交互动力学复杂，且褶皱、边缘、抓取点等关键视觉线索常被遮挡，导致感知歧义，使布料操作成为难题。
AI.method: 采用"空中重抓取"（regrasping-in-the-air）策略：一个机械臂持布，另一机械臂在最优选择点抓取以展开布料。提出CeDiRNet-6DoF，融合稠密3D抓取回归、分割以及正弦-余弦编码的欧拉角，联合预测有效抓取点和完整6-DoF抓取位姿，以最大化展开面积。
AI.result: 在ICRA 2024 Cloth Competition框架下的双臂机器人平台上评测，达到state-of-the-art性能；消融实验验证了联合分割、背景随机化和图像裁剪等关键设计组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CeDiRNet-6DoF为非结构化环境中可靠的机器人布料操作提供了稳健且通用的基础。

title: Different Corruptions, Different Signals: Uncertainty and Loss in Federated Data Quality
comment: Accepted at IEEE The 4th International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA26)
summary: Federated learning (FL) data corruption can affect either inputs or labels, but it remains unclear whether input-conditional uncertainty and prediction-label loss expose these corruption modes equally. This paper compares two corruption-detection signals in FL: input-conditional uncertainty and prediction-label loss. The uncertainty signal is characterised using a learned aleatoric variance estimate together with Monte Carlo (MC) dropout variance and entropy measures, while the loss is computed against the supplied label. We test these signals against additive image noise and persistent random label flips. On ResNet-20 with CIFAR-10 and SVHN under Dirichlet partitions with data that are not independent and identically distributed (non-IID), the two corruption types behave differently. For persistent random label flips, the within-client per-sample area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) is 0.85 on CIFAR-10 and 0.95 on SVHN for prediction-label loss, while every uncertainty estimator stays at chance (0.49--0.50). This pattern is consistent with the model remaining confident in the underlying image despite the supplied label being wrong. For image noise, expected-entropy uncertainty rises above chance (0.67 on CIFAR-10 and 0.66 on SVHN), while loss responds comparably (0.64 on both). Each signal is therefore the stronger detector for a different corruption: the prediction-label loss for persistent label flips, and expected-entropy uncertainty for image noise, with its advantage becoming apparent as federation-wide corruption prevalence increases. Robust FL data-quality assessment should match the signal to the corruption rather than rely on uncertainty alone across corruption types.

AI.tldr: 本文在联邦学习场景下对比"输入条件不确定性"与"预测-标签损失"两种数据损坏检测信号，发现二者分别对应不同的损坏模式：预测-标签损失更擅长检测持续随机标签翻转，而期望熵不确定性更擅长检测图像噪声。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中的数据损坏既可能发生在输入端，也可能发生在标签端，但学界尚不清楚输入条件不确定性与预测-标签损失是否能等同地暴露这两类损坏模式，因此需要一个针对性的对比研究来明确各信号的适用边界。
AI.method: 在非独立同分布（non-IID）的Dirichlet划分下，基于ResNet-20在CIFAR-10和SVHN上开展实验。不确定性信号由学习到的aleatoric方差估计、Monte Carlo (MC) dropout方差与熵度量共同刻画，损失信号则基于供给标签计算。测试对象为加性图像噪声与持续随机标签翻转两类损坏，评估指标为客户端内逐样本AUC。
AI.result: 对持续随机标签翻转，预测-标签损失在CIFAR-10和SVHN上的逐样本AUC分别为0.85与0.95，而所有不确定性估计器均停留在随机水平（0.49–0.50），说明模型对图像本身仍保持自信，仅标签错误。对图像噪声，期望熵不确定性升至随机水平之上（CIFAR-10为0.67，SVHN为0.66），损失表现相当（两者均为0.64），且熵信号的优势随联邦范围内损坏流行率上升而更明显。
AI.conclusion: 每种信号各自是一类损坏的更强检测器：预测-标签损失适用于持续标签翻转，期望熵不确定性适用于图像噪声。稳健的联邦学习数据质量评估应根据损坏类型匹配检测信号，而非在所有损坏类型上单一依赖不确定性。

title: Diagnosing the Sources of Compositional Failure in Vision-Language Models: A Controlled Analysis
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) often struggle with compositional reasoning tasks, but the reasons for this underperformance remain unclear. A common hypothesis is that models struggle to integrate multiple components, leading to training interventions to improve compositional binding. However, this assumption has never been directly quantified. Existing benchmarks evaluate captions only in their composed form, making it impossible to separate the cost of joint reasoning from the cost of recognizing individual components under increasing load. We introduce COMPASS (COMPositional Analysis of SkillS), a controlled evaluation framework designed to isolate and measure the distinct factors underlying compositional failure. By comparing performance on composed captions with their decomposed counterparts , we directly quantify the cost of compositional integration across 87K image-caption pairs. Across multiple VLMs, this gap is real but partial, accounting for only part of the observed degradation. This motivates a finer-grained investigation into what additional factors govern model behavior. We analyze performance at the level of individual skills: object detection, attribute binding, and relation reasoning, using skill-targeted perturbations across 274K image-caption pairs. We find a consistent skill-specific pattern: each skill degrades primarily with the count of its own primitive type (self-load), while cross-load effects are predominantly positive, suggesting that primitives of different types provide useful grounding context. This pattern holds across standard contrastive encoders, explicitly trained compositional reasoning models, and non-contrastive architectures. These findings show that compositional degradation reflects multiple separable factors that cannot be reduced to joint reasoning alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COMPASS评估框架，量化分解组合推理成本与单项技能负载，发现组合退化由多个可分离因素构成，并非仅由联合推理导致。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在组合推理任务上表现不佳，常见假设是模型难以整合多个组成成分，但该假设从未被直接量化；现有基准仅在组合形式上评估描述，无法区分联合推理成本与在负载增加下识别单个组件的成本。
AI.method: 提出COMPASS受控评估框架，通过对比组合描述与分解描述的表现，在87K图文对上直接量化组合整合成本；进一步以技能为粒度，在274K图文对上使用技能定向扰动，分析目标检测、属性绑定和关系推理三项技能的自负载与交叉负载效应。
AI.result: 组合整合成本真实存在但仅部分解释退化；技能层面呈现一致模式：每项技能主要随其自身原始类型数量增加而退化（自负载），交叉负载效应多为正向，说明不同类型原始要素可提供有用的 grounding 上下文；该模式在标准对比编码器、显式训练的组合推理模型及非对比架构中均成立。
AI.conclusion: 组合退化反映多个可分离因素，不能仅归因于联合推理，为后续细粒度诊断与改进提供依据。

title: KneePreM: Towards 3D Knee MRI Foundation Models via Large-Scale Unlabeled Pretraining and Label-Efficient Fine-Tuning
summary: Background: Large volumes of unlabeled knee MRI scans are available across repositories but remain insufficiently leveraged. We developed KneePreM, a knee-specific 3D self-supervised model, and evaluated transfer and label efficiency for classification and segmentation. Methods: A 3D U-Net masked autoencoder was pretrained on 19,011 unlabeled Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI) MRI series from 4,791 participants. Downstream fine-tuning used full and reduced training sets for fastMRI+ two-label classification (1,172 examinations), Arthroscopic Partial Meniscectomy (APM) eight-target classification (1,716 examinations), SKM-TEA segmentation (155 examinations), and APM segmentation (25 examinations). Baselines were random initialization and SuPreM. Deployment workflow was implemented with a Model Context Protocol interface. Evaluation metrics included balanced accuracy, F1 score, ROC AUC, PR AUC, and Dice score. Statistical analysis used bootstrap confidence intervals and paired bootstrap tests for classification and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests for segmentation. Results: KneePreM achieved higher full-data macro ROC AUC than both baselines for fastMRI+ and APM (all p < .001). For fastMRI+ classification, KneePreM achieved a ROC AUC of 0.722 using 50% of the training data, exceeding both full-data baselines. In APM classification, KneePreM reached a ROC AUC of 0.740 with 70% of the data, matching the full-data random baseline and outperforming SuPreM. For SKM-TEA segmentation, its 70%-data Dice of 0.838 exceeded the full-data random baseline (0.835) and both same-budget comparators. In APM segmentation, its 75%-data Dice of 0.746 exceeded the full-data random baseline (0.731) and both same-budget comparators. Conclusion: KneePreM improves transfer performance and label efficiency across knee MRI classification and segmentation tasks, particularly when labeled training data are limited.

AI.tldr: KneePreM是一种基于3D U-Net掩码自编码器的膝关节专用3D自监督模型，在19,011例未标注OAI MRI序列上预训练，在分类与分割下游任务中均提升迁移性能与标签效率。
AI.motivation: 大量未标注膝关节MRI数据散落于各数据库但未被充分利用；现有自监督模型缺乏膝关节特异性，标注数据稀缺时迁移效果与标签效率不足。
AI.method: 采用3D U-Net掩码自编码器，在来自4,791名参与者的19,011例未标注OAI MRI序列上预训练。下游微调任务包括：fastMRI+双标签分类（1,172例）、APM八目标分类（1,716例）、SKM-TEA分割（155例）与APM分割（25例），并使用全量与缩减训练集。基线为随机初始化与SuPreM。部署流程通过Model Context Protocol接口实现。评价指标含平衡准确率、F1、ROC AUC、PR AUC与Dice；统计采用bootstrap置信区间、配对bootstrap检验（分类）与Wilcoxon符号秩检验（分割）。
AI.result: 全量数据下，KneePreM在fastMRI+与APM分类的宏ROC AUC均高于两个基线（均p<.001）。fastMRI+分类中，仅用50%训练数据即达ROC AUC 0.722，超过两个基线的全量结果；APM分类中用70%数据达ROC AUC 0.740，与随机初始化全量基线持平并优于SuPreM。SKM-TEA分割中用70%数据的Dice为0.838，超过随机初始化全量基线（0.835）及同预算对照；APM分割中用75%数据的Dice为0.746，超过随机初始化全量基线（0.731）及同预算对照。
AI.conclusion: KneePreM在膝关节MRI分类与分割任务中提升了迁移性能与标签效率，在标注训练数据有限时优势尤为明显。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Federated Learning for Infant Movement Analysis
comment: Accepted at IEEE The 4th International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA26)
summary: Infant movement analysis provides valuable biomarkers for the early identification of neurodevelopmental disorders. Recent advances in deep learning have enabled automated analysis of infant movements from video-derived skeletal representations, achieving performance comparable to expert assessment for tasks such as General Movement Assessment (GMA). However, most existing approaches rely on centralized training, requiring data from multiple institutions to be collected and stored at a single site. Such assumptions are often impractical in clinical settings due to privacy, governance, and data-sharing constraints. To address these challenges, we present, to the best of our knowledge, the first federated learning framework for automated infant movement analysis and General Movement Assessment using skeletal motion data. As a clinically relevant use case, the proposed framework is evaluated on fidgety movement classification. To quantify model confidence, Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout is employed to estimate predictive uncertainty during inference. Building upon this, we propose an Uncertainty-Aware Federated Averaging (UA-FedAvg) strategy that incorporates predictive entropy derived from MC-Dropout into the federated aggregation process, enabling client contributions to be adjusted according to their predictive uncertainty. Experiments were conducted using a cross-subject evaluation protocol under a three-client federated learning setting. Results demonstrate that federated learning substantially improves classification performance compared with independently trained local models while achieving performance approaching that of centralized training. Furthermore, UA-FedAvg and its variant incorporating validation loss generally outperform conventional FedAvg across the evaluated data-split configurations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出首个用于婴儿骨骼运动分析与全身运动评估（GMA）的联邦学习框架，并引入不确定性感知的联邦平均策略（UA-FedAvg），在烦躁运动分类任务上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 婴儿运动分析是早期识别神经发育障碍的重要生物标志物，深度学习已能基于视频骨骼表示实现接近专家的GMA评估。但现有方法多依赖集中式训练，需将多机构数据汇聚存储，在临床中受隐私、数据治理和共享限制而难以实现。因此作者希望在不共享原始数据的前提下实现多机构协同建模。
AI.method: 提出首个基于骨骼运动数据的联邦学习框架用于婴儿运动分析和全身运动评估；以烦躁运动分类为临床用例。采用蒙特卡洛（MC）Dropout在推理阶段估计预测不确定性，并据此提出不确定性感知的联邦平均（UA-FedAvg），将MC-Dropout得到的预测熵融入联邦聚合过程，按客户端预测不确定性调整其贡献权重；另提出引入验证损失的变体。实验采用跨受试者评估协议和三客户端联邦设置。
AI.result: 联邦学习相比独立训练的本地模型显著提升分类性能，并接近集中式训练的效果；在各数据划分配置下，UA-FedAvg及其结合验证损失的变体总体优于传统FedAvg。
AI.conclusion: 该框架表明联邦学习可在保护数据隐私、满足临床数据治理约束的前提下，实现接近集中式训练的婴儿运动分析性能；通过预测不确定性驱动的聚合策略可进一步提升联邦建模效果，为多机构协作的神经发育障碍早期筛查提供了可行方案。

title: PriceBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Price, Quality, and Brand Preferences in LLM Booking Agents
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Industry Track. 19 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Pashasan/pricebench-emnlp
summary: LLMs increasingly act as purchasing agents, which makes the LLM, not the user, the one choosing among the options that satisfy a request; its preferences quietly fix what gets bought and what it costs. Hotel booking is a clean instance: a high-volume choice settled on a few comparable attributes, where the pick reveals those preferences. We introduce PriceBench, a diagnostic benchmark that recovers an LLM's price, quality, and brand preferences from its booking choices with a logit choice model, applied to 28 LLMs from 8 providers on 3,600 hotel tasks from 179 real New York City properties. We find that capability is associated with how consistently an LLM chooses, not with what it chooses: more capable LLMs hold stronger, more consistent preferences, while weaker ones either lock onto one position, exploitable by whoever controls listing order, or choose almost indifferently. What those preferences favor varies sharply across providers and even within one family: price sensitivity spans more than an order of magnitude, and the price/quality trade-off moves mean booked nightly price from \$247 to \$393 on identical tasks. What an agent buys must therefore be measured per LLM, not inferred, and we release the tasks, code, and all 28 response sets.

AI.tldr: 提出 PriceBench，用 logit 选择模型从 LLM 的酒店预订选择中还原其价格、质量与品牌偏好；对 8 家供应商 28 个 LLM、179 家纽约真实酒店的 3,600 个任务测试发现：能力与选择一致性相关而非选择内容相关，偏好跨供应商差异巨大。
AI.motivation: LLM 日益充当采购代理，由其（而非用户）在满足需求的选项中做决策，其偏好会悄然决定买什么、花多少钱。酒店预订是理想测试场景：高频、基于少数可比属性、选择结果可直接揭示偏好。现有工作缺乏对 LLM 作为购买代理时偏好结构的可测量诊断手段。
AI.method: 构建 PriceBench 诊断基准：选取 179 家真实纽约酒店、3,600 个预订任务，覆盖 8 家供应商 28 个 LLM；用 logit 选择模型（离散选择模型）从其选择行为中反推价格、质量和品牌偏好参数，即恢复隐含效用权重。
AI.result: 能力与一致性相关而非与偏好内容相关：更强 LLM 的偏好更强且更一致；较弱 LLM 要么锁定单一位置（可被控制列表顺序者利用），要么几乎无差别选择。偏好跨供应商乃至同一模型家族内部差异显著：价格敏感度跨越一个数量级以上，价格/质量权衡使相同任务下平均预订每晚价格从 $247 到 $393 不等。
AI.conclusion: 代理 LLM 买什么必须按单个模型实测，而不能推断（例如由基座或家族外推）。发布任务、代码及全部 28 个模型的响应集，以支撑可复现的偏好测量与审计。

title: A Surgical Foundation Model Reveals Task-Dependent Label Efficiency
summary: Developing label-efficient models is a central challenge in surgical AI due to the high cost and scarcity of expert annotation. While self-supervised foundation models adapt well to new tasks with minimal data, how label efficiency varies across different surgical tasks remains largely unexplored. Here, we introduce SURGE, a surgical foundation model trained on SurgSpectrum-30M+, the largest pretraining dataset comprising over 30 million frames, with checkpoints released to enable further research. We systematically evaluate label efficiency across 5 task categories and 15 benchmarks. These range from temporal and spatial scene understanding to fine-grained reasoning tied to instrument-anatomy interactions and safety-critical maneuvers.
