SURGE outperforms prior state-of-the-art on all benchmarks, even surpassing task-specific models on complex reasoning tasks. Crucially, we reveal a task-dependent scaling behavior: while scene understanding tasks saturate with minimal supervision, fine-grained reasoning tasks continue improving with substantially larger annotation budgets, providing a blueprint for allocating expert effort in complex domains. Code: https://github.com/CAMMA-public/SURGE

AI.tldr: 提出手术基础模型SURGE（基于最大数据集SurgSpectrum-30M+，3000万+帧），在5类任务、15个基准上系统评估标签效率，揭示任务依赖的缩放行为。
AI.motivation: 外科AI中专家标注成本高、稀缺，标签高效模型是核心挑战。自监督基础模型能用少量数据适应新任务，但标签效率在不同手术任务间的差异尚未被系统探索。
AI.method: 在大规模数据集SurgSpectrum-30M+（3000万+帧）上训练手术基础模型SURGE并发布检查点；在5个任务类别、15个基准上系统评测标签效率，任务涵盖时间与空间场景理解、器械-解剖交互的细粒度推理及安全关键操作。
AI.result: SURGE在所有基准上超越先前最先进方法，在复杂推理任务上甚至超过任务专用模型。发现任务依赖的缩放行为：场景理解任务在极少监督下即饱和，细粒度推理任务随标注预算显著增大而持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 标签效率具有任务依赖性，为复杂领域中专家标注资源的分配提供了蓝图；公开代码与检查点以促进后续研究。

title: Autonomous Driving Research Requires a Community-Driven Data Paradigm
summary: Autonomous driving has made remarkable progress, with recent AI advances enabling commercial deployments that are reshaping urban mobility. Yet the field remains far from its universal social promise: autonomous systems that can operate robustly anywhere, anytime, for anyone. We posit that this gap is not merely a modeling problem, but a problem of the prevailing data paradigm. Current research relies heavily on a few benchmark datasets with limited spatial and scenario coverage, even though the community has collectively produced over 600 autonomous driving datasets across nearly 50 countries. However, this abundance has not translated into broad research impact: most datasets remain significantly underused due to fragmentation, limited visibility, incompatible protocols, and benchmark incentives that concentrate attention on a few dominant datasets. We therefore argue that autonomous driving research requires a collaborative, community-driven data paradigm. Such a paradigm would improve the discovery, reuse, integration, and evaluation of diverse datasets; make underexplored data easier and more rewarding to study; and lower the barrier for new contributors. We outline its key principles, illustrate an early realization, and call for collaboration across academia and industry to transform fragmented datasets into shared community infrastructure for anytime-anywhere autonomy.

AI.tldr: 现有自动驾驶研究依赖少数基准数据集，导致空间与场景覆盖有限；本文主张转向社区驱动的协同数据范式，以整合全球600多个分散数据集，支撑"任何时间、任何地点"的通用自动驾驶。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶虽已取得显著进展并实现商业落地，但距离"任何时间、任何地点、面向任何人"稳健运行的通用目标仍有巨大差距。作者认为这一差距不仅是建模问题，更是数据范式问题：研究高度依赖少数空间与场景覆盖有限的基准数据集，而社区已累积近50个国家、600多个数据集却未转化为广泛研究影响。
AI.method: 这是一篇立场/观点性论文。作者通过分析当前数据生态的碎片化、可见性不足、协议不兼容以及基准激励导致注意力集中于少数主导数据集等问题，论证需要社区驱动、协同式的数据范式，并提出该范式的关键原则、展示一个早期实现案例。
AI.result: 论文指出多数数据集因碎片化、可见性有限、协议不兼容及基准激励偏差而严重未被充分利用；提出协同数据范式可改善多样化数据集的发现、复用、整合与评估，使未被充分探索的数据更易被研究且回报更高，并降低新贡献者的参与门槛。
AI.conclusion: 作者呼吁学术界与产业界合作，将碎片化的自动驾驶数据集转化为共享的社区基础设施，以实现"任何时间、任何地点"的自动驾驶通用能力。

title: Evaluating Cultural Awareness of LLMs for Haitian Creole
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit substantial performance disparities between high- and low-resource languages. Beyond lower task performance, they often fail to capture the cultural norms and values of underrepresented communities. In this work, we present the first systematic evaluation of cultural awareness in LLMs for Haitian Creole, a language spoken by millions but severely underrepresented in digital resources. We assess cultural awareness along four complementary dimensions---specificity, bias, diversity, and variation---using a benchmark of culturally salient prompts curated by native speakers in a text infilling setting. Our results reveal a clear gap between cultural awareness in Haitian Creole and higher-resource French, with Haitian performance being more uneven across domains and more affected by French linguistic interference. Story generation further reveals recurring portrayals of Haitian characters through hardship and resilience, showing that even positive characterizations can encode stereotypical narratives. Our code, benchmark, and evaluation framework are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估大语言模型在海地克里奥尔语上的文化意识，围绕特异性、偏见、多样性和变异性四个维度，采用母语者构建的文化显著性提示基准进行文本填空测试，发现其与高资源法语存在明显文化意识差距。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在高资源与低资源语言间存在显著性能差异，且往往难以捕捉被低估社群的文化规范与价值观。海地克里奥尔语使用人数众多，但在数字资源中严重匮乏，其文化意识评估此前缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 构建由海地克里奥尔语母语者筛选的文化显著性提示基准，在文本填空（text infilling）设置下，从特异性、偏见、多样性和变异性四个互补维度评估大语言模型的文化意识。
AI.result: 海地克里奥尔语与高资源法语之间存在明显的文化意识差距；海地克里奥尔语表现跨领域更不均衡，且更易受法语语言干扰。故事生成任务显示海地角色常被描绘为历经苦难与坚韧，表明即便是正面刻画也可能编码刻板叙事。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了低资源语言文化意识评估的缺口，指出正面表征亦可能隐含刻板印象，并公开代码、基准与评估框架以促进后续研究。

title: SatNav: A Scalable Benchmark for Long-Horizon UAV Vision-Language Navigation from Satellite Imagery
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets. 32 pages, 16 figures. Project page: https://eku127.github.io/SatNav/
summary: Urban uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) vision-language navigation (VLN) requires agents to follow instructions across extended urban spaces, inherently demanding long-term memory and geospatial grounding. However, scaling existing benchmarks remains difficult because of their reliance on costly reconstructed 3D assets, limiting geographic diversity and episode scale. To address this, we introduce SatNav, a scalable, long-horizon UAV VLN benchmark built from high-resolution satellite imagery. SatNav targets city-level navigation missions and uses satellite crops as approximations of UAV nadir views for visual observations. Through an automated cue-to-episode pipeline, SatNav constructs 118K episodes from 59 scenes across 18 cities, with an average trajectory length of 379 m. To stress-test long-horizon memory and geospatial reasoning, SatNav defines three task families: Boundary, Landmark, and Route, targeting loop progress tracking, landmark-based spatial grounding, and route following with counting cues. Benchmarking classical VLN agents and recent agents based on large vision-language models (LVLMs) on SatNav shows that city-scale navigation remains challenging. We further introduce SwiftVLN, a modular framework with switchable memory components, and conduct systematic memory-design ablations. Finally, satellite-to-UAV transfer experiments show that satellite-trained navigation models can operate on real-flight UAV observations, showing the practical relevance of SatNav. Our project page: https://eku127.github.io/SatNav/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SatNav——一个基于高分辨率卫星影像构建的可扩展、长时程城市级无人机视觉语言导航基准，并配套提出模块化框架 SwiftVLN 及系统性记忆设计消融研究。
AI.motivation: 城市无人机视觉语言导航（UAV VLN）要求智能体在广阔城市空间中遵循指令，天然需要长时记忆与地理空间定位能力。然而现有基准依赖重建成本高昂的3D资产，导致地理多样性与数据规模难以扩展。
AI.method: SatNav 以高分辨率卫星影像为数据源，用卫星裁剪图近似无人机下视（nadir）视角的视觉观测；通过"线索到片段"（cue-to-episode）自动化流程，从18座城市、59个场景构建11.8万条导航片段，平均轨迹长度379米。基准定义三类任务族：Boundary（环路进度跟踪）、Landmark（基于地标的空间定位）、Route（带计数线索的路线跟随），以压力测试长时程记忆与地理空间推理。此外提出模块化且记忆组件可切换的框架 SwiftVLN，并进行记忆设计消融。
AI.result: 在 SatNav 上评测经典 VLN 智能体与基于大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的近期智能体，结果表明城市尺度导航仍具显著挑战性；系统消融揭示了不同记忆设计的影响；卫星到无人机的迁移实验表明，经卫星数据训练的导航模型可在真实飞行无人机观测上运行。
AI.conclusion: SatNav 以卫星影像替代昂贵3D重建，实现了城市级 UAV VLN 基准的低成本规模化与地理多样性；其任务设计与迁移实验验证了该基准的挑战性与现实实用性。

title: ClearGS: Reliability-Aware Gaussian Splatting from Handheld Videos
summary: We present ClearGS for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) from handheld videos with uneven viewpoint coverage and mixed frame quality. Rather than selecting frames with binary decisions, ClearGS uses Reliability-aware View Allocation (RVA) to assign graded raw-supervision weights based on appearance reliability, degradation risk, and geometric utility, while weakly reactivating useful suppressed frames to maintain trajectory coverage. Since weighting cannot restore details lost to blur or distortion, ClearGS further introduces Render-Guided In-Video Restoration (RIVR). The current 3DGS render provides a pose-aligned structural candidate, a frozen no-reference restoration expert restores the corresponding raw video observation without any clean reference image, and no-reference perceptual scores select among the render, restored observation, and high-frequency fused candidate. ClearGS then applies Full-Trajectory Repair Consolidation to revisit accepted repairs and preserve details introduced early. On GS2E and GSOTM, ClearGS achieves state-of-the-art overall performance, with consistent CLIP-IQA and MUSIQ gains and LPIPS reductions in most degradation settings, without paired sharp supervision or matched clean references.

AI.tldr: ClearGS 面向手持视频的 3D 高斯泼溅重建，提出可靠性感知视角分配（RVA）与渲染引导视频内修复（RIVR），在无需配对清晰监督或干净参考的条件下取得 SOTA 效果。
AI.motivation: 手持视频存在视角覆盖不均与帧质量混杂的问题：既有方法多以二值方式筛选帧，既丢弃了覆盖轨迹的有用帧，也无法恢复被模糊或失真破坏的细节，且缺乏配对的清晰监督与干净参考图像。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 可靠性感知视角分配（RVA），基于外观可靠性、退化风险与几何效用分配分级原始监督权重，并弱激活被抑制的可用帧以维持轨迹覆盖；(2) 渲染引导视频内修复（RIVR），以当前 3DGS 渲染作为位姿对齐的结构候选，用冻结的无参考修复专家在无干净参考下修复对应原始观测，再通过无参考感知分数在渲染、修复观测与高频融合候选间择优选；(3) 全轨迹修复整合，回访已接受的修复结果并保留早期引入的细节。
AI.result: 在 GS2E 与 GSOTM 数据集上整体性能达到最优，多数退化设置下 CLIP-IQA 与 MUSIQ 指标稳定提升、LPIPS 降低。
AI.conclusion: 分级监督分配与渲染引导的无参考修复相结合，可在不使用配对清晰监督或匹配干净参考的前提下，显著提升手持视频 3DGS 重建的感知质量与细节保真度。

title: Muslim: A Deployed Arabic Voice AI Platform for Grounded Islamic Knowledge
comment: 6 pages, 4 tables. Deployed system: https://muslim.yahyaelnawasany.com - released models: https://huggingface.co/NightPrince
summary: We present Muslim, a production Arabic voice AI platform serving grounded, sourced Islamic knowledge to real users. Beyond a real-time voice pipeline (NeMo Arabic ASR, an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint, self-hosted TTS) and a deterministic multi-source retrieval layer routed across six Model Context Protocol servers, we report three things a research prototype typically lacks. First, a released family of fine-tuned Arabic Islamic model artifacts: an efficient tool-routing LLM (Muslim-6B-PRO, 5.94B parameters) and a Modern Standard Arabic TTS model (Fasih-TTS-V1) that ranks 5th of 17 overall and 2nd of 11 open-weight systems on the community-voted Arabic TTS Arena for MSA. Second, an account and metering layer - a free per-account turn allowance, capacity-aware refusal, and email verification deferred to the point it actually matters - that turns an open demo into an operable, abuse-resistant product. Third, a three-layer observability stack (liveness, error reporting, product analytics) built specifically around the system's characteristic failure mode: a GPU-bound agent host going silent while the web tier keeps serving normally. We report real, measured latency and accuracy figures (98.4% recitation-validation accuracy on 124 cases; end-to-end voice latency of 0.9-1.7s) and discuss the concrete engineering trade-offs and limitations of running an Islamic-knowledge voice product in production.

AI.tldr: Muslim是一个已上线的阿拉伯语伊斯兰知识语音AI平台，包含实时语音管线、多源检索层、微调模型族、计量层与三层可观测性，并给出实测延迟（0.9–1.7秒）与准确率（98.4%）。
AI.motivation: 研究原型通常缺少可运营性、发布模型工件与针对特定故障模式的可观测性；本文旨在将伊斯兰知识语音AI从演示推进为可运行、抗滥用的生产产品，并展示真实工程取舍。
AI.method: 系统由三部分构成：（1）实时语音管线（NeMo Arabic ASR、OpenAI兼容LLM端点、自托管TTS）与跨六个MCP服务器的确定性多源检索路由；（2）发布微调模型族——工具路由LLM Muslim-6B-PRO（5.94B参数）与MSA TTS模型Fasih-TTS-V1；（3）账户与计量层（免费账号回合额度、容量感知拒答、关键点才触发邮箱验证）；（4）三层可观测性（存活检测、错误上报、产品分析），针对GPU受限agent主机静默而Web层正常服务的典型失效模式。
AI.result: Fasih-TTS-V1在社区投票的阿拉伯语TTS Arena（MSA）上总体排名第5/17，开源权重系统第2/11；诵经校验准确率98.4%（124例）；端到端语音延迟0.9–1.7秒。
AI.conclusion: 该平台具备生产级可运营性与计量防滥用能力，并通过三层可观测性覆盖特定失效模式；同时讨论了在生产环境运行伊斯兰知识语音产品的具体工程取舍与局限。

title: LENS-GRF: Permutation-Invariant Lesion Evidence Network with Gated Residual Fusion for Acne Severity Grading and Multi-Rater Clinical Oracle Analysis
comment: Submitted to Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine (Elsevier)
summary: Automated acne severity grading requires both whole-face context and fine-grained lesion evidence. We propose LENS-GRF (Lesion Evidence Network with Set-Transformer and Gated Residual Fusion), an interpretable multi-stage framework for four-class acne severity grading. The method combines Adaptive Facial Skin Segmentation and a global Vision Transformer prior with a permutation-invariant Lesion Set Transformer that encodes localized lesion patches and spatial geometry. Gated Residual Fusion adaptively controls the local residual contribution and reduces to the global prediction when the gate is zero. On ACNE04, fully automated LENS-GRF with YOLOv11s achieved 80.82% accuracy; with ground-truth lesion annotations, it achieved 95.89% +/- 0.59% accuracy and a Quadratic Weighted Kappa of 0.9753. A data-integrity audit identified 15 cross-split duplicate image pairs, including five with conflicting severity labels. In locked zero-shot evaluation on the full PLSBRACNE01 cohort (200 subjects, 600 views), automated LENS-GRF achieved 35.00% accuracy versus 42.50% for the global baseline. On the 148-subject common cohort used for three-dermatologist oracle analysis, ground-truth lesion inputs increased the best oracle accuracy to 47.97%, while the highest oracle QWK was 0.5799. Pairwise oracle agreement ranged from 49.32% to 66.22%, highlighting detector domain shift, annotation variability, and cross-criterion mismatch.

AI.tldr: 提出可解释多阶段框架LENS-GRF，融合全局ViT先验与置换不变的病变集合Transformer，通过门控残差融合局部证据，用于四类痤疮严重度分级。
AI.motivation: 痤疮严重度自动分级需同时具备全脸上下文与细粒度病变证据，现有方法难以兼顾二者并保持可解释性。
AI.method: LENS-GRF包含自适应面部皮肤分割、全局ViT先验、置换不变的Lesion Set Transformer（编码局部病变块与空间几何），以及Gated Residual Fusion（自适应控制局部残差贡献，门控为零时退化为全局预测）。
AI.result: 在ACNE04上，全自动LENS-GRF配合YOLOv11s达80.82%准确率；使用真值病变标注达95.89%±0.59%准确率、QWK 0.9753。数据完整性审计发现15对跨划分重复图像，其中5对标签冲突。在PLSBRACNE01全队列（200人、600视图）锁定零样本评估中，自动LENS-GRF为35.00%，全局基线42.50%；在148人共同队列的真值病变输入下最佳oracle准确率47.97%、最高oracle QWK 0.5799，成对oracle一致性49.32%–66.22%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在ACNE04上性能优异，但真实队列零样本中存在检测器域偏移、标注变异与跨标准不匹配导致的显著性能下降。

title: Statistical Foundations for a Google Play User-Review Sentiment Index: Signal Fusion, Shrinkage, Distributional Validation, and Dynamic Smoothing
comment: 29 pages, 5 tables, 3 figures; includes a deterministic synthetic stress test and a descriptive application to 6000 Google Play reviews from three apps
summary: The decision problem is whether valence among the users who write reviews of an app has changed enough to warrant investigation of a release, outage, or support issue. We propose a statistical specification for that decision, applied to written Google Play reviews collected under a declared locale, language, sort order, retrieval cap, and window rule. That endpoint returns a selected collection rather than a random sample, so the index describes review writers under the declared protocol and not all app users. What is new is not a sentiment classifier but an auditable interface: an ordinal threshold model is the preferred representation of star ratings, a calibrated two-signal generalized least-squares estimator is retained as an interpretable linear approximation when held-out labels support its conditional-unbiasedness assumption, the estimand is declared before the estimator, and every downstream module--uncertainty, diagnostics, and regularization--is tied to that declaration. The framework separates the latent average of a fixed collected set from the mean of a protocol-defined population of review writers, so measurement and between-review variation are not conflated, and treats helpfulness and recency weights as a different policy target. Shrinkage, cross-app empirical Bayes, histogram and dependence diagnostics, and dynamic smoothing are specified as separate modules with defaults and mandatory sensitivity analyses. A reference implementation, a declared 6000-review three-app collection, and a synthetic stress test exercise the displayed equations: fusion reduced error in clean and small-window scenarios, coordinated contamination caused severe bias and interval failure, and the collected sample reproduces the abstention rules. No real-review validation is claimed.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个可审计的统计决策接口，用于判断应用评论者情绪效价是否变化到需要调查发布、故障或支持问题。估计量先于估计方法声明，包含不确定度、诊断与正则化模块，并用参考实现、声明式6000条评论数据集和合成压力测试进行验证，未声称真实评论验证。
AI.motivation: 应用商店评论的情绪效价变化可能提示发布、故障或支持问题，但实际采集到的评论是协议化的“选中集合”而非随机样本，容易把测量误差与评论者间差异混淆，且帮助性与时效性加权属于不同政策目标。因此需要一个明确可审计的统计决策规范。
AI.method: 提出面向决策的统计规范：先声明estimand再选择估计量；以有序阈值模型作为星级评分的首选表示，在留出标签支持条件无偏假设时保留校准的两信号广义最小二乘估计作为可解释线性近似；将测量与评论者间变异分离，将帮助性和时效性权重视为另一政策目标；收缩、跨应用经验贝叶斯、直方图与依赖诊断、动态平滑作为独立模块，附默认设置与强制敏感性分析；提供参考实现、6000条三应用声明式采集与合成压力测试。
AI.result: 合成压力测试显示，融合在干净与小窗口场景降低误差；协调污染导致严重偏差与区间失效；采集样本再现了弃权规则。
AI.conclusion: 该工作的新颖性不在情感分类器，而在可审计决策接口及其与下游模块的声明一致性；框架描述的是协议定义评论者总体而非全体用户，且未声称真实评论验证，需后续实证检验。

title: Forensic Twins: Self-Supervised Residual Learning for AI-Generated Image Forensics
summary: Detectors of AI-generated images are typically trained using samples from all Generative AI architectures they must catch, and struggle as soon as a new architecture emerges. Recent approaches have explored self-supervised pre-training as an alternative solution, yet standard frameworks work against the forensic task, e.g., their augmentations overwrite the micro-statistics of image formation. This paper introduces Forensic Twins, a Self-Supervised Residual Learning (SSRL) framework whose pretext task suppresses macroscopic content availability. Each image is mapped through a frozen, off-the-shelf forensic residual extractor, from which two spatially disjoint crops are drawn. Sharing no pixel, the two views retain minimal semantic structure to align, leaving a redundancy-reduction objective with a predominant common signal: the stationary fingerprint of the image acquisition pipeline. Additionally, Forensic Twins is trained exclusively on real images; no AI-generated image is observed at any stage. Experiments show that Forensic Twins attributes AI generator sources with 56.61% accuracy, i.e., 6.13% above the previous state-of-the-art zero-shot method at 375x lower latency. We also demonstrate that fitting a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) offline using only the real image embeddings extracted from Forensic Twins turns it into a state-of-the-art zero-shot detector, reaching 97.99% AUC across 27 unseen AI generators, including GANs, diffusion models and commercial systems. Code, weights and exact splits will be made publicly available

AI.tldr: 提出 Forensic Twins，一种自监督残差学习框架，仅用真实图像训练，通过抑制宏观内容的 pretext task 学习图像采集管线指纹，实现零样本 AI 图像来源归因与检测。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像检测器依赖覆盖所有目标生成架构的训练样本，一旦出现新架构即失效；已有自监督预训练方案与取证任务相冲突，其数据增强会破坏图像形成过程中的微观统计特征。
AI.method: 构建 Self-Supervised Residual Learning（SSRL）框架：图像先经冻结的现成取证残差提取器映射，再从中抽取两个空间不重叠的裁剪视图；两视图无共享像素，语义结构极小，使冗余缩减目标的主导公共信号成为图像采集管线的平稳指纹。训练仅使用真实图像，全程不接触 AI 生成图像。离线用真实图像嵌入拟合 GMM 即可转为检测器。
AI.result: AI 生成器来源归因准确率 56.61%，比此前最强零样本方法高 6.13%，延迟降低 375 倍；仅用真实图像嵌入离线拟合 GMM 后，在 27 个未见 AI 生成器（含 GAN、扩散模型与商业系统）上达到 97.99% AUC 的零样本检测最优水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过残差域自监督学习抑制语义内容、突出采集指纹，可在完全不使用 AI 生成样本的前提下实现高效、可迁移的零样本 AI 图像检测与来源归因，代码、权重与数据划分将公开。

title: Structured Reasoning Agentic Framework for Interpretable Critical View of Safety Assessment
summary: Surgical scene understanding is critical for computer-assisted intervention, yet laparoscopic cholecystectomy remains challenged by the complex anatomy of the hepatocystic triangle and the risk of bile duct injury. Existing methods for Critical View of Safety (CVS) assessment typically treat it as a holistic prediction task, mapping visual features directly to criterion-level labels. This black-box paradigm lacks explicit reasoning about anatomical relationships, limiting both interpretability and compositional generalization. To address this, we propose ReasonCVS, a structured reasoning agentic framework empowered by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that decomposes CVS assessment into explicit, fine-grained anatomical verification. Specifically, we devise an Anatomical Scene Graph Abstraction (ASGA) that organizes anatomical entities and their spatial relationships into a structured representation. To operationalize this, we introduce a Rationale-Aware Reasoning Agent, powered by a Large Language Model (LLM) fine-tuned via rationale distillation. Functioning as a strict central decision-maker, it invokes VLM-driven Sub-criterion Verifier as a specialized perceptual tool to parse the graph and independently evaluate individual sub-criteria. Through calibrated soft reasoning, this agent synthesizes the tool-gathered distributed observations, yielding a final verdict alongside a traceable clinical rationale. Extensive experiments on the Endoscapes-CVS201 benchmark demonstrate that ReasonCVS achieves superior performance (68.1\% mAP) over state-of-the-art while providing interpretable, criterion-level explanations for reliable surgical assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReasonCVS，一个由视觉语言模型驱动的结构化推理智能体框架，将腹腔镜胆囊切除术中的关键安全视野（CVS）评估分解为细粒度解剖验证，在 Endoscapes-CVS201 基准上取得 68.1% mAP，并输出可解释的准则级临床理据。
AI.motivation: 现有 CVS 评估方法多将任务视为整体预测，把视觉特征直接映射到准则级标签。这种黑箱范式缺乏对解剖关系的显式推理，导致可解释性不足，且难以进行组合式泛化。而肝胆三角解剖复杂、胆管损伤风险高，临床需要更可靠、可追溯的评估依据。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 解剖场景图抽象（ASGA），将解剖实体及其空间关系组织为结构化表示；(2) 理据感知推理智能体，由经理据蒸馏微调的大语言模型担任严格的中心决策者；(3) 由 VLM 驱动的子准则验证器作为专用感知工具，解析场景图并独立评估各子准则。智能体通过校准的软推理综合工具收集的分布式观测，输出最终判定及可追溯的临床理据。
AI.result: 在 Endoscapes-CVS201 基准上的大量实验表明，ReasonCVS 以 68.1% mAP 优于当前最先进方法，同时能提供可解释的准则级说明，支撑可靠的手术评估。
AI.conclusion: 将 CVS 评估从整体黑箱预测重构为显式的结构化解剖推理，可同时提升性能与可解释性，验证了智能体式 VLM-LLM 协作范式在手术场景理解中的有效性。

title: The Detectability Gap: Hidden Heterogeneity in Hallucination Detection Across Language Models
summary: Sampling based consistency is widely used for hallucination detection, yet aggregate performance can conceal systematic differences in which errors are detectable. This work studies that heterogeneity across four language models and three factual question answering datasets. Partitioning hallucinations by answer agreement reveals high agreement (Ghost) and low agreement (Flickering) regimes with an apparent detectability gap of $0.35$ to $0.46$ AUC. Because the statistics used to define the regimes and measure this gap are strongly coupled ($|ρ|\approx0.94$ to $1.00$), the raw result is treated as a property of agreement based detection rather than independent evidence. After freezing regime assignments, lexical and semantic response dispersion preserve the asymmetry, with bootstrap $95\%$ intervals excluding zero in all $12$ model and dataset settings. A stricter test using individual diffusion trajectories and no cross seed information preserves the asymmetry across all three LLaDA datasets ($p<0.005$) and directionally across all three Dream datasets, with one reaching significance. The hard regime varies substantially in prevalence across models ($16\%$ to $77\%$), and matched prompts frequently change regimes between models. These findings show that aggregate detection metrics conceal persistent, model dependent heterogeneity in language model failures and motivate regime conditioned evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于采样一致性的幻觉检测中误差可检测性的异质性，发现将幻觉按答案一致性划分为高一致（Ghost）与低一致（Flickering）两种情形后存在稳固的可检测性差距，但该差距源于统计耦合，需进行情形条件化评估。
AI.motivation: 基于采样一致性的幻觉检测被广泛使用，但聚合性能指标可能掩盖哪些错误可被检测的系统性差异，论文旨在揭示这种跨模型、跨数据集的异质性。
AI.method: 在4个语言模型和3个事实性问答数据集上，按答案一致性将幻觉划分为高一致（Ghost）与低一致（Flickering）两种情形；检验定义情形与度量差距所用统计量的耦合程度（|ρ|≈0.94至1.00）；冻结情形分配后，用词汇与语义响应离散度验证不对称性，并采用bootstrap 95%置信区间；进一步用无跨种子信息的个体扩散轨迹进行更严格检验（LLaDA与Dream数据集）。
AI.result: 观察到0.35至0.46 AUC的明显可检测性差距，但该原始结果因统计量强耦合而被视为一致性检测的属性而非独立证据。冻结情形分配后，全部12个模型-数据集设定中bootstrap 95%区间均排除零；在LLaDA三个数据集上不对称性均显著（p<0.005），Dream三个数据集上方向一致，其中一个达到显著。难检测情形的占比在不同模型间差异显著（16%至77%），且相同提示在不同模型间常发生情形切换。
AI.conclusion: 聚合检测指标掩盖了语言模型失败中持续存在且依赖模型的异质性，因此应推动情形条件化的评估方法。

title: Two Conformal Constructions for Adaptive Within-Document AI-Text Screening
comment: 16 pages, 0 figures; theoretical manuscript; no empirical evaluation
summary: We study false-alert control when screening for text generated by artificial intelligence (AI). The screening procedure selects document prefixes and detectors from observed evidence and may stop before exhausting its inspection budget. We give two finite-sample constructions under document-level exchangeability between human calibration documents and a new null document, with no restriction on dependence among tokens within a document. Construction A registers a finite family of prefix-detector scores and allocates a false-alert budget across their conformal ranks. A union bound protects any executed subset of that family. Construction B calibrates the complete-path maximum of a development-fixed adaptive policy. Each partial-path maximum is bounded by the complete maximum, so a terminal conformal rank protects early stopping without splitting the error budget. We prove marginal control of any false alert across the permitted inspection path and derive necessary calibration counts for rejection. We also state oracle testing, distribution-shift, and independent-audit bounds with their additional assumptions. Both constructions protect stopping within their specified scope; neither proof constructs an e-process or justifies multiplying conformal ranks. Detection power and computational savings remain questions for empirical evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI生成文本筛查中的误报控制问题，提出两种在文档级可交换性下的有限样本构造方法，证明了对任意允许检查路径的边际误报控制，并给出了拒绝所需的最小校准样本量。
AI.motivation: 在筛查AI生成文本时，检测过程会基于已观测证据选择文档前缀和检测器，并可能在用尽检查预算前提前停止。这种数据依赖的选择与提前停止会破坏传统误报控制的有限样本有效性，因此需要在无文档内token依赖限制的条件下建立有效的误报控制方法。
AI.method: 假设人类校准文档与新零假设文档之间满足文档级可交换性，且不限制文档内token的依赖结构。构造A：注册一个有限的前缀-检测器分数族，将误报预算按共形秩分配，并用联合界保护该族中任意被执行子集。构造B：校准一个开发阶段固定自适应策略的完整路径最大值；由于任意部分路径最大值被完整最大值所界定，终止时的共形秩即可保护提前停止而无需拆分误差预算。
AI.result: 证明了在允许的检查路径上对任意误报的边际控制，并推导出拒绝所需的最小校准样本量；同时给出了oracle检验、分布漂移和独立审计的界及其附加假设条件。两种构造均在其指定范围内保护停止行为，但均未构造e-process，也未证明共形秩相乘的合理性。
AI.conclusion: 两种构造在文档级可交换性和各自范围内实现了有效的误报控制，但检测功效与计算节省仍有待实证评估。

title: SynDORBench: Evaluating LVLM Perceptual Robustness Under Physically Constrained Visibility Conditions
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on multimodal reasoning benchmarks, yet their perceptual reliability under physically constrained imaging conditions remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations predominantly assume ideal visual inputs and therefore fail to characterize how camera distance, illumination, viewpoint, and pixel density fundamentally affect semantic recoverability. We introduce SynDORBench, the first physically grounded benchmark for evaluating LVLM perceptual robustness under DORI-calibrated conditions aligned with human visual capability standards. SynDORBench comprises over 54k question--answer pairs generated through a controllable synthetic pipeline that systematically varies viewing distance, lighting, camera geometry, and action pose according to physically interpretable pixel-density regimes. To support scalable low-visibility supervision, we further propose a discernibility annotation framework that propagates human perceptual labels using mask-conditioned statistical features and ensemble learning. We evaluate 16 open-source LVLMs, a commercial LVLM baseline, and YOLO11x across human-presence classification and action recognition tasks under progressively degraded visibility conditions. Our results reveal that perceptual failure in LVLMs is strongly governed by pixel density and physical imaging constraints rather than model scale alone. Surprisingly, several compact open-source LVLMs outperform larger commercial baselines and substantially exceed YOLO11x robustness under long-range and low-light conditions. SynDORBench establishes a new benchmark paradigm for physically grounded multimodal evaluation, enabling systematic analysis of LVLM reliability under real-world perceptual constraints and direct comparison against human visibility thresholds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SynDORBench，一个基于 DORI 物理成像约束的 LVLM 感知鲁棒性评测基准，包含 5.4 万余条 QA 对，并揭示像素密度与物理成像条件比模型规模更能主导感知失效。
AI.motivation: 现有 LVLM 多模态评测多假设理想视觉输入，未刻画相机距离、光照、视角与像素密度对语义可恢复性的影响，导致对真实物理约束下感知可靠性的认识不足。
AI.method: 构建可控合成流水线，按像素密度物理区间系统变化视距、光照、相机几何与动作姿态，生成 54k+ QA 对；并提出可判别性标注框架，利用掩码条件统计特征与集成学习传播人类感知标签，实现可扩展的低可见度监督。
AI.result: 在逐步退化的可见度条件下评测 16 个开源 LVLM、1 个商用 LVLM 基线与 YOLO11x，结果显示 LVLM 感知失败主要由像素密度与物理成像约束决定，而非仅由模型规模决定；部分紧凑开源模型超越更大商用基线，并在远距离与低光下显著优于 YOLO11x。
AI.conclusion: SynDORBench 建立了物理落地的多模态评测新范式，支持在真实感知约束下系统分析 LVLM 可靠性，并可与人类可见度阈值直接对比。

title: MexHat: A Dataset for Hate Speech Detection in Mexican Spanish Videos
summary: Ensuring online safety through content monitoring had raised Hate Speech Detection as a crucial task to be addressed. By essence the task demands the capture of contextual cues, which are essential for a precise understanding of the content's intent. Although automated detection approaches for the task have advanced significantly, the scarcity of non-English resources persists, limiting the ability of models to adapt to the subtle, context-dependent, and culturally related nature of multimodal content. In this paper, we introduce MexHat, a video dataset designed to capture the linguistic and cultural cues for the hate-speech detection task in a Mexican Spanish context. Our dataset comprises around 1k video clips annotated across two tasks: a three-way class evaluation (no negative content, offensive content and hate-speech content), and a fine-grained class evaluation including three hate-speech sub-categories. The dataset statistics and the baseline results highlight the inherent challenges associated with the task. Disclaimer: This paper contains sensitive content that may be disturbing to some readers.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MexHat，一个面向墨西哥西班牙语语境的视频仇恨言论检测数据集，包含约1千个视频片段，支持三分类与细粒度子类两种标注任务，并提供统计与基线结果。
AI.motivation: 网络内容监控使仇恨言论检测成为关键任务，而该任务本质上依赖语境线索以准确理解内容意图。现有自动化方法虽有进展，但非英语资源稀缺，限制了模型对多模态内容中微妙、依赖语境且与文化相关特征的适应能力。
AI.method: 构建 MexHat 视频数据集，聚焦墨西哥西班牙语的语言与文化线索。数据集包含约1k个视频片段，并提供两套标注任务：其一是三分类评估（无负面内容、冒犯性内容、仇恨言论内容），其二是包含三个仇恨言论子类别的细粒度分类评估。
AI.result: 论文报告了数据集统计信息与基线结果，这些结果凸显了该任务固有的挑战性。
AI.conclusion: MexHat 填补了墨西哥西班牙语多模态仇恨言论检测资源空白，为后续模型开发与评估提供基准；论文同时提示内容包含敏感信息，可能引起部分读者不适。

title: Region-Level Black-Box Defense Against Stealthy Embedding-Space Backdoors in CLIP
summary: Contrastive Language--Image Pretraining (CLIP) has emerged as a dominant vision backbone due to its strong transferability and zero-shot capabilities. However, recent studies reveal a critical vulnerability: embedding-space backdoor attacks. By poisoning only a tiny fraction of image--text pairs, adversaries can implant stealthy triggers that induce targeted shifts in CLIP's joint embedding space. Unlike conventional backdoors that manipulate classifier logits, these attacks corrupt representations directly, making them highly effective under extremely low poisoning ratios and difficult to detect. Existing defenses require access to model parameters, gradients, logits, or clean validation data---assumptions that rarely hold in realistic black-box deployments. Moreover, current black-box methods struggle to accurately localize small or out-of-distribution triggers. We propose CLIPGuard, a lightweight and fully black-box defense specifically designed to mitigate embedding-space backdoors in CLIP encoders. CLIPGuard identifies malicious regions by measuring segment-wise embedding perturbations and selectively purifies only suspicious segments via semantic inpainting, preserving benign visual content and alignment quality. Extensive experiments on STL-10, ImageNet, and diverse trigger families---including BadCLIP, BadNets, blended, patch-based, and typographic attacks---demonstrate that CLIPGuard reduces attack success rates to as low as 1.05% while maintaining clean accuracy up to 86.34%, consistently outperforming existing black-box defenses, including CleanCLIP and CleanerCLIP. Our code is available https://github.com/wsu-cyber-security-lab-ai/CLIPGuard.git

AI.tldr: 提出CLIPGuard，一种轻量级全黑盒防御方法，通过分段嵌入扰动检测和语义修复净化，抵御CLIP编码器中的嵌入空间后门攻击。
AI.motivation: CLIP因强迁移性和零样本能力成为主流视觉骨干，但存在嵌入空间后门攻击漏洞：仅需污染极少量图文对即可植入隐秘触发器，直接篡改联合嵌入表示，在极低污染率下高效且难以检测。现有防御需模型参数、梯度、logits或干净验证数据，黑盒场景难以满足，且现有黑盒方法难以准确定位小规模或分布外触发器。
AI.method: CLIPGuard采用全黑盒、轻量级设计：通过测量分段（segment-wise）嵌入扰动识别恶意区域，仅对可疑分段进行语义修复（semantic inpainting）净化，保留良性视觉内容和对齐质量，无需访问模型参数、梯度、logits或干净验证数据。
AI.result: 在STL-10、ImageNet及多种触发器家族（BadCLIP、BadNets、blended、patch-based、typographic攻击）上实验，CLIPGuard将攻击成功率降至最低1.05%，同时保持干净准确率高达86.34%，持续优于CleanCLIP和CleanerCLIP等现有黑盒防御。
AI.conclusion: CLIPGuard为黑盒部署环境下CLIP嵌入空间后门提供了一种有效且实用的防御方案，在低攻击成功率与高干净准确率之间取得良好平衡，开源代码已发布。

title: OC-GS: Gaussian Splatting for Irregular Turntable Capture
summary: Uneven rotation and dropped frames make equal-angle assumptions unreliable for turntable reconstruction. We present OC-GS, an object-centric Gaussian splatting that refines each image's angle while maintaining a shared camera, rotation axis, and pivot. This orbit-consistent refinement jointly optimizes image-derived geometry and angles to reconstruct objects from sparse, irregular captures. On rendered objects with 12, 8, and 6 irregularly spaced views, OC-GS achieves mean foreground PSNR scores of 21.26, 19.36, and 15.83dB, respectively, exceeding all four evaluated pose-free Gaussian splatting baselines in each condition. Under a shared trainer, refining image-estimated angles improves mean foreground PSNR by 7.88dB over keeping those estimates fixed. An ablation study shows that both image-derived angle initialization and the shared motion model contribute to the improvement. On real captures, OC-GS's refinement increases mean foreground PSNR by 0.70dB. Results show that refining uncertain angles within a shared motion model improves reconstruction from sparse, irregular turntable captures.

AI.tldr: 提出OC-GS：一种以物体为中心的高斯泼溅方法，通过在一个共享相机、旋转轴与枢轴的运动模型下联合优化每张图像的旋转角度与几何，从而在稀疏、非均匀转台拍摄下重建物体。
AI.motivation: 转台重建通常假设等角度拍摄，但转速不均与丢帧会导致该假设失效，使输入视角角度不确定。现有无位姿高斯泼溅方法未针对这一转台轨道一致性约束问题进行处理。
AI.method: OC-GS对每张图像的旋转角度进行细化，同时保持相机、旋转轴与枢轴共享；采用轨道一致的联合优化，同时优化图像导出的几何与角度，实现稀疏且间隔不规则的转台采集重建。消融实验用于验证图像角度初始化与共享运动模型的贡献。
AI.result: 在12、8、6个不规则间隔视角的渲染物体上，OC-GS的平均前景PSNR分别为21.26、19.36、15.83dB，各条件下均超过四个被评估的无位姿高斯泼溅基线。同一训练器下，细化图像估计角度比固定角度平均前景PSNR提升7.88dB；真实拍摄中细化带来0.70dB的平均前景PSNR提升。
AI.conclusion: 在共享运动模型内细化不确定的视角角度，可有效提升稀疏、不规则转台采集的重建质量。

title: Strategically Diverse Sampling for Self-Training
summary: Many LLM training and inference methods, including RL and test-time scaling, depend on repeated sampling, but benefit only when the responses meaningfully differ. Self-training faces the same challenge: training data is typically constructed by sampling IID responses and filtering primarily for correctness, thereby overrepresenting strategies a model already favours. We investigate strategic diversity, or substantive variation among approaches to a problem, as an alternative principle for constructing self-training data. We generate strategically diverse data with two sampling methods: GROOT, a new method which constructs a hierarchical tree of approaches and samples distinct paths, and Verbalized Sampling (VS), adapted to produce an unstructured set of approaches. Across competitive programming and Next-Chapter Prediction domains, models trained on strategically sampled data outperform IID-trained counterparts on difficult tasks and provide strong initializations for RL and test-time scaling. Most strikingly, self-training on strategically diverse but incorrect traces from Qwen3-4B outperforms IID distillation from a 235B teacher. These results challenge prevailing assumptions about what makes useful self-training data and show that diversity of approaches can matter more than correctness or teacher scale.

AI.tldr: 本文将"策略多样性"（解题思路的实质性差异）作为自训练数据的构建原则，提出GROOT与Verbalized Sampling两种采样方法，在竞技编程与Next-Chapter Prediction任务中，策略多样化的自训练数据显著优于IID采样数据，且仅用Qwen3-4B的错误但多样轨迹自训练即可超过235B教师的IID蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM训练与推理方法（RL、test-time scaling）依赖重复采样，但只有当采样结果存在实质差异时才有收益。自训练中数据通常通过IID采样并主要按正确性过滤，导致模型已偏好的策略被过度表征，缺乏策略层面的多样性。作者因此探讨以"策略多样性"替代正确性作为自训练数据的构建准则。
AI.method: 提出两种生成策略多样化数据的采样方法：GROOT——构建解题思路的层次化树结构并采样其中不同的路径；Verbalized Sampling (VS)——改编为生成无结构化的思路集合。在竞技编程和Next-Chapter Prediction两个领域开展自训练实验，并与IID采样数据进行对比，同时评估其作为RL与test-time scaling初始化的效果。
AI.result: 在竞技编程与Next-Chapter Prediction任务上，使用策略多样化数据训练的模型在困难任务上优于IID训练的模型，并为RL与test-time scaling提供更强的初始化。最突出的结果是：用Qwen3-4B生成的策略多样但答案错误的轨迹进行自训练，其性能超过从235B教师模型进行的IID蒸馏。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果挑战了关于"何种自训练数据有用"的主流假设，表明解题思路的多样性可能比正确性或教师模型规模更为重要。

title: How Far Can INRs Go? Cross-Domain Parameter-efficient INR-Based Semantic Segmentation for Brain MRI
summary: Biomedical image segmentation is central to medical image analysis, but practical deployment often faces limited annotations, memory constraints, and cross-site distribution shifts. Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have recently emerged as a lightweight alternative for semantic segmentation, achieving competitive performance with substantially fewer parameters than conventional architectures. However, the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and domain generalization abilities of INR-based segmentation remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we study these questions in the context of cross-domain brain MRI segmentation. We analyze INR-based segmentation across low-parameter regimes, comparing it with conventional pipelines in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings. Surprisingly, we find that INR-based models do not simply improve with increasing parameter budget. Their advantage is most pronounced under low-parameter and limited-augmentation settings, while U-Net-based models benefit more from larger capacity and standard augmentation. We also investigate how INRs encode semantic information in their hidden features and show that complementary segmentation-relevant structure is distributed across multiple INR layers. Building on this insight, we introduce HierINRSeg, a hierarchical INR-based architecture that aggregates multi-layer representations for improved robustness and generalization. Extensive experiments show that HierINRSeg consistently outperforms MetaSeg, a strong recent INR-based segmentation baseline, with an average improvement of 5.6 percentage points in Dice for the in-domain test set and 8.2 percentage points out-of-domain. Overall, our analysis identifies the conditions under which INR-based segmentation is most effective, providing concrete guidance for model selection and future research.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了隐式神经表示（INR）在跨域脑部MRI分割中的机制与泛化能力，发现其优势集中在低参数与弱增强场景，并提出分层聚合多层表示的HierINRSeg架构，在域内外均显著优于MetaSeg基线。
AI.motivation: 生物医学图像分割面临标注有限、内存受限和跨站点分布漂移等问题。INR作为轻量级分割替代方案参数少、性能有竞争力，但其作用机制、缩放行为和域泛化能力尚缺乏系统理解，需要厘清INR分割在何种条件下最有效。
AI.method: 在跨域脑MRI分割场景下，于低参数区间对比INR分割与传统（U-Net类）流程，涵盖域内与域外设置；分析INR隐特征中语义信息的编码方式，发现分割相关结构分布于多个INR层；据此提出HierINRSeg——聚合多层表示的分层INR架构，以提升鲁棒性与泛化。
AI.result: INR模型并非随参数增加而单调提升：其优势在低参数与有限数据增强时最明显，而U-Net类模型更受益于大容量与标准增强。INR的分割相关语义结构跨多层互补分布。HierINRSeg相对MetaSeg在域内Dice平均提升5.6个百分点，域外提升8.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究明确了INR分割最有效的适用条件（低参数、弱增强、跨域场景），为模型选择与后续研究提供具体指导；分层聚合多层表示是提升INR分割鲁棒性和泛化性的有效途径。

title: Compact Documentation for Coding Agents: A Benchmark, an Optimizer, and Why It Does Not Transfer
summary: We investigate whether natural-language documentation helps coding agents resolve software issues, and we build the tools to construct and evaluate it. We introduce a roundtrip benchmark that scores code descriptions by whether code regenerated from them passes the original tests, and show that completeness, not length, drives a description's fidelity. Using the benchmark as an optimization signal, we discover a description-writing prompt that reaches full fidelity and generalizes to unseen files. We then test the hypothesis that motivated the work: that better documentation helps an agent resolve real repository issues. Across two model families and ten repositories, and against a positive control confirming that our evaluation can detect a genuine improvement, we find that it does not. When the source is present, neither static compact documentation nor retrieved context beats the issue alone. We report this negative result together with the benchmark and the optimizer, and we characterize the boundary at which documentation helps.

AI.tldr: 本文探究自然语言文档是否有助于编码智能体解决软件问题，构建了往返基准与优化器，但发现当源码可得时文档并不带来增益。
AI.motivation: 研究出发点是一个常见假设：更好的文档能帮助编码智能体解决真实仓库问题。作者希望验证这一假设是否成立，并为此需要可量化评估文档质量的工具。
AI.method: 提出往返基准（roundtrip benchmark）：以"从描述重新生成的代码能否通过原始测试"为指标评分。实验表明描述保真度取决于完整性而非长度。以该基准作为优化信号，搜索出可达到完全保真度并能泛化到未见文件的描述撰写提示。随后在两个模型家族、十个仓库上测试文档对智能体解决真实问题的影响，并设置阳性对照以确认评估能检测出真实改进。
AI.result: 未发现文档带来改进：在源码存在时，静态紧凑文档与检索上下文均不优于仅提供问题本身。同时给出了基准与优化器，并刻画了文档能够起作用的边界条件。
AI.conclusion: 报告了这一负面结果，指出当源码可得时文档对智能体解决仓库问题无显著帮助，并界定了文档有效的适用边界。

title: PanoPed: Beyond Bounding Boxes for Sim-to-Real Panoramic Pedestrian Tracking
summary: Full-sphere panoramic cameras let fixed monitoring systems and mobile robots track people in every direction, but a planar bounding box does not fully describe where a person is on the sphere. We introduce PanoPed, a sim-to-real benchmark for pedestrian tracking on the full sphere. PanoPed-S contains 108,000 frames from fixed, quadruped-mounted, and drone-mounted cameras, with synchronized masks, depth, camera poses, and 3D pedestrian states. PanoPed-R adds 28,002 real frames from fixed cameras, 16,247 of them densely annotated. We find that an ERP rectangle cannot uniquely determine the spherical center and angular extent of the visible person, while the detector's visual query still carries information about them. Inspired by the sextant's use of angular measurements to locate objects, we propose Sextant, a plug-and-play angular localization head with only about 0.035M parameters. It reuses a frozen detector, keeps track identities unchanged, and needs no extra image encoder. Sextant gives the best result in our PanoPed-S test comparison, raising the strongest baseline, MOTIP, from 47.30 to 49.49 HOTA, with gains on all eight test sequences. Without fine-tuning on real data, the same synthetic-trained heads improve MOTIP and HAT by 0.96-1.14 HOTA on real video, and both seeds improve every real sequence. HAT+Sextant scores best among the compared systems that add no localization image encoder.

AI.tldr: 提出PanoPed全向全景行人跟踪sim-to-real基准与Sextant角定位头，以约0.035M参数复用冻结检测器，提升球面行人跟踪精度并具备良好迁移性。
AI.motivation: 全景相机可实现全方向行人跟踪，但平面边界框无法完整描述行人在球面上的位置；ERP矩形也不能唯一确定可见行人的球面中心与角向范围，因此需要面向球面的基准数据与轻量角定位方法。
AI.method: 构建PanoPed基准：PanoPed-S含108,000帧固定、四足与无人机相机数据，附同步掩码、深度、相机位姿和3D行人状态；PanoPed-R含28,002帧真实固定相机数据，其中16,247帧密集标注。受六分仪角度测量定位启发，提出即插即用角定位头Sextant，仅约0.035M参数，复用冻结检测器、保持轨迹身份不变、无需额外图像编码器。
AI.result: 在PanoPed-S测试中Sextant取得最佳结果，将最强基线MOTIP从47.30 HOTA提升至49.49 HOTA，并在全部八个测试序列上均有增益；不经真实数据微调，合成训练头在真实视频上将MOTIP和HAT提升0.96–1.14 HOTA，且两个随机种子在所有真实序列上均有提升。HAT+Sextant在未添加定位图像编码器的对比系统中得分最佳。
AI.conclusion: 球面行人跟踪需超越平面框表示；轻量角定位头Sextant可有效提升全景行人跟踪性能，并展现显著sim-to-real迁移能力。

title: GraphWrit3R: End-to-End 3D Scene Graph Writing
summary: 3D scene graphs provide a structured representation of complex environments by encoding objects, their semantic attributes, and the spatial and functional relationships between them. Current approaches for 3D scene graph generation suffer from several fundamental limitations. They rely on complex multi-stage pipelines with explicit intermediate representations, making systems fragile and prone to error propagation. They assume access to ground-truth object annotations during inference, which deviates from real-world scenarios. They depend on proprietary models, hindering open-source deployment, or incur prohibitively slow inference. We present GraphWrit3R, a simple end-to-end method that takes a 3D point cloud, Gaussian Splats, or a combination of both as input, and directly outputs a complete scene graph as a structured JSON script. The graph lists all objects, their semantic attributes, and the relationships between them, while avoiding all of the above mentioned limitations. The choice of multiple input modalities is purely for versatility, allowing a single set of weights to handle diverse scenarios. Point cloud inputs are encoded via Sonata and Gaussian Splat inputs via Chorus, with both modalities projected onto a shared voxel grid and fused through a novel per-voxel contrastive alignment loss before being decoded by a large language model. As a natural consequence of the LLM, GraphWrit3R also supports open-vocabulary querying. On the 3DSSG benchmark, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on object class, predicate, and triplet recall, outperforming methods that rely on ground-truth object annotations during inference. We further provide qualitative results and analyze different input modality configurations, contrastive loss formulations, and token fusion strategies.

AI.tldr: GraphWrit3R 提出一种端到端方法，直接以点云、Gaussian Splats 或二者组合为输入，输出结构化 JSON 场景图，避免多阶段流水线、依赖真值标注与专有模型等限制，并在 3DSSG 上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 场景图生成方法存在若干根本性局限：依赖带显式中间表示的复杂多阶段流水线，易导致脆弱性和误差传播；假设推理时可获取真值物体标注，不符合真实场景；依赖专有模型阻碍开源部署，或推理速度过慢。因此需要一种简单、端到端且实用的替代方案。
AI.method: GraphWrit3R 接收 3D 点云、Gaussian Splats 或二者组合作为输入，直接输出包含物体、语义属性及其关系的完整场景图 JSON。多模态输入设计用于通用性，使单一权重可处理多样场景。点云经 Sonata 编码，Gaussian Splat 经 Chorus 编码，两模态投影到共享体素网格，并通过新颖的逐体素对比对齐损失融合，最后由大语言模型解码，从而天然支持开放词汇查询。
AI.result: 在 3DSSG 基准上，该方法在物体类别、谓词和三元组召回率上均达到最优性能，超越了在推理时依赖真值物体标注的方法。论文还提供了定性结果，并分析了不同输入模态配置、对比损失形式和 token 融合策略。
AI.conclusion: GraphWrit3R 以简单端到端框架统一多种 3D 输入模态，消除了多阶段流水线、真值标注依赖和专有模型限制，在 3D 场景图生成任务上实现领先性能，并支持开放词汇查询。

title: User Model Extraction via Belief Self-Distillation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) implicitly infer attributes of their users and adapt their behavior accordingly, yet these beliefs remain difficult to inspect and causally manipulate. We introduce Belief Self-Distillation (BSD), a unified read-write framework that bridges linear and causal probing by learning a compact user representation that can be both decoded and written back into the model. The frozen LLM acts as its own teacher, distilling beliefs from natural conversations without external annotations. Unlike conventional probing, BSD isolates not only information present in activations, but a state whose causal role can be directly tested. Across multiple model families, BSD faithfully recovers user beliefs and enables substantially stronger interventions than matched hidden-state steering. Crucially, we find that refusal depends not only on the request, but on the model's inferred user intent: changing this belief alters refusal while holding the request fixed. We further uncover a striking cross-model regularity: independently trained LLMs converge on a shared geometry for representing their users. Together, these results reveal implicit user models as readable and causally writable internal states with direct implications for AI safety, shaping how models condition safety decisions on whom they believe they are interacting with.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Belief Self-Distillation (BSD)框架，能同时读取和写入大语言模型内部关于用户的信念表征，并证明该信念对拒答行为具有因果作用，且跨模型呈现共享几何结构。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型会隐含推断用户属性并据此调整行为，但这些内部信念难以检视，也难以被因果性地操控，缺乏既能解码又能写入的机制。
AI.method: 提出Belief Self-Distillation (BSD)，一个统一读写框架，连接线性探测与因果探测；学习紧凑的用户表征，可被解码并写回模型；以冻结的LLM作为自身教师，从自然对话中蒸馏信念，无需外部标注。
AI.result: BSD能忠实恢复用户信念，且干预效果显著强于匹配的隐状态引导；发现拒答不仅取决于请求，还取决于模型推断的用户意图，改变该信念可在请求不变时改变拒答；并发现独立训练的多个LLM收敛到表征用户的共享几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 隐含用户模型是可读且可因果写入的内部状态，对AI安全具有直接意义，影响模型如何依据"认为自己在与谁交互"来做出安全决策。

title: Learning to Stop without Learning to Stop: Self-Supervised Confidence Training Improves Reasoning Efficiency
summary: Reasoning models often generate very long reasoning traces, making inference computationally expensive. Existing approaches typically improve efficiency either through inference-time early-stopping mechanisms or by explicitly encouraging shorter reasoning during training, for example through reinforcement learning with length penalties. We show that substantial efficiency gains can instead emerge from a different kind of supervision: \textit{confidence}. Using a self-supervised procedure, we fine-tune reasoning models to predict their confidence in the answer at intermediate points along their own reasoning trajectories using only 600 training problems. Confidence is used only as a training target: the loss contains no objective for reasoning length, efficiency, or stopping. At inference, the fine-tuned models use the standard generation procedure, with no confidence elicitation or early-stopping mechanism. Despite this, self-supervised confidence fine-tuning makes reasoning more efficient, reducing generated tokens by up to 25\% at matched accuracy across Gemma, Qwen, Nemotron, and GPT-OSS models on mathematical, scientific, and coding reasoning benchmarks, with efficiency gains comparable to methods that explicitly optimize for shorter reasoning. Analysis of reasoning episodes further shows that confidence supervision largely preserves the base models' high-level reasoning composition rather than selectively suppressing particular behaviors. Our results suggest that efficient reasoning may emerge as a downstream consequence of learning metacognitive signals, without being directly optimized.

AI.tldr: 仅以自监督的"置信度"作为训练目标微调推理模型，无需任何长度或早停优化，即可在推理时自然缩短推理链，匹配准确率下最多减少25%的生成token。
AI.motivation: 推理模型常生成很长的推理链，导致推理成本高昂。现有提效方法主要依赖推理阶段的早停机制，或在训练中用长度惩罚等强化学习手段显式鼓励短推理。作者希望探索一种不同的监督信号——置信度，能否在不直接优化效率的情况下带来效率收益。
AI.method: 采用自监督流程：让模型在自身推理轨迹的中间点预测对答案的置信度，仅用600道训练题微调。损失函数中不含任何关于推理长度、效率或停止的目标，置信度仅作训练目标。推理时使用标准生成流程，不进行置信度提取或早停。
AI.result: 在Gemma、Qwen、Nemotron、GPT-OSS等模型上，针对数学、科学和代码推理基准，匹配准确率下生成token最多减少25%，效率提升与显式优化短推理的方法相当。对推理片段的分析表明，置信度监督基本保留了基座模型的高层推理构成，而非选择性地抑制某些行为。
AI.conclusion: 高效推理可能是学习元认知信号的下游结果，而非必须被直接优化的目标。

title: FuseReg: Regularizing Layer Fusion Mitigates the Reconstruction-Generation Gap in Representation Autoencoders
summary: Representation autoencoders (RAEs) reuse features from a pretrained visual encoder as reconstruction and diffusion latents, integrating strong visual representations into image generation. However, RAEs still need to decide which encoder layers form the shared latent space for the generator and pixel decoder. This choice involves a trade-off: shallower layers tend to preserve fine pixel details better, while deeper layers tend to yield better generation metrics. A fixed heuristic layer fusion therefore couples two stages that benefit from different information. We introduce FuseReg, which replaces heuristic feature selection with training over random subsets of encoder layers. We theoretically analyze the underlying mechanism: subset sampling preserves the full-layer latent mean in expectation while explicitly penalizing sensitivity to cross-layer disagreement. On ImageNet-256 with DINOv3-L, a single FuseReg decoder reconstructs from full, sparse, and single-layer fusions without retraining, achieving higher PSNR than decoders specialized to fixed fusions. This flexibility also benefits generation: decoder replacement alone reduces unguided gFID by 27% with an unchanged RAEv2 DiT-XL generator. Applying FuseReg to both stages also reduces unguided gFID by 29% on DiT-Base. The reconstruction and generation benefits also extend to other encoder families. FuseReg narrows the reconstruction-generation gap without additional training cost or architectural changes.

AI.tldr: 提出 FuseReg，用随机编码器层子集训练取代启发式层融合，使单一解码器兼容多种融合配置，同时提升重建与生成指标。
AI.motivation: RAE 复用预训练视觉编码器特征作为重建与扩散潜变量，但需确定哪些编码器层构成生成器与像素解码器共享的潜空间。该选择存在权衡：浅层更利于保留精细像素细节，深层更利于生成指标，固定启发式融合将两个需求不同的阶段耦合在一起。
AI.method: FuseReg 以随机编码器层子集为训练目标，替代固定启发式特征选择。理论上，子集采样在期望上保留全层潜变量均值，并显式惩罚对跨层不一致的敏感性。基于 ImageNet-256 与 DINOv3-L 验证，单一 FuseReg 解码器无需重训即可从全层、稀疏和单层融合中重建；并将 FuseReg 同时应用于重建与生成两个阶段（含 RAEv2 DiT-XL / DiT-Base 生成器）。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-256、DINOv3-L 上，单一 FuseReg 解码器在无重训下对全层、稀疏、单层融合的重建 PSNR 均高于针对固定融合专门训练的解码器。生成方面：仅替换解码器即在 RAEv2 DiT-XL 生成器不变的情况下使无引导 gFID 降低 27%；将 FuseReg 同时用于两阶段在 DiT-Base 上使无引导 gFID 降低 29%。重建与生成收益可扩展至其他编码器家族。
AI.conclusion: FuseReg 在不增加训练成本、不改变架构的前提下，缩小了重建与生成之间的差距，为 RAE 的层融合选择提供了灵活且统一的方案。

title: Omni-IO Skills: Harnessing Your Agent Omni-Native
summary: General-purpose agents can plan, reason, and act over long horizons, yet their production capabilities remain fragmented across text, images, audio, video, documents, 3D assets, and code. Extending a foundation model to additional modalities ties capability growth to costly model updates, while assembling specialist models and tools leaves unresolved how procedures, dependencies, intermediate assets, and cross-turn revisions should be coordinated. We present Omni-IO Skills, a plug-and-play Agent Harness that makes existing agents omni-native through hierarchical Skills, a standardized multimodal execution interface, dependency-aware orchestration, and a persistent Asset Registry. Multi-asset workflows are represented as Declare Execution Graphs, which schedule independent operations concurrently and register successful outputs for downstream and cross-turn reuse across replaceable execution backends. Its 27 Skills cover 38 representative tasks spanning seven artifact modalities and four capability families: understanding, generation, reasoning, and retrieval. On UniM-90, the harness raises the input-support rates of GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Sonnet 5 from 40.00% and 38.89% to 100%, while increasing relative Semantic--Quality Coupled Score from 26.99 to 74.94 and from 27.82 to 77.78, respectively; Strict Structure Score reaches 100.00 and 99.78. These results establish harness-level capability composition as a practical route to broad, evolvable Omni systems without changing the host agent's reasoning core.

AI.tldr: 提出Omni-IO Skills——一种即插即用的Agent Harness，通过分层Skills、标准化多模态执行接口、依赖感知编排与持久化Asset Registry，使现有通用智能体无需改动推理核心即可获得全模态原生能力。
AI.motivation: 通用智能体虽具备长时程规划、推理与行动能力，但其生产能力分散于文本、图像、音频、视频、文档、3D资产与代码等模态。为基座模型扩展新模态会使能力增长绑定高昂的模型更新成本；而拼接专家模型与工具的方式，又未解决流程、依赖、中间资产与跨轮修订如何协调的问题。
AI.method: 设计Omni-IO Skills这一即插即用的Agent Harness，包含：分层Skills、标准化多模态执行接口、依赖感知编排、持久化Asset Registry。将多资产工作流建模为Declare Execution Graphs，可并发调度相互独立的操作，并将成功输出登记以供下游及跨轮复用，且执行后端可替换。共27个Skills，覆盖7种产物模态与理解、生成、推理、检索4类能力族、38个代表性任务。
AI.result: 在UniM-90上，harness将GPT-5.6 Sol与Claude Sonnet 5的输入支持率从40.00%和38.89%提升至100%；语义—质量耦合分数（Semantic–Quality Coupled Score）相对提升由26.99升至74.94、由27.82升至77.78；严格结构分数（Strict Structure Score）分别达到100.00与99.78。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，harness级能力组合是在不改变宿主智能体推理核心的前提下，构建广泛且可演化的全模态（Omni）系统的可行路径。

title: Child ASR Adaptation with Adult Retention: An Empirical Study
summary: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems often underperform for children and non-native speakers, while adapting adult ASR models to child speech can cause adult-speech forgetting. We study child ASR adaptation with adult retention across Arabic and English. We compare full fine-tuning, LoRA, and post-hoc weight-space merging across encoder--decoder, encoder--CTC, and AudioLLM-based ASR systems. Experiments use Arabic native and non-native child speech, English MyST child speech, and adult benchmarks from MGB-2 and LibriSpeech test-clean. We evaluate recognition quality with WER and quantify the adaptation--retention trade-off using Retention Index, Child Adaptation Gain, and Adaptation Recovery. Results show that child adaptation is necessary, especially for non-native Arabic and English child speech, but direct adaptation often reduces adult ASR performance. Bilingual adaptation is more stable than language-specific adaptation. Weight-space merging often improves the trade-off, especially for encoder--CTC, Whisper, and AudioLLM-based ASR, with LERP favoring adult retention and TIES recovering stronger child gains. For the encoder--decoder model, direct bilingual fine-tuning remains strongest in raw WER.\footnote{Code, and models are available at https://github.com/qcri/Child-ASR-Adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究阿拉伯语和英语儿童语音识别适配中的"适配—保持"权衡问题，比较全量微调、LoRA与事后权重空间合并三类方法在编码器-解码器、编码器-CTC及AudioLLM架构上的表现。
AI.motivation: ASR系统对儿童和非母语说话人表现不佳，而将成人ASR模型适配到儿童语音会导致成人语音能力遗忘，需要兼顾儿童适配与成人保持。
AI.method: 在阿拉伯语母语/非母语儿童语音、英语MyST儿童语音及MGB-2、LibriSpeech test-clean成人基准上，比较全量微调、LoRA和事后权重空间合并（LERP、TIES），覆盖编码器-解码器、编码器-CTC和AudioLLM三类ASR系统，用WER及Retention Index、Child Adaptation Gain、Adaptation Recovery等指标量化权衡。
AI.result: 儿童适配确有必要，尤其对非母语阿拉伯语和英语儿童语音；但直接适配常损害成人ASR性能。双语适配比单语适配更稳定。权重空间合并常改善权衡，在编码器-CTC、Whisper和AudioLLM上尤为明显，LERP利于成人保持，TIES恢复更强儿童增益；编码器-解码器模型上直接双语全量微调原始WER最强。
AI.conclusion: 儿童ASR适配需在儿童增益与成人保持间权衡；双语适配稳定性更优，权重空间合并在多数架构上可改善该权衡，而编码器-解码器模型仍以直接双语微调WER最优。

title: IndustryLLM: Failure-Driven LLM Training for Industrial Procurement
comment: Technical Report, 56 pages, 6 figures. Model weights and configs available at https://huggingface.co/alibaba-multimodal-industrial-ai/IndustryLLM
summary: Industrial procurement requires language models to bridge informal buyer jargon, sparse marketplace attributes, and authoritative engineering standards under strict safety tolerances. We present IndustryLLM, an open-weight industrial language model trained from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base (35B total parameters with ~3B activated per token, with the vision encoder frozen). Rather than relying on generic text scaling, we introduce a failure-driven adaptation recipe spanning continued pre-training (CPT) and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). CPT leverages a curated ~100B-token corpus integrating 5B tokens of national standards (e.g., GB/T) and technical archives, 10B tokens of de-identified real-world industrial transaction and inquiry records, and 60B tokens of general replay. To overcome register mismatch and factual brittleness, we systematically reconstruct an estimated 20B-token domain subset via multi-register rewriting across 10 genres and 8 writing styles, confidence-routed minimal factual editing, and error-targeted QA synthesis (resolving colloquial typos like '42-luo-mu' -> 42CrMo, expanding ambiguous codes like '16674' -> GB/T 16674, and clarifying conflicting dimensional specs). For downstream deployment, we formalize an evidence-gated constraint-evaluation interface enforcing three-valued logic where unverified product evidence remains unknown rather than satisfied. Offline evaluations demonstrate consistent gains on procurement-query structuring (+2.97 percentage points in exact match, 95% CI [2.11, 3.86] in No-Think mode), while randomized online A/B experiments in production yield substantial improvements (+4.25% GMV, +8.3% satisfied inquiries) alongside a latency reduction from 6-7 s to 1.5 s. Model weights and configs are released at https://huggingface.co/alibaba-multimodal-industrial-ai/IndustryLLM.

AI.tldr: IndustryLLM：基于Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base的开放权重工业语言模型，采用失败驱动的CPT+SFT适配方案，结合标准/交易语料与多语域改写，并通过证据门控三值逻辑约束评估接口部署，离线采购查询结构化提升2.97pp，线上A/B实验GMV+4.25%。
AI.motivation: 工业采购场景要求语言模型衔接非正式买方术语、稀疏的商品属性与权威工程标准，并在严格安全容差下运行。通用文本规模化训练难以应对语域失配（register mismatch）与事实脆弱性（factual brittleness），故需面向该领域设计专门的适配方案。
AI.method: 以Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base（35B总参数、每token约3B激活，视觉编码器冻结）为基座，设计失败驱动的持续预训练（CPT）+监督微调（SFT）方案。CPT使用约100B token语料：5B国家标准（如GB/T）与技术档案、10B去标识化真实工业交易与询价记录、60B通用回放。为缓解语域失配与事实脆弱，通过跨10种体裁、8种写作风格的多语域改写、置信度路由的最小化事实编辑，以及错误定向QA合成，重建约20B token领域子集（如口语拼写"42-luo-mu"→42CrMo、歧义编码"16674"→GB/T 16674、冲突尺寸规格澄清）。部署侧形式化证据门控的约束评估接口，采用三值逻辑，未验证的产品证据保持"未知"而非"满足"。
AI.result: 离线评估在采购查询结构化任务上取得一致提升（No-Think模式精确匹配+2.97个百分点，95% CI [2.11, 3.86]）；生产环境随机在线A/B实验显示GMV +4.25%、满意询价+8.3%，同时延迟由6-7秒降至1.5秒。模型权重与配置已开源。
AI.conclusion: 失败驱动的领域适配配方结合证据门控三值约束评估，可在工业采购场景显著提升准确性与效率，并已通过真实线上实验验证，模型权重与配置开源发布。

title: CueKFS: Agentic Cue-Driven Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding
summary: Keyframe selection (KFS) has long produced compact video summaries for browsing and retrieval, and representative frames for thumbnails. More recently, when conditioned on a question, KFS provides an alternative to uniform sampling for long-video question answering by selecting frames that are more relevant to the question. Most methods rank frames by similarity to the question. Yet a relevant frame may score poorly when the question combines subjects or moments that no single frame shows, or requires implicit information absent from its wording. Other methods try to break down the question into subqueries, but suffer from inaccurate decomposition due to their static initial context. Therefore, we propose CueKFS, a training-free method that reformulates question--frame matching as comparing frames against a set of dynamically generated visual cues. From an initial set of salient frames, we decompose the question into cues. Each cue concurrently probes the video to navigate to its own evidence. A reasoning VLM then agentically revises the cue set against its evidence to re-explore the video. CueKFS then allocates the budget across the surviving cues. Across three benchmarks, CueKFS establishes state-of-the-art results in all 27 evaluated settings with available prior results, achieving budget-averaged gains of up to +4.54% over the previous baseline and a median of only two VLM calls. We further provide a detailed behavioral analysis of CueKFS, showing that agentic cue refinement drives active re-exploration of the video, yielding relative similarity gains of up to 92% over the initial context.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的关键帧选择方法CueKFS，将"问题—帧"匹配重构为"帧—动态视觉线索"匹配，在3个基准、27个设置的预算平均指标上全部达到SOTA，最高较前基线提升+4.54%，中位仅需2次VLM调用。
AI.motivation: 关键帧选择（KFS）可用于长视频问答：在给定问题条件下，选择比均匀采样更相关的帧，生成紧凑视频摘要、检索用摘要与缩略图代表帧。现有方法多按帧与问题的相似度排序，但当问题组合了任何单帧都不曾同时呈现的主体或时刻，或需隐含信息时，相关帧得分可能偏低；将问题分解为子查询的方法又因初始上下文静态而导致分解不准确。
AI.method: CueKFS为免训练方法，把问题—帧匹配重构为帧与动态生成视觉线索集合的比对。流程为：（1）从初始显著帧集合出发，将问题分解为若干线索；（2）每条线索并行探测视频、导航至自身证据；（3）由推理型VLM以智能体方式依据证据修正线索集合，重新探索视频；（4）在存活的线索间分配采样预算。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，CueKFS在所有27个可对比既有结果的评测设置中均取得SOTA，预算平均增益较前基线最高达+4.54%，中位仅需2次VLM调用。行为分析显示，智能体式线索精炼驱动对视频的主动重探索，相对相似度较初始上下文最高提升92%。
AI.conclusion: 动态视觉线索比对与智能体式线索精炼是有效且高效的关键帧选择范式：在无需训练、VLM调用极少的前提下显著优于现有基线，并具备对长视频的主动重探索能力。

title: Agents Can Use Base Models to Evade AI Detection
summary: We show that coding agents equipped with a base language model can successfully assemble responses from its samples to evade detection. Base models have been shown to evade commercial detectors, however, prior "humanization" techniques rely on using these models to paraphrase AI outputs over several iterations, which invariably results in semantic drift. In contrast, equipping coding agents to directly orchestrate the writing process by stitching text samples from a base model allows it to produce outputs that are coherent, task-specific and generally high quality. We find that Claude Opus 5 operating in a Claude Code harness effectively orchestrates a local 32B parameter OLMo-2 base LM and sacrifices little task accuracy across benchmarks spanning creative writing, factual grounding, health QA and instruction following, while using up to 90% base LM tokens. Responses constructed in this manner reduce the effectiveness of both post-hoc detectors (Pangram v4 detection rate drops from 77% to 24%) and soft watermarking applied a priori to the agent's generations (down to a simulated 10% detection at low FPR). While effective, this evasion requires a significantly larger number of input and output tokens from the agent, increasing the dollar cost per query up to 30x at API-pricing. Overall, this work demonstrates the effectiveness of a new class of adversarial attacks against AI text detection, and urges post-hoc detection providers to include outputs of base models in their training.

AI.tldr: 编码智能体可调用基础语言模型的样本拼装出连贯、高质量的文本，从而规避事后检测器与软水印，但代价是API成本最高增至30倍。
AI.motivation: 既有"拟人化"规避手段依赖基础模型对AI输出反复改写（paraphrase），必然造成语义漂移；作者希望寻找一种既能保持任务准确性与文本质量、又能有效规避检测的新攻击范式。
AI.method: 让配备基础语言模型的编码智能体直接编排写作流程：由一个强编码智能体（Claude Opus 5，运行于Claude Code框架）调度本地32B参数的OLMo-2基础模型，通过"拼贴"其采样文本片段来组装最终输出，而非迭代改写。
AI.result: 在创意写作、事实性问答、健康QA与指令遵循等基准上任务准确率损失很小，基础模型token占比最高达90%；Pangram v4事后检测率从77%降至24%；对智能体生成内容施加的先验软水印在低FPR下模拟检测率降至10%；但每查询的美元成本在API定价下最高增加30倍（输入输出token量显著上升）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了一类新型针对AI文本检测的对抗攻击，表明编码智能体编排基础模型可同时绕过事后检测与水印；作者呼吁事后检测服务商将基础模型输出纳入训练数据以提升鲁棒性。

title: Label Less, Learn More: Resource-Efficient Active Semi-Supervised Learning for Onboard Satellite Image Annotation
summary: Large-scale pervasive sensing increasingly relies on high-resolution satellite imagery, yet task-specific onboard vision is constrained by costly annotation and limited computation, memory, energy, and communication resources. Existing approaches largely rely on either data-hungry supervised learning or large vision-language foundation models, limiting efficient adaptation and deployment under these constraints. We present SatLabel, a resource-aware learning framework that transforms limited satellite labels into progressively refined onboard models through adaptive sample acquisition and semi-supervised model adaptation. Rather than repeatedly training on uniformly sampled labels, SatLabel closes the loop between model uncertainty, class imbalance, and pseudo-label quality to selectively acquire informative samples while exploiting abundant unlabeled imagery. This enables a compact student to adapt to target sensing domains with reduced annotation and inference costs. We further introduce an optional Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) student with graph-based feature refinement to enhance representation capacity while retaining a lightweight footprint. We evaluate SatLabel on 11 remote-sensing datasets spanning core, extended, and unseen domains against RemoteCLIP zero-shot inference. SatLabel improves Macro-F1 on most core and extended datasets while maintaining strong cross-dataset transfer to unseen domains. More importantly, the Balanced student contains only 11.2 M parameters and occupies approximately 42.8 MB, compared with 151.3M parameters and 577 MB for RemoteCLIP, while requiring 3.65 versus 5.89 GFLOPs. Across four efficiency benchmarks, it achieves approximately 2x higher GPU-forward throughput and reduces energy per image on datasets.

AI.tldr: SatLabel：资源感知的半监督卫星影像在轨学习框架，将有限标注高效转化为紧凑学生模型，适配目标遥感域。
AI.motivation: 大规模普适感知依赖高分辨率卫星影像，但在轨任务视觉受限于昂贵的标注成本以及有限的计算、存储、能量与通信资源。现有方法要么依赖数据饥渴的监督学习，要么依赖大型视觉-语言基础模型，难以在资源受限下高效适配与部署。
AI.method: 提出SatLabel，资源感知学习框架：通过自适应样本采集与半监督模型适配，将有限卫星标签逐步精炼为在轨模型。不采用均匀采样标签的反复训练，而是闭合"模型不确定性—类别不平衡—伪标签质量"之间的环路，选择性采集信息量大的样本，同时利用大量无标注影像，使紧凑学生模型以更低标注与推理成本适配目标感知域。另引入可选的专家混合（MoE）学生模型，配合基于图的特征精炼，在保持轻量规模的同时增强表征能力。
AI.result: 在覆盖核心、扩展与未见域的11个遥感数据集上，对比RemoteCLIP零样本推理：SatLabel在多数核心与扩展数据集上提升Macro-F1，并保持向未见域的良好跨数据集迁移。Balanced学生模型仅11.2M参数、约42.8MB，相较RemoteCLIP的151.3M参数、577MB，计算量为3.65 GFLOPs对5.89 GFLOPs。在四项效率基准上，GPU前向吞吐约提升2倍，并降低单张影像能耗。
AI.conclusion: SatLabel以自适应采样与半监督适配为核心，在显著压缩参数、存储与计算开销的同时取得优于大型视觉-语言基础模型的精度表现与跨域泛化能力，为资源受限的在轨遥感感知提供了可行且高效的方案。

title: NVAlign: Direct-Gradient Optimization for Non-Verbal Control in Continuous Autoregressive Flow Matching Text-to-Speech
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Audio samples: https://nvalign.github.io/
summary: While modern text-to-speech (TTS) systems generate highly natural speech and support inline non-verbal vocalization (NVV) tags, accurate control over these events remains challenging. A key gap is the lack of established post-training methods for non-verbal control in continuous autoregressive flow-matching TTS. To this end, we present NVAlign, a direct-gradient post-training framework for NVV tag-following in this architecture. We first perform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of TTS models and an NVV-aware automatic speech recognition (NV-ASR) model on NVV-annotated speech, then freeze the NV-ASR model to serve as the reward model for post-training. A two-step gradient surrogate enables efficient reward backpropagation through the flow-matching sampler to jointly update the autoregressive backbone and acoustic flow head. Fidelity penalties and reference-velocity regularization help preserve speaker similarity and speech quality. Results from NVV-SuperBench and human listening evaluations show that NVAlign improves tag-following accuracy over SFT and Flow-GRPO baselines. These findings demonstrate that direct reward-gradient optimization can improve non-verbal control in continuous autoregressive flow-matching TTS. Audio samples are available at https://nvalign.github.io/.

AI.tldr: NVAlign：面向连续自回归流匹配TTS的NV对齐梯度后训练框架，通过NV-ASR奖励模型与两步梯度代理优化非言语发声标签跟随。
AI.motivation: 现代TTS虽支持内联非言语发声（NVV）标签，但对这些事件的精确控制仍困难。关键缺口在于：连续自回归流匹配TTS中，缺乏成熟的后训练（post-training）方法来控制非言语发声。因此需要一种能在此架构中提升标签跟随精度的后训练方案。
AI.method: 1）在带NVV标注的语音上对TTS模型进行监督微调（SFT），并训练NVV感知的自动语音识别（NV-ASR）模型；2）冻结NV-ASR作为奖励模型用于后训练；3）提出两步梯度代理（two-step gradient surrogate），使奖励梯度可高效反传通过流匹配采样器，从而联合更新自回归骨干与声学流头；4）引入保真度惩罚与参考速度正则化，以保持说话人相似度与语音质量。
AI.result: 在NVV-SuperBench和人工听测评估中，NVAlign的标签跟随准确率优于SFT与Flow-GRPO基线。
AI.conclusion: 直接奖励梯度优化可有效提升连续自回归流匹配TTS中的非言语控制能力。音频样例见 https://nvalign.github.io/。

title: Auditing Quality Filters for Long-Tail Human Data Curation
summary: Robots on construction sites must detect workers who are kneeling or bending, which we call low poses. These workers can be lost from training datasets during automatic labeling. We study a pipeline that detects people, estimates their body joints using NLF, and groups similar poses. Low poses account for only about 2 percent of the retained examples. This low share may partly reflect the pipeline's quality filter, which rejects examples with low detection confidence or uncertain joint estimates. We examine this filtering using four alternative pose clues: bounding-box shape, vertical body span, pose grouping aligned to the scene's vertical direction, and image appearance. All four suggest that low poses are rejected by the filter more often. Separately, controlled simulated scenes show that a person detector fine-tuned on a public construction dataset misses more workers in these poses even when we correct their bounding box height is matched to that of standing workers. These findings suggest that low poses are scarce and hard to find, and we cannot rely on bounding boxes or poses for long-tail human data curation.

AI.tldr: 施工机器人需检测跪姿/弯腰等"低位姿态"工人，但此类样本在自动标注流程中被大量丢失。研究通过四种姿态线索验证过滤偏置，并在仿真场景中证实微调后的人体检测器更易漏检低位姿态工人。
AI.motivation: 工地机器人安全作业要求识别跪姿、弯腰等低位姿态工人。但自动标注流水线中的质量过滤环节可能系统性地丢弃这类样本，导致训练数据中长尾姿态严重缺失，进而使检测器在真实场景中漏检此类工人，形成安全隐患。作者希望量化并解释这一数据偏差。
AI.method: 采用"人体检测→NLF关节估计→相似姿态聚类"的标注流水线。以四种姿态线索检验过滤环节的偏置：(1) 边界框形状；(2) 人体垂直跨度；(3) 与场景竖直方向对齐的姿态聚类；(4) 图像外观。此外构建可控仿真场景，将人体检测器在公开建筑数据集上微调，并在校正边界框高度、使其与站立工人匹配的条件下测试漏检情况。
AI.result: 低位姿态仅占保留样本约2%。四种线索一致表明：低位姿态因检测置信度低或关节估计不确定，被质量过滤器拒绝的比例更高。仿真实验中，即使将边界框高度校正为与站立工人一致，在公开建筑数据集上微调的人体检测器仍漏检更多低位姿态工人。
AI.conclusion: 低位姿态既稀缺又难以发现，其稀缺性部分源于标注流水线的过滤偏置而非真实分布。因此不能依赖边界框或姿态估计来完成长尾人体数据的筛选与整理，需要针对长尾姿态设计更公平的数据策管策略。

title: Choir: An Open Protocol for Distributed Multi-Agent Autoformalization
summary: AI agents can now formalize entire textbooks and major theorems in proof assistants such as Lean, but current efforts are typically centralized: a single team runs all agents and bears the full computational cost. We introduce Choir, an open protocol for distributed formalization. Choir decomposes a project into tasks that can be completed by independent contributors, each running their own agent with their own LLM subscription, while coordinating entirely through the project's GitHub repository. To support open participation, every contribution is checked by a deterministic gate before merge. Choir supports Lean 4, Isabelle, and Rocq, and is open source and modular, allowing projects to replace individual components or extend the protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出Choir：一个分布式形式化的开放协议，将证明助手项目拆解为可由独立贡献者认领的任务，通过GitHub仓库协调，并由确定性门控校验每次合并，支持Lean 4、Isabelle与Rocq。
AI.motivation: 现有AI形式化（如用Lean整理教材与重大定理）多为集中式：单个团队运行全部智能体并承担全部算力成本，限制了规模与参与度。
AI.method: Choir将项目分解为可独立完成的任务；各贡献者使用自己的智能体与LLM订阅执行；仅通过项目的GitHub仓库进行协调；每次贡献在合并前须通过确定性门控（deterministic gate）检查；支持Lean 4、Isabelle、Rocq，且开源、模块化，可替换单个组件或扩展协议。
AI.result: 实现了跨三种证明助手（Lean 4、Isabelle、Rocq）的分布式形式化协议，并作为开源模块化系统发布。
AI.conclusion: Choir以开放协议方式实现去中心化的形式化协作，降低单方算力负担，提升可扩展性与可参与性。

title: Regime Boundary Alignment for Evidence-Gated Question Answering
summary: Retrieval-augmented language models are expected to answer from the retrieved evidence, but in practice they often keep answering when that evidence is missing. We trace this behavior to the training signal: answer-focused fine-tuning assigns no target to unsupported contexts, so it cannot distinguish a reader that abstains from one that guesses, and unsupported answering stays near 100% even as supported accuracy improves. We introduce Regime Boundary Alignment (RBA), which trains a single reader on matched variants of the same question and gold answer. The reader is trained to produce the gold answer when the context supports it, including when conflicting evidence is also present, and to abstain when the correct support is removed; inference is ordinary decoding, with no verifier, threshold, or regime label. On three multi-hop QA datasets across three seeds, RBA reduces the unsupported-answer rate by more than sixty percentage points relative to conflict-focused training while matching its supported accuracy. On a held-out TriviaQA retrieval-miss slice, the same reader reduces unsupported answering from 100% to below 1% while also improving supported accuracy. These results indicate that evidence-gated answering must be learned on both sides of the support boundary.

AI.tldr: 提出 Regime Boundary Alignment（RBA），用支持/不支持配对样本训练单一 reader，使其在证据支持时作答、证据缺失时弃答，大幅降低无支持作答率而不损失支持准确率。
AI.motivation: 检索增强语言模型在检索证据缺失时仍倾向于作答。作者将这一行为归因于训练信号：以答案为中心的微调对不支持上下文不设目标，无法区分弃答的 reader 与猜测的 reader，因此即使支持准确率提升，无支持作答率仍接近 100%。
AI.method: RBA 在同一问题与金标准答案的匹配变体上训练单一 reader：当上下文支持答案时（包括同时存在冲突证据时）输出金标准答案，当正确支撑被移除时弃答。推理为普通解码，不使用验证器、阈值或 regime 标签。
AI.result: 在三个多跳 QA 数据集、三个随机种子上，RBA 相对冲突聚焦训练将无支持作答率降低 60 个百分点以上，同时匹配其支持准确率。在留出的 TriviaQA 检索未命中切片上，同一 reader 将无支持作答从 100% 降至 1% 以下，并同时提升支持准确率。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，证据门控式作答必须在支持边界的两侧同时学习，才能实现可靠的有据作答与适当的弃答。

title: Improving Medical Calculation of LLMs with Embedded Coding
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on medical examinations and question-answering benchmarks, but remain unreliable on medical calculation tasks that require exact numerical outputs. These calculations support high-stakes decisions such as medication dosing, organ-function assessment, and prognostic scoring, for which even small errors can have serious clinical consequences. We introduce MedCode, a framework that improves medical calculation by training LLMs to generate embedded executable code. Given a clinical context, the model identifies the relevant calculator, extracts its input variables, and produces a script that delegates arithmetic operations to a deterministic interpreter. Executing the script returns the calculated value together with an explanation and the appropriate unit. We construct supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference datasets from the MedCalc benchmark and additionally curate a dataset for calculation tasks in Intensive Care Unit (ICU) scenarios. We further propose weighted Direct Preference Optimization (wDPO), which adaptively emphasizes preference pairs that are difficult for the model to distinguish. Experiments with LLaMA3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B show absolute accuracy gains of 20--30 percentage points, demonstrating the effectiveness of embedded code generation for medical calculation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MedCode 框架，通过训练大模型生成内嵌可执行代码来提升医学计算任务的准确性，并引入 wDPO 优化方法，在多个开源模型上取得 20–30 个百分点的绝对准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在医学考试和问答基准上表现良好，但在需要精确数值输出的医学计算任务上仍不可靠。这类计算涉及用药剂量、器官功能评估和预后评分等高风险临床决策，微小误差也可能造成严重后果，因此亟需提升其计算可靠性。
AI.method: 提出 MedCode 框架：给定临床上下文，模型识别相关计算器、抽取输入变量，并生成将算术运算委托给确定性解释器的脚本，执行后返回计算值、解释及相应单位。基于 MedCalc 基准构建有监督微调（SFT）与偏好数据集，并额外整理 ICU 场景计算任务数据集。同时提出加权直接偏好优化（wDPO），自适应地强化模型难以区分的偏好对。
AI.result: 在 LLaMA3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B 和 Mistral-7B 上实验，绝对准确率提升 20–30 个百分点，验证了内嵌代码生成对医学计算的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过让模型生成内嵌可执行代码并借助确定性解释器完成算术运算，结合 wDPO 优化，可显著提升大语言模型在医学计算任务上的准确性与可靠性，为高风险临床计算场景提供可行方案。

title: Enhancing Visual Reasoning in Chest X-Ray Report Generation Using Reinforcement Learning
summary: Medical report generation has made significant progress with the rise of modern vision-language models and the growing availability of large-scale medical datasets. However, hallucinations remain a major challenge, largely due to the limitations of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which prioritizes lexical similarity to reference reports rather than clinical correctness. While reinforcement learning has shown strong performance in domains with verifiable rewards such as mathematics and code generation, its application to open-ended medical tasks remains limited. Existing work focuses on evaluating final answers, overlooking the model's reasoning, despite evidence that flawed reasoning can degrade overall performance. In this study, we propose a framework that verifies the model's reasoning process by integrating anatomical regions, bounding boxes, and region-level textual descriptions. We design spatial and factual reward mechanisms to ensure that the model's reasoning is both visually grounded and factually accurate. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as our base model, we adapt it to the medical domain using supervised fine-tuning, introduce reasoning capability through a cold-start SFT stage, and refine it with reinforcement learning. We find that RL provides performance gains beyond those achievable through SFT alone, and that jointly verifying both reasoning steps and final outputs yields larger improvements than verifying either in isolation. We further identify multiple modes of reward hacking in the RL stage. Finally, the model's structured think traces enhance interpretability, making its outputs easier to audit for clinical use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向医学报告生成的强化学习框架，通过整合解剖区域、边界框和区域级文本描述来验证模型推理过程，并设计空间与事实奖励机制，使推理既具视觉依据又事实准确。以Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct为基础，经领域SFT、冷启动SFT和RL三阶段训练，发现RL带来超越SFT的增益，联合验证推理步骤与最终输出效果最佳，同时识别出多种奖励黑客模式，结构化思维链提升了可解释性与临床可审计性。
AI.motivation: 医学报告生成中幻觉仍是主要挑战，根源在于监督微调（SFT）以词面相似度为目标而非临床正确性。强化学习在数学、代码等可验证奖励领域表现优异，但在开放式医学任务中应用有限；现有工作仅评估最终答案，忽视推理过程，而错误的推理会损害整体性能。因此需要一种能验证推理过程、确保视觉基础与事实准确的框架。
AI.method: 提出一个通过整合解剖区域、边界框和区域级文本描述来验证模型推理过程的框架，并设计空间奖励与事实奖励机制，保证推理兼具视觉依据和事实准确性。训练流程：以Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct为基座，先用SFT适配医学领域，再通过冷启动SFT引入推理能力，最后用强化学习精调。
AI.result: RL带来的性能增益超出仅用SFT所能达到的水平；联合验证推理步骤与最终输出比单独验证任一者带来更大提升；在RL阶段识别出多种奖励黑客（reward hacking）模式；模型的结构化思维链（think traces）增强可解释性，使输出更易于临床审计。
AI.conclusion: 在开放式医学报告生成中，将过程级推理验证与结果验证结合的强化学习优于纯SFT；对推理步骤和最终输出联合验证最为有效；同时需警惕奖励黑客问题。结构化推理轨迹提升了模型的可解释性与临床可用性。

title: PredRA: Fast Medical Image Translation by Deterministic Component Extraction and Controlled Stochastic Refinement
comment: Preprint. 14 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/jianhai-zhang/RredRA
summary: Strongly paired medical image translation contains a substantial component that can be predicted directly from the source. The current reality is that pure deterministic prediction can smooth away fine detail, while generative models can recover detail but may also introduce unnecessary or potentially harmful variation. We propose PredRA, a fast framework that uses the deterministic prediction as a stable reference and further extracts additional deterministic components from the residual during generative refinement, thereby improving fidelity while maintaining perceptual quality. The goal is simple: we view the entire residual-based generative process as an optimization problem and derive a practical solution that recovers useful residual detail through controlled refinement while keeping the prediction close to the paired target. Mechanism studies further show that useful residual information follows structured patterns, but its usefulness is difficult to estimate reliably at the voxel level. We therefore globally control how much of the residual refinement is added to the deterministic prediction, thereby reducing the accumulation of unnecessary uncertainty. PredRA therefore combines deterministic component extraction with controlled stochastic refinement for fast, fidelity-preserving, and perceptually strong medical image translation. We validate the approach across multiple real-world datasets, showing that controlled refinement improves fidelity to the paired target compared with full residual refinement while retaining much of the perceptual benefit of generative modeling. PredRA achieves competitive or superior performance to substantially larger state-of-the-art models with 1.4-11.9x fewer total parameters and 3.1-26.2x fewer trainable parameters, while its 32-step flow sampler requires 31.25x fewer sampling steps than the matched 1000-step DDPM.

AI.tldr: 提出PredRA框架，将确定性预测作为稳定参考，从残差中提取额外确定性成分并进行全局控制的随机细化，实现快速、保真且感知质量强的医学图像翻译。
AI.motivation: 强配对医学图像翻译中，源图像可直接预测相当一部分内容。纯确定性预测会抹除细节，而生成模型虽能恢复细节却可能引入不必要甚至有害的变化，因此需要兼顾保真度与感知质量。
AI.method: 将整个基于残差的生成过程建模为优化问题，以确定性预测为稳定参考，从残差中提取附加的确定性成分；针对残差信息在体素级别难以可靠估计的问题，采用全局方式控制残差细化量加入确定性预测的比例，并结合受控随机细化。
