AI.result: 在多个真实数据集上验证，受控细化相比完全残差细化提升了对配对目标的保真度，同时保留大部分感知收益；参数量比大型SOTA模型少1.4-11.9倍（总参数）、3.1-26.2倍（可训练参数），32步流采样器比匹配的1000步DDPM少31.25倍采样步数。
AI.conclusion: PredRA将确定性成分提取与受控随机细化结合，实现快速、保真且感知强的医学图像翻译，性能相当或更优且模型与采样更高效。

title: Facial classification Using Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning
summary: Hybrid quantum methods have received limited study for resource-constrained facial biometrics. We present a hybrid quantum-classical facial recognition pipeline designed to run on standard computing hardware. Images undergo gamma correction, contrast enhancement, and principal component analysis before their features are encoded into an eight-qubit variational quantum classifier. Classical image matching then performs recognition. In experiments with 50,000 images, comprising 25,000 faces from CelebA and 25,000 non-face images from CIFAR-10, the method outperformed the reported CPU-trained FaceNet baseline in accuracy and training efficiency. The pipeline was also evaluated on GPU and quantum hardware. In an attendance monitoring deployment at Mahindra University in collaboration with Lloyds Technology Centre, CPU inference took 0.2 to 0.5 seconds per person, and the system remained robust to the use of spectacles. These findings support the feasibility of deploying hybrid quantum methods for facial recognition on existing CPU hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可在标准计算硬件上运行的人脸识别混合量子-经典流水线，结合图像预处理、PCA降维与八量子比特变分量子分类器，在5万张图像实验中优于CPU训练的FaceNet基线，并完成GPU与量子硬件及校园考勤场景验证。
AI.motivation: 面向资源受限场景的人脸生物识别中，混合量子方法的研究尚不充分，亟需验证其在现有硬件上的可行性与实用性。
AI.method: 流水线首先对图像进行伽马校正、对比度增强与主成分分析（PCA）特征提取，随后将特征编码进八量子比特变分量子分类器，最后由经典图像匹配完成识别。
AI.result: 在包含CelebA的25,000张人脸与CIFAR-10的25,000张非人脸共50,000张图像的实验中，方法在准确率与训练效率上均优于所报道的CPU训练FaceNet基线；同时在GPU与量子硬件上完成评估。在Mahindra University与Lloyds Technology Centre合作的考勤部署中，CPU推理每人耗时0.2–0.5秒，且对佩戴眼镜情形保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，在现有CPU硬件上部署混合量子人脸识别方法具有可行性。

title: Recipe-Matching, Not Equivalence
summary: MathNet-Retrieve asks a retriever to find, for a math problem, a document stating the same problem. An LLM under one fixed prompt writes each gold document and its near-miss distractors; LLM judges filter them. We call this procedure the "recipe", training on pairs built the same way "recipe-matching", and ask how much score it buys beyond the ability the benchmark claims to test. Two models from one base, matched in rows and settings, differ only in the training file: pairs written under the benchmark's published prompt by another vendor's LLM and judge, or computer-algebra-verified pairs with no LLM anywhere. The first leads by 45 R@1 points on the easy tier. By a non-LLM paraphrase control, half to two thirds of that gap comes from the pairs being LLM-written at all: LLM rewrites under two unrelated prompts, with the verified model's negatives, recover 30 and 22 of the 45 points; back-translations with the same negatives recover almost none. The remaining 15 to 25 points appear only under the benchmark's own prompt and vanish on real duplicates no generator wrote, the same problem in two languages. The hard tier rewards the recipe's pair structure, a deep rewrite against a minimal-edit near-miss: LLM rewrites alone score zero on it, attaching negatives unlocks it, and every negative that does so costs cross-language points; the sets scoring highest on it separate near-misses no LLM wrote worse than LLM rewrites with verified negatives. MELD also moves when a model trains on pairs built its way, without losing retention; on SABER-Math the registered attack fails, and the one gain, from its LLM-written summaries, is small but holds at a matched budget. Only on MathNet-Retrieve could we pin an inversion, benchmark score up and real retention down, to one edit of a training file. We release the generator-free duplicate evaluations, the near-miss test and three trained models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制实验揭示：在MathNet-Retrieve基准上，训练文件中的配对由LLM撰写这一事实本身（而非模型真正习得的问题匹配能力）贡献了大部分基准分数提升；性能增益可被拆解为"LLM撰写效应""基准特定提示词效应"与"配方配对结构效应"三部分，并首次将一个"基准分数上升而真实保留能力下降"的倒挂现象精确定位到训练文件的单次编辑。
AI.motivation: 检索类基准（如MathNet-Retrieve）要求模型为数学问题找到陈述同一问题的文档，但基准本身可能存在"配方"（recipe）污染：金标文档与近似干扰项均由某个LLM在固定提示词下生成、再由LLM评判过滤。作者希望量化：按同样方式构造配对进行训练（recipe-matching），能带来多少超出该基准本应测试的能力之外的分数？即检验基准分数究竟反映了真实检索能力，还是被训练文件构造方式所"购买"。
AI.method: 采用严格对照实验：同一基座训练两个模型，行数与设置完全匹配，仅训练文件不同——一组为按基准发布提示词由另一家厂商LLM与评判器撰写的配对，另一组为经计算机代数系统验证、完全不含LLM的配对。引入非LLM改写对照（LLM改写、回译）与真实重复项测试（无生成器撰写、跨语言同题）以拆分增益来源；并对hard tier的配对结构（深度改写对最小编辑近似干扰项）做因子分析，验证干扰项与跨语言分数的权衡。同时在MELD、SABER-Math上进行迁移与攻击验证，并做匹配预算对比。
AI.result: LLM撰写配对在easy tier领先45个R@1点。非LLM改写对照显示：其中二分之一至三分之二的差距源于配对本身由LLM撰写——在两个不相关提示词下做LLM改写并配以验证模型的负样本，可分别回收45点中的30点和22点；同一负样本的回译几乎无法回收。剩余15至25点仅在基准自身提示词下出现，并在无生成器撰写的真实重复项（跨语言同题）上消失。hard tier奖励"深度改写 vs 最小编辑近似干扰项"的配对结构：仅LLM改写得零分，加入负样本后解锁，但每个起作用的负样本都以跨语言分数为代价；得分最高的集合在无LLM撰写的近似干扰项上分离效果优于LLM改写配验证负样本。MELD在按其方式训练时也发生移动且不损失保留；SABER-Math上注册攻击失败，唯一增益（来自其LLM撰写摘要）虽小但在匹配预算下成立。仅在MathNet-Retrieve上可把"基准分数上升、真实保留下降"的倒挂精确归因于训练文件的单次编辑。
AI.conclusion: MathNet-Retrieve的分数在很大程度上由训练配对的构造方式（LLM撰写、基准特定提示词、配方配对结构）所"购买"，而非纯粹的检索能力；作者将其拆解为LLM撰写效应、提示词特定效应与配对结构效应，并首次将基准分数与真实保留能力的倒挂精确定位到一次训练文件编辑。作者发布无生成器的重复项评测、近似干扰项测试及三个已训练模型，以推动对检索基准有效性的检验。

title: Resource-Aware Federated Mixture-of-Experts with Adaptive Pruning for Onboard Learning in LEO Satellite Constellations
summary: Low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellites are increasingly expected to perform onboard learning for applications such as disaster response and environmental monitoring. However, conventional federated learning (FL) is ill-suited to onboard satellite learning, as it assumes computational, memory, and communication resources beyond the capabilities of resource-constrained LEO platforms, often necessitating the transmission of raw imagery to ground stations. We present COSMIC-FL, a resource-aware FL framework for efficient onboard learning in LEO satellite constellations. COSMIC-FL introduces two complementary Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures: a Sliced design that shares backbone representations while activating task-specific channel subsets, and a Modular design that employs lightweight gating to route inputs to physically separated expert networks. A semantic class-to-expert mapping enables each satellite to train, update, and communicate only the expert paths relevant to its local data. To further improve efficiency, COSMIC-FL integrates staged optimization with three structured pruning strategies: server-side pruning, client-side fixed-ratio pruning with mean-vote aggregation, and adaptive client-side per-layer pruning based on aggregated importance and a MAD-based gap criterion. Combined with semantic expert routing, these techniques jointly adapt computation and model sparsity to both data semantics and layer importance, yielding a favourable accuracy--efficiency trade-off for heterogeneous space platforms. Experiments on six image classification benchmarks under highly non-i.i.d. settings show that COSMIC-FL maintains competitive accuracy while reducing communication, computation, and energy consumption by up to 80% over SOTA FL methods. We further validate COSMIC-FL on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, confirming its efficiency gains under realistic embedded deployment constraints.

AI.tldr: COSMIC-FL：面向LEO卫星星座的资源感知联邦学习框架，通过MoE架构与结构化剪枝实现高效星上学习。
AI.motivation: 传统联邦学习假设计算、存储与通信资源充足，不适配资源受限的LEO卫星平台，往往需将原始影像传回地面站，难以支撑灾害响应、环境监测等星上学习应用。
AI.method: 提出COSMIC-FL框架：(1)两种互补MoE架构——Sliced设计共享骨干表示并激活任务特定通道子集，Modular设计用轻量门控将输入路由至物理分离的专家网络；(2)语义类别到专家的映射，使卫星仅训练、更新、通信与本地数据相关的专家路径；(3)分阶段优化结合三种结构化剪枝策略：服务端剪枝、客户端固定比例剪枝配合均值投票聚合、基于聚合重要性与MAD间隙准则的自适应客户端逐层剪枝；(4)语义专家路由与剪枝协同，使计算与模型稀疏度自适应匹配数据语义与层重要性。
AI.result: 在六个图像分类基准、高度非独立同分布设置下，COSMIC-FL保持有竞争力的精度，同时相较SOTA联邦学习方法将通信、计算与能耗最高降低80%；并在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上验证了真实嵌入式部署约束下的效率增益。
AI.conclusion: COSMIC-FL为异构空间平台提供了良好的精度-效率权衡，证明了MoE语义路由与结构化剪枝结合在资源受限LEO星上联邦学习中的有效性与部署可行性。

title: ANaLOG: Anisotropic Native-Latent Operator Guidance for Solving Inverse Problems
summary: Native-latent guidance is a recent paradigm for solving inverse problems with latent diffusion models. It replaces repeated evaluations of the image-space forward model, each requiring a decoder pass, with efficient guidance computed using a learned latent-space surrogate. However, existing methods apply guidance uniformly across latent dimensions, ignoring that measurements are informative only along certain directions and that the reliability of model predictions varies across inputs and timesteps. We propose ANaLOG, a framework for efficient uncertainty-aware guidance with pretrained latent diffusion models. ANaLOG models uncertainty by learning an anisotropic, input- and time-dependent covariance that is integrated into the guidance mechanism to emphasize reliable directions and downweight uncertain ones. We theoretically analyze this framework in a linear model setting and prove that anisotropic, uncertainty-aware weighting is necessary for correct sampling, whereas isotropic guidance induces sampling errors. Experiments across five challenging inverse problems show that ANaLOG improves perceptual reconstruction quality over existing methods while preserving efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ANaLOG，一种面向预训练潜扩散模型的高效、不确定性感知引导框架，通过学习各向异性、依赖输入与时间步的协方差来调节引导强度，从而在五类逆问题上提升感知重建质量，同时保持效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于潜空间代理模型的“native-latent guidance”范式虽避免了重复的像素空间前向评估与解码器开销，但沿所有潜维度均匀施加引导，忽略了两个问题：测量信息仅沿特定方向有效；模型预测的可靠性随输入与时间步变化。均匀引导会引入采样偏差。
AI.method: ANaLOG 在预训练潜扩散模型上学习一个各向异性、输入依赖且时间步依赖的协方差，用以刻画不确定性，并将其整合进引导机制：对可靠方向加权、对不确定方向降权。作者还在线性模型设定下给出理论分析。
AI.result: 理论证明：各向异性、不确定性感知的加权是正确采样的必要条件，而各向同性引导会导致采样误差。在五个具有挑战性的逆问题实验中，ANaLOG 在保持效率的同时，感知重建质量优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知的各向异性引导优于统一引导，能同时兼顾潜扩散模型求解逆问题的正确性、效率与重建感知质量。

title: Transformer MLP Gate Thresholds Are Couplings to a Carried Reference Direction
comment: 18 pages, 4 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/EvidentSolutions/llm-interp/tree/main/background. An earlier version of this paper is archived on Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21498411; this version supersedes it and corrects several reported values
summary: The corpus-mean direction of a transformer's residual stream is a component shared across all inputs, and is commonly removed by mean-centering before representational analysis. We present evidence that it is a functional component: the reference against which the MLP gate population sets its operating point. In Phi-2, an exact decomposition of resting gate pre-activations shows that at mid-stack layers the resting inhibition of >99.9% of gates is carried by the coupling $w \cdot b_L$ to the carried mean direction, at 48-56$\times$ the explicit bias parameter, and the coupling is direction-specific: a random direction at matched norm orders the population's firing rates at Spearman $ρ\leq 0.09$ where the reference reaches 0.95. (That 0.95 is near-tautological on its own; the paper derives its null.) Causally, removing the stream's projection on the reference multiplies above-threshold firing by about 9$\times$, dose-monotonically, at 23-59$\times$ a norm-matched control; a random-initialised twin is flat, and replacement tests show that the direction carries the function and the magnitude does not. A direction-matched control makes the same point: noise injected along the reference costs 8-42$\times$ the same energy along a random direction. The decomposition replicates on four further families spanning both gate types (GELU with an explicit gate bias, bias-free SwiGLU), and the dose-response on two of them. Across an eight-model scan the mechanism is present in every GELU and SiLU family and absent only in OPT, where an opposing LayerNorm bias cancels the carried reference. Gate thresholds are implemented as couplings to a constant the network builds for the distribution it is reading, with the bias parameters contributing little; how much of that constant is carried in the stream and how much in parameters depends on the architecture.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并验证：Transformer残差流的"语料均值方向"并非可忽略的分析伪影，而是MLP门控群体的功能性参考基准（operating point reference）。
AI.motivation: 语料均值方向（corpus-mean direction）是所有输入共享的残差流分量，通常在做表征分析前被去均值处理而视为噪声/伪影。该工作质疑这一惯例，旨在探究该共享方向是否承担功能性角色。
AI.method: 在Phi-2上对静息态门控预激活做精确分解，量化耦合项 w·b_L 与显式偏置参数的贡献；用随机方向、同范数对照、随机初始化孪生网络进行对照实验；通过移除残差流在参考方向上的投影做因果干预并检验剂量单调性；沿参考方向注入噪声做方向匹配对照；在四个以上模型家族（GELU带显式门偏置、无偏置SwiGLU）及八模型扫描中复现。
AI.result: 中层堆叠中>99.9%门控的静息抑制由 w·b_L 耦合承担，达显式偏置的48-56倍；耦合具方向特异性（随机方向Spearman ρ≤0.09，参考方向达0.95）。移除投影使超阈值放电约增9倍且剂量单调，为同范数对照的23-59倍；随机初始化孪生网络无此效应；替换实验表明方向承载功能而幅度不承载。方向匹配噪声注入代价为随机方向的8-42倍。八个模型扫描中该机制在所有GELU与SiLU家族中均存在，仅OPT因对向LayerNorm偏置抵消而缺失。
AI.conclusion: 门控阈值实现为网络为所读分布构建的常数上的耦合，偏置参数贡献甚微；该常数有多少存于残差流、多少存于参数中取决于架构。均值中心化前的共享方向应被视为功能性组件而非可丢弃的伪影。

title: CaptchaArena: A Large-Scale, Fine-Grained Dataset for Training Computer-Use Agents on Interactive CAPTCHAs
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/X0X0X00/CaptchaArena
summary: Interactive CAPTCHAs remain challenging for computer-use agents, while existing datasets face trade-offs among type coverage, interaction fidelity, and trajectory supervision. To address these gaps, we present CaptchaArena, the first large-scale, fine-grained training dataset for interactive CAPTCHA solving. It contains 50K puzzles across 20 CAPTCHA types and 5 interaction modes, with every solution verified through execution. CaptchaArena provides 50K screenshot-action trajectories, including 46K with step-by-step reasoning annotations. It also includes fine-grained pixel-mask annotations for irregular targets. Using CaptchaArena, we train CaptchaAgent, a single 9B policy for all 20 CAPTCHA types, with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. The environment verifier directly provides the RL reward. Supervised fine-tuning reaches 70.5 Pass@1, and reinforcement learning further improves it to 71.7, while also improving performance on two external benchmarks. These results demonstrate the value of large-scale, fine-grained computer-use supervision for training interactive CAPTCHA agents. We release CaptchaArena and CaptchaAgent at https://github.com/X0X0X00/CaptchaArena.

AI.tldr: 提出首个大规模细粒度交互式CAPTCHA求解训练数据集CaptchaArena（5万题、20类、5种交互模式），并基于此训练统一9B策略CaptchaAgent，SFT达70.5 Pass@1，RL提升至71.7。
AI.motivation: 交互式CAPTCHA对计算机使用智能体仍具挑战，现有数据集在类型覆盖、交互保真度与轨迹监督之间存在权衡，缺少大规模、细粒度且经执行验证的训练数据。
AI.method: 构建CaptchaArena数据集：覆盖20种CAPTCHA类型、5种交互模式共5万道题，每道解答均经执行验证；提供5万条截图-动作轨迹（其中4.6万条含逐步推理标注）及不规则目标的细粒度像素掩码标注。基于该数据训练单一9B策略CaptchaAgent，采用监督微调后接强化学习，RL奖励直接由环境验证器提供。
AI.result: 监督微调达到70.5 Pass@1，强化学习进一步提升至71.7，同时在两个外部基准上也有性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明大规模、细粒度的计算机使用监督对训练交互式CAPTCHA智能体具有重要价值，数据集与模型已开源。

title: Improving Audiovisual Speech Recognition through Synthetic Visual Data Augmentation
summary: Audiovisual Speech Recognition (AVSR) is a multimodal approach to speech recognition that incorporates visual information from lip movements to enhance model performance. Despite its advantages, its development remains constrained by the limited availability of labeled audiovisual (AV) datasets. This work explores the use of synthetic visual data as a solution, using an audio-driven talking-head pipeline to generate lip-synchronized visual content from existing audio data. We evaluate the effectiveness of synthetic visual data both as an augmentation strategy and as a standalone training resource, applying our approach to Spanish and Catalan. Our results show that augmenting real AV data with synthetic samples yields relative Word Error Rate (WER) reductions of up to 16.2%, demonstrating the potential of this approach. Moreover, we demonstrate that synthetic data alone can serve as a baseline for AVSR training in languages lacking AV datasets. These findings provide evidence that synthetic visual data can serve as a scalable solution to AVSR data scarcity, enabling broader language coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文探索用音频驱动的说话人头部合成视觉数据来缓解视听语音识别（AVSR）的数据稀缺问题，在西班牙语和加泰罗尼亚语上验证其作为数据增强与独立训练资源的效果。
AI.motivation: AVSR借助唇动视觉信息提升语音识别性能，但其发展受限于带标注视听（AV）数据集的稀缺，尤其对缺乏AV数据的语言而言难以开展训练。
AI.method: 采用音频驱动的说话人头部（talking-head）生成管线，从已有音频数据合成唇形同步的视觉内容，并将其分别作为真实AV数据的增强样本和独立训练资源，在西班牙语和加泰罗尼亚语上进行评估。
AI.result: 将合成样本与真实AV数据结合增强后，相对词错误率（WER）最多降低16.2%；仅用合成数据也能为缺乏AV数据集的语言提供AVSR训练的基线。
AI.conclusion: 合成视觉数据可作为应对AVSR数据稀缺的可扩展方案，有助于扩大语言覆盖范围。

title: IndicFDB: Benchmarking Full-Duplex Voice Agents across Indian Languages
summary: Full-duplex voice agents must handle pauses, take turns, backchannel, and respond to user interruptions in real time. Full-Duplex-Bench evaluates these behaviors, but its English-only corpus and reliance on word-timestamped ASR and an English-prompted LLM judge make it difficult to extend to Indian languages. We introduce IndicFDB, which extends it to ten languages spoken in India with 12,350 samples, nearly 17 times as many as the original. We address three challenges: finding conversational events in multilingual speech, evaluating their timing without reliable word-level alignment, and judging responses across languages. We mine pause handling, turn taking, and backchanneling samples from roughly 50,000 hours of channel-separated conversations using voice activity detection (VAD), and construct human-validated synthetic user interruption samples. Language-independent VAD heuristics evaluate timing, while an open-weight transcription and translation pipeline converts responses to English for LLM ratings of relevance and quality. Across seven voice agents, commercial APIs show unexpectedly consistent behavior across languages but are either fast or robust to pauses, never both, while monolingual open full-duplex models expose further tradeoffs among backchanneling, response quality, and latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IndicFDB，将全双工语音智能体评测基准Full-Duplex-Bench扩展到印度十种语言，含12,350个样本（约为原始的17倍），并提出语言无关的评测方法。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音智能体需实时处理停顿、轮次切换、反馈与用户打断，但现有基准Full-Duplex-Bench仅有英语语料，且依赖带词级时间戳的ASR与英语提示的LLM评判，难以扩展到印度语言。
AI.method: 从约50,000小时声道分离对话中，用VAD挖掘停顿处理、轮次切换与反馈样本，并构建经人工验证的合成用户打断样本；采用语言无关的VAD启发式评估时序，并用开放权重转录与翻译流水线将回复转为英语以供LLM评分相关性与质量。
AI.result: 覆盖七种语音智能体：商用API跨语言行为出奇一致，但要么响应快、要么抗停顿，二者不可兼得；单语开放全双工模型则在反馈、回复质量与延迟之间存在进一步权衡。
AI.conclusion: IndicFDB为多语言全双工交互提供了可扩展的评测方案，揭示了现有语音智能体在延迟、抗停顿与回复质量间的固有权衡。

title: Double-Edged Sword of Mediated Visibility: How Visual Framing Undermines Congresswomen's Perceived Competence
comment: 36 pages, 3 figures, plus 25-page online appendix (included). Under review
summary: Women's presence in Congress has stalled below 30%. That institutional underrepresentation is mirrored by their limited visibility on televised news, where visual presentation can shape perceived competence and authority. Yet research tells us more about whether congresswomen appear than how they are visually framed. Facial recognition analysis of 695,464 image-text segments from CNN and Fox News (2011-2021) reveals that congresswomen appear disproportionately in split-screen rather than solo shots. Two pre-registered experiments with 6,220 participants show that, in static frames, split-screen framing reduces congresswomen's perceived political competence, but not congressmen's. In dynamic videos, the competence penalty disappears; instead, outraged language reduces a congresswoman's perceived warmth roughly three times as much as a congressman's. Suggestive evidence (p = .057) indicates that women viewers report greater external political efficacy after watching a congresswoman appear alone. We conclude that visual framing shapes both congresswomen's mediated visibility and their perceived capabilities.

AI.tldr: 通过大规模面部识别分析CNN与Fox News的695,464个图文片段（2011-2021）并结合两项预注册实验（6,220名被试），发现女议员更多出现在分屏而非单人镜头中；分屏画面降低女议员的政治能力评价但不影响男议员，动态视频中该效应消失，但愤怒语言对女议员亲和力的损害约为男议员的三倍。
AI.motivation: 女议员在国会占比长期停滞于30%以下的制度性代表不足，与电视新闻中的视觉可见性不足相互映射。由于视觉呈现能塑造公众对能力与权威的感知，而既有研究多关注女议员是否出镜，较少探讨其"如何被视觉框定"，因此需要考察视觉框定对女议员媒介可见性及能力评价的影响。
AI.method: 1）对CNN与Fox News 2011-2021年间695,464个图像-文本片段进行面部识别分析，比较女议员与男议员在分屏镜头与单人镜头中的出现比例；2）开展两项预注册实验（共6,220名被试），分别测试静态图片中的分屏框定、动态视频中的分屏框定以及愤怒语言对女议员与男议员感知能力与亲和力的影响。
AI.result: 数据表明女议员在分屏镜头中出现的比例显著高于男议员。静态图片中，分屏框定降低女议员的政治能力感知，而对男议员无显著影响；在动态视频中该能力惩罚效应消失，转而表现为愤怒语言使女议员的亲和力下降幅度约为男议员的三倍。此外，存在提示性证据（p = .057）显示女性观众在观看女议员单独出镜后报告更高的外部政治效能感。
AI.conclusion: 视觉框定同时塑造女议员的媒介可见性及其被感知的能力：分屏与语言情绪等视觉/情绪线索对女议员的评价产生不对称影响，且单独特写镜头可能对女性观众的政治效能感具有潜在积极作用。

authors: Ana Paula Wernz da Cunha Müller
title: Extraction of clinical findings from mammography and breast ultrasound reports: a comparison between specialists and Artificial Intelligence
comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to Artificial Intelligence in Medicine
summary: Breast cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related death among women in Brazil, and the time between the request and the release of mammography reports directly influences adherence to screening, making the agility in processing these reports a critical factor for early diagnosis. In this context, this study compares the performance of a Large Language Model (LLM) with manual extraction performed by a team of health researchers in identifying clinical findings from mammography and breast ultrasound reports written in Brazilian Portuguese. Named Entity Recognition (NER) was applied through Prompt Engineering using a few-shot strategy, employing the Gemini 2.5 Flash model, selected from preliminary exploratory tests with four candidate models. The Gemini 2.5 Flash model demonstrated the best performance, achieving a Macro F1 of 0.91 and a Micro F1 of 0.98. The subjective validation, in which 29 exams of different formats were evaluated by health researchers using a Likert scale, yielded an agreement index of 93.1%. The model outperformed human extraction in overall Macro F1 (0.91 vs. 0.72), as in four reports the model correctly identified information that had been omitted or incorrectly recorded during manual extraction, demonstrating its potential as a complementary verification tool alongside specialists. The results confirm the hypothesis that LLMs, when instructed through Prompt Engineering, can achieve performance comparable to or superior to manual extraction by health professionals.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用提示工程（few-shot策略）驱动 Gemini 2.5 Flash 大语言模型，对巴西葡萄牙语乳腺钼靶与超声报告进行命名实体识别（NER），并与健康研究人员的人工提取进行对比，结果显示模型性能优于人工提取。
AI.motivation: 乳腺癌是巴西女性癌症相关死亡的首要原因，报告从申请到发布的时间直接影响筛查依从性，因此快速处理报告对早期诊断至关重要。研究旨在验证 LLM 能否在此类临床文本信息抽取任务中达到或超越人工提取水平。
AI.method: 采用命名实体识别（NER）任务，通过提示工程（Prompt Engineering）结合 few-shot 策略，使用经四个候选模型初步探索性测试后选定的 Gemini 2.5 Flash 模型，从巴西葡萄牙语书写的乳腺钼靶与超声报告中识别临床发现，并与健康研究人员团队的人工提取结果进行对比；同时对 29 份不同格式的检查报告由健康研究人员以李克特量表进行主观验证。
AI.result: Gemini 2.5 Flash 表现最佳，Macro F1 达 0.91、Micro F1 达 0.98；主观验证一致率为 93.1%；模型整体 Macro F1 优于人工提取（0.91 vs. 0.72），并在 4 份报告中正确识别出人工提取时被遗漏或错误记录的信息。
AI.conclusion: 结果证实了假设：经提示工程指导的 LLM 可达到与健康专业人员人工提取相当甚至更优的性能，具备作为专家辅助核查工具的潜力。

title: Toward Embedding-Based Psychometrics: Structural Modeling of Assessment-Item Semantics With Contextual Scores
summary: Contextual scores represent assessment items through their similarities to reference words in an external corpus. We examine the semantic structure of scores for 40 TIMSS mathematics scored units using a partially specified two-step factor procedure. A search across factor counts identifies a persistent seven-group structure under the featured construction. Subsequent comparisons consistently favor a general dimension alongside group associations, although individual group memberships remain sensitive to some specification choices. Item examples distinguish recurring, cross-domain, sensitive, and imposed associations. Simpler and unrestricted references clarify the contribution and limits of the anchored representation: it improves on a single factor but does not achieve the lowest working Bayesian information criterion (BIC). A separate response benchmark compares three initial Q constructions and their Hull-PVAF revisions under higher-order and saturated attribute distributions. Among these diagnostic models, BIC favors the official content framework and the Akaike information criterion (AIC) favors its direct four-factor augmentation, but a matched unidimensional two-parameter logistic model has lower AIC and BIC than all twelve conditions. These findings support a conditional semantic representation while limiting direct diagnostic interpretation. We discuss learned text-assisted response calibration as a prospective application requiring a larger calibrated item bank and independent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该文通过两步因子程序分析40个TIMSS数学评分单元的语境分数语义结构，发现稳定的七组结构及一般维度，并比较多种Q矩阵构造与诊断模型的信息准则表现。
AI.motivation: 语境分数以外部语料中参照词的相似度表征测评题目，但其语义结构及能否用于诊断解释尚不明确，需检验其因子组织与心理测量模型的表现。
AI.method: 对40个TIMSS数学评分单元采用部分指定的两步因子程序，搜索因子数以识别结构；比较一般维度与组关联的模型；用更简单与无限制参照评估锚定表征；并以独立作答基准比较三种初始Q构造及其Hull-PVAF修正，在高阶与饱和属性分布下检验诊断模型。
AI.result: 在所选构造下识别出持续存在的七组结构；比较结果一致支持一般维度加组关联，但个别组成员关系对部分设定选择敏感。锚定表征优于单因子，却未达到最低工作BIC。BIC偏好官方内容框架，AIC偏好其直接四因子扩展，而匹配的单维2PL模型在全部十二种条件下AIC与BIC均更低。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持条件性的语义表征，但限制直接的诊断解释；文本辅助的作答校准作为前瞻应用，需要更大规模校准题库与独立评估。

title: Does Vision-Language Pretraining Granularity Matter? A Controlled Evaluation of Vision-Language Objectives Across Chest X-Ray Interpretation Tasks
summary: Vision-language pretraining objectives differ in the spatial granularity of their supervision, yet the implications of this distribution for chest X-ray interpretation remain underexplored. We present a controlled study that isolates the pretraining objective: holding the encoder and pretraining data fixed, we train nine objectives spanning global and local contrastive learning, captioning, and their combinations, and evaluate across five chest X-ray tasks of increasing spatial granularity. We find that (i) pretraining granularity aligns with task granularity at the extremes, with local objectives leading on abnormality detection and global objectives on classification; (ii) local objectives are surprisingly competitive on global-level generation and question answering tasks; (iii) the merits of captioning and contrastive learning reverse across granularity levels; and (iv) among combinations, mixing captioning and contrastive supervision is strongest on classification and in distribution generation, while pairing two captioning objectives generalizes best on zero-shot report generation. These results show that no single objective is universally optimal, and that the interaction of objective type, granularity, and task governs downstream performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过控制变量实验，系统比较了9种视觉-语言预训练目标在5项空间粒度递增的胸部X光任务上的表现，发现预训练粒度与任务粒度在两端对齐，且不存在普遍最优的预训练目标。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言预训练目标在监督的空间粒度上存在差异，但这种分布对胸部X光影像解读的影响尚未被充分探究。作者希望厘清预训练目标本身（而非编码器或数据）如何影响下游任务表现。
AI.method: 采用控制实验设计，隔离预训练目标变量：固定编码器与预训练数据，训练9种目标（涵盖全局与局部对比学习、描述生成及其组合），并在5项空间粒度递增的胸部X光任务上进行评估。
AI.result: (i) 预训练粒度与任务粒度在两端对齐：局部目标在异常检测上领先，全局目标在分类上领先；(ii) 局部目标在全局级生成与问答任务上出乎意料地具有竞争力；(iii) 描述生成与对比学习的优势随粒度层级发生反转；(iv) 组合中，描述生成+对比监督在分类与分布内生成上最强，而两种描述生成目标配对在零样本报告生成上泛化最佳。
AI.conclusion: 没有单一目标普遍最优；下游性能由目标类型、粒度与任务三者的交互作用共同决定。

title: Communication between Frozen Large Language Models via Prompt Optimization in a Referential Game
summary: We study communication between two frozen large language models from different providers, with different tokenizers, accessed through their API endpoints. The two play a referential game: one sees an object and describes it in a short fixed-length message over a small alphabet; the other must pick that object out of a candidate set. Neither model's weights are updated. Each agent's prompt is rewritten by an isolated prompt optimizer whose reflection model reads that agent's scored interactions. In the positional setting, optimized prompts carry a shared code that generalizes to held-out objects above a measured no-codebook baseline, including when the memory window is removed. In a second setting, independent per-letter blocks no longer fit within the message, although a whole-object place value code does. The base system fails to establish reliable communication: the sender struggles to retain an injective rule, and the receiver has too few confirmed examples in view. A sender collision penalty, retention of successful interactions, and sequential optimization enable successful place value communication in some runs. Outcomes vary across runs and reflection models. In successful runs, the protocol is written into the optimized prompts, where it can be read and audited directly.

AI.tldr: 研究两个来自不同厂商、使用不同分词器、仅通过API访问的冻结大语言模型之间的通信：二者进行指称游戏（referential game），通过提示优化而非权重更新，在特定条件下可建立可泛化的共享编码协议，协议可直接从优化后的提示中读出。
AI.motivation: 探究权重完全冻结、分词器不同、跨厂商API访问的两个大模型能否在无梯度训练的条件下自发建立可靠的通信协议，并检验优化后提示中是否可沉淀出可泛化、可审计的编码规则。
AI.method: 采用指称游戏设定：发送方看到目标物体，用固定长度短消息（小字母表）描述，接收方需从候选集中选出该物体；两模型权重均不更新，由各自独立的提示优化器（其反思模型读取该智能体的打分交互记录）重写提示。设置两种编码条件：位置式（positional）编码与逐字母分块编码，并与无码本基线对比；同时引入发送方碰撞惩罚、保留成功交互及顺序优化等改进。
AI.result: 位置式设定下，优化后的提示携带可迁移到留出物体的共享编码，效果优于实测的无码本基线，且在移除记忆窗口后依然成立。逐字母独立分块在该消息长度内无法容纳，而整体物体的位值编码可行。基础系统无法建立可靠通信：发送方难以维持单射规则，接收方可见的已确认样例过少。加入碰撞惩罚、成功交互保留和顺序优化后，部分运行中实现了成功的位值通信；结果随运行轮次和反思模型而变化。
AI.conclusion: 即便权重冻结、分词器不一致且跨API，提示优化也能让两个模型建立可泛化的通信协议；成功运行中协议被写入优化后的提示文本，因而可被直接读取与审计，但结果对运行条件和反思模型较为敏感。

title: Before the Rollout Ends: Early Terminal Reward Prediction for Long-horizon Coding Agents
summary: Long-horizon coding agents receive verifiable rewards only after completing expensive sequences of tool calls. This increases inference cost, amplifies early wrong hypotheses, and can lead to sparse terminal reward and unstable training. We introduce Contextual Early Reward (CER), which predicts terminal reward through behavioral evidence in a trajectory prefix. CER synthesizes adaptive rubrics specific to the current task and stage through experiences summarized from related historical tasks. In test-time scaling on SWE-bench Verified, CER improves RM@8 over the strongest baseline by 4.2 percentage points (pp) on Nemotron 3 Ultra and 2.0 pp on Qwen 3.6 27B; on Nemotron, it takes only 15.3% tokens to match the best baseline performance. In RL training experiments, CER exceeds full-rollout TMax by 1.9 pp while using 52.7% fewer online policy-and-judge tokens. Together, CER provides an interpretable, efficient, and dense evaluation method for long-horizon coding agents.

AI.tldr: 提出上下文早期奖励（CER）方法，通过轨迹前缀中的行为证据预测终端奖励，为长周期编码智能体提供可解释、高效、密集的评估信号。
AI.motivation: 长周期编码智能体需完成昂贵的工具调用序列后才能获得可验证奖励，导致推理成本高、早期错误假设被放大、终端奖励稀疏且训练不稳定。
AI.method: CER通过从相关历史任务中总结的经验，为当前任务及其所处阶段合成自适应评分标准（rubric），并基于轨迹前缀中的行为证据预测终端奖励。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified测试时扩展中，CER在Nemotron 3 Ultra上使RM@8较最强基线提升4.2个百分点，在Qwen 3.6 27B上提升2.0个百分点；在Nemotron上仅用15.3%的token即可达到最佳基线性能。RL训练实验中，CER在使用少52.7%在线策略与评判token的情况下，超过完整rollout的TMax 1.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CER为长周期编码智能体提供了一种可解释、高效且密集的评估方法。

title: Type-Balanced Federated Learning for Visual Analog Meter Reading
summary: Analog dial meters are widely deployed in industrial applications and utility sites, where environments and meter types vary and inspection data may be sensitive. Currently, automatic meter readers must be individually developed and deployed for each environment and meter type in practice. Deep learning could handle this variability but requires diverse labeled data that are costly to collect and update. In practice, meter images are distributed across independent sites, each with limited labels, while raw images often cannot be pooled because of ownership, governance, or privacy constraints. To address these challenges, we present a federated framework for visual analog meter reading that enables multiple sites to collaboratively train a reading model without sharing their raw images. Our framework consists of a four-stage pipeline: (1) dial localization, (2) thin-structure segmentation trained federatively across clients, (3) polar unwrapping, and (4) tick-counting decoding for final reading. To enable systematic evaluation of this setting, we release MeterFL, a 1,382-image mask-annotated dataset organized into deployment-motivated pseudo-clients derived from visual attributes via deterministic rules, with dHash near-duplicate control between the segmentation train and test splits. We evaluate both segmentation quality and end-to-end reading accuracy. MeterFL is publicly available at https://github.com/weidazhaoooo/Meter-FL.

AI.tldr: 提出联邦式视觉指针表读数框架及 MeterFL 数据集。
AI.motivation: 模拟表广泛部署于工业与公用事业场景，环境与表型多样、巡检数据敏感；现有自动抄表需针对每种环境与表型单独开发部署，深度学习虽可应对变化但依赖昂贵且难以更新的标注数据；实际中图像分散于各独立站点、标签有限，受所有权、治理与隐私约束无法集中原始图像。
AI.method: 提出联邦视觉模拟表读数框架，使多站点在不共享原始图像前提下协同训练读数模型；框架为四阶段流水线：(1) 表盘定位，(2) 跨客户端联邦训练的细结构分割，(3) 极坐标展开，(4) 刻度计数解码得到最终读数；同时发布 MeterFL 数据集（1,382 张带掩码标注图像），按视觉属性经确定性规则划分为部署导向的伪客户端，并在分割训练/测试划分间使用 dHash 近重复控制。
AI.result: 在 MeterFL 上评估分割质量与端到端读数精度；数据集已公开于 https://github.com/weidazhaoooo/Meter-FL。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以联邦学习缓解跨站点数据孤岛与隐私约束，并提供可系统评估该设定（分割与端到端读数）的公开基准数据集 MeterFL，支撑视觉模拟表读数研究。

title: TriO: Tri-Modal Unsupervised Occupancy World Model for Anything Perception
summary: We present TriO, a multi-modal unsupervised world model that predicts 4D occupancy, obstacle segmentation, flow and LiDAR. In contrast to prior work, TriO utilizes three distinct sensor modalities (camera, LiDAR, and RADAR) as both inputs and sources of self-supervision, eliminating the need for additional human annotations. Thanks to its novel supervision, the model is able to segment any occupancy from the drivable surface, overcoming the limitations of existing open-set methods in handling long-tail objects. TriO achieves state-of-the-art results in multiple 3D and 4D tasks, including occupancy, flow, and LiDAR prediction, as well as zero-shot road obstacle segmentation across multiple datasets such as Argoverse 2, and Spotting the Unexpected.

AI.tldr: TriO是一种多模态无监督世界模型，可预测4D占据、障碍物分割、光流和LiDAR，利用相机、LiDAR和RADAR三种模态同时作为输入与自监督来源，无需额外人工标注，在多项3D/4D任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖人工标注，且开放集方法在长尾物体处理上存在局限，难以在无监督条件下完成从可行驶表面到任意占据物的分割与预测。
AI.method: 提出TriO，将相机、LiDAR和RADAR三种传感器模态同时作为输入和自监督信号，设计新型监督方式，实现任意占据物（从可行驶表面起）的分割与多任务联合预测。
AI.result: 在占据、光流、LiDAR预测等多项3D与4D任务上取得SOTA，并在Argoverse 2、Spotting the Unexpected等多个数据集上实现零样本道路障碍物分割。
AI.conclusion: TriO通过多模态自监督消除了人工标注需求，并克服开放集方法在长尾物体上的局限，验证了多模态无监督世界模型在统一感知与预测任务上的有效性。

title: Resolving the Missing Financial Data Crisis: A Generative AI Pipeline for SEC 10-K Extraction
comment: Presented as a Lightning Talk at MIT URTC 2026
summary: SEC 10-K filings contain substantial financial information that is not consistently captured in structured datasets, creating a missing-data problem affecting over 70% of firms and half of total market capitalization. This can disproportionately bias quantitative analysis against smaller firms, which may be excluded due to limited available data. Traditional financial extraction methods such as Regular Expressions (Regex) and BERT, have been widely used. However, they are highly brittle when parsing complex SEC 10-K filings, which leads to data that is existent in the files being lost since these methods do not consider that a data attribute could be located in a different section or a footnote. This study evaluates several Large Language Models (LLMs), including Llama-3 8B, Qwen-2.5 14B, and Llama-3.3 70B, to figure out individual model strengths and weaknesses when extracting specific attributes from SEC 10-K text. The extraction quality was evaluated across four financial variables of varying structural complexity: Cash and Cash Equivalents (tabular), Short-Term Debt (hybrid), Credit Facilities (narrative), and Research and Development (hybrid). Results show that while smaller models like Llama-3 8B experience performance degradation under complex negative prompting, aligning parameter scale with document complexity yields high zero-shot accuracy. Qwen-2.5 14B excels as a tabular specialist with an 83.33% F1 score on Cash, whereas Llama-3.3 70B effectively navigates dense narrative footnotes, achieving a 76.92% F1 score on R&D. This scalable framework addresses critical information gaps in quantitative finance datasets and eliminates missing-data bias through a more thorough analysis of the SEC 10-K files.

AI.tldr: 本文评估 Llama-3 8B、Qwen-2.5 14B、Llama-3.3 70B 等大模型从 SEC 10-K 文本抽取财务属性，发现参数规模与文档复杂度匹配时可实现高零样本准确率，Qwen-2.5 14B 擅长表格类、Llama-3.3 70B 擅长叙述脚注类变量。
AI.motivation: SEC 10-K 中大量财务信息未被结构化数据集一致捕获，造成超 70% 公司和约一半总市值的缺失数据问题，并使定量分析偏向大公司、对小公司不利；传统 Regex 和 BERT 方法在解析复杂 10-K 时过于脆弱，忽略属性可能位于不同章节或脚注，导致本已存在的数据丢失。
AI.method: 评估多个大语言模型（Llama-3 8B、Qwen-2.5 14B、Llama-3.3 70B）从 SEC 10-K 文本中抽取特定属性的表现，分析各模型优劣；针对四种结构复杂度不同的财务变量（货币资金及现金等价物—表格型、短期债务—混合型、信贷额度—叙述型、研发费用—混合型）评测抽取质量，并考察负向提示等条件的影响。
AI.result: 较小的 Llama-3 8B 在复杂负向提示下性能下降；参数规模与文档复杂度匹配时可获得高零样本准确率。Qwen-2.5 14B 作为表格类专家，在 Cash 上达到 83.33% F1；Llama-3.3 70B 能有效处理密集叙述脚注，在 R&D 上达到 76.92% F1。
AI.conclusion: 该可扩展框架弥补了定量金融数据集中的关键信息缺口，通过更全面地分析 SEC 10-K 文件消除缺失数据偏差。

title: Depth Any Seen: Which Surfaces and How Far?
comment: 54 pages, 31 figures, including appendix. Video demo: https://youtu.be/D8TIzhjq-2Y
summary: When several surfaces are visible along a ray, recovering visible 3D structure from one image requires jointly estimating their presence and metric depth. Depth Any Seen represents these surfaces as image-conditioned multi-Bernoulli depth sets, whose components each contribute one depth or remain absent. Its auxiliary-free Exact Multi-Bernoulli objective (ExactMB) learns depth and presence by marginalizing one-to-one assignments to complete, distinct targets. Our analysis shows that matching expected count can leave component-surface assignment unresolved. We extend real and synthetic layered-depth benchmarks to evaluate depth accuracy, recovered support, and overprediction. Compared to depth stacking, ExactMB reduces overprediction by a relative 88.2% on LD-Real and 80.5% on MD-3K while retaining most ordinal accuracy, with comparable conditional metric-depth error on LD-Syn. Further ablation studies show that ordered assignment improves depth-accurate recall and precision over marginalization, whereas the count-regularized configuration achieves higher deeper-rank precision than ordered assignment at lower recall. Our code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出 Depth Any Seen，将多表面深度表示为图像条件下的多伯努利深度集合，并分析 ExactMB 目标中组件-表面分配未解决的问题；在分层深度基准上显著降低过预测。
AI.motivation: 单张图像中沿同一光线可见多个表面时，需要同时估计各表面的存在性与度量深度。现有多伯努利建模虽能表示多深度分量，但仅匹配期望计数可能导致组件与表面的分配未确定，从而产生过预测。
AI.method: 将可见表面建模为图像条件下的多伯努利深度集合，每个分量输出一个深度或保持缺失；采用无需辅助项的 Exact Multi-Bernoulli（ExactMB）目标，通过对完整且互异目标的一对一分配进行边缘化来学习深度与存在性。扩展到真实与合成分层深度基准，评估深度精度、恢复支撑与过预测，并进行消融比较有序分配与计数正则化配置。
AI.result: 相比 depth stacking，ExactMB 在 LD-Real 上过预测相对减少 88.2%，在 MD-3K 上减少 80.5%，同时保留大部分序数精度，在 LD-Syn 上条件度量深度误差相当。消融显示有序分配相比边缘化提升深度准确召回与精度；计数正则化配置在更低召回下获得更高的深层秩精度。
AI.conclusion: 仅匹配期望计数不足以解决组件-表面分配；ExactMB 能有效抑制过预测并保持深度精度，有序分配与计数正则化在召回与深层秩精度间存在权衡。代码将公开。

title: Who Governs Data in the AI Era? A Computational Analysis of the U.S. Privacy Workforce in Job Postings
summary: Privacy protection now spans legal, technical, and managerial duties, and demand for privacy professionals is growing across sectors. However, little is known about how employers define these roles. We analyze 1,143 U.S. privacy job postings from LinkedIn and Indeed. We examine job titles, salaries, competencies, certifications, education, experience, regulatory references, and AI-related language by using rule-based text mining. We also apply Topic Modeling (BERTopic) to the same postings and identify 18 latent themes which we grouped them into four categories. Our findings show that privacy roles are hybrid and they combine legal knowledge, technical skills, and interpersonal competence. Artificial intelligence appears in more than half of postings, with AI language spread across compliance, legal, governance and security themes. Our research indicates that AI governance responsibilities are often embedded within existing privacy roles, contributing to the rise of hybrid positions alongside dedicated AI governance roles.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过规则文本挖掘与BERTopic主题建模分析1,143条美国隐私岗位招聘信息，发现隐私职位呈混合型特征，AI治理职责多嵌入既有隐私角色中。
AI.motivation: 隐私保护已扩展至法律、技术与管理多重职责，市场对隐私专业人才需求上升，但雇主如何界定这些岗位的职责与能力要求尚缺乏系统实证了解。
AI.method: 采集LinkedIn与Indeed上1,143条美国隐私岗位招聘信息；采用基于规则的文本挖掘分析职位名称、薪资、能力要求、认证、学历、经验、法规引用及AI相关表述；并对同一语料应用BERTopic主题建模，识别出18个潜在主题并归纳为四个类别。
AI.result: 隐私岗位呈混合型，融合法律知识、技术技能与人际能力；超过半数招聘信息中出现人工智能相关内容，AI语言分布于合规、法律、治理与安全等主题；AI治理责任常被嵌入既有隐私岗位，与专门的AI治理岗位并存。
AI.conclusion: AI治理职责正被大量整合进隐私职能，推动混合型职位兴起，同时催生专职AI治理岗位，反映出隐私专业角色的边界扩展与能力复合化趋势。

title: ScreenHaystack: Finding Blind Zones in GUI Grounding
summary: We introduce ScreenHaystack, a dynamic needle-in-a-haystack benchmark for evaluating spatial reliability in GUI grounding. Instead of testing each target at a fixed position, ScreenHaystack systematically relocates controlled target icons across high-resolution GUI backgrounds and measures whether models can localize them consistently. Using this benchmark, we find that leading GUI grounding models, including Qwen3-VL, UI-TARS, GTA, and UI-Venus, exhibit blind zones: spatial regions where grounding accuracy drops sharply despite fixed target appearance and instruction. These blind zones transfer to unseen ScreenSpot-Pro examples: targets inside blind zones are consistently harder to ground, with Qwen3-VL-8B dropping by 16.1 percentage points, and controlled relocation shows that moving targets into blind zones decreases accuracy while moving them out improves accuracy. We further show through controlled synthetic experiments that uneven spatial coverage in training data can induce such blind zones. Therefore, we propose a simple strategy, blind-zone-oriented augmentation, which adds supervision in blind zones and improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy over both original and randomly augmented Click-100k fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ScreenHaystack 基准，发现主流 GUI grounding 模型存在由位置引起的"盲区"，并给出盲区导向的数据增强方案。
AI.motivation: 现有 GUI grounding 评测通常将目标固定在特定位置，无法反映模型对目标空间位置的敏感性，可能掩盖模型在部分区域定位能力的系统性缺陷。
AI.method: 构建 ScreenHaystack 动态"大海捞针"基准：在高分辨率 GUI 背景上系统性地移动受控目标图标，测量模型定位的一致性与空间可靠性；在 Qwen3-VL、UI-TARS、GTA、UI-Venus 等模型上评测，并用受控合成实验分析训练数据空间覆盖不均的影响；提出 blind-zone-oriented augmentation 策略，在盲区增加监督。
AI.result: 模型普遍存在"盲区"——目标外观与指令不变时定位精度骤降；盲区可迁移到未见过的 ScreenSpot-Pro 样本，盲区内目标更难定位，Qwen3-VL-8B 下降 16.1 个百分点；受控移动显示移入盲区精度下降、移出则提升；合成实验表明训练数据空间覆盖不均会诱发盲区；所提增强策略在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上优于原始与随机增强的 Click-100k 微调。
AI.conclusion: 当前 GUI grounding 模型的定位能力在空间上不均匀，存在可迁移的盲区，且可通过针对性的数据增强缓解。

title: ControlGS: Conditioning Neural Gaussians for Downstream-Processing-Aware XR Rendering
comment: Accepted to Siggraph Asia'26, 36 pages, poject page: https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/
summary: Extended Reality (XR) users do not directly perceive the output of a rendering engine. Instead, rendered images pass through a post-processing pipeline and the physical display-optics path before reaching the eye. Critically, the exact downstream processing can vary significantly at run time, influenced by, for instance, camera pose and display power budget. Traditional 3DGS methods either implicitly assume that this downstream pipeline preserves image quality or cannot adapt to downstream processing changes. To bridge this gap, we present ControlGS, an XR Gaussian rendering pipeline that optimizes end-to-end visual quality. ControlGS models and integrates the entire downstream processing, between the rendering output and the human eye, into the optimization objective. To adapt to downstream processing at run time, ControlGS dynamically generates Gaussian primitives conditioned upon the downstream processing parameters. Experiments show that ControlGS consistently improves end-to-end post-optics XR quality across different neural Gaussian backbones and datasets, with minimal overhead. Code is available at https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/.

AI.tldr: ControlGS 是一个面向 XR 的端到端高斯渲染管线，将渲染输出到人眼之间的完整下游处理（后处理管线与显示-光学路径）纳入优化目标，并依据下游处理参数动态生成高斯基元，从而在运行时下游处理变化时持续提升端到端成像质量，且开销极小。
AI.motivation: XR 用户看到的并非渲染引擎的直接输出，而是经过后处理管线和物理显示-光学路径后的图像；该下游处理在运行时（如受相机位姿、显示功耗预算影响）会显著变化。传统 3DGS 方法要么隐含假设下游管线保持图像质量，要么无法适应下游处理变化，导致端到端视觉质量与优化目标脱节。
AI.method: ControlGS 将渲染输出到人眼之间的整个下游处理建模并集成进优化目标，实现端到端优化；同时为适应运行时的下游处理变化，以条件化的方式依据下游处理参数动态生成高斯基元（动态生成、条件于下游参数）。
AI.result: 实验表明，在不同神经高斯主干网络与数据集上，ControlGS 均能一致地提升端到端“后光学”（post-optics）XR 质量，且额外开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 将下游处理（后处理与显示-光学路径）纳入高斯渲染的优化闭环并按运行时参数条件化生成基元，是提升 XR 端到端视觉质量的有效途径，且具备良好的通用性与低开销特性。

title: Amnesia by Design, Memory By Necessity: Persistent State for Document Intelligence
summary: Modern Document AI reads contracts, extracts fields, reasons over tables, and grounds answers to page regions, then forgets everything. Processing an amendment the next day begins from scratch: no schema retained, no contradiction detected, no experience carried forward. This is a structural choice, not a scale failure: current systems are stateless functions. We call this the statelessness bottleneck. This bottleneck lies beyond parameter scaling, context extension, and retrieval augmentation: storage provides persistence and retrieval provides access, but neither consolidates observations into knowledge that improves future processing. This survey formalizes persistent evidence-grounded document state as a unifying framework, specifying the operations and invariants required to convert multimodal evidence into durable, provenance-linked state. We introduce a statefulness audit showing that ten representative benchmarks, coded against eight statefulness criteria, leave cross-session state evolution untested, and derive a longitudinal benchmark harness with five counterfactual metrics: Experience Gain, Cost Efficiency, Memory Harm, Forgetting Fidelity, Coverage Retention, to characterize the benefit, cost, risk, and governability of persistent document state. Document AI lacks mechanisms coupling persistent state to document-native structure, provenance, and temporal validity. The next era of Document AI will be defined by what systems retain across documents, sessions, and time.

AI.tldr: 该综述指出当前文档AI本质上是无状态函数，即"无状态瓶颈"，并形式化"持久化、证据落地的文档状态"统一框架，提出状态性审计与包含五项反事实指标的纵向基准工具。
AI.motivation: 现代文档AI能读取合同、抽取字段、推理表格并将答案定位到页面区域，但处理完即遗忘：次日处理修订须从零开始，无模式保留、无矛盾检测、无经验积累。作者强调这是架构性选择而非规模失败——现有系统是无状态函数，该瓶颈无法靠参数扩展、上下文延长或检索增强解决：存储提供持久性、检索提供访问，但二者都不能将观察固化为可改进未来处理的知识。
AI.method: 本文将"持久化、证据落地的文档状态"形式化为统一框架，规定将多模态证据转化为持久、可溯源状态所需的操作与不变量；设计状态性审计，以八项状态性准则对十个代表性基准进行编码评估；并推导出纵向基准工具，提出五项反事实指标：经验增益、成本效率、记忆危害、遗忘保真度、覆盖保持。
AI.result: 审计显示十项代表性基准均未测试跨会话的状态演化；所提出的五项反事实指标可分别刻画持久文档状态的收益、成本、风险与可治理性。
AI.conclusion: 文档AI缺乏将持久状态与文档原生结构、溯源信息及时间有效性相耦合的机制；下一代文档AI将由系统在跨文档、跨会话、跨时间维度上"保留什么"来定义。

title: Quantization Thresholds Replicate, Failure Modes Do Not: A Three-Model Study of Agentic Tool Use in Polish from 8-bit to 2-bit
comment: 34 pages, 1 figure, 21 tables. Code, tasks, trajectories and analysis scripts: https://github.com/JakubPrejzner/polagentbench
summary: We ask how GGUF quantization affects agentic tool use in Polish and whether the effects generalize across models. We introduce PolAgentBench, a deterministic benchmark with Polish prompts and English tool schemas: a 67-task main suite (15 adversarial probes, 52 hard-tier tasks) and a 46-task arithmetic isolation ladder. Three models span two axes of variation: Bielik-11B-v3.0 and its pruned, distilled child Bielik-Minitron-7B-v3.0 isolate model compression, and Llama-PLLuM-8B adds a change of pretraining family. Each is measured at six precisions, Q8_0 to Q2_K. Only the collapse threshold replicates. (1) All three models fall off a cliff between 3-bit and 2-bit (11B 0.716 to 0.045, 7B 0.463 to 0.149, PLLuM 0.224 to 0.015; paired McNemar p < 0.001 in each), across a fourfold capability spread and both axes. (2) Failure modes do not replicate: at 2-bit the 7B fails long (median 9.1k tokens, 4 steps) while the 11B mostly answers at the first step with a confabulated final answer (37 of 64 failures); PLLuM fails on content across precisions (71.8-92.0% of steps parse). (3) On the arithmetic ladder the unscaffolded rung is a floor, left standing by a rerun that states the no-tool rule; four explicit calls lift the 8-bit 11B from 1/10 to 9/10 and the 7B from 0/10 to 7/10 after format-only failures with the gold value are forgiven, an exploratory effect with eight distinct baseline inputs that does not survive multiplicity correction, while the order-trap arm separates the models at 8-bit (11B 6/6, 7B 0/6). (4) The Polish-versus-English gap is associated with degradation or with task family. We document four artifacts that shaped our conclusions (rounding-hostile gold values, strict answer typing, a no-tool rule the prompt never stated, priority-ordered failure labels), report affected results in strict and corrected form, and release the benchmark, trajectories and commit-stamped artifacts.

AI.tldr: 提出波兰语智能体工具使用基准 PolAgentBench，测试 GGUF 量化（Q8_0–Q2_K 六档精度）对三个模型的工具调用影响；发现唯一稳健复现的效应是 3-bit 到 2-bit 之间的能力崩塌，而失败模式与算术阶梯效应不具跨模型泛化性。
AI.motivation: 研究 GGUF 量化如何影响非英语（波兰语）场景下的智能体工具使用能力，并检验该影响能否跨模型泛化——这一方向在低资源语言与量化后 agent 行为的交叉领域尚缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 构建确定性基准 PolAgentBench：波兰语提示 + 英文工具 schema，含 67 任务主套件（15 个对抗探针、52 个 hard 任务）与 46 任务算术隔离阶梯。模型覆盖两条变异轴：Bielik-11B-v3.0 及其剪枝蒸馏子模型 Bielik-Minitron-7B-v3.0（压缩轴），Llama-PLLuM-8B（预训练家族轴）。每模型在六档量化精度（Q8_0 至 Q2_K）下测量，使用配对 McNemar 检验，并记录四条影响结论的伪影（对舍入不友好的金标值、严格答案类型、提示从未声明的无工具规则、优先序失败标签）。
AI.result: (1) 三模型均在 3-bit 与 2-bit 之间出现崩塌（11B 0.716→0.045，7B 0.463→0.149，PLLuM 0.224→0.015，配对 McNemar p<0.001），跨越四倍能力差与两条变异轴，为唯一复现的效应。(2) 失败模式不复现：2-bit 下 7B 长程失败（中位 9.1k token、4 步），11B 多在首步给出虚构终答（64 次失败中 37 次），PLLuM 则跨精度内容失败（71.8–92.0% 步骤可解析）。(3) 算术阶梯中无脚手架档位为下限；显式四次调用将 8-bit 11B 从 1/10 提升至 9/10、7B 从 0/10 提升至 7/10（格式类失败且金标值被原谅），为探索性效应，不通过多重校正；顺序陷阱档在 8-bit 分离模型（11B 6/6，7B 0/6）。(4) 波英差距与退化或任务族相关。
AI.conclusion: 量化对智能体工具使用的影响中，仅"崩塌阈值"可跨模型、跨能力与跨预训练家族复现，失败模式高度依赖具体模型；算术增益为不稳健的探索性结果。研究以严格与修正两种形式报告受影响结果，并发布基准、轨迹与提交戳记工件以支持复现。

title: EngramRAG: Dynamic Usage-Weighted Topology and Synaptic Consolidation for Multi-Hop Agentic Memory
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Code and reproduction suite: https://github.com/bpoti001/epigraph
summary: As autonomous LLM agents are deployed across multi-session environments, conventional memory architectures suffer from Associative Blindness (inability to traverse multi-hop relational dependencies), Scaffolding Amnesia (temporal decay evicting core persona invariants), and Static Topology Stagnation (immutable graphs ignoring usage dynamics). Grounded in Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) principles, we propose EngramRAG, an adaptive memory architecture coupling a low-latency Waking State reflex with an asynchronous background Dreaming State consolidation cycle. EngramRAG introduces: (1) Usage-Modulated Personalized PageRank (U-PPR), where transition probabilities adapt via Hebbian plasticity to promote persistent entities into high-centrality Epistemic Macro-Hubs; (2) Consolidation-Activated Topology Decay (CATD), which scales retention half-life by topological load-bearing weight rather than wall-clock recency, protected by a cold-start grace period (N_grace >= 4); (3) Directed SUPERSEDES DAG filtering to suppress obsolete state during fact mutations; and (4) Triple-source hybrid retrieval fusing dense vectors, BM25, and U-PPR via dynamic Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). Evaluating on all 1,982 QA pairs across 10 long-term conversations in the LoCoMo benchmark, EngramRAG achieves +38.9% relative improvement in Recall@5 (53.21% vs. 38.29%, p < 0.001) and +43.1% in MRR (0.4203 vs. 0.2937) over dense vector RAG, significantly outperforming Okapi BM25 (48.66%) and isolated static graph retrieval (8.50%). On temporal reasoning, EngramRAG reaches 62.33% Recall@5 (+16.67 points over dense vectors). In controlled mutation tests, SUPERSEDES suppresses split-brain hallucinations from 70.0% to 0.0%, while 90-day simulations show 100.0% scaffolding retention under a 26.21ms interactive retrieval reflex.

AI.tldr: EngramRAG：基于互补学习系统原理的自适应记忆架构，通过“清醒反射+异步梦境巩固”双态耦合机制，缓解多会话LLM智能体的联想盲区、脚手架遗忘与静态拓扑停滞问题。
AI.motivation: 多会话自主LLM智能体的传统记忆架构存在三大缺陷：Associative Blindness（无法遍历多跳关系依赖）、Scaffolding Amnesia（时间衰减驱逐核心人格不变量）、Static Topology Stagnation（图结构不可变、忽略使用动态）。
AI.method: 以互补学习系统（CLS）为理论基础，提出双态记忆架构：低延迟“清醒态”反射 + 异步后台“梦境态”巩固。四项核心机制：(1) Usage-Modulated Personalized PageRank（U-PPR），转移概率经Hebbian可塑性自适应，将持久实体提升为高中心性“认知宏枢纽”；(2) Consolidation-Activated Topology Decay（CATD），按拓扑承重权重而非挂钟时间缩放保留半衰期，并设冷启动宽限期（N_grace>=4）；(3) 有向SUPERSEDES DAG过滤，在事实变更时抑制过时状态；(4) 三源混合检索，融合稠密向量、BM25与U-PPR，经动态RRF排序融合。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo基准10段长期对话共1,982个QA对上评测：Recall@5相对稠密向量RAG提升+38.9%（53.21% vs. 38.29%，p<0.001），MRR提升+43.1%（0.4203 vs. 0.2937），显著优于Okapi BM25（48.66%）与孤立静态图检索（8.50%）；时序推理Recall@5达62.33%（较稠密向量+16.67点）。受控变更测试中，SUPERSEDES将分裂脑幻觉从70.0%降至0.0%；90天模拟下脚手架保留率达100.0%，交互式检索反射延迟仅26.21ms。
AI.conclusion: EngramRAG验证了将生物互补学习系统的双态巩固机制引入RAG记忆架构的有效性，在检索精度、时序推理、事实变更一致性与长期稳定性上均显著优于稠密向量、BM25及静态图基线，同时保持低延迟交互。

title: ReFM: Semantic-Aware Refinement Flow Model for Motion Retargeting
summary: Motion retargeting transfers motion across characters with different skeletal structures while preserving semantic intent and physical plausibility. Despite recent progress, two fundamental questions remain: (i) how can reliable source-motion semantics be learned without high-quality paired retargeting data, and (ii) how should retargeting be formulated when no reliable paired motion can serve as a definitive regression objective? Existing methods commonly preserve semantics by constraining predictions toward copied motions. However, such initializations entangle useful articulation cues with artifacts caused by mismatched skeletal proportions and body geometry. Moreover, directly regressing a final motion in one forward pass is restrictive because retargeting is inherently underdetermined, and the desired solution must balance semantic fidelity with target-specific physical and temporal constraints rather than match a unique paired target. Motivated by these limitations, we propose ReFM, a source-mesh-agnostic, energy-guided model that reformulates motion retargeting as progressive refinement. First, an SO(3) canonicalizer removes redundant global-orientation variations. Second, a cross-character semantic encoder, pretrained through contrastive learning, provides a character-invariant representation for both optimization guidance and semantic evaluation. ReFM then progressively refines an initialized target motion through a learned flow guided by semantic consistency, physical plausibility, temporal coherence, and minimal motion modification. The framework is compatible with different initialization strategies, including both direct motion copying and Autodesk HumanIK, an industry-standard full-body inverse-kinematics retargeting system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReFM，将动作重定向重构为渐进式细化问题，通过 SO(3) 规范化、跨角色语义编码器与能量引导的流模型，在无需高质量配对数据的情况下兼顾语义保真与物理可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有动作重定向方法依赖将预测约束向"复制动作"靠拢，但该初始化会将有用的关节运动线索与因骨架比例、身体几何不匹配产生的伪影纠缠在一起；同时，单次前向回归最终动作的做法过于受限，因为重定向本质上是欠定的，理想解需在语义保真与目标角色的物理、时序约束间取得平衡，而非匹配唯一的配对目标。因此作者追问：如何在没有高质量配对数据时学习可靠的源动作语义，以及当缺乏可靠配对动作作为回归目标时应如何形式化重定向问题。
AI.method: ReFM 是一个与源网格无关、能量引导的模型，将重定向表述为渐进式细化：(1) 使用 SO(3) 规范化器去除冗余的全局朝向变化；(2) 通过对比学习预训练跨角色语义编码器，提供角色不变表征，用于优化引导与语义评估；(3) 以语义一致性、物理合理性、时序连贯性和最小动作修改为引导，通过学习到的流逐步细化初始化的目标动作。框架兼容不同初始化策略，包括直接动作复制与工业级全身 IK 系统 Autodesk HumanIK。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，仅说明该框架可兼容直接动作复制与 Autodesk HumanIK 等不同初始化策略，并借助多维能量引导实现渐进细化。
AI.conclusion: ReFM 通过将动作重定向从单步回归转变为能量引导的渐进式细化，缓解了对高质量配对数据的依赖与欠定问题，为跨骨架动作迁移提供了一种兼顾语义保真与物理可行性的新范式。

title: mu-bench: A Multilingual Utterance Transcription Benchmark
comment: 5 pages, 7 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/sierra-research/mu-bench . Code: https://github.com/sierra-research/mu-bench/tree/icassp-2027 . Leaderboard: https://research.sierra.ai/mubench/
summary: Voice agents depend on accurate automatic speech recognition (ASR) to act on what callers say, yet ASR is evaluated on read, English-centric speech with word error rate (WER), which penalizes surface rather than semantic differences. We introduce mu-bench, a dataset of 4,270 caller utterances from 250 phone calls to an AI banking agent in English, Spanish, Turkish, Vietnamese, and Mandarin, centered on form-field inputs such as names, email addresses, and confirmation codes. We release Utterance Error Rate (UER), an LLM judge of whether a transcript preserves meaning, calibrated against human raters, together with an LLM normalizer that makes WER comparable across providers' output formats. On 1,847 human-rated transcripts, UER agrees with annotators at $κ$ = 0.78, versus 0.53 for exact-match WER on normalized text. We rank six commercial providers on a public leaderboard; the best reaches 11.9% UER, and Mandarin is hardest for all six.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 mu-bench 数据集与 Utterance Error Rate (UER) 指标，用语义判断替代传统 WER 评估 ASR 在真实语音代理场景（多语言、表单字段）中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 ASR 评估基于朗读式、以英语为中心的语音，并使用 WER 指标，惩罚的是表面文本差异而非语义差异，无法反映语音代理在实际通话中理解用户意图的真实需求。
AI.method: 构建 mu-bench 数据集，包含 250 通 AI 银行语音代理通话中的 4,270 条来电人语音，覆盖英语、西班牙语、土耳其语、越南语和普通话，聚焦姓名、邮箱、确认码等表单字段输入。发布 UER（Utterance Error Rate），由 LLM 判定转录是否保留语义，并与人工评分者校准；同时提供 LLM 归一化器，使不同厂商输出格式下的 WER 可比较。
AI.result: 在 1,847 条人工评分转录上，UER 与标注者一致率达 κ = 0.78，而归一化文本上的精确匹配 WER 仅为 0.53。基于公开排行榜对六家商业厂商排序，最优者 UER 为 11.9%，普通话对六家厂商均为最难语言。
AI.conclusion: UER 是更符合语义的 ASR 评估指标，能更好反映语音代理场景下的实际可用性；mu-bench 与排行榜为多语言商业 ASR 提供了可比较的基准，并揭示普通话等语言的性能差距。

title: On Evaluating and Improving Conversational Agents in Production
summary: We present a framework for evaluating and improving a large-scale, multi-agent shopping assistant in production, and report lessons from its use. Offline evaluation of such a system faces three obstacles. (i) A logged conversation cannot be replayed against a modified system, because a different response changes every turn that follows. (ii) The unchanged system itself varies from run to run. Its LLM components are stochastic, and in product search the available products, their prices, and the customer's personalization signals change. (iii) Aggregate quality scores combine distinct behaviors, so they show that quality has changed but not which behavior caused the change. Our framework addresses each obstacle in turn. For a reported behavior, an Evaluation Harness generates targeted assertions and a fixed cohort of customer scenarios. It then reproduces the behavior in a local instance of the assistant through grounded user simulation. Instead of replaying the log, the simulator writes new customer turns conditioned on the recorded messages and context. Repeated runs of the unchanged system form a stored baseline. An Improvement Orchestrator turns the assertion results into hypotheses, implements each as an isolated modification, and compares it with the baseline using paired percentile bootstrap intervals over scenario-level differences. When an investigation ends, the harness may propose revisions to future evaluations, subject to human approval and without altering past decisions. We report production investigations with this framework. Assertion profiles showed which positions of a product carousel a failure affected, and repeated runs distinguished a real improvement from run-to-run fluctuation. Audits of the evaluation itself found a judge that lacked the evidence it needed and a model setting that was configured but not applied.

AI.tldr: 提出一套用于生产环境大规模多智能体购物助手评估与改进的框架，依次解决离线评估的三个障碍：无法回放日志、系统自身波动、聚合指标无法定位行为；通过评估装置、固定场景队列、接地用户模拟、存储基线与改进编排器实现，并报告生产实践发现。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中大规模多智能体购物助手的离线评估面临三个障碍：(i) 日志对话无法对修改后的系统回放，因为任一回复变化会改变其后所有轮次；(ii) 未修改系统本身也存在运行间波动，LLM 组件具随机性，且商品搜索结果、价格与个性化信号均会变化；(iii) 聚合质量分数混合了不同行为，只能显示质量变化而无法定位是哪种行为导致变化。
AI.method: 针对每种障碍逐一应对：对某报告行为，Evaluation Harness 生成定向断言与固定客户场景队列，并通过接地用户模拟在本地实例中复现该行为——模拟器基于已记录消息与上下文生成新的客户轮次而非回放日志；对未修改系统重复运行形成存储基线；Improvement Orchestrator 将断言结果转为假设，以隔离修改方式实现，并用场景级差异的配对百分位 bootstrap 区间与基线比较；调查结束时，harness 可提出对未来评估的修订建议，须经人工批准且不改变既往决策。
AI.result: 在生产调查中，断言画像显示了商品轮播中哪些位置受到失败影响；重复运行可将真实改进与运行间波动区分开。对评估本身的审计发现：某评审模型缺乏其所需证据，以及某模型设置被配置却未生效。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过定向断言、接地用户模拟、存储基线、隔离式改进与配对 bootstrap 比较，可在无法回放日志且系统本身波动的生产条件下支撑多智能体购物助手的评估与改进；同时需对评估自身进行审计，以发现证据不足与配置未生效等问题，并允许经人工批准迭代更新未来评估。
